We propose Universal Byte-Level Encoding (UBE), a dual-alphabet tokenizer that keeps 1-2-byte UTF-8 characters on the UTF-8 path while routing 3-4-byte UTF-8 characters through UTF-16. This lowers the encoding floor for 3-byte Basic Multilingual Plane (BMP) characters in scripts with high token premiums (token counts relative to English) without raising it for already-efficient spans in mixed-script text. UBE changes only the byte representation presented to byte-pair encoding (BPE); the merge rule remains standard, and exact decoding is preserved. UBE also composes with alternative boundary policies and morphology-based representations. In a Unicode 17 audit, UBE exactly round-trips all Unicode scalar values and all inputs in the official normalization, grapheme-break, and emoji test suites. Across intrinsic evaluations, UBE lowers dispersion in English-normalized token-count ratios, reducing cross-lingual token-budget disparity. In multilingual language model (LM) experiments, UBE matches BBPE's LM quality. In the main multilingual settings, UBE reduces token counts most for high-premium scripts and slightly lowers English token counts, yielding more usable context under fixed token budgets and faster prompt processing in content-matched benchmarks.

</details>


### [275] [Mem++: Non-Destructive Memory for Long-Term Organizational LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02002)
*Ahmad Yehia,Aly O. Abdelkareem,Islam Ahmed,Hesham Omran,Khaled Alashmouny,Christian Claudel,Abduallah Mohamed*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出Mem++，一种非破坏性记忆框架，将记忆处理从"写入时蒸馏"转为"读取时选择"：写入时完整保存每份文档及其日期与作者、不调用生成模型；读取时仅检索问题所涉时间点之前的文档，并融合词法与语义排序，把版本选择权留给回答模型。在OrgMemBench上较最强基线提升8.0–13.1分，gpt-4.1-mini下总分领先RAG 2.6分，并在LoCoMo上取得最佳平均LLM-judge得分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体参与组织工作时，决策的修订以新文档而非编辑形式出现，因此回答组织类问题需要知道某一时点上生效的是哪个版本。现有记忆系统多在写入时压缩记录，将文档蒸馏为事实、笔记或图边，这等于在提问之前就固定了可回答的问题范围，无法支持对历史版本与时点状态的查询。

Method: Mem++是一种非破坏性记忆框架。写入阶段：完整存储每份文档及其日期与作者，不调用任何生成模型。读取阶段：仅检索日期不晚于问题所询问时点的文档，并融合词法排序与语义排序以完成候选选择；对被覆盖的旧版本不做覆写，而是保留并由回答模型自行判断采用哪个版本。

Result: 在组织类基准OrgMemBench上，Mem++在两种回答模型下均超过最强记忆系统基线8.0至13.1分；使用gpt-4.1-mini时取得最佳总体得分，比RAG高2.6分。在LoCoMo上取得最佳平均LLM-judge分数，在LongMemEval-S上排名第二，仅次于其自身实体图变体。

Conclusion: 将记忆处理由写入时蒸馏改为读取时选择，可在不丢失版本历史的前提下提升时序敏感的组织类问答表现，并跨多个基准取得竞争性或领先的结果；代码与评测已开源。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents now take part in organizational work, where many authors record decisions across documents over months. Because a revised decision arrives as a new document rather than an edit, answering a question requires knowing which version held at a given time. However, most memory systems compress the record at write time. By distilling each document into facts, notes or graph edges, these methods fix what can be answered before any question is asked. To address this, we propose Mem++, a non-destructive memory framework shifting from write-time distillation to read-time selection. Mem++ stores every document whole with its date and author, and it calls no generative model at write time. At read time, it retrieves only documents dated up to the time a question asks about and fuses lexical and semantic rankings. Unlike systems that overwrite older versions, Mem++ keeps them and leaves the choice to the answering model. Evaluations on the organizational benchmark OrgMemBench demonstrate that Mem++ surpasses the strongest memory system baseline by 8.0 to 13.1 points across two answering models. With gpt-4.1-mini, it also achieves the best overall score, 2.6 points above RAG. In addition, Mem++ achieves the best average LLM-judge score on LoCoMo and ranks second on LongMemEval-S, behind only its entity-graph variant. Code for benchmark evaluation is available at https://github.com/AIDAChip-Inc/mem-plus-plus.

</details>


### [276] [Controllable Multi-label Video Safety Detection via Adaptive Tversky Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02019)
*Guangyu Yang,Jingbiao Mei,Mingsheng Sun,Jinghong Chen,Yingtong Bu,Pengda Qin,Da Chen,Bill Byrne*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出ATPO强化学习框架用于多标签视频安全检测，通过自适应Tversky奖励动态调节精确率-召回率权衡，在SafeWatch-Bench上Jaccard指数从40.66提升至75.44。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频社交媒体中不安全内容激增，需要可靠的自动化检测。现有VLM检测系统存在两大缺陷：将安全检测简化为二分类，忽略不安全视频固有的多标签特性；依赖静态训练目标，无法支持可控的精确率-召回率权衡，而不同审核流程和类别对操作点的需求各异。

Method: 提出自适应Tversky策略优化（ATPO），一个面向多标签视频安全检测（Multi-VSD）的强化学习框架。其核心是自适应Tversky奖励（ATR），在训练过程中动态调整假阳性与假阴性惩罚，从而实现可控的精确率-召回率权衡。

Result: 在SafeWatch-Bench与XD-Violence上实验，ATPO显著提升多标签性能，SafeWatch-Bench-Real的Jaccard指数从40.66提升至75.44；ATR能可靠引导精确率-召回率操作点，支持异构策略需求的部署场景。

Conclusion: ATPO通过强化学习与自适应奖励机制，同时解决了多标签建模与精确率-召回率可控性问题，为视频安全审核提供可调、可靠的检测方案。

Abstract: The rapid growth of video-based social media has increased users' exposure to harmful content, creating a need for reliable automated video safety detection. Although recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) show strong video understanding capabilities, existing harmful video detection systems face two key limitations: they typically reduce safety detection to binary classification, overlooking the inherently multi-label nature of unsafe videos, and they rely on static training objectives that do not support controllable precision-recall trade-offs, though the desired operating point may vary across moderation pipelines and unsafe categories. To address these gaps, we propose Adaptive Tversky Policy Optimization (ATPO), a reinforcement learning framework for Multi-label Video Safety Detection (Multi-VSD). ATPO introduces the Adaptive Tversky Reward (ATR), which dynamically adjusts false-positive and false-negative penalties during training to enable controllable precision-recall trade-offs. Experiments on SafeWatch-Bench and XD-Violence show that ATPO substantially improves multi-label performance, increasing the Jaccard Index from 40.66 to 75.44 on SafeWatch-Bench-Real. Moreover, ATR enables reliable steering of the precision-recall operating point, supporting deployment scenarios with heterogeneous policy requirements. Code and checkpoints are provided at https://bruceyg.github.io/ATPO-project-page/ .

</details>


### [277] [Old Ideas, Novel Problems: The Instability of LLM-Based Novelty Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02022)
*Noy Sternlicht,Simra Shahid,Peter Jansen,Daniel S. Weld,Pao Siangliulue,Tom Hope*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该文系统研究了LLM新颖性评判器的可靠性，发现提示设计等微小选择会造成判定的巨大波动，现有自动新颖性评测方法不可靠。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动构思系统常以其产出想法的新颖性作为评价指标，而这一判断越来越依赖大语言模型。然而这类评判器多为临时搭建，且验证时使用人类撰写的论文，而非它们真正要打分的目标（生成的想法），因此其可靠性存疑。作者由此提出核心问题：新颖性评判器表现究竟如何？

Method: 作者开展了一项系统性的受控研究，考察新颖性评测的设计选择。他们自动构建评测集：从OpenReview中挖掘审稿人明确肯定或质疑论文原创性的段落，仅保留在其研究领域极端评价上一致认同的投稿，并将其与普通LLM生成器产生的想法配对。随后在六个评判器上测试不同提示设计、检索增强与推理预算等变量的影响。

Result: 结果显示表现不佳。微小的提示设计变化带来巨大后果：例如仅告知评判器"审稿人认为其中一个想法新颖而另一个不新颖"，就会使其在同一想法对的判定上改变超过一半，成对准确率波动超过50个百分点，有时甚至低于随机水平；同样的改动对一个评判器有益、对另一个却有害。检索增强与更大的推理预算帮助甚微，两个专门构建的新颖性评估器还不如最廉价的提示式基线。

Conclusion: 这些结果对自动构思系统所报告的新颖性提升提出了质疑，并呼吁建立更稳健的新颖性评测方法。

Abstract: Automated ideation systems are often evaluated on the novelty of the ideas they produce, and that judgment is increasingly delegated to large language models. Such judges are typically built ad hoc and validated, if at all, on human-authored papers rather than on the generated ideas they are meant to score. So, how do novelty judges perform?
  Not well. We present a systematic controlled study of novelty evaluation design choices. We first build an evaluation set automatically, mining OpenReview for passages where reviewers explicitly affirm or dispute a paper's originality and keeping only submissions with unanimous agreement at the extremes of their research area; we pair these with ideas from a vanilla LLM generator. Across six judges, we find that small prompt design choices have large consequences; e.g., simply telling the judge that reviewers found one idea novel and the other not can change its verdict on more than half of the identical idea pairs it is shown, shifting pairwise accuracy by over 50 points and occasionally pushing it below chance. The same change helps one judge and hurts another. Retrieval and larger reasoning budgets help little, and two purpose-built novelty evaluators are outperformed by our cheapest prompted baseline. These results raise questions about reported novelty gains of automated ideation systems, and call for robust novelty evaluation methods.

</details>


### [278] [Typological Alignment of Stack-Based Language Models on Mildly Context-Sensitive Artificial Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02040)
*Nadine El-Naggar,Tatsuki Kuribayashi,Ted Briscoe*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文从数据与模型两侧扩展了语言模型学习偏置与类型学共性关系的分析，聚焦交叉序列依存（cross-serial dependencies）与基于栈的语言模型（SLMs），发现SLMs难以泛化此类结构，但工作记忆受限的SLMs泛化更好，暗示归纳偏置的可能基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然语言中某些属性（如SOV语序）在数千种语言中更为普遍，通常被归因于学习偏置。已有计算模拟（尤其是语言模型）为验证该理论提供了工具，但现有分析在句法复杂度上限（交叉序列依存）和具备层级学习能力的栈式语言模型方面仍有待扩展。

Method: 在数据侧，选取交叉序列依存这一已证实句法复杂度的上限作为研究对象；在模型侧，采用基于栈的语言模型（SLMs）以促进层级模式学习。构建多样化人工语言，评估SLMs在交叉序列依存上的泛化能力，并进一步分析工作记忆容量限制对泛化表现的影响。

Result: SLMs在多样化人工语言的交叉序列依存结构上表现不佳，泛化能力有限；然而，当SLMs具备有限的工作记忆时，其泛化表现反而更好。

Conclusion: 工作记忆受限的SLMs泛化更优，提示这种受限机制可能是相关归纳偏置的基础，进而可解释某些语序配置在自然语言中的类型学共性。

Abstract: Some properties of languages, e.g., subject-object-verb (SOV) word order, are more prevalent than others among the thousands of attested natural languages (NLs). Such typological commonality is often attributed to learning biases. Computational simulations, recently with language models (LMs), have facilitated the exploration of this theory. In this paper, we extend existing analyses of the relationship between LMs' learning biases and typological commonality on both data and model sides, focusing on: (i) cross-serial dependencies, the upper limit of attested syntactic complexity, and (ii) stack-based LMs (SLMs), potentially facilitating learning of hierarchical patterns. We first evaluate generalization of SLMs on cross-serial dependencies across diverse artificial languages and confirm that they struggle with such constructions. However, SLMs with limited working memory generalize better suggesting a possible basis for such inductive bias and thus the typological commonality of some word order configurations.

</details>


### [279] [LLM2Jev: LLMs Are Already Jev-Style Decision Models -- When and How to Fine-Tune Them](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02076)
*Yinheng Li,Justin Wagle*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出LLM2Jev框架，从LLM下一token概率中直接抽取分类决策，并给出免训练推理配方与树因子化listwise微调目标；实验表明现代LLM本身即为有效决策模型，微调收益具有针对性而非普遍性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Jev风格决策模型输出预定义选项的分类概率分布而非自由文本，便于软件系统直接消费其输出。作者希望探究通用LLM是否已开箱具备该能力，以及何时才真正需要微调。

Method: LLM2Jev采用保持原架构的框架，从带括号数字标识符上的下一token概率直接抽取校准决策。提供两部分：(1)免训练推理配方；(2)微调目标，通过树因子化(listwise)损失优化候选选择，并用KL散度惩罚将辅助预测锚定到基础模型。实验在Qwen3.5-4B与Qwen3-0.6B上进行，涉及LoRA等设置。

Result: 现代LLM本身即是有效决策模型：4B模型无需训练即可匹敌同骨干的社区Jev风格模型，优于letter-logit读出，支持任意选项数，并原生处理图像上的多模态决策。微调带来的是针对性而非普适收益——显著提升较弱模型与特定任务（如多选项意图路由），但对强骨干收益递减。KL锚定可防止对话文本生成的行为退化，LoRA在强模型上表现最佳。

Conclusion: 通用LLM已具备开箱的分类决策能力，微调并非总是必需；KL锚定是避免生成能力退化的关键，LoRA适合能力较强的基础模型。该框架在架构不变的前提下实现了校准决策抽取。

Abstract: Jev-style decision models return categorical probability distributions over predefined options without generating free-form text, enabling software systems to act on their outputs directly. In this work, we investigate the extent to which general-purpose LLMs already possess this capability out of the box, and when fine-tuning is actually necessary. We present LLM2Jev, an architecture-preserving framework that extracts calibrated decisions directly from next-token probabilities over bracketed numeric identifiers. LLM2Jev provides both a training-free inference recipe and a fine-tuning objective that optimizes candidate selection via a tree-factorized listwise loss while anchoring auxiliary predictions to the base model using KL divergence penalties. Evaluating on Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3-0.6B, we find that modern LLMs are inherently effective decision models: without training, the 4B model matches community Jev-style models built on the same backbone, outperforms letter-logit readouts, supports arbitrary option counts, and natively handles multimodal decisions over images. Fine-tuning provides targeted rather than universal benefits -- substantially improving weaker models and specific tasks (such as many-option intent routing), but offering diminishing returns for strong backbones. Crucially, our KL anchors prevent behavioral degradation in conversational text generation, with LoRA delivering the strongest performance on capable models.

</details>


### [280] [Scalable, Transferable Meta-network for Data Selection Requires a Different Loss (and Why the Obvious Choice is Problematic)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02092)
*Zilin Du,Bowen Yang,Boyang Albert Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出TESS，一个基于逐点价值匹配（PVM）目标的可扩展数据选择框架，用于解决元学习训练数据选择中细粒度估值与迁移性之间的权衡问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在大规模、异构语料上训练大语言模型时，数据选择至关重要。元学习式训练数据选择（MTS）相比启发式打分更有原则，通过从目标验证目标中学习数据权重来实现，但现有方法面临细粒度估值与对未见数据可迁移性之间的权衡。自然思路是用选择网络替代逐样本权重，但直接将该网络纳入现有MTS目标会导致权重抑制和对易学特征的持续依赖，从而造成优化不稳定和泛化差。

Method: 提出TESS（Transferable Example Scoring and Selection），一个可扩展的数据选择框架，构建在逐点价值匹配目标（Pointwise Value Matching, PVM）之上，以缓解权重抑制和易学特征依赖问题。

Result: 在LLM安全性和定向指令微调任务上的实验表明，TESS在多个维度上具有很强的迁移能力：从子集到全语料、从较小模型到较大模型。

Conclusion: TESS通过PVM目标实现了可扩展且可迁移的数据选择，验证了其在真实LLM训练场景（安全性与指令微调）中的有效性。

Abstract: Data selection is critical for training large language models on massive and heterogeneous corpora. Meta-learning for Training-data Selection offers a principled alternative to heuristic scoring by learning data weights from a target validation objective, but existing methods face a trade-off between fine-grained valuation and transferability to unseen data. A natural solution is to replace per-sample weights with a selection network. However, we find that directly incorporating such a network into existing MTS objectives leads to unstable optimization and poor generalization, caused by weight suppression and persistent reliance on easy-to-learn features. To address these issues, we propose Transferable Example Scoring and Selection (TESS), a scalable data-selection framework built on a Pointwise Value Matching objective (PVM). Experiments on LLM safety and targeted instruction tuning demonstrate strong transfer across datasets, from subsets to full corpora, and from smaller to larger models.

</details>


### [281] [Argo-Bench: Evaluating Data Agents on Enterprise-Scale Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02122)
*Gabriel Tomitsuka,Arman Raayatsanati,Emma Xing,Duke Gand,Joseph J Ma*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Argo-Bench 是一个面向企业数据科学与分析工作流的评测框架，包含210个任务，基于模拟的纽约市外卖平台（8100万订单、235张表、75亿行）构建，要求智能体在数据仓库中重建事实并执行动作，以模拟器后果评分。最强模型仅34.8%任务达95分以上，平均59.5分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实企业数据科学与分析工作流需要跨数十张表推理、执行统计分析并基于结果采取行动。现有 text-to-SQL 基准仅评估查询生成，且其答案常被审计发现错误。由于真实企业数仓过于敏感无法公开，现有基准多基于单表单事件的公开数据集，无法反映真实规模与复杂性。因此需要一个能评估智能体理解、导航并作用于真实数据环境的基准。

Method: 提出 Argo-Bench 评测框架，含210个数据科学与分析任务。基于公开数据、同行评审的行业文献与监管文件，模拟纽约市外卖平台，规模达2024年8100万订单，并引入真实经济、欺诈模式与市场激励。将该世界导出为仿照 Oracle E-Business Suite 模式的 ERP 数据仓库，共235张表、75亿行。模拟器的真实状态对智能体所见仓库隐藏，任务需先导航仓库重建事实再行动。任务超越 text-to-SQL：智能体执行封禁欺诈账户、分配骑手激励预算、发放补发工资等动作，评分器依据模拟器中的后果打分。每个任务都有可执行参考解，证明仅用仓库即可求解。

Result: 在14个前沿与开源权重模型中，最强模型仅在34.8%的任务上达到95分或以上，平均得分59.5分。

Conclusion: Argo-Bench 超越了传统 text-to-SQL 评测，强调在企业级数据环境中的事实重建与行动后果评估。作者希望该基准推动智能体理解、导航并作用于真实数据环境的研究进展。

Abstract: Real-world enterprise data science and analytics workflows require reasoning across dozens of tables, performing statistical analyses, and acting on the results. Established text-to-SQL benchmarks evaluate query generation alone, and audits have found their answer keys frequently wrong. Because real enterprise warehouses are too sensitive to release, these benchmarks are built on public datasets where a business event fits in a single table. We introduce Argo-Bench, an evaluation framework comprising 210 data science and analytics tasks. Drawing on public data, peer-reviewed industry literature, and regulatory filings, we simulate a food delivery platform in New York City at true scale, with 81 million orders in 2024, grounded economics, fraud patterns, and marketplace incentives. We export this world to an ERP warehouse of 235 tables and 7.5 billion rows, modeled on the Oracle E-Business Suite schema. The simulator's ground-truth state is withheld from the warehouse the agent sees, so tasks require reconstructing facts by navigating the warehouse before acting on them. Argo-Bench goes beyond text-to-SQL: the agent files actions such as banning fraudulent accounts, allocating courier incentive budgets, or issuing back pay, and the grader scores each by its consequences in the simulator. Every task has an executable reference solution that demonstrates solvability using only the warehouse. The strongest of 14 frontier and open-weight models scores 95 or higher on only 34.8% of tasks and averages 59.5 points. We hope Argo-Bench drives progress toward agents that understand, navigate, and act within real data environments.

</details>


### [282] [Keyword Harnesses Fail Open: A Cheap Diagnostic Ladder for Tool-Use Claims in Small Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02142)
*Juan S. Santillana*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 关键词匹配式工具使用评测会给"从未真正执行工具调用"的小模型错误加分。作者在西班牙语安全领域的同架构模型对(661.6M与1,109M)上记录了该假阳性:两者在宽松指标上几乎同分(B4:0.660 vs. 0.650),但逐字复现检查显示600M在6/6样例上生成合法工具调用,1B为0/6。首个token探针将1B的失败定位为<|tool_call|>先验缺失(概率10^-4~10^-5),该先验被其网页为主的多阶段训练抹除。一条低成本定向SFT配方(2,202步、约3.3 GPU小时)以少三个数量级的token修复1B:语料内合法生成率0.100→0.959,未见提示上0.536优于600M的0.428(p=0.004)。嵌入漂移检查显示修复未改变触发token的绑定嵌入,变化发生在周边网络。作者据此提出一套分钟级CPU的严格诊断阶梯,用于把关小模型的工具使用声明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前工具使用评测多依赖关键词匹配,可能把"从不真正执行工具调用"的小模型判为具备工具使用能力,产生假阳性。作者需要:(1)用匹配架构的模型对实证这一假阳性确实存在;(2)提供一套廉价、严格、可快速执行的诊断方法,以在宣称小模型具备工具使用能力前进行把关。

Method: 1) 选一对共享解码器、分词器与特殊token的西班牙语安全模型:661.6M(约65%代码/技术文本,无专用SFT)与1,109M(网页为主的多阶段课程+6B token工具SFT)。2) 对比宽松工具使用指标与逐字复现检查(6个训练样例)。3) 用首token探针定位1B失败原因。4) 设计定向SFT修复配方(多样语料、5倍学习率、2,202步、约3.3 GPU小时)。5) 在全部269条语料行与238条未见提示上评测,并做嵌入漂移检查与因子分析。

Result: 宽松指标:B4 0.660(600M) vs. 0.650(1B)。逐字复现:600M在6/6样例生成合法工具调用且参数泛化,1B在0/6(跨checkpoint)。首token探针:<|tool_call|>概率仅10^-4~10^-5,先验被网页为主阶段抹除。修复后,269条语料上1B合法生成率0.100→0.959(600M:0.926);238条未见提示上1B 0.536 vs. 600M 0.428(p=0.004)。嵌入漂移:触发token绑定嵌入未变,bf16表中97.7%保持逐位相同。两模型均过度触发(负向提示不调用率:600M 0.09,修复后1B 0.17)。因子分析显示各修复配置都能装上格式,但多样语料对抑制的收益受seed敏感性影响,仍属假设。

Conclusion: 关键词匹配指标会掩盖小模型工具调用能力的缺失,同架构模型对中1B在宽松指标上"看起来合格"实为假阳性。作者提出的诊断阶梯(逐字复现、首token探针、嵌入漂移、因子分析)成本仅数分钟CPU,能有效区分真实能力与指标幻觉;并证明可用远少于失败阶段的token量(约三个数量级更少)通过定向SFT修复该能力。建议在宣称小模型具备工具使用能力前,以此阶梯进行把关。

Abstract: Keyword-matching benchmarks can credit small models for tool use they never perform. We document such a false positive in a matched-architecture pair of Spanish security language models and propose a ladder of strict, cheap diagnostics. A 661.6M parameter model (approx. 65% code/technical text; no dedicated SFT) and a 1,109M model (web-heavy multi-phase curriculum; 6B-token tool-SFT) share decoder, tokenizer, and special tokens, scoring almost identically on lenient tool-use metrics (B4: 0.660 vs. 0.650).
  Verbatim-reproduction checks on training examples separate them completely: the 600M emits valid tool calls with generalized arguments on 6/6 examples; the 1B does so on 0/6 across checkpoints. A first-token probe localizes the 1B's failure to a missing prior (prob. $10^{-4}$--$10^{-5}$ on <|tool_call|>), which was erased by its web-heavy training phase. A targeted SFT recipe (diverse corpus, 5x higher learning rate, 2,202 steps, ~3.3 GPU-hours) repairs the 1B using three orders of magnitude fewer tokens than the failed phase. On all 269 corpus rows, valid emission rises from 0.100 to 0.959 (600M: 0.926). On 238 unseen prompts, the repaired 1B passes 0.536 vs. the 600M's 0.428 ($p = 0.004$). Embedding-drift checks show the repair did not move the trigger token's tied embedding (97.7% of the bf16 table remains bit-identical), meaning changes live in the surrounding network.
  Both models over-trigger, rarely answering negative prompts without a call (0.09 for 600M, 0.17 for repaired 1B). Factorial analyses confirm all repair configurations install the format, though suppression benefits from a diverse corpus remain a hypothesis due to seed sensitivity. This cheap diagnostic ladder costs minutes of CPU time and should gate tool-use claims on small models.

</details>


### [283] [From Knowledge Access to Source Learning: Developing Source-Specific Competence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02150)
*Lucheng Fu,Kejing Xia,Yiyang Wang,Yiqiao Jin,Jinjin He,Xiyuan Yang,Haoxin Liu,Ye Yu,Haibo Jin,Yijia Xiao,Wenke Lee,B. Aditya Prakash,Haohan Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出"源学习"(source learning)问题:针对持久性权威信息源,构建可持续演进、可复用的源专属能力,并用持久化"源模型"表征该能力。方法SourceLearn结合自导向源学习与任务引导源学习两种机制,在5个基准、3个LLM后端上15个设置中13个取得最优,较Hybrid RAG最高提升22.6分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体在解决连续的知识密集型任务时,越来越依赖持久的外部信息源。现有工作分别聚焦于源内容的访问与组织方式改进,以及智能体记忆系统对既往交互中可复用知识的保存,但对同一信息源的重复使用仍被视为"重复访问",而非渐进式深化对该源理解的机会。因此论文提出并研究"源学习",即在持久权威源上形成可复用的源专属能力。

Method: 以持久化"源模型"表征源专属能力,刻画对信息源知识"如何组织、如何解释、如何应用"的可复用理解。提出SourceLearn,融合两种互补学习机制:自导向源学习(Self-Directed Source Learning)识别尚未完全理解的内容并自适应回访源;任务引导源学习(Task-Guided Source Learning)利用下游任务经验揭示局部表征缺口及源知识组织方式的反复性需求。两者均由学习信号决定"应重新审视什么",而持久化更新则从权威源重建,以保证忠实性。

Result: 在5个基准、3个LLM后端共15个设置中,SourceLearn在13个设置上取得最佳性能,相较Hybrid RAG提升最高达22.6分,并在整体上显著优于静态源表征与基于经验的记忆基线。

Conclusion: 将持久信息源的重复使用从"重复访问"重构为渐进式"源学习",可构建并持续精炼源模型,从而带来可复用的源专属能力,并在多基准、多后端下稳定优于现有RAG与记忆类方法。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on persistent external sources to solve sequences of knowledge-intensive tasks. Existing methods improve how source content is accessed and organized, while agent-memory systems preserve reusable knowledge from prior interactions, but repeated use of the same source is still largely treated as repeated access rather than an opportunity to progressively improve understanding of that source. We study source learning: developing reusable source-specific competence over a persistent authoritative source. We represent this competence with a persistent source model that captures reusable understanding of the source, including how its knowledge is structured, interpreted, and applied. To construct and progressively refine such models, we propose SourceLearn, which combines two complementary learning mechanisms. Self-Directed Source Learning identifies what remains incompletely understood and adaptively revisits the source, while Task-Guided Source Learning uses downstream experience to reveal local representational gaps and recurring needs in how source knowledge should be organized. In both cases, learning signals determine what should be reconsidered, while persistent updates are reconstructed from the authoritative source. Across five benchmarks and three LLM backends, SourceLearn achieves the best performance in 13 of 15 settings, with gains of up to 22.6 points over Hybrid RAG and substantial overall improvements over static source representations and experience-based memory baselines.

</details>


### [284] [AutoCompact: Learning When to Compact Context in Long-Horizon Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02163)
*Xuan Zhang,Longtao Zheng,Cunxiao Du,Bo An,Xin Dong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: AutoCompact训练编码智能体将上下文压缩决策（何时压缩、保留何状态、如何续接）纳入策略，通过裁判纠错生成轨迹进行SFT与RL联合优化，在SWE-bench Verified和SWE-PolyBench Verified上分别提升9.2%和5.0%的通过率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体处理仓库级任务时轨迹长，早期探索会过时，因此上下文管理不只是防止溢出，还需决策压缩时机、保留的工作状态及续接方式。现有方法缺乏将此类决策内化为策略的学习机制。

Method: 让基座智能体执行编码任务，用裁判审查其压缩决策、摘要及压缩后动作；将有缺陷的输出替换为纠正版本后再在环境中执行，使轨迹从纠正后的决策继续。利用这些轨迹进行监督微调，再通过带任务成功奖励的强化学习联合优化编码与压缩能力。

Result: 在SWE-bench Verified和SWE-PolyBench Verified上，相对基座模型通过率绝对提升9.2%和5.0%；提升在所有评估推理预算下均保持，在256K上下文窗口下永不溢出，在16K窗口下溢出触发回退压缩亦有效。

Conclusion: 将上下文压缩决策学习为策略的组成部分，可有效提升长轨迹仓库级编码任务的性能，并在不同上下文窗口与推理预算下具备鲁棒性。

Abstract: Coding agents solve repository-level software engineering tasks through long trajectories of code inspection, search, editing, and testing. As a task progresses, earlier exploration becomes stale, so managing context is more than avoiding overflow: an agent must decide when to compact, what working state to preserve, and how to continue from it. We introduce AutoCompact, which trains a coding agent to make these decisions as part of its policy. To collect training data, we run the base agent on coding tasks and use a judge to review its compaction decisions, summaries, and actions after compaction. Flawed outputs are replaced with corrected ones before being executed in the environment, so each trajectory continues from the corrected decisions. We use these trajectories for supervised fine-tuning, then jointly optimize coding and compaction through reinforcement learning with task-success rewards. Experiments on SWE-bench Verified and SWE-PolyBench Verified show that AutoCompact improves pass rates over the base model by an absolute 9.2\% and 5.0\%, respectively. The improvements hold across all evaluated inference budgets, with a 256K context window that never overflows and with a 16K window whose overflow triggers fallback compaction.

</details>


### [285] [Hierarchical Continuous Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02193)
*Hui Ren,Zihan Li,Chang Liu,Huidong Liu,Alexander Schwing*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出HC-DLM，将离散token生成与连续隐轨迹耦合于统一去噪过程，使隐状态成为唯一持久生成状态，在Sudoku、Countdown和LM1B上超越离散与连续扩散基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散扩散语言模型并行解码时各token从边缘分布独立采样，破坏了同批token间的统计依赖；连续扩散语言模型虽用共享连续状态去噪，但去噪器仅见该状态，在最终解码前与合法token配置无约束。两类方法均存在结构性瓶颈。

Method: 提出分层连续扩散语言模型（HC-DLM）：在单一、有原则的去噪过程中耦合离散token生成与连续隐轨迹，训练目标由token似然的变分下界导出；与将连续上下文附加到自足离散链的近期方法不同，HC-DLM以隐状态为唯一持久生成状态，每步从中读出token，并反馈作为下一步隐更新的脚手架。

Result: 在结构化推理（Sudoku）、数学规划（Countdown）和语言建模（LM1B）上，相同模型规模下HC-DLM优于离散与连续扩散基线：Sudoku与Countdown的谜题准确率提升，LM1B的生成困惑度改善。

Conclusion: 通过让连续隐轨迹成为唯一持久生成状态并每步读出token反馈为脚手架，HC-DLM以变分下界为训练目标，有效缓解离散并行解码的独立性瓶颈与连续扩散的token无效性，在推理、规划与语言建模任务上取得一致增益。

Abstract: Discrete diffusion language models offer a compelling alternative to autoregressive generation for tasks demanding bidirectional reasoning and global constraint satisfaction. Yet they share a structural bottleneck: when decoding in parallel, each token is sampled independently from its marginal, severing the statistical dependencies among the tokens decoded together. Continuous diffusion language models avoid this by denoising a shared continuous state, but their denoiser sees only that state, so nothing ties it to a valid token configuration until it is finally decoded. To address this, we propose Hierarchical Continuous Diffusion Language Models (HC-DLM), which couple discrete token generation with a continuous latent trajectory in a single, principled denoising process, whose training objective is derived from a variational bound on the token likelihood. In contrast to recent methods that attach continuous context to a self-contained discrete chain, HC-DLM makes the latent the only persistent generative state: tokens are read out from it at every step and feed back as a scaffold for the next latent update. On structured reasoning (Sudoku), mathematical planning (Countdown) and language modeling (LM1B), HC-DLM improves over discrete and continuous diffusion baselines at matched model size, in puzzle accuracy on Sudoku and Countdown and in generative perplexity on LM1B. Project page: https://hc-dlm.github.io/.

</details>

### [286] [Safety in Self-Evolving Agents: A Survey](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00093)
*Jiahao Chen,Zhou Feng,Oubo Ma,Yichen Yan,Ruixiao Lin,Hangtao Zhang,Linkang Du,Hengyu An,Yong Yang,Jun Liu,Junhao Li,Naen Xu,Chunyi Zhou,Yuan Su,Zehao Jin,Qianli Ma,Leyi Qi,Yiming Wang,Zhe Ma,Yuwen Pu,Mengyao Du,Yuanyi Song,Enhao Huang,Zhihui Fu,Jun Wang,Jinfeng Li,Yuefeng Chen,Hui Xue,Yiming Li,Tianyu Du,Shouling Ji*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该文提出以“转变（transition）”为中心的自演化智能体安全框架SAVER（Substrate–Adaptation–Violation–Exposure–Response），指出安全风险不再主要来自有害信息本身，而源于合法可复用状态在累积、泛化与跨情境复用中扩大其持久性、权限或作用范围；主张开展纵向评估以追溯不安全影响的来源转变、验证后代状态修复并检验其在持续演化下的再涌现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM参数在部署后通常固定，难以从新交互中持续学习，因此催生了能够持续更新可复用状态（模型参数、记忆、工具定义、技能、工作流）的自演化智能体。这一转变改变了安全问题的性质：当经验成为可复用状态，过去事件会成为未来的因果来源，原本在特定情境下无害的信息可能因持久性、权限或作用范围的扩大而在后续决策中产生更大影响。因此需要新的安全分析视角，回答安全属性能否在经验的累积、泛化与跨情境复用中得以保持。

Method: 提出SAVER框架，以“转变”为核心组织安全分析：Substrate（定位可复用影响的载体）、Adaptation（刻画其如何变化）、Violation（识别被破坏的安全属性）、Exposure（标记失效何时可被观测）、Response（评估遏制、修复或撤销）。据此对现有研究进行系统综述，将证据按准入、检索、激活、暴露与局部遏制等环节归类，识别研究空白。

Result: 综述发现：失效并不必然源于有害信息，合法状态在适应过程中超出其有效性条件而扩大持久性、权限或作用范围时即可变得不安全。现有工作在准入、检索、激活、暴露和局部遏制方面证据相对充分，但在适应继续推进后的“后代修复”与评估方面证据明显不足。

Conclusion: 主张采用纵向评估范式：将不安全影响追溯至其起源转变，跨后代状态验证修复效果，并检验其在持续演化条件下是否可能再次涌现。这一视角将自演化智能体安全从单点响应/动作授权检查，扩展为对可复用状态全生命周期的安全属性保持性评估。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong general capabilities, yet their parameters typically remain fixed after deployment, limiting learning from new interactions. In open-ended environments, this motivates self-evolving agents that continually update reusable state-including model parameters, memories, tool definitions, skills, and workflows-from data, feedback, and accumulated experience. This shift changes the safety problem: once experience becomes reusable state, past events become future causes, and information harmless in one context may later influence decisions with greater persistence, authority, or scope. Self-evolving agent safety therefore asks not only whether a response is aligned or an action authorized, but whether safety properties survive the accumulation, generalization, and cross-context reuse of locally useful experience. We introduce SAVER, a transition-centered framework in which Substrate locates reusable influence, Adaptation captures how it changes, Violation identifies compromised safety attributes, Exposure marks where failures become observable, and Response assesses containment, repair, or revocation. Our survey reveals that failures need not originate from harmful information: legitimate state can become unsafe when adaptation expands its persistence, authority, or scope beyond the conditions under which it was valid. Existing work provides comparatively strong evidence for admission, retrieval, activation, exposure, and local containment, but much less for descendant repair and evaluation after adaptation resumes. We therefore argue for longitudinal evaluation that traces unsafe influence to its originating transition, verifies repair across descendants, and tests whether it can re-emerge under continued evolution.

</details>


### [287] [Characterizing and Codifying Malware Sophistication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00098)
*Angelo Porcella,Zachary Wadhams,Clemente Izurieta,Jonathan Crussell,Ann Marie Reinhold*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文对现有基于静态二进制分析的恶意软件质量评估方法进行系统化梳理，借助ISO/IEC 25010软件质量标准重新定义恶意软件"复杂性（sophistication）"，并筛选出可通过静态分析度量的相关特性，为在无源码或无法动态执行场景下一致评估恶意软件复杂性奠定基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: "Sophisticated"虽被广泛用于描述恶意软件，但学术文献中缺乏统一定义；现有软件质量与复杂性度量虽能反映部分结构信息，却无法刻画影响真实威胁潜力的对抗性与操作性特征。因此需要一个一致、可操作的恶意软件复杂性评估视角。

Method: 采用系统化综述（systematization）方法，梳理现有基于静态二进制分析的恶意软件质量评估途径；以质量为导向，重新诠释ISO/IEC 25010软件质量标准中的若干特性（可靠性、可维护性、灵活性、安全性），并评估其在恶意软件二进制层面的适用性；识别既与恶意软件相关又可通过静态分析度量的特性。

Result: 识别出若干既适用于恶意软件又可通过静态分析度量的ISO/IEC 25010质量特性，构成一致性评估恶意软件复杂性的框架基础，适用于无源码或动态执行不可行的情形。

Conclusion: 本文为恶意软件复杂性提供了基于质量视角的统一定义路径，并为后续构建一致、可复现的静态评估框架奠定基础。

Abstract: 'Sophisticated' is widely used to describe malware, yet it lacks a consistent definition within academic literature. While existing software quality and complexity metrics offer some insight into malware structure, they do not capture the broader adversarial and operational traits that contribute to real-world threat potential. This paper presents a systematization of existing approaches for assessing malware quality using static binary analysis. We define malware sophistication through a quality-focused lens by reinterpreting select characteristics from the ISO/IEC 25010 software quality standard, including reliability, maintainability, flexibility, and security, and evaluating their applicability to malware binaries. We identify which characteristics are both relevant to malware and measurable through static analysis, forming the basis for future frameworks that consistently assess malware sophistication when source code is unavailable or dynamic execution is infeasible.

</details>


### [288] [A Comprehensive Review of One-Pixel Attack: Research Status, Taxonomy, Applications, Regulation Policy and Future Directions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00125)
*Mirza Niaz Morshed,Md. Masudul Islam,Galib Muhammad Shahriar Himel,Md. Aslam Uddin,Hui Liu,Md. Shafiqul Islam*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 一篇PRISMA指导的综述，系统梳理2017-2026年单像素攻击（OPA）研究，提出多维分类体系，总结算法、防御与领域漏洞，并指出研究空白与未来方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单像素攻击是深度学习对抗脆弱性的极端例证，改一个像素即可导致高置信度误分类，波及医疗诊断、自动驾驶、生物识别、量子通信等领域；但现有对抗攻击综述对其覆盖零散、浅薄，缺乏系统梳理与统一框架。

Method: 采用PRISMA指导的文献综述方法，筛选2017至2026年间高质量研究，构建统一的多维分类体系，涵盖算法基础、黑箱进化优化、新兴混合与程序合成攻击、防御机制、可解释性工具及领域特定脆弱性。

Result: 分析显示差分进化策略占主导地位，效率优化与显著性引导方法兴起；防御范式包括像素恢复、异常检测、输入空间变换和鲁棒训练，在鲁棒性、不可感知性与计算开销之间存在权衡；数据集多样性、迁移性和标准化评估仍存在持续空白。

Conclusion: 提出选择性像素恢复、Transformer特定脆弱性分析、显著性驱动优化和面向真实领域的自适应防御等未来研究重点，并倡导以鲁棒性测试、事件披露和AI安全治理为核心的监管框架，为理解、评估和缓解超稀疏对抗威胁奠定基础。

Abstract: One-Pixel Attacks (OPAs) represent one of the most extreme demonstrations of adversarial fragility in deep learning, where modifying a single pixel can reliably induce high-confidence misclassification across domains such as medical diagnosis, autonomous driving, biometrics, and quantum communication. Despite their conceptual simplicity, OPAs remain underexamined in existing adversarial-attack surveys, which provide only fragmented or cursory coverage. This PRISMA-guided review synthesizes high-quality studies from 2017 to 2026 and delivers a unified, multi-axis taxonomy of OPA research spanning algorithmic foundations, black-box evolutionary optimization, emerging hybrid and program-synthesis attacks, defence mechanisms, interpretability tools, and domain-specific vulnerabilities. Our analysis reveals the dominance of Differential Evolution-based strategies, the rise of efficiency-optimized and saliency-guided methods, and persistent gaps in dataset diversity, transferability, and standardized evaluation. We summarized and assess defence paradigms including pixel restoration, anomaly detection, input-space transformations, and robust training highlighting their trade-offs in robustness, imperceptibility, and computational overhead. Building on these insights, we outline future research priorities involving selective pixel recovery, transformer-specific vulnerability analysis, saliency-driven optimization, and real-world domain-adaptive defences. We further propose a regulatory framework emphasizing robustness testing, incident disclosure, and AI security governance. This review establishes a comprehensive foundation for understanding, evaluating, and mitigating ultra-sparse adversarial threats in contemporary AI systems.

</details>


### [289] [A Verifier Can Leak the Answer: Diagnosability Before Optimization in Closed-Loop Agent Debugging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00126)
*Peiying Zhu,Sidi Chang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 论文报告了一种仿真验证器失效案例：验证器的探针与谓词泄露了目标身份，使精确优化器与贪心方法表现相同，比较因此变得空洞。作者改用"支持门控验证契约"重新评估，在1440例留出集上通过多级门槛且假接纳率为0。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体开发者日益依赖仿真验证器来比较提示、工具、策略与诊断算法。但若验证器的探针或谓词编码了目标身份，则精确优化器会在未解决真正歧义的情况下显得有效，导致算法比较失去意义。作者意在揭示该失效并建立不泄露答案的评估规范。

Method: 首先审计一个闭环决策智能体的聚合轨迹调试器，对比精确最小命中集（MHS）与传播感知贪心方法的支持集及植入故障恢复情况，并检查精确锚点谓词是否泄露植入对。随后以"支持门控验证契约"替代求解器优先评估：先要求干净参考图显示组件重复暴露，再通过参考/当前匹配门控确认运行期证据可比，最后由独立校准的信号规则给出检测判定。在预注册留出集（1440例、21600分区行）上验证。

Result: 初始阶段：精确MHS与贪心方法在12/12开发案例中返回相同支持集，9/12中恢复相同植入故障；审计发现精确锚点谓词在9/9案例中直接产生植入对。移除锚点后，植入对整体恢复为8/9；硬探针单例对仍在9/9中与植入对匹配，且传播后无任何案例保留非空残余冲突族（0/9）。改进评估后：72个政权-组件单元中55个通过参考门，其中54/55通过运行期门，稳定假接纳为0/20（单侧精确95%上界0.1391）；在已接纳单元内，受影响干净流量比名义故障单元比例更能预测检测。

Conclusion: 核心结论是结构性的：在优化组件选择器之前，必须先验证证据资格与不泄露性。否则更强的求解器只能证明一个更强的验证器假象，使算法比较沦为空洞认证。

Abstract: Agent developers increasingly compare prompts, tools, policies, and diagnosis algorithms through simulator-grounded verifiers. A verifier can nevertheless make a solver comparison vacuous: if its probes or predicates encode the target identity, an exact optimizer may appear effective without resolving any genuine ambiguity. We report such a failure in an aggregate-trace debugger for a closed-loop decision agent. Exact minimum hitting set (MHS) and a propagation-aware greedy method returned identical supports in 12/12 development cases and the same planted-fault recovery in 9/12. A subsequent audit found that exact-anchor predicates produced the planted pair in 9/9 cases. After removing those anchors, overall planted-pair recovery was 8/9; hard-probe singleton pairs nevertheless matched the planted pair in 9/9, and no case retained a nonempty residual conflict family after propagation (0/9). The optimizer was correct, but the verifier had already disclosed the answer. We replace solver-first evaluation with a support-gated verification contract. A clean reference map must first show repeated component exposure; a matched reference/current gate must then establish comparable runtime evidence; only afterward may an independently calibrated signal rule return a detection. In a preregistered heldout comprising 1,440 cases and 21,600 partition rows, 55/72 regime-component units passed the reference gate, 54/55 passed the runtime gate, and stable false admission was 0/20 represented components with a one-sided exact 95% upper bound of 0.1391. Within admitted units, affected clean traffic predicted detection better than nominal fault-cell fraction. The main lesson is structural: verify evidence eligibility and non-revelation before optimizing the component selector. Otherwise a stronger solver can merely certify a stronger verifier artifact.

</details>


### [290] [The Cognitive Continuity Test: Verifying Governed State Transitions in Persistent AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00132)
*Jun He,Deying Yu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出认知连续性测试(CCT)框架与身份谱系基准(IdentityLineageBench),用于在策略相对契约下验证持久AI智能体的状态转移申明,区分可采纳、违规与证据不足三类结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持久AI智能体会修改信念、整合记忆并更换执行基座;相似的后继状态可能对应授权依据不同的转移申明,而合法的演化也可能大幅改变状态,因此需要一种可验证的机制来判定转移申明的合法性。

Method: CCT采用策略相对契约,包含作用域授权、来源追溯、确定性应用、语义谓词和候选持久化收据五类构件;并构建IdentityLineageBench,含24个生成式转移家族,以参考的后解析验证器进行评测,辅以词法状态相似度与仅谱系诊断基线,以及签名对抗回归测试。

Result: 参考验证器在576个规范留出标签上全部匹配;词法相似度与仅谱系基线分别放行60.0%与80.0%的无效样本;对抗回归覆盖伪造交互计数、无依据信念变更、证据缺失与矛盾混合。18,000次执行的合法路径研究中位延迟为6.21 ms。

Conclusion: 该工作建立的是合成环境下的符合性证据,而非相对已部署策略感知系统的优越性;分离性结论针对转移申明而非运行时身份,可靠性以检查器与评估器假设为条件;SIT行为与真实模型迁移尚未测量,落地还需补充激活与恢复义务。

Abstract: Persistent AI agents revise beliefs, consolidate memory, and replace execution substrates. Similar successor states can accompany differently authorized transition claims, while legitimate development can change state substantially. We introduce the Cognitive Continuity Test (CCT), a policy-relative contract for verifying submitted transitions using scoped authority, provenance, deterministic application, semantic predicates, and candidate-persistence receipts. CCT distinguishes verified admissibility, affirmative violation, and unresolved required evidence. Separation results concern transition claims rather than live runtime identity; soundness is conditional on the specified checker and evaluator assumptions.
  IdentityLineageBench provides 24 generated transition families. The reference post-resolution verifier matches all 576 canonical held-out labels; lexical state similarity and a lineage-only diagnostic baseline admit 60.0% and 80.0% of invalid fixtures. These comparisons establish synthetic conformance, not superiority to a policy-aware deployed system. Signed adversarial regressions cover fabricated interaction counts, unsupported belief changes, and mixed missing/contradictory evidence. SIT behavior and actual model migration remain unmeasured. An 18,000-execution valid-path study measures a 6.21 ms default median on resident inputs. We specify the additional activation and recovery obligations needed for deployment.

</details>


### [291] [Evasion Attacks: How Adversarial Noise Bypasses ML Classifiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00136)
*Parker Hummel,Ryne Skabo,Muhammad Abusaqer*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文开展可复现的教学性研究，对比图像与文本分类中的逃逸攻击：MNIST上CNN遭FGSM/PGD攻击准确率大幅下降，而SMS垃圾短信上的DistilBERT在扰动下表现稳健，未出现误分类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在以可复现、教学导向的方式实证考察逃逸攻击的模态依赖性，说明鲁棒性必须通过实验验证，而不能由干净准确率推断。

Method: 图像侧：MNIST训练紧凑卷积网络，施加FGSM与PGD两种白盒攻击，并测试位深缩减防御；文本侧：在SMS Spam Collection上微调DistilBERT，施加字符替换、空白噪声与良性后缀等受控扰动序列，观察预测概率与标签翻转。

Result: 图像侧干净准确率98.63%，FGSM在ε=0.15/0.30下降至60.20%/1.72%，PGD降至32.47%/0.41%，位深缩减仅部分恢复；文本侧准确率98.75%、F1为94.96%，扰动仅引起多数样本概率小幅变化，无垃圾短信误判为正常短信。

Conclusion: 对抗脆弱性高度依赖模态：MNIST实验构成明确的逃逸演示，文本实验更接近受控鲁棒性评估；鲁棒性应由实证测试而非干净准确率推断。

Abstract: This paper presents a reproducible, educational study of evasion attacks in image classification and text classification. A compact convolutional network trained on MNIST reached 98.63% clean test accuracy and was evaluated under two white-box attacks. Under FGSM, accuracy fell to 60.20% at $ε$ = 0.15 and 1.72% at $ε$ = 0.30; under PGD it fell to 32.47% and 0.41%, and a bit-depth-reduction defense recovered only part of the loss. In the second experiment, DistilBERT fine-tuned on the SMS Spam Collection reached 98.75% accuracy and a 94.96% F1-score, but a controlled sequence of pre-defined perturbations (character substitutions, whitespace noise, and a benign suffix) produced only modest probability shifts in most displayed examples and no flip from spam to ham. Adversarial vulnerability is strongly modality-dependent: the MNIST experiment is a clear evasion demonstration, whereas the text experiment is a controlled robustness evaluation. Robustness must be tested empirically rather than inferred from clean accuracy.

</details>


### [292] [Intrusion Detection for Agentic Processes: Evidence-Based Runtime Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00151)
*Arslan Brömme*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该文提出A-IDS——一个以智能体流程本身为监控对象的证据感知运行时入侵检测解释层，通过将证据支持的观察与受治理、版本化的期望基线（涵盖流程状态、授权、通信与强制事件）进行比对来识别安全相关偏差，贡献为概念性模型而非实现或性能验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体部署日益将语言模型推理与检索、委派、工具执行、外部系统访问及人工审批相结合，安全相关偏差可能跨越演进的流程浮现，而非局限于单一输入或动作；同时监控平面自身在对抗性内容经由合法观察路径抵达语义证据生产者时也成为攻击面。

Method: A-IDS作为证据感知的安全解释层，将证据支持的观察与受治理、版本化的期望基线（工作流状态、授权、通信、强制事件）比对；组合动态到期受治理期望、可见性与三值匹配分离、显式未决观察状态、以及区分证据状态与运营影响的有界发现；部分观察可脱离智能体自述路径产生，但不假设完全可观测或捕获普遍可信。

Result: 该工作为概念性贡献，未验证实现、未展示实证检测性能、未建立因果归因，也未提供执行机制；A-IDS不从异常行为推断恶意意图，不将未观察事件视为未发生的证明，亦不主张新的异常检测器、时序逻辑或溯源模型。

Conclusion: A-IDS为智能体流程的运行时入侵检测提供了一种证据感知的解释框架，将提示注入同时视为输入安全问题及后续流程偏差与跨智能体影响路径的可能来源，其价值在于概念建模与监控平面攻击面的识别，而非检测性能或强制执行的实证结论。

Abstract: Agent deployments increasingly combine language-model inference with retrieval, delegation, tool execution, external-system access, and human approval. Security-relevant deviations can therefore emerge across an evolving process rather than in one isolated input or action. Building on the author's earlier black-box architecture for agentic processes and the subsequent evidence-claim model, this paper proposes an Agentic-Process Intrusion Detection System (A-IDS), an evidence-aware security interpretation layer for runtime intrusion detection whose monitored object is the agentic process itself. A-IDS compares evidence-supported observations with a governed and versioned expectation baseline for workflow state, authorization, communication, and mandatory events. Its conceptual contribution combines dynamically due governed expectations, visibility separated from three-valued matching, explicit unresolved observation states, and bounded findings that separate evidentiary status from operational impact. The model further identifies the monitoring plane itself as an attack surface when adversarial content reaches semantic evidence producers through otherwise legitimate observation paths. Some observations may be produced outside the operational agent's self-report path, but the model does not assume complete observability or universally trustworthy capture. Prompt injection is treated both as an input-security problem and as a possible origin of later process deviations and cross-agent influence paths. A-IDS does not infer malicious intent from anomalous behavior, does not treat an unobserved event as proof of non-occurrence, and does not claim a new anomaly detector, temporal logic, or provenance model. The contribution is conceptual: it does not validate an implementation, demonstrate empirical detection performance, establish causal attribution, or provide an enforcement mechanism.

</details>


### [293] [Tokenized Key-Gated Adapter Routing: A Secure Access Control Mechanism Against Private Data Leakage in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00309)
*Mohamed Shaaban,Mohamed Elmahallawy*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: Locket 提出一种面向 LoRA 的键控入口令牌访问控制框架，将细粒度、策略驱动的访问权限嵌入 LLM 生成过程，在授权时保留私有知识，在未授权时脱敏或抑制 PII 泄露。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在医疗、金融、政府等隐私敏感场景中大规模部署，但其记忆并泄露个人可识别信息（PII）的能力带来严重安全与合规风险。现有防御手段通常被迫在模型效用、隐私保护与微调私有知识访问三者之间做取舍，难以兼顾。

Method: Locket 训练一组轻量级 LoRA 适配器，每个适配器编码一种访问策略（如完全披露、通过 PII 掩码进行部分脱敏、或在指定差分隐私水平下披露）。同时训练一个紧凑的门控模块，通过序列级硬路由将学习到的键控入口令牌与唯一一个 LoRA 适配器绑定。有效令牌作为授权密钥解锁对应私有知识；无效或缺失令牌则触发隐私保护适配器对敏感内容进行脱敏或净化。该设计保持与现成 LLM 完全兼容，支持可扩展部署。

Result: 在 Enron、ECHR、Yelp 多个数据集以及 Qwen3（1.7B、8B）、Llama-3.2（1B、3B）、Gemma-2-2B 等多种先进 LLM 上进行评估。实验表明：提供正确令牌时，Locket 的困惑度与在原始数据上微调（无任何防御）相当；令牌缺失或无效时，显著降低 PII 泄露，同时效用与困惑度与强基线防御持平。

Conclusion: Locket 通过键控入口令牌与多策略 LoRA 的硬路由机制，在单一模型中实现了细粒度访问控制，同时兼顾模型效用、隐私保护与私有知识访问，且与现有 LLM 兼容、部署可扩展，满足监管与隐私要求。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in privacy-critical domains (e.g., healthcare, finance, and government), but their propensity to memorize and disclose personally identifiable information (PII) poses serious security and compliance risks. Existing defenses typically force a trade-off between model utility, privacy protection, and access to fine-tuned private knowledge. We propose LoRA-Oriented Control via Keyed Entry Tokens (Locket), a practical framework that embeds fine-grained, policy-driven access control directly into LLM generation. Locket trains a set of lightweight LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) adapters, each encoding a distinct access policy (e.g., full reveal, partial redaction via PII masking, or reveal under a specified differential privacy level). A compact gating module is trained to associate a learned keyed entry token with exactly one LoRA adapter via sequence-level hard routing; the presence of a valid token acts as an authorization key that unlocks corresponding private knowledge, while an invalid or absent token triggers a privacy-preserving adapter that redacts or sanitizes sensitive content. This design ensures Locket remains fully compatible with off-the-shelf LLMs, supporting scalable deployment while satisfying regulatory and privacy requirements. We evaluate Locket across multiple datasets (Enron, ECHR, Yelp) and a diverse set of state-of-the-art LLMs, including Qwen3 (1.7B and 8B), Meta's Llama-3.2 (1B and 3B), and Google's Gemma-2-2B. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that, when the correct token is provided, Locket preserves perplexity comparable to fine-tuning on raw data (without any defense). Conversely, when the token is missing or invalid, it substantially reduces PII leakage while maintaining utility and perplexity on par with strong baseline defenses.

</details>


### [294] [Actions with Receipts: Jointly Binding Claims, Evidence, and Execution for Replayable Tool-Agent Auditing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00327)
*Miaobo Hu,Shuhao Hu,Xiaobo Guo,Xin Wang,Bokun Wang,Yina Sa,Daren Zha,Jun Xiao*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该论文提出“以论断为锚点的执行契约”，联合绑定论断、来源跨度、有序执行前缀及来源版本/访问状态，并分离完整性平面与支持性平面，通过确定性校验器检测跨对象替换攻击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具使用型智能体虽会暴露引用与执行日志，但“呈现给用户的论断是否就是已提交执行所产生、且被引用来源所支持的论断”这一关键关联未被审计。有效引用与有效轨迹可能各自形式完好，却被跨论断、跨动作、跨运行或跨来源版本移植。

Method: 引入 claim-anchored execution contract：每条 receipt 含 emission anchor，确定性定位已提交答案或承载论断动作中的论断，并包含来源标识符、偏移、哈希、引文及域分离的执行承诺。确定性完整性校验器在语义或任务标签加入前重建这些绑定。将完整性平面与可插拔支持平面分离，避免以结构有效性替代蕴含判断。

Result: 契约暴露七个可独立测试属性：论断-发射绑定、来源绑定、有序执行绑定、oracle 分离、持久对象重放、执行重跑一致性、版本/访问绑定。1,280 次跨对象攻击中，联合契约检测出 1,275 次替换（0.9961）；移除某一目标属性后，其攻击检测率降至 0.0156–0.0625。在独立裁定的 384 对拆分上，冲突感知支持守卫达到 F1 0.8865、误接受率 0.0729；在未见失败族上分别为 0.8679 与 0.0938。

Conclusion: 通过联合绑定论断、来源与执行轨迹并分离完整性校验与语义支持判断，可有效检测跨对象替换攻击，同时保持结构有效性与蕴含性评估的解耦。

Abstract: Tool-using agents can expose citations and execution logs while leaving a critical association unaudited: whether the claim shown to a user is the claim emitted by the committed execution and supported by the cited source. A valid citation and a valid trace can therefore remain individually well formed while being transplanted across claims, actions, runs, or source versions. We introduce a claim-anchored execution contract that jointly binds the emitted claim, its exact source span, the ordered execution prefix that produced it, and the source version and access state observed by that execution. Each receipt contains an emission anchor that deterministically locates the claim inside a committed answer or claim-bearing action, together with source identifiers, offsets, hashes, quotes, and a domain-separated execution commitment. A deterministic integrity verifier reconstructs these bindings before semantic or task labels are joined. We separate this integrity plane from a pluggable support plane, so structural validity is not used as a proxy for entailment. The contract exposes seven independently testable properties: claim-emission binding, source binding, ordered-execution binding, oracle separation, persisted-object replay, execution-rerun consistency, and version/access binding. Across 1,280 cross-object attacks, the joint contract detects 1,275 substitutions (0.9961). Removing a targeted property reduces its attack-detection rate to 0.0156-0.0625. On an independently adjudicated 384-pair split, the conflict-aware support guard reaches F1 0.8865 and false acceptance 0.0729; on unseen failure families, these rates are 0.8679 and 0.0938.

</details>


### [295] [UnifiedAttack: Evaluating the Safety of Large Multimodal Models in Synergistic Harmful Image-Text Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00341)
*Bingjun Luo,Jialin Guo,Tony Wang,Siqi Li*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出 UnifiedAttack 基准与协同劫持框架，用于评估统一架构大模型在图文协同有害生成中的安全性，并揭示其对齐机制可被系统性绕过。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大模型向原生统一架构演进，图文协同产生的"协同风险"远超单模态危害之和，但现有安全评估缺乏针对跨模态协同增益的基准与验证手段。

Method: 构建 UnifiedAttack 基准，纳入经多模态潜力筛选的样本及合成虚假信息查询子集；提出协同劫持框架，包含上下文换壳（ICR，用少样本学习将对抗意图包装为良性虚拟外壳以弱化安全过滤）与认知规划注入（CPI，强制"先规划后执行"，借一致性驱动同步输出有害多模态内容）。

Result: 在主流先进架构上的广泛评测显示，UnifiedAttack 能稳定绕过现代对齐防护，成功诱导有害图文协同生成。

Conclusion: 统一模型的结构化有用性与逻辑连贯性可被系统性武器化，凸显协同生成任务中逻辑感知防御的迫切需求。

Abstract: As Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) transition toward natively unified architectures, evaluating their safety in synergistic harmful image-text generation tasks becomes a critical challenge. Unlike unimodal threats, synergistic risks emerge when text and image modalities are coordinated to produce harm that significantly exceeds their individual components. We introduce UnifiedAttack, a novel benchmark designed to evaluate LMM safety in collaborative scenarios by focusing on the harmfulness gain achieved through cross-modal synergy. The benchmark incorporates samples filtered for their multimodal potential alongside a novel subset of synthesized disinformation queries. To verify identified vulnerabilities, we propose a synergistic hijacking framework featuring In-Context Reskinning (ICR) and Cognitive Planning Injection (CPI). ICR utilizes few-shot learning to wrap adversarial intent in benign virtual shells to desensitize safety filters, while CPI hijacks the reasoning path by enforcing a plan-then-execute paradigm. By compelling the system to commit to a neutral logical plan, we exploit its internal drive for consistency to induce the synchronized generation of harmful multimodal content. Extensive evaluations on state-of-the-art architectures demonstrate that UnifiedAttack consistently bypasses modern alignment. Our findings reveal that the structural helpfulness and logical coherence of unified models can be systematically weaponized, highlighting the urgent need for logic-aware defenses in synergistic generation tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/bingjunluo/UnifiedAttack .

</details>


### [296] [Authorization for Self-Modifying AI Agent Populations: Conserving Authority across Replacement, Forking, and Rollback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00347)
*Genliang Zhu,Chu Wang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出“授权继承”（authorization succession）机制，为可自我修改的AI智能体在单亲代际森林中守恒权威，防止配额重复、权限合并与祖先撤销失效，并通过可执行评估验证其安全性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自我修改的AI智能体可替换、分叉、回滚携带身份的软件，其后代仍可执行。逐后继授权无法约束由此形成的智能体群体：兄弟节点可能重复使用配额、合并权限、在祖先撤销后存活，或在晋升时与前驱重叠。因此需要一种在代际活跃前沿上守恒权威的授权机制。

Method: 定义“授权继承”，在单亲代际森林的活跃前沿守恒权威。外部协议将每代绑定到清单、根、唯一父代、完整谱系及新鲜种群序列；分离不变量分别限制根生命周期消耗与当前种群暴露。采用分阶段预留在替换时冻结前驱残余权威，分叉通过划分验证完整子代家族，每次提交原子隔离前驱并激活后继。祖先撤销使依赖后代失效；回滚生成新代而不恢复已消耗权威；新根需独立授权。在完全中介、认证记录、可靠效应抽象、持久单调状态及完整谱系核算假设下给出安全证明。

Result: 可执行评估覆盖32个注册决策，通过直接调用与邮箱映射实现64/64重放（28允许、36拒绝）。独立检查器接受全部64条原始轨迹，拒斥28/28语义变异体；12/12剖面不变量、16/16崩溃截断、32/32竞争调度通过。两个外部适配器在OurArk与Darwin Gödel Machine突变上复现全部32个决策，包括新进程重启、原子继承与前驱拒绝。

Conclusion: 结果确立了针对已注册受保护效应的授权继承，证明种群安全继承、分叉守恒、撤销闭包、原子交接、回滚不重复铸造及自我认证排除等性质。

Abstract: Self-modifying AI agents can replace, fork, and roll back identity-bearing software while descendants remain executable. Per-successor authorization does not constrain the resulting population: siblings may duplicate quotas, combine permissions, survive ancestor cuts, or overlap predecessors during promotion. We define authorization succession, which conserves authority across the active frontier of a single-parent generation forest.
  Our external protocol binds each generation to a manifest, root, unique parent, complete lineage, and fresh population sequence. Separate invariants bound root-lifetime consumption and current population exposure. A staged reservation freezes predecessor residual authority during replacement, while a partitioning fork validates the complete child family. Each commit atomically fences the predecessor and activates successors. Ancestor cuts invalidate dependent descendants; rollback creates a fresh generation without restoring spent authority; and a new root requires an independent grant. Under complete mediation, authenticated records, sound effect abstraction, durable monotone state, and complete lineage accounting, we prove population-safe succession, fork conservation, revocation closure, atomic handoff, rollback non-reminting, and exclusion of self-certification.
  An executable evaluation covers 32 registered decisions through direct-call and mailbox mappings (64/64 replays; 28 allows, 36 denies). An independent checker accepts all 64 original traces and rejects 28/28 semantic mutants; 12/12 profile invariants, 16/16 crash cuts, and 32/32 contender schedules pass. Two external adapters reproduce all 32 decisions around measured OurArk and Darwin Godel Machine mutations, including fresh-process restart, atomic succession, and predecessor rejection. The results establish authorization succession for registered protected effects.

</details>


### [297] [Removing the NEEDLE in the Haystack: Backdoor Removal in LLMs via Weight Orthogonalisation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00348)
*Minoo Kim,Vasileios Lampos,George Drayson*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出免训练后门移除方法 NEEDLE，通过估计后门方向与拒绝子空间并施加顺序权重正交化，在抑制后门的同时避免改变拒绝相关表征，实现最低攻击成功率且对模型能力与安全性影响最小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 后门防御在移除后门时会无意间将模型输出分布偏移至良性提示上，导致模型性能与安全性下降；且通常依赖干净参考模型或原始中毒训练数据。

Method: NEEDLE 为免训练方法：一旦识别出触发器，便通过激活向量估计一个后门方向和一个拒绝子空间，随后施加顺序权重正交化，以抑制后门同时防止拒绝相关表征发生变化；无需干净参考模型，也无需原始中毒训练数据。

Result: 在多个模型家族与攻击类型上评估，NEEDLE 取得所评估防御中最低的平均攻击成功率（ASR），在具有挑战性的代码注入攻击上达到 0%，同时 KL 散度最低，模型能力与安全性的变化最小。

Conclusion: NEEDLE 通过权重正交化实现精准后门移除，兼顾防御有效性与模型原有能力及安全性的保持，且不依赖干净模型或中毒数据。

Abstract: Backdoor attacks can be implanted in Large Language Models (LLMs) during training, causing unwanted behaviour when a trigger appears in the input. Existing backdoor defences for LLMs attempt to remove the backdoor but inadvertently shift the model's output distribution to benign prompts, which can result in degraded model performance and safety. We propose NEEDLE, a training-free method for targeted backdoor removal. Once a trigger has been identified, our method estimates a backdoor direction and a refusal subspace through activation vectors, then applies sequential weight orthogonalisation to suppress the backdoor while preventing changes in refusal-related representations. NEEDLE requires neither a clean reference model nor the original poisoned training data. Evaluation is conducted across multiple model families and attack types. NEEDLE achieves the lowest mean Attack Success Rate (ASR) among the evaluated defences, including 0% on challenging code injection attacks, while resulting in the lowest KL divergence and minimal changes in capability and safety.

</details>


### [298] [Proof-Gated Signing: Solver-Checked Transaction Guards that Hold Under State Drift for Onchain AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00354)
*Bravish Ghosh*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出 Proof-Gated Signing (PGS)，通过 SMT 求解与链上后置条件证明，在状态漂移下保证 AI 钱包代理提出的交易符合声明式价值与权限策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 钱包代理会读取攻击者可影响的内容，因而可能被诱导提出有害交易。现有签署前检查（静态白名单、LLM 审核、交易模拟）均只描述检查时刻的链上状态，而交易实际在更晚且可被对手塑造的状态中执行（前跑、合约升级、代币参数变更），即“状态漂移”，导致检查与执行状态不一致。

Method: PGS 先模拟拟议交易并提取其效果，在预言机不确定性区间内对每个价格用 SMT 求解器检验声明式的价值与权限策略；随后编译链上后置条件（钱包余额上下界、收款方到账、授权额度上限与所有权），并证明任何满足后置条件的执行也满足该策略；由代理的智能合约钱包原子化强制执行这些后置条件。

Result: 在包含 260 个场景的开放测试平台（14 个攻击族，其中 5 个漂移族、2 个自适应族，以及 12 个良性族）上，以攻击者余额而非策略来度量危害：PGS 阻止了 140 个有害场景中的 93.6%，通过 97.5% 的良性场景；纯模拟检查阻止 57.9%，静态白名单 71.4%；50 个漂移场景在 PGS 下均未产生攻击者收益。唯一未被阻止的族群（策略内抽取）受每会话预算限制。此外发现，向 LLM 审核者提供干净的漂移前模拟反而提高其批准漂移攻击的概率。每次检查开销约 41k gas 与 0.1–0.2 秒。

Conclusion: PGS 通过将签署前策略检查与链上原子后置条件结合，把安全保证从“检查时刻”推广到“任意漂移下的实际执行”，在显著优于模拟与白名单的同时保持较低开销，为 AI 钱包代理提供了抗状态漂移的签署防护。

Abstract: AI agents that control wallets read attacker-reachable content, so they can be steered into proposing harmful transactions. The usual last line of defense is a pre-signing check: a static allowlist, an LLM reviewer, or a transaction simulation. All three share a gap: the check describes the chain state at check time, but the transaction executes in a later state that an adversary can shape through front-running, contract upgrades or token-parameter changes. We call this state drift. We present Proof-Gated Signing (PGS), which simulates a proposed transaction, extracts its effects, and uses an SMT solver to check a declarative value-and-permission policy for every price in an oracle-uncertainty band. It then compiles on-chain post-conditions (wallet balance bounds, payee receipts, allowance caps and ownership) and proves that every execution satisfying them also satisfies the policy. The agent's smart-contract wallet enforces them atomically, so the guarantee applies to the executed transaction under arbitrary drift. On an open testbed of 260 scenarios (14 attack families including five drift and two adaptive families, and 12 benign families), with harm measured from attacker balances rather than from any policy, PGS prevented 93.6% of the 140 harmful scenarios and passed 97.5% of the benign ones. Simulation-only checking prevented 57.9% and a static allowlist 71.4%. None of the 50 drift scenarios produced attacker gain under PGS. The only unprevented family, an in-policy drain, was bounded by the per-session budget. We also find that giving an LLM reviewer a clean pre-drift simulation made it more likely to approve a drift attack. Overhead is about 41k gas and 0.1-0.2 s per check.

</details>


### [299] [On the Relationship between Model Quantization and Model Inversion Attacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00382)
*Rongke Liu,Youwen Zhu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文研究模型量化如何影响模型反演攻击及数据特性的作用，并提出一种隐私感知的训练后量化方法，在恢复精度的同时提升反演抗性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量化会降低权重与激活的数值精度，而模型反演攻击可从模型输出或中间特征恢复敏感训练数据，因此量化可能改变反演攻击的效果。但量化如何影响反演、数据特性如何调节这一关系尚不明确。

Method: 理论上界定量化对输入与预测概率类别变量间互信息变化的影响，区分信息效应与攻击优化障碍；分析数据相关的特征分布与反演结果变化。据此提出隐私感知训练后量化：使用Fisher型任务敏感度代理进行预算感知比特分配，校准激活范围，联合优化权重/激活缩放与舍入决策，并结合任务恢复、几何保持目标及缩放与舍入正则化。

Result: 在多种指标、网络架构及人脸、掌纹、虹膜识别任务上验证。ResNet-50上Palm 4比特将RL-MIA严格成功率从54%降至26%，精度相对FP32从99.01%降至96.55%；Iris 4.5比特加入SSD（epsilon=0.1）后，BREP-MI严格成功率从63.33%降至37.33%，精度相对仅量化从92.8%降至87.6%。

Conclusion: 量化通过信息效应与优化障碍两方面影响模型反演，且该影响具有明显的数据依赖性（4比特处敏感度差异显著）；所提隐私感知量化可在少量精度损失下显著提升反演抗性，并兼容输出级防御。

Abstract: Model quantization reduces the numerical precision of neural network weights and activations to lower storage and computational costs. Model inversion attacks recover or reconstruct sensitive training data or inference inputs from model outputs or intermediate features, so quantization may also alter their effectiveness. However, two questions remain unresolved: How does model quantization affect model inversion? How do data characteristics influence this relationship? To address the first, we bound quantization-induced changes in mutual information between inputs and a categorical variable defined by prediction probabilities, distinguishing informational effects from attack optimization obstacles. To address the second, we identify data-dependent changes in feature distributions and inversion outcomes, with pronounced quantization sensitivity differences at 4 bits. These insights guide a privacy-aware post-training quantization method that improves inversion resistance while recovering utility. It uses a Fisher-type task-sensitivity proxy for budget-aware bit allocation, calibrates activation ranges, and jointly optimizes weight and activation scales and weight-rounding decisions with task-recovery and geometry-retention objectives and scale and rounding regularization. Experiments cover multiple metrics, neural network architectures, and face, palmprint, and iris recognition tasks. On ResNet-50, Palm at 4 bits reduces RL-MIA's strict success from 54% to 26%, while accuracy decreases from 99.01% to 96.55% relative to FP32. Our method also supports output-level defenses: adding Stealthy Shield Defense (SSD, epsilon = 0.1) to Iris at 4.5 bits reduces BREP-MI's strict success from 63.33% to 37.33%, while accuracy decreases from 92.8% to 87.6% relative to quantization alone.

</details>


### [300] [From A2A Attacks to Envelope-Layer Defense: Red-Teaming Evaluation of LLM Agents and a Three-Layer Isomorphic Attack-Defense Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00392)
*Yuelin Han*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出A2A-TIBA攻击范式（间接提示注入+绕过规避）、GDA Measurement红队评测方法（四类攻击结局A/B/C/D）与ELA-ITL三层同构攻防模型，将单一ASR扩展为语义拒绝率、语义突破率、拦截率与穿透率，并揭示"信封层"为新防御维度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ACP、A2A等智能体交互协议推动多智能体协作，同时引入新安全威胁：远端对等方的任务被当作合法请求，成为间接提示注入的天然通道。现有评测多依赖单一ASR指标，无法区分攻击失败是因LLM识别了恶意内容，还是因智能体层机制拦截了执行，导致防御评估粒度不足。

Method: （1）A2A-TIBA攻击原则：结合间接提示注入与绕过规避，通过"植入-指令-外传"步骤诱导目标智能体部署回调交互程序，随后攻击者绕过智能体直接下发命令。（2）GDA Measurement评测方法：借助LLM网关进行原始上下文捕获、双份数据留存与智能体自主判定完成红队测试。（3）四类攻击结局A/B/C/D与四项指标。（4）ELA-ITL三层同构攻防模型：防御分为信封封装、LLM识别、智能体拦截；攻击分为植入通道、提示优化、执行机制。

Result: 在15种智能体前端×LLM后端组合上测试，并构建1000条案例数据集，验证了A2A-TIBA的攻击有效性、GDA Measurement的评测有效性；同时证实：在A2A、工具、记忆等信封通道中加入恶意提示标签，可显著提升LLM对恶意内容的识别能力。

Conclusion: 将ASR细化为语义拒绝率、语义突破率、拦截率与穿透率，可更精细地刻画攻击失败原因；"信封层"（恶意内容进入智能体的通道）可作为新的防御维度，ELA-ITL模型为智能体协议安全提供了三层同构的攻防分析框架。

Abstract: Agent interaction protocols such as ACP and A2A have moved LLM-based agents toward multi-agent collaboration, introducing new security threats. A task sent by a remote peer over A2A is treated as a legitimate request, providing a natural channel for indirect prompt injection. Existing agent security evaluations mostly rely on a single metric, the attack success rate (ASR), and cannot distinguish whether an attack failed because the LLM recognized the malicious content or because a mechanism at the agent layer blocked execution. To address this, we propose A2A-TIBA, an attack principle combining indirect prompt injection with bypass circumvention. Through implant-command-exfiltration steps, it induces the target agent to deploy a callback interaction program, after which the attacker issues commands bypassing the agent. To evaluate defenses finer, we design GDA Measurement, a red-team testbed method using raw context capture via an LLM gateway, dual data preservation, and agent-based autonomous judging. We propose four attack outcomes, Class A/B/C/D, extending ASR into semantic refusal rate, semantic breach rate, interception rate, and penetration rate. Experiments reveal the envelope layer -- the channel through which malicious content enters an agent -- as a new defense dimension. We accordingly propose ELA-ITL, a three-layer isomorphic attack-defense model, dividing defense into envelope packaging, LLM recognition, and agent interception, and attack into implant channel, prompt optimization, and execution mechanism. Testing on 15 agent front-end x LLM back-end combinations and building a 1,000-case dataset verifies the attack effectiveness of A2A-TIBA, the evaluation validity of GDA Measurement, and confirms that adding malicious prompt labels to envelope packaging such as A2A, tool, and memory channels significantly improves LLM recognition of malicious content.

</details>


### [301] [ZoneClaw: Mitigating Persistent Memory Attacks by Establishing Memory-Zoning in OpenClaw-Style Computer-Use Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00450)
*Haokai Ma,Chieh Lin,Yupeng Qiu,Ee-Chien Chang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出 ZoneClaw，用分层信任区替代扁平工作区记忆，将"持久化"与"权限"解耦，使外部声明只能留在低信任区，须跨显式权限边界才能获得指导行动的权威。在 4 种攻击场景、2 种注入设置、4 个骨干模型下，ASR 从 372/480 降至 6/480，同时在 458/480 次试验中保持效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OpenClaw 式计算机使用智能体（CUA）以自动重载文件形式实现持久工作区记忆，用户指令、系统摘要与外部声明处于同一权限等级，因此"记住某条声明"即等同于赋予其后续行为的权威。攻击者仅需控制看似无害的外部内容，即可在合法任务中诱导 CUA 写入有利于攻击者的声明，之后这些声明会在攻击者从未接触的良性任务中支配行为，形成"恶意上下文→记忆注入→恶意执行"的跨环境威胁链。现有防御要么在内容进入记忆前干预，要么在其后续诱发的动作处干预，都无法解决"已存储内容能否指导行动"这一根本问题。

Method: ZoneClaw 将持久性与权威分离：用带显式权威等级的分层信任区取代扁平工作区记忆。外部声明仅持久化于低信任区，只有跨越显式权威边界才能获得指导行动的权威；越界时的晋升需与攻击者无法直接写入的信任区交叉校验。该边界由非对称权限的角色专用进程强制执行，确保不存在同时"摄入外部内容"与"向外行动"的进程。

Result: 在 4 种攻击场景、2 种注入设置与 4 个骨干模型上，ZoneClaw 将攻击成功率（ASR）从 372/480 降至 6/480，同时在 458/480 次试验中保持任务效用，并对部分具备防御意识（defense-aware）的攻击者依然有效。攻击者的声明仍会持久留存于低信任记忆，但极少跨越权威边界，说明 ZoneClaw 是在扣留权威，而非拒绝从环境学习。

Conclusion: ZoneClaw 通过"持久化与权威分离"的思路缓解了持久记忆攻击这一跨环境威胁，在保持效用的同时大幅压低 ASR，并揭示其机制本质是限制权威授予而非阻止学习。代码已开源。

Abstract: Computer-use agents increasingly operate as long-running assistants through persistent workspace memory, which OpenClaw-style CUAs realize as automatically reloaded files that hold user instructions, system summaries, and external claims at the same privilege level. Here, remembering a claim confers authority over later behavior. This enables a persistent memory attack, in which an attacker who controls only benign-looking external content induces the CUA to record attacker-favored claims during a legitimate task, and those claims later govern benign tasks the attacker never touches. The attack chain extends "malicious context -> malicious response" into "malicious context -> memory injection -> malicious execution", making this a cross-environment threat. Existing defenses studied intervene either before content enters memory or at the action it later induces, not whether stored content may guide action. We propose ZoneClaw, which separates persistence from authority by replacing flat workspace memory with hierarchical trust zones carrying explicit authority levels. External claims persist in a low-trust zone and acquire action-guiding authority only by crossing an explicit authority boundary, at which promotion is cross-checked against zones the attacker cannot directly write. Role-specific processes of asymmetric privilege enforce this boundary, ensuring that no process both ingests external content and acts outward. Across four attack scenarios, two injection settings, and four backbones, ZoneClaw drives ASR from 372/480 to 6/480 while retaining utility in 458/480 trials, and remains effective against some defense-aware attackers. Attacker claims still persist in low-trust memory yet rarely cross the authority boundary, showing that ZoneClaw withholds authority rather than refusing to learn from the environment. Our code is available at: https://github.com/euph00/ZoneClaw-code.

</details>


### [302] [Harbormaster: Evidence-Gated, Replay-Safe Maritime Anomaly Detection on AWS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00519)
*Arun Sharma*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出生产级AWS系统Harbormaster，围绕物理校验优先、幂等投影与LSN守卫、模型灰度与燃烧率门控三条规则，保证AIS异常告警的可归因、可复核与故障后可恢复，并给出重放正确性证明与受限AWS窗口下的实测延迟、吞吐与消费滞后结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AIS船舶位置报告可能虚假或缺失；基于异常告警行动的运营者需要告警可归因、可复核、失败后可恢复。而真实生产系统还需应对重复重放、部分写失败、模型上线风险等问题，因此需要一个具备可验证一致性与受控发布机制的系统设计。

Method: Harbormaster遵循三条规则：所有报告先做物理校验再进入学习模型；DynamoDB读存储作为PostgreSQL的幂等投影，每次写入由LSN守卫保护；候选模型须通过留出门控与影子对比，再经金丝雀逐步放量，每步由燃烧率检查守护。作者证明变更日志任意前缀或后缀的重放使每个投影键保持在其最高已应用LSN对应的取值。

Result: 受限AWS窗口下，一小时浸泡测试对36,000次请求返回35,999个HTTP 200，客户端p95延迟142.751 ms；另一900 s运行中流路径承受400 records/s突发，消费滞后随后排空至零。作者同时指出该重放结论未覆盖的效应，如重复的缓存失效与重复的审计行。

Conclusion: 系统通过物理校验前置、幂等LSN守卫投影与分阶段模型发布，实现告警的可归因、可复核与可恢复，并用带有测量位置标签的数据验证了延迟、成功率与消费滞后；同时明确列出未构建的设计部分与定理未覆盖的副作用，体现结论边界。

Abstract: Ships broadcast their positions through the Automatic Identification System (AIS), and those reports can be false or missing. An operator who acts on an anomaly alert needs that alert to be attributable, reviewable, and recoverable after a failure. This paper describes Harbormaster, a production-shaped system on AWS that follows three rules. Physics checks run on every report before any learned model runs. The DynamoDB read store is an idempotent projection of PostgreSQL, and a guard on the log sequence number (LSN) of each change protects every write to it. A candidate model must pass a holdout gate and a shadow comparison before a canary gives it traffic, and a burn-rate check guards each canary step. The paper proves that replaying any prefix or suffix of the change log leaves each projected key at the value of its highest applied LSN. It also notes effects this result does not cover, such as repeated cache invalidations and repeated audit rows. In a bounded AWS window, a one-hour soak returned 35,999 HTTP 200 responses to 36,000 requests, with a 95th-percentile (p95) client latency of 142.751 ms. In a separate bounded AWS run of 900 s, the stream path received a burst of 400 records/s, and its consumer lag later drained to zero. Every number in the paper carries a label that says where it was measured, and the paper lists the parts of the design that were never built.

</details>


### [303] [No One Architecture Fits All: A Cross-Environment Evaluation of Hierarchical Red Team Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00557)
*Ayan Javeed Shaikh,Arunesh Sinha,Nathaniel D. Bastian,Ankit Shah*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文通过受控跨环境比较两种同构分层红队架构（RL规划器+RL执行器 与 LLM规划器+LLM执行器），发现在不同网络环境中优势发生反转：RL+RL在紧凑密集奖励的CAGE-4和100主机Cyberwheel中占优，而预训练网络安全LLM在1010主机升级门控网络中占优，表明单环境结论难以泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主红队智能体被用于压力测试AI赋能的网络防御，RL与LLM提供互补的规划与执行机制，已有工作将其组合为混合层级架构。但以往架构通常仅在单一环境中开发与评估，无法判断观察到的优势是普遍更强的决策机制，还是仅与该特定环境匹配。为填补此空白，作者开展受控的跨环境比较。

Method: 构建两种同构分层红队架构：RL规划器+RL执行器（RL+RL）与LLM规划器+LLM执行器（LLM+LLM）。在CybORG CAGE-4和Cyberwheel两种网络规模下，针对专家自主防御者进行评测，共18种配置，统一采用同一中断（disruption）指标，并进一步做杀伤链（kill-chain）分析以定位架构特有的瓶颈。

Result: 出现明显的环境依赖反转：RL+RL在紧凑、密集奖励的CAGE-4中成功率为78.5%（最强LLM配置仅18.0%），在100主机Cyberwheel中为81.0%（LLM为50.5%）；而在更大、升级门控的1010主机Cyberwheel中，预训练网络安全LLM智能体以55.0%胜出，RL为0.0%。杀伤链分析显示：在1010主机网络中，RL能发现并攻陷主机但卡在权限提升阶段；在CAGE-4中，LLM能获得特权访问却很少转化为实际作战影响，聚合成功率掩盖了这些架构特有瓶颈。

Conclusion: 单一环境得出的结论可能无法泛化；混合规划器-执行器设计应由具体失败模式驱动，而非假设某一架构普遍更优。

Abstract: Autonomous red team agents increasingly stress-test AI-enabled cyber defenses by planning strategy and executing multistage attacks. Reinforcement learning (RL) and large language models (LLMs) offer complementary mechanisms for the planning and execution such agents require, and prior work has combined them in hybrid hierarchies. Yet a given architecture is typically developed and evaluated within a single environment, leaving open whether an observed advantage reflects a generally stronger decision mechanism or merely alignment with a particular setting. We address this gap with a controlled cross-environment comparison of two homogeneous hierarchical red team architectures: an RL planner with an RL executor (RL+RL) and an LLM planner with an LLM executor (LLM+LLM). We evaluate both against expert autonomous defenders in CybORG CAGE-4 and in Cyberwheel at two network scales, across 18 configurations under one unified disruption metric. We find a pronounced environment-dependent inversion. RL+RL wins the compact, densely rewarded CAGE-4 (78.5% disruption success versus 18.0% for the strongest LLM configuration) and the 100-host Cyberwheel network (81.0% versus 50.5%), while a pretrained cybersecurity LLM agent wins the larger, escalation-gated 1010-host Cyberwheel network (55.0% versus 0.0% for RL). A kill-chain analysis explains the inversion through architecture-specific bottlenecks that aggregate success rates conceal.In the 1010-host Cyberwheel network, RL discovers and compromises hosts but stalls at privilege escalation, whereas in CAGE-4, LLM agents obtain privileged access but rarely convert it into operational impact. These results indicate that conclusions drawn in a single environment may not generalize, and that hybrid planner-executor designs should be motivated by specific failure modes rather than the assumption that one architecture is universally preferable.

</details>


### [304] [Progressive-Resolution Secure Aggregation for Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00695)
*Seyed Mohammad Azimi-Abarghouyi*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 论文提出并形式化了“渐进分辨率安全聚合”（PSA）这一新功能，允许客户端仅上传一次，之后服务器可在无需客户端重新参与的情况下，按需获授权获得同一聚合结果的逐级更精细分辨率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统安全聚合协议在上传时即固定了聚合精度，无法在上传后按需获得更细粒度结果；若需更高精度，必须重新收集客户端参与，成本高昂且不灵活。

Method: 采用兼容的嵌套格数字表示每个经截断、加噪（dithered）的更新；将可分层释放的各层通过安全聚合及额外聚合填充（aggregate pad）加以保护，且该填充仅在非串通的释放控制器授权对应层后才对服务器可用。

Result: 摘要仅阐述了功能与方案设计，未提供实验数据或量化性能结果。

Conclusion: 该工作将安全聚合从固定精度扩展为渐进分辨率释放，兼顾隐私与可授权的精度提升，为一次上传、多次分层授权提供了可实现的密码学框架。

Abstract: Secure aggregation lets a server recover an aggregate of client updates without observing any individual update, but conventional protocols fix the aggregate precision when clients upload. We introduce and formulate a new progressive-resolution secure-aggregation functionality in which clients upload once and successively finer resolutions of the same aggregate can later be authorized without renewed client participation. To realize this functionality, we propose progressive-resolution secure aggregation (PSA): each clipped, dithered update is represented by compatible nested-lattice digits; separately releasable layers are protected by secure aggregation and an additional aggregate pad that remains unavailable to the server until a non-colluding release controller authorizes that layer.

</details>


### [305] [Towards Hierarchical Cyber Defense with Large Language Models: From Planning to Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00590)
*Harshith Doppalapudi,Nathaniel D. Bastian,Ankit Shah*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 研究采用冻结的零样本大语言模型（LLM）在分层网络防御中实现免重训练控制，发现将 LLM 控制从规划扩展到执行可显著提升跨网络规模的防御性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主网络防御智能体通常通过强化学习（RL）训练，但其性能与训练所用网络规模绑定，网络规模变化时需重新训练。分层 RL 虽通过分离战略目标与战术执行降低决策复杂度，却无法消除这一重训练依赖。因此作者探究冻结、零样本 LLM 能否提供免重训练的分层网络防御控制。

Method: 作者构建了控制器无关的"规划器—执行器"分层结构：规划器在固定时间范围内选择要防御的子网，执行器在该子网内选择防御动作。基于高保真 Cyberwheel 环境（内置自动化红队智能体并映射至 MITRE ATT&CK 框架），在小、中、大三种网络规模下比较 RL+RL、LLM+RL、LLM+LLM 三种配置，使用 6 个 3B 至 70B 参数的模型，其中包含两个网络安全专用模型。

Result: 仅用 LLM 替换规划器时，随网络规模增大收益有限；而将 LLM 控制扩展至执行层，对能力足够强的模型产生显著提升。例如一个冻结的通用 70B 模型在三种网络规模下使用相同权重，将成功横向移动控制在约 1% 的步数，攻击者影响接近零；相比之下 RL 基线需针对每种规模重新训练。

Conclusion: 能力足够强的冻结 LLM 可在所评估的网络规模范围内保持较强防御性能，无需任务特定重训练；同时表明强大的战术执行能力是实现 LLM 控制优势的关键因素。

Abstract: An autonomous cyber defender trained with reinforcement learning (RL) is typically tied to the network on which it was trained, limiting its ability to generalize as network scale changes. Hierarchical RL reduces decision complexity by separating strategic targeting from tactical execution, but it does not eliminate this retraining dependence. We investigate whether frozen, zero-shot large language models (LLMs) can provide retraining-free control in hierarchical cyber defense and how performance changes as LLM control is extended from planning to execution. We formulate a controller-agnostic planner-executor hierarchy in which the planner selects a subnet to defend over a fixed horizon and the executor selects defensive actions within that subnet. Using the high fidelity Cyberwheel environment, with its built-in automated red team agent mapped to the MITRE ATT&CK framework, we compare RL+RL, LLM+RL, and LLM+LLM configurations using six models ranging from 3B to 70B parameters, including two cybersecurity-specialized models, across small, medium, and large networks. Replacing only the planner with an LLM yields limited gains as network size increases. In contrast, extending LLM control to execution produces notable improvements for sufficiently capable models. For instance, a frozen general purpose 70B model holds successful lateral movement to approximately 1% of steps and attacker impact near zero across all three network scales using the same model weights, while the RL baseline is retrained for each scale. Our results show that sufficiently capable frozen LLMs can maintain strong defensive performance across the evaluated network scales without task-specific retraining, while also indicating that strong tactical execution is important to realizing the benefits of LLM-based control.

</details>


### [306] [Crossing the Cyber Divide: Sim-to-Sim and Sim-to-Real Transfer for RL Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00759)
*Sabrina Saika,Yinuo Du,Aritran Piplai*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文研究网络攻防智能体跨模拟器与模拟器到真实的策略迁移问题，提出将状态对齐与动作翻译分离的框架，实现无需重训练的策略迁移，并在四个平台上验证了零样本迁移的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网络攻击智能体通常在单一模拟器中训练与评估，导致学习到的策略能否泛化到其他环境尚不明确。由于各网络模拟器在状态表示、观测模型和动作空间上差异显著，这既阻碍了实际部署，也难以进行公平比较。作者主张模拟器间迁移与模拟器到真实迁移本质上是同一类对齐问题。

Method: 提出一个将状态对齐（state alignment）与动作翻译（action translation）分离的框架，使在某一环境中训练的策略无需重训练即可在另一环境中运行。在CyberBattleSim、NetSecGame、CyberWheel和NASim四个网络平台上评估迁移效果，并包含NASim中的仿真部署实验。

Result: 实验表明零样本迁移可行：在高度对齐的环境中能完全保持源策略性能；当源性能为60.5%时，迁移后胜率达45.2%。在仿真虚拟机环境中，迁移策略与原生态策略的Jensen-Shannon散度为0.085，表明行为高度相似。

Conclusion: 跨网络环境的策略迁移是可行的，模拟器间与模拟器到真实迁移可统一为对齐问题；所提的状态对齐与动作翻译分离框架能够支持零样本迁移并保持较强的行为相似性，为跨模拟器部署与公平比较提供了基础。

Abstract: Cyber attack agents are typically trained and evaluated within a single simulator, making it unclear whether learned policies transfer beyond the environments in which they were developed. This limitation hinders both deployment and fair comparison, as cyber simulators differ substantially in their state representations, observation models, and action spaces. In this paper, we study policy transfer across cyber environments and argue that simulator-to-simulator and simulator-to-real transfer can be viewed as instances of the same underlying alignment problem. We propose a framework that separates state alignment from action translation, enabling a policy trained in one environment to operate in another without retraining.
