We evaluate transfer across four cyber platforms, CyberBattleSim, NetSecGame, CyberWheel, and NASim, including emulated deployments in NASim. Our experiments show that zero-shot transfer is feasible, fully preserving source-policy performance in closely aligned environments and achieving 45.2% win rates when transferring policies whose source performance is 60.5%. In emulated virtual machine environments, transferred policies exhibit a Jensen-Shannon divergence of 0.085 from native policies, indicating strong behavioral similarity. Code and benchmarks are available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/RL-Transfer-between-env-4F47/.

</details>


### [307] [Made to Measure: Designing Image Watermarks to Specification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00780)
*Mingzhe Li,Yuefeng Peng,Kejing Xia,Pranav Jeyakumar,Ruolan Leslie Famularo,Shiqing Ma*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出请求条件化的水印组合框架TAILOR，通过离线表征、联合配置选择与在线校准三阶段，在满足误报率、时延等约束下求解低失真水印组合方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际部署的图像水印需同时满足抗攻击性、误报率（FPR）、图像质量与延迟四项要求。单一水印难以兼顾，组合互补水印可提供更广保护，但组合会带来失真与解码开销增加，且需共享同一FPR预算，因此组合配置本身是一个受约束的优化难题。

Method: TAILOR为请求条件化的水印组合框架，含三阶段：(1) 离线表征：以嵌入强度为自变量，测量各水印片段的恢复率、失真与运行时响应曲线；(2) 联合配置选择：将请求编码为基于上述曲线的SMT模型，求解片段、强度、顺序与几何恢复的最低失真组合；(3) 在线校准：在用户图像上验证所选配置，并修正迁移失败的预测。

Result: 在涵盖五种场景、20种攻击设置的7,321个不同请求上，TAILOR取得96.21%的场景平均请求满足率，平均PSNR为41.02 dB，在鲁棒性上优于现有方法，且图像质量持续更优。

Conclusion: TAILOR通过请求条件化与多水印片段的最优组合，在统一FPR预算与失真约束下实现了鲁棒性与图像质量的联合提升，验证了互补水印组合在实际部署中的可行性与有效性。

Abstract: Image watermarking supports provenance and attribution by embedding verifiable identity information into images. Practical deployments, however, must jointly satisfy requirements for attack resistance, false-positive rate (FPR), image quality, and latency. Existing watermarking methods are robust to different classes of transformations, so combining complementary methods can provide broader protection than any single watermark. Such composition is challenging, as additional fragments increase distortion and decoding cost and must share the same FPR budget. Therefore, we propose **TAILOR**, a request-conditioned watermark composition framework with three stages: (1) *offline characterization* measures fragment recovery, distortion, and runtime as response curves over embedding strength; (2) *joint configuration selection* encodes the request as an SMT model over these curves and solves for the lowest-distortion composition of fragments, strengths, order, and geometric recovery; and (3) *live calibration* validates the selected configuration on the user's images and refines predictions that fail to transfer. Experimental results across 7,321 distinct requests spanning five scenarios and 20 attack settings show that **TAILOR** achieves **96.21%** scenario-averaged request satisfaction with a mean PSNR of **41.02 dB**, outperforming existing methods in robustness while achieving consistently better image quality. Code is available at [https://github.com/aaFrostnova/Tailor](https://github.com/aaFrostnova/Tailor).

</details>


### [308] [Identity-Bound Governance Under Execution Uncertainty: An Accountability Proof Block for LLM Agent Persistent Halts, with Cryptographic Implementation and Cross-Model Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00787)
*Marcelo Fernandez*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 论文提出"身份绑定治理事件"概念及APB（问责证明块）机制，用于解决LLM智能体在持续性可观测性失效或漂移时无法自行授权继续或停止的问题，通过系统证据块+人工决策块+ed25519签名绑定注册主体，并证明四个定理，经实验验证治理完备性、抗攻击性与阈值稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 正确治理的LLM智能体可能出现两难状态：既不能继续执行也不能自动停止——系统已检测到可观测性或漂移检测层的持续性失效，但自身无权决定由谁来恢复、拒绝或重新校准部署。这一"身份绑定治理事件"缺乏形式化机制来解析与授权转移，需要可问责的权限移交手段。

Method: 提出问责证明块（APB）：由系统构建的证据块、人工提供的决策块，以及将二者绑定到注册主体的ed25519签名组成。系统无法伪造签名，主体也无法在未检测情况下篡改证据。证明四个定理：协议有界治理完备性、不可否认性、匿名再授权不可能性、APB构建有限时间终止性。实现采用RFC 8785 JSON规范化与基于UUID4的重放谓词。并提出k-of-n多主体变体。

Result: 治理完备性在3,812次停机事件中零未解决案例；验证器在9类对抗向量的1,800次攻击中检测率100%；k-of-n多主体变体在2,000次单密钥捕获尝试中零误接受。对六个开放LLM的研究发现漂移阈值T*在模型内稳定（sigma/T*<2%）但跨模型变化，推翻规模单调性：最大模型并未漂移。

Conclusion: T*必须按部署逐一测量，而APB正是使该阈值产生可问责权限转移的载体。

Abstract: A correctly governed LLM agent can reach a state in which neither continuing execution nor automatically halting is admissible: the system has detected a persistent failure of its observability or drift-detection layer, but cannot itself decide who has the authority to resume, deny, or recalibrate the deployment. We call this an identity-bound governance event and formalise the mechanism that resolves it. We introduce the Accountability Proof Block (APB): a system-constructed evidence block, a human-supplied decision block, and an ed25519 signature binding both to a registered principal. The system cannot forge the signature, and the principal cannot alter the evidence undetected. We prove four theorems: Protocol-Bounded Governance Completeness, Non-Repudiability, Impossibility of Anonymous Re-Authorization, and Finite-Time APB Construction Termination. The implementation uses RFC 8785 JSON canonicalization and a UUID4-based replay predicate. Empirically, governance completeness holds over 3,812 halt events with zero unresolved cases; the verifier detects 100% of 1,800 attacks across 9 adversarial vectors; a k-of-n multi-principal variant shows 0 false acceptances in 2,000 single-key capture attempts. A study of six open LLMs finds the drift threshold T* stable within model (sigma/T* < 2%) but varying across models, refuting size-monotonicity: the largest model did not drift. T* must therefore be measured per deployment, and the APB is the vehicle by which that threshold yields accountable authority transfer.

</details>


### [309] [SafeDepth: Safety-Aware Token-Level Adaptive Computation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00815)
*Nizhang Li,Ian G. Harris*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: SafeDepth：一种即插即用的选择性层执行框架，通过路由器与适配器联合训练，在减少计算量的同时降低有害回复率并保持良性任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有token级自适应模型选择性跳过层以降低计算，但实验发现这类模型相比其参考骨干网络会产生更高的有害回复率；且安全效应与所跳过的层、跳过发生在prompt处理还是答案生成阶段相关，识别有害请求与生成拒答依赖不同的层级计算。

Method: 提出SafeDepth，一种轻量级即插即用框架，利用选择性层执行同时提升安全性与效率。路由器基于token表示、层位置和推理阶段来决定层执行，适配器支持被跳过的路径；两者联合训练以减少计算和有害回复，同时保持良性任务性能。预训练骨干全程冻结，无需额外预训练。

Result: 在Llama-3-8B-Instruct上，SafeDepth相较全深度推理降低计算量且基本保持任务性能；相比FlexiDepth，在全部5个有害请求基准上降低不安全回复率，其中HarmBench-HJ绝对降幅最大（55.44%降至25.25%），并将XSTest误拒率从12.0%降至4.0%。

Conclusion: 选择性层执行可同时改善安全性与效率，SafeDepth在冻结骨干条件下实现了更优的安全-效率权衡，说明层级计算差异与安全行为密切相关。

Abstract: Recent studies suggest that not every token needs to pass through all Transformer layers, motivating token-level adaptive models that selectively skip layers to reduce computation. Our experiments show that these execution choices also affect safety: existing token-level adaptive reasoning models exhibit higher harmful-response rates than their reference backbones. The safety effects depend on which layers are skipped and whether skipping occurs during prompt processing or answer generation. We further find that recognizing harmful requests and producing refusals depend on different layer-wise computations. We introduce SafeDepth, a lightweight, plug-in framework that uses selective layer execution to improve both safety and efficiency. SafeDepth learns to retain computations that support safe responses and bypass those that contribute to unsafe generation. A router selects layer execution based on token representations, layer position, and inference phase, while an adapter supports the skipped paths. We jointly train these modules to reduce computation and harmful responses while preserving performance on benign tasks, targeting a better safety-efficiency trade-off. The pretrained backbone remains frozen throughout, requiring no additional pretraining. Experimental results on Llama-3-8B-Instruct show that SafeDepth reduces computation relative to full-depth inference while largely preserving task performance. Compared with FlexiDepth, it lowers unsafe-response rates across all five harmful-request benchmarks, with the largest absolute decrease on HarmBench-HJ (from 55.44% to 25.25%), while reducing the XSTest false-refusal rate from 12.0% to 4.0%.

</details>


### [310] [Do Defenses Against LLM Extraction Work Across Attacks? A Lifecycle Benchmark of Black-Box Model Extraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00839)
*Shuze Liu,Kaixiang Zhao,Runyang Xu,Jingzhi Chen,Nathan Wu,Yu Wang,Yushun Dong*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个统一基准，覆盖6种提取攻击、10种防御和2种自适应攻击，用于在纯文本API访问下系统比较LLM模型提取攻击与防御的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通过纯文本API部署的大语言模型面临模型提取风险，攻击者可收集其响应来训练复现其能力的替代模型。然而现有攻击与防御工作在访问假设、模型配置、查询预算和安全目标上各异，评估碎片化，缺乏可比性。

Method: 构建统一基准：包含六种提取攻击、十种防御，以及两种自适应攻击（在替代模型训练前对受保护响应进行改写或回译）。在每次比较中控制模型配置、查询数据、预算和留出评估条件，同时保留攻击特定的查询与训练流程。评估替代模型的能力、对受害模型的保真度、使用Rep-4衡量输出质量及查询预算敏感性；防御则使用自身安全指标并配以替代模型表现。对自适应攻击，联合测量溯源检测器分数及在改写响应上训练的替代模型的能力与保真度。

Result: 该基准为在纯文本访问下比较提取方法及其与防御的交互提供了可复现的基础，能够在统一条件下评估替代模型能力、保真度、输出质量（Rep-4）和查询预算敏感性，并联合评估自适应攻击下溯源检测分数与替代模型性能。代码与产物已开源。

Conclusion: 该基准填补了模型提取攻击与防御评估碎片化的空白，提供了跨方法可比的统一评测框架，有助于系统理解提取方法与防御的交互，并在纯文本访问条件下支持可复现研究。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) deployed through text-only APIs face model extraction risks, as adversaries can collect their responses to train surrogates that reproduce their capabilities. While prior work has developed diverse attacks and defenses, evaluations remain fragmented across access assumptions, model configurations, query budgets, and security objectives, limiting comparability across methods. To address this gap, we introduce a unified benchmark covering six extraction attacks, ten defenses, and two adaptive attacks that paraphrase or back-translate protected responses before surrogate training. The benchmark controls model configurations, query data, budgets, and held-out evaluation conditions within each comparison while preserving attack-specific querying and training procedures. We measure surrogate capability, fidelity to the victim, output quality using Rep-4, and query-budget sensitivity; defenses use their own security metrics paired with surrogate performance. For the adaptive attacks, we jointly measure provenance-detector scores and the capability and fidelity of surrogates trained on rewritten responses. The benchmark thus provides a reproducible basis for comparing extraction methods and their interactions with defenses under text-only access. Code and artifacts are available at https://github.com/sliu11-byte/MEA-Bench.

</details>


### [311] [AuraForge: Scaling Security Supervision for Training Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00850)
*Danqing Wang,Songwen Zhao,Harsh Sharma,Jierui Wang,Andre Vicente Duarte,Ivan Bercovich,Lei Li*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: AuraForge 能合成并验证可执行安全测试，构建多语言多CWE的 AuraGym 训练环境，以更可靠地训练安全编码智能体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体已能凭单条提示生成复杂软件，人类监督从逐行代码审查转向结果评估，但功能正确并不保证实现安全；而真实代码库难以大规模获得可靠的安全监督信号，训练更安全的编码智能体因此困难。

Method: 提出 AuraForge，结合面向攻击的测试合成、语言可扩展的任务构建以及防奖励作弊机制，用于合成并验证可执行安全测试；据此构建 AuraGym，一个跨语言、跨 CWE 的可执行训练环境，含来自 344 个真实仓库的 679 个功能实现任务，覆盖 Python、JavaScript、TypeScript 与 177 类 CWE。

Result: 在含人工编写安全测试的子集上，AuraForge 平均测试用例数量约为人工的 3 倍，误报率降低 83.23%，使替代性安全实现获得正确监督；用合成安全测试训练 Qwen3.5-4B，在三种语言上相比人工测试取得更大提升（平均 19.7 FuncPass 与 6.2 SecPass，对比 14.9 FuncPass 与 4.4 SecPass）。

Conclusion: AuraForge 提供了更多样、更可靠的安全监督，可有效用于训练安全编码智能体。

Abstract: Coding agents are now proficient enough to generate complex software applications from a single prompt. As their capabilities have grown, human oversight has increasingly shifted from line-by-line code review toward hands-off evaluation of outcomes. However, recent studies have shown that such a transition exposes a critical risk: functional correctness alone does not guarantee a secure implementation. Despite growing attention to code security, training safer coding agents remains challenging because reliable security supervision is difficult to obtain at scale from real-world repositories. We introduce AuraForge to synthesize and validate executable security tests for training secure coding agents. Our approach combines attack-oriented test synthesis, language-extensible task construction, and safeguards against reward hacking. Using AuraForge, we construct AuraGym, a multi-language and multi-CWE executable training gym: 679 executable feature-implementation tasks from 344 real-world repositories across Python, JavaScript, and TypeScript, covering 177 CWE categories. On the subset with human-written security tests, AuraForge produces about 3 times as many test cases on average and reduces the false-positive rate by 83.23%, allowing alternative secure implementations to receive correct supervision. Training Qwen3.5-4B with synthesized security tests gains larger improvements than human-written security tests (average 19.7 FuncPass and 6.2 SecPass vs. 14.9 FuncPass and 4.4 SecPass) on three languages. These results demonstrate that AuraForge provides more diverse and reliable security supervision to train secure coding agents.

</details>


### [312] [ABSENTIA: Detecting Broken Access Control Vulnerabilities in Web Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00977)
*André V. Duarte,Aditya Oke,Rui Melo,Shubham Gandhi,Nachiket Kotalwar,Charmi Khandor,Danqing Wang,Arlindo L. Oliveira,Carolyn Rosé,Lei Li*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: ABSENTIA：以LLM智能体构建路由-代码图并做不变量证伪，系统性检测Web后端越权漏洞；配套BAC-Bench基准（30条2025年后公告），召回19条，优于CodeQL/Semgrep。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 越权（失效的授权）是最普遍的Web安全风险之一。与注入这类"不可信输入流入危险操作"的污点流不同，授权是一种关系——谁可以对什么执行操作，而非数据如何流动。该关系由每个应用自行定义，预置规则无法迁移到下一个应用。LLM智能体虽能从代码中推断该关系，但缺乏系统性覆盖应用并排序审查优先级的手段，导致搜索无方向、越权缺陷漏检。

Method: 提出ABSENTIA安全脚手架，将通用LLM智能体转化为Web后端系统性漏洞检测器，供维护代码的开发者与安全工程师审计使用。在其引导下，智能体构建将应用路由映射到其后端代码的图；随后逐路由进行不变量证伪：推断代码本应满足的属性，凡未被强制执行的属性，即将该路由上报供维护者复核。

Result: 发布BAC-Bench，覆盖25个仓库、3种语言、9个框架的30条越权公告，均为2025年及以后发布，经人工审计员验证，并配有对应修复提交，因此须标记出易受攻击版本而非已修复版本才算得分。ABSENTIA召回19条，其中17条获得配对得分，LLM验证器确认其51%的发现。CodeQL与Semgrep均无召回，同一模型上的非结构化智能体仅召回3条。在OWASP Benchmark注入类别中，ABSENTIA在Python上领先各专用分析器，在Java上仅落后于CodeQL与IRIS。

Conclusion: ABSENTIA通过路由-代码图与不变量证伪，为授权这一"关系型"漏洞提供了可系统化审计的路径，在越权检测上显著优于传统静态分析工具与非结构化智能体，并兼具注入类缺陷的竞争力；BAC-Bench以配对修复提交的评测设计提升了结果可信度。

Abstract: Broken access control, the failure of authorization, is one of the most prevalent web security risks. Unlike injection, a flow of untrusted input into a dangerous operation, authorization is a relation: who may act on what, not how data moves. Each application decides that relation for itself, so no rule written in advance carries to the next. An LLM agent can infer it from the code, but with no systematic way to cover the application and prioritize what to inspect, its search stays undirected and access-control flaws go undetected.
  We present ABSENTIA, a security scaffolding that turns general LLM agents into systematic vulnerability detectors for the backend of web applications, run as an audit by the developers and security engineers who maintain the code. Under its direction, the agents build a graph that maps the application's routes to the code behind them. ABSENTIA then works route by route, applying invariant falsification: it infers the properties the code is meant to satisfy, and where one is not enforced, reports the route for maintainer review.
  We also release BAC-Bench, a benchmark of 30 broken access control advisories across 25 repositories, 3 languages, and 9 frameworks, each published in 2025 or later, verified by a human auditor, and paired with its fixing commit, so credit requires flagging the vulnerable version and not the fixed one. ABSENTIA recalls 19 of them, 17 under paired credit, and an LLM verifier confirms 51% of its findings. CodeQL and Semgrep recall none, and an unstructured agent on the same model recalls 3. In the OWASP Benchmark injection categories, ABSENTIA leads the dedicated analyzers in Python and trails only CodeQL and IRIS in Java.

</details>


### [313] [Helol Tunnel: Covert Channel Exploitation of TLS Extensibility & Privacy Features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01009)
*Reza Soosahabi,Rakesh Seal*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出Helol隐蔽隧道，利用TLS Client Hello包中密码信息元素的组合排列来嵌入信息，借助反僵化合规与抗指纹随机化趋势规避NGFW检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代网络攻击需要隐蔽信道进行数据外泄与C2通信，而TLS协议广泛存在，其Client Hello包的组合特性尚未被充分利用，具备构建高隐蔽性信道的潜力。

Method: 利用TLS Client Hello包中密码信息元素的战略性重排来嵌入信息，构建Helol隐蔽隧道；借助反僵化TLS合规要求促使中间盒与NGFW保留CHLO参数配置，以及流行应用为抗指纹而随机化CHLO参数这两点特性实现检测规避。

Result: 实验表明Helol隧道能够规避具备交互式代理与全面威胁防护的NGFW；基于真实流量抓取与公开TLS指纹数据的数值评估显示其效果优于现有利用TLS的最先进隐蔽信道。

Conclusion: Helol隧道有效利用了TLS生态中的最新发展趋势，在隐蔽性上超越现有TLS隐蔽信道，对NGFW构成实际威胁。

Abstract: Covert channels exploiting network protocols for data exfiltration and command-and-control (C2) are integral parts of modern cyberattacks. In search of a significant covert channel within the fabric of the Internet, we targeted the combinatorial properties of the Client Hello (CHLO) packets in the ubiquitous Transport Layer Security (TLS) protocol. The proposed Helol tunnel is a novel covert approach to embedding information in TLS Client Hello packets, which involves the strategic rearrangement of their cryptographic information elements. To sustain TLS protocol extensibility, the recent anti-ossification TLS compliance measures encourage the interactive middleboxes and next-generation firewalls (NGFWs) to preserve the parameter configuration in the Client Hello packets. Furthermore, to improve user privacy, popular Internet applications are varying their TLS CHLO parameter configurations to resist TLS fingerprinting by third-party network entities. We demonstrate the strength of the Helol tunnel to exploit these recent developments to evade NGFWs with interactive proxy and comprehensive threat protection. We also numerically show the efficacy of Helol tunneling over state-of-the-art covert channels that exploit TLS through the use of real traffic captures and public TLS fingerprinting data.

</details>


### [314] [MOMAT: Mixture of Multiple Atlases for Low-Power Jailbreak Defense of Quantized LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01058)
*Boyang Li,Bingyu Shen,Weihao Hong,Zhiyuan Jiang,Xinlei Guan,Yan Ma,Miles Q. Li,Yi Sheng,Ruiyang Qin*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: MOMAT 是一种面向边缘端量化大模型的硬件增强安全框架，通过多图集结构化检索+轻量 MoE 检测器实现域局部化 RAG 防护，并借助存内计算（CiM）加速相似度检索，在保持 SOTA 防御性能的同时大幅降低延迟与能耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量化大模型因低延迟、高能效被广泛部署于边缘设备，但量化会削弱对齐安全防护，使 qLLM 极易受到越狱攻击。现有防御方案难以兼顾安全性、效率与边缘部署的功耗约束。

Method: 提出 MOMAT（Mixture of Multiple Atlases）：将有害/良性样本集与策略模板组织为多个语义聚类的"图集"（atlas），实现域局部化的检索增强生成（RAG）防护，缓解大型异构安全数据库中的维数灾难与语义稀疏问题。对每个提示从所有图集中检索 top-k 相似特征，由轻量级 MoE 检测器进行评估；检索环节由 CiM（存内计算）加速的相似度引擎完成，实现快速低功耗的图集内局部检索。

Result: CiM 检索将 100 查询批次的耗时从 15,052.44 ms 降至 3,207.21 ns（约 4.69×10^6 倍加速），能耗从 8.1×10^7 μJ 降至 3.32 μJ，相较基于 DRAM 的树莓派基线实现约 2.5×10^5 倍能耗降低。红队测试表明，MOMAT 在标准基准上达到与 SOTA 方法相当的防御性能，同时避免对良性输入的过度拦截，并获得显著效率收益。将公开 223.2k 样本数据集。

Conclusion: 基于 CiM 的模块化防御可让边缘部署的 qLLM 同时更安全、更节能，为量化模型的安全对齐提供了硬件-算法协同的可行路径。

Abstract: Quantized large language models are increasingly deployed on edge devices for their low latency and energy efficiency. However, model quantization weakens alignment safeguards, leaving qLLMs (quantized large language models) highly vulnerable to jailbreak attacks. To address this challenge, we present MOMAT (Mixture of Multiple Atlases), a hardware-enhanced safety framework that combines structured knowledge retrieval with low-power defense acceleration. Each atlas represents a semantic cluster of harmful or benign sample sets and policy templates, enabling domain-localized Retrieval-Augmented Generation guarding that mitigates the curse of dimensionality and the resulting semantic sparsity problem in large, heterogeneous safety databases. MOMAT retrieves top-$k$ similarity features from all atlases for each prompt and evaluates them using a lightweight MoE (Mixture of Experts) detector, while a CiM (Compute-in-Memory)-accelerated similarity engine performs fast, low-power atlas-local retrieval. MOMAT's CiM-based retrieval accelerates a 100-query batch from 15,052.44 ms to 3,207.21 ns (a $4.69 \times 10^6\times$ speedup) and reduces energy from $8.1 \times 10^7$ $μ$J to 3.32 $μ$J, yielding an approximately $2.5 \times 10^5\times$ energy reduction over DRAM-based (Raspberry Pi) baselines. Red-team evaluations across standard benchmarks show that MOMAT matches the defense performance of state-of-the-art methods while avoiding benign overkill and providing substantial efficiency gains, demonstrating that CiM-based modular defenses can make edge-deployed qLLMs both safer and more energy-efficient. We will release the full 223.2k-sample dataset to foster future research.

</details>


### [315] [Jev-IDS: System One Models for Network Intrusion Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01079)
*Paulo Severo,Silvio E. Quincozes,Amanda Dias*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出 JEV-IDS，一个基于 Jev SOM 的开放实验性通用网络入侵检测系统，在标签稀缺条件下检测零日入侵，并在性能、成本与延迟上优于对比基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统机器学习 NIDS 依赖大量标注数据和任务特定训练；LLM 检测虽可直接分析流记录，但推理成本高、延迟大、输出约束弱。因此需要一个兼顾低成本、低延迟与可靠输出的通用零日入侵检测方案。

Method: JEV-IDS 基于 Jev System One Model（SOM），每条请求序列化一条流记录，向 JEV 提出两个问题：二值攻击概率与有限选项的流量类别分类；在 k=1 与 k=2 的两轮投票设置下进行评估。

Result: 在 k=1 时，JEV 比 GPT-5.6 Luna 快 4.8 倍、便宜 3.8 倍，新攻击召回高 1.5 倍；误报比低数据量 Random Forest 少 15 倍。在 300 条流的 NSL-KDD 试点划分上共 5,400 次决策，F1 0.859、精确率 0.941、召回率 0.790、新攻击召回 0.838；k=2 时 F1 降至 0.839。

Conclusion: JEV-IDS 在标签稀缺与零日攻击场景下展现出高效、低成本的通用检测潜力，且单轮（k=1）优于双轮（k=2）设置。

Abstract: Machine-learning Network Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) depend on substantial labeled datasets and task-specific training, whereas Large Language Models (LLMs) detection can analyze flow records directly but incurs higher inference cost and latency, with less constrained outputs. This paper presents JEV-IDS, an open experimental general NIDS based on the Jev System One Model (SOM) to detect zero day intrusions Under label scarcity. JEV-IDS serializes one flow per request and asks JEV two questions: a binary attack probability and a finite-choice traffic category. Our results show that, at k=1, JEV was 4.8 times faster and 3.8 times cheaper than GPT-5.6 Luna, with 1.5 times higher novel-attack recall; it also produced 15 times fewer false alarms than a low-data Random Forest. Across 5,400 decisions on a 300-flow NSL-KDD pilot split, JEV achieved F1-Score 0.859, precision 0.941, recall 0.790, and novel-attack recall 0.838. Increasing k to 2 reduced its F1-Score to 0.839.

</details>


### [316] [ReCast: Contract-Preserving Protection for Fixed-Interface Multimodal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01184)
*Bingchen Pei,Lichong Chen,Bingxi Zhao,Ziang Wu,Sirui Wang,Min Zhang,Yanhao Chen,Qingxu Liu,Qiang Gao,Chang-Tien Lu,Bo Gao*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: ReCast：一种代理式即插即用框架，在保持任务相关关系与输入模态的前提下替换源特定内容，实现隐私保护下的远程多模态数值推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 远程多模态模型在图表与语音上的数值推理能力强，但直接上传私有输入会泄露敏感内容。纯文本脱敏无法适配固定媒体接口，而身份匿名化仍会暴露底层任务内容，因此需要一种既满足媒体接口约束又能保护源内容的方案。

Method: ReCast 在本地把输入转换为共享的文本证据-查询记录，用蒸馏的 4B 模型联合重写实体与主题，并通过本地可逆、角色感知的数值映射替换数值。重建代理根据受保护记录生成并校验所需媒体；远程求解器返回程序，其受保护操作数在本地还原后再执行。

Result: 在 4,000 条留出的 ChartQA 与 NMSQA 样本上，ReCast 达到 75.10% 准确率，保留了无保护远程准确率的 92.43%；基于模型的审计显示仅 7.95% 的发往求解器的请求存在源内容泄露。其表现优于所有评估过的本地基线。

Conclusion: ReCast 在现有媒体接口约束下，既保留了远程推理的收益，又降低了源内容暴露风险，可用于远程多模态数值推理的隐私保护。

Abstract: Remote multimodal models offer strong numerical reasoning capabilities over charts and speech, but sending private inputs risks exposing sensitive content. Text-only sanitization cannot directly satisfy fixed media interfaces, while identity anonymization leaves the underlying task content exposed. We introduce ReCast, an agentic plug-in framework that replaces source-specific content while preserving task-relevant relations and the required input modality. ReCast locally converts inputs into a shared textual evidence-query record, jointly rewrites entities and topics with a distilled 4B model, and substitutes values through a locally invertible, role-aware numerical map. A reconstruction agent generates and validates the required media from the protected record. The remote solver returns a program whose protected operands are restored locally before execution. On 4,000 held-out ChartQA and NMSQA examples, ReCast achieves 75.10% accuracy, retaining 92.43% of unprotected remote accuracy, while a model-based audit flags source-content leakage in 7.95% of solver-bound requests. It outperforms all evaluated local baselines, preserving the benefit of remote reasoning while reducing source-content exposure under existing media interfaces.

</details>


### [317] [A Resource-Aware Behavior Reconstruction and Hierarchical Semantic Learning Framework for Host Intrusion Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01250)
*Youli Tao,Rui Tang,Hao Ren,Chengsheng Zhou,Dengzhe Wang,Shuyu Jiang,Xingshu Chen*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出ReSHID，一个资源感知的行为重构与层次语义学习框架，用于主机入侵检测，通过重构系统调用序列并构建主题行为图，显著提升检测性能并减少特征数量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于系统调用（syscall）的主机入侵检测方法通常按原始执行顺序建模，不同进程的序列相互交错，导致难以提取有判别力的模式。因此需要解决两个问题：能否以更有判别力的方式重组原始系统调用序列，以及如何从重组序列中有效学习复杂攻击模式。

Method: ReSHID利用系统调用语义不变量，将跨PID命名空间的主体身份与关系解析转化为二分匹配问题，并跟踪文件描述符（FD）生命周期以关联指向同一资源的描述符，从而重构语义连续的序列。随后将提取的特征组织为轻量级主题行为图，包含主体间关系，并使用GATv2捕获关键协作模式以建模涉及多主体的复杂攻击。

Result: 实验结果表明，序列重构结合检测方法可提升HIDS性能。即使使用轻量级线性分类器，该方法在F1-score（98.64%）、ROC-AUC（99.80%）和PR-AUC（98.10%）上均优于所有对比方法，同时相比原始序列和MGFE分别减少约75.2%和44.1%的n-gram特征数量。

Conclusion: ReSHID通过语义连续序列重构与层次语义学习，有效解决系统调用交错问题，在提升主机入侵检测性能的同时显著降低特征维度，验证了序列重构与检测方法结合的优越性。

Abstract: System calls (syscalls) record key interactions between running programs and the operating system kernel, providing fine-grained and minimally intrusive data for host-based intrusion detection systems (HIDS) deployed in cloud and other modern computing environments. However, existing methods often model syscalls in their original execution order, where sequences from different processes are interleaved, making informative patterns difficult to extract and raising two questions: whether raw syscall sequences can be reorganized in a way that yields more discriminative representations, and how complex attack patterns can be effectively learned from the reorganized sequences. We propose ReSHID, a resource-aware behavior reconstruction and hierarchical semantic learning framework for host intrusion detection. It reconstructs semantically continuous sequences by leveraging syscall semantic invariants to cast subject identity and relationship resolution across PID namespaces as a bipartite matching problem and tracking file descriptor (FD) lifecycles to associate descriptors referring to the same resource. Additionally, features extracted from these sequences are organized into a lightweight subject behavior graph incorporating inter-subject relationships, where GATv2 captures key coordination patterns to model complex attacks involving multiple subjects. Experimental results show that sequence reconstruction combined with the detection method can improve HIDS performance. Even with a lightweight linear classifier, the proposed method achieves the best results among all compared methods in terms of F1-score (98.64%), ROC-AUC (99.80%), and PR-AUC (98.10%), while reducing the number of n-gram features by approximately 75.2% and 44.1% compared with the raw sequences and MGFE, respectively.

</details>


### [318] [Autonomous OSS Threat Detection via Taxonomy-Aligned LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01263)
*Md. Robiul Islam Niloy*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出面向开源软件供应链威胁检测的"分类法对齐"大语言模型框架，构建AV-xxx五类威胁分类法与999条真实事件数据集，使用GPT-4在五类攻击上达到97.0%多分类准确率与97.0%宏F1；对比实验表明，分类法对齐的提示工程而非模型规模、领域预训练或微调，才是高分类精度的关键因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开源软件生态面临typosquatting、依赖混淆、Trojan Source混淆、恶意构建注入与CI/CD流水线投毒等日益复杂的供应链攻击。现有检测方法依赖签名工具与规则系统，难以跨攻击变体泛化，也无法应对新兴威胁模式，因此需要更具泛化能力的自动化检测与分类方案。

Method: 1) 提出结构化AV-xxx威胁分类法，覆盖五类攻击；2) 构建经人工校验的真实数据集，共999起OSS供应链事件，来源包括GitHub Security Advisories、CISA警报与安全研究报告，时间跨度2018—2026年；3) 采用分类法对齐的提示工程（taxonomy-aligned prompt engineering）驱动GPT-4进行威胁检测与多分类；4) 与五类传统机器学习基线、一个零样本开源LLM及两个微调神经模型进行对比评测。

Result: 框架在五类威胁上取得97.0%多分类准确率与97.0%宏F1。对比实验中，微调的Llama 3.1 8B（70.5%）与SecRoBERTa（77.5%）均低于简单TF-IDF分类器（82.3%），未做分类法对齐的Mistral 7B仅65.7%。

Conclusion: 结果表明，分类法对齐的提示方式（而非模型规模、领域预训练或微调）是决定高分类准确率的关键因素。数据集与代码已公开，以支持可复现的供应链安全研究。

Abstract: Open source software (OSS) ecosystems face growing threats from sophisticated supply chain attacks including typosquatting, dependency confusion, Trojan Source obfuscation, malicious build injection, and CI/CD pipeline poisoning. Existing detection approaches rely on signature-based tools and rule-based systems that struggle to generalize across attack variants and emerging threat patterns. In this paper we propose a taxonomy-aligned large language model framework for automated detection and classification of OSS supply chain threats. We introduce a structured AV-xxx threat taxonomy covering five attack categories and construct a curated dataset of 999 verified real-world OSS supply chain incidents sourced from GitHub Security Advisories, CISA alerts, and security research reports spanning 2018 to 2026. Using taxonomy-aligned prompt engineering with GPT-4, our framework achieves 97.0\% multi-class classification accuracy and 97.0\% macro F1 score across all five threat categories. Comparative evaluation against five traditional machine learning baselines, one zero-shot open source LLM, and two fine-tuned neural models reveals a surprising finding: fine-tuned Llama 3.1 8B (70.5%) and SecRoBERTa (77.5%) both underperform simple TF-IDF classifiers (82.3%), while Mistral 7B without taxonomy alignment achieves only 65.7%. These results confirm that taxonomy-aligned prompting rather than model scale, domain pretraining, or fine-tuning is the critical factor enabling high classification accuracy. Our dataset and code are publicly available to support reproducible supply chain security research.

</details>


### [319] [GNSS Spoofing in Mobile Devices: A Survey on Impact and Countermeasures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01294)
*Robert Argo,Andrea Nardin,Alex Minetto,Pau Closas*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文综述智能手机GNSS欺骗攻击的脆弱性及对策，提出面向移动平台约束的攻击效应与对策分类法，并通过比较框架评估各类检测与反制技术的优劣，填补现有综述忽视智能手机特定限制的空白。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能手机日常功能依赖GNSS定位，其嵌入式接收机因接收低功率、开放架构的卫星信号，易受人为射频干扰（干扰与欺骗）攻击。欺骗威胁尤为隐蔽，可诱使接收机输出虚假的PVT解。智能手机普及性高且存储敏感地理定位数据，成为主要攻击目标。然而其硬件受限且无法深入访问GNSS接收机处理链，导致有效对策难以实施。现有综述虽全面探讨通用欺骗对策，却未涉及这些移动端特有的限制。

Method: 本文采用综述研究方法：建立用于界定GNSS欺骗攻击效应与对策的分类体系（taxonomy）；对智能手机脆弱性刻画进行历史性回顾；概述针对智能手机欺骗威胁的检测与反制技术；并提出比较框架，以权衡各技术在移动平台上的优劣。

Result: 提出了面向智能手机架构独特约束的GNSS欺骗对策新综述，构建了攻击效应与对策的分类法，梳理了智能手机脆弱性表征的历史脉络，并汇总了现有检测与反制技术，形成可比较的评估框架。

Conclusion: 该综述填补了现有文献在智能手机特定限制方面的空白，为在移动平台约束下研究和选择GNSS欺骗检测与反制技术提供了系统化分类和比较依据。

Abstract: Smartphones rely on Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS)-based positioning for many of the functions they execute everyday. The GNSS receivers embedded in smartphones are susceptible to anthropogenic radio frequency interference attacks in the forms of jamming and spoofing due to the low-power and open-architecture signals they receive from the satellite constellations. While jamming is a practice that denies a GNSS receiver the ability to form a position, velocity, and time (PVT) solution, spoofing represents a more insidious threat by using forged satellite signals that aim at causing the victim receiver to compute a false PVT solution. The ubiquity of smartphones and the sensitive geolocation data they hold make them a primary target for malicious spoofing. However, their hardware constraints and the lack of deep visibility into the GNSS receiver processing chain create significant hurdles for effective countermeasures. Existing surveys comprehensively explore general spoofing countermeasures but fail to address these mobile-specific limitations. This article fills that gap with a novel survey focused on techniques viable within the unique constraints of smartphone architectures. Specifically, we establish a taxonomy for defining GNSS spoofing attack effects and countermeasures, provide a historical review of smartphone vulnerability characterization, and provide an overview of techniques proposed to detect and counteract smartphone spoofing threats, offering a comparative framework to weigh their respective pros and cons on mobile platforms.

</details>


### [320] [A Systematization of Knowledge on DeFi Vaults: Architectures, Curation Mechanisms, and Strategy Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01300)
*Davide Mancino,Luca Pennella*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该论文对DeFi金库架构及策展人中介的控制层进行系统化梳理，提出统一系统模型、形式化定义与三套分类法，并将代表性生产协议映射到各维度，以支持严谨分析与更安全的设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DeFi金库从早期收益聚合器演变为模块化、主动管理系统，催生了"策展"这一新控制层，负责策略选择、风险参数配置与运营执行协调，从而引入委托-代理动态与新型失效模式，亟需系统化的分析框架。

Method: （i）构建统一的系统模型及关于份额记账、角色与运营依赖的形式化定义；（ii）提出三套互补分类法，分别覆盖金库敞口与目标、策展人治理与问责机制、策略执行模式及其失效模式；并将一组代表性生产协议映射至上述维度。

Result: 建立了统一的DeFi金库与策展人控制平面系统模型、形式化定义，以及涵盖敞口/目标、治理/问责、执行模式/失效模式的三维分类体系，并完成生产协议与各维度的对应映射。

Conclusion: 所提出的框架可为区块链金融应用的严谨分析与更安全设计提供支撑，有助于识别和控制策展人中介控制带来的新风险。

Abstract: Decentralized finance (DeFi) vaults are smart-contract-based asset management systems that pool deposits, execute programmable strategies, and mint tokenized shares representing claims on underlying assets and strategy performance. As vault designs have evolved from early yield aggregators to modular, actively managed systems, a new control layer, curation, has emerged to select strategies, configure risk parameters, and coordinate operational execution, introducing principal-agent dynamics and new failure modes.
  This paper systematizes DeFi vault architectures and curator-mediated control planes through (i) a unified system model and formal definitions for share accounting, roles, and operational dependencies, and (ii) three complementary taxonomies covering vault exposures and objectives, curator governance and accountability mechanisms, and strategy execution patterns together with their failure modes. We further map a representative set of production protocols to the proposed dimensions. The frameworks in this work aim to support rigorous analysis and safer design of blockchain-based financial applications.

</details>


### [321] [PACE: Provenance-Aware Capability Enforcement for Tool-Using LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01349)
*Fengpeng Li,Qizhou Wang,Yuke Hu,Kemou Li,Jun Liu,Haiwei Wu,Jiantao Zhou,Di Wang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出 PACE（溯源感知能力强制执行），在工具调用执行前进行中介，通过路径限制、能力与效果验证，实现约 62/79 攻击列最低攻击成功率且效用损失不超过 3 分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具型 LLM 智能体将生成文本转化为真实副作用，被投毒的工具元数据、检索页面、记忆与可复用技能都可能操控下一次调用。仅在准入前审查工件无法解决该问题：安全变体与泄露变体可产生相同准入证据，健全的门控无法据此放宽。因此需要作用于部署阶段仍可干预的"最后边界"。

Method: PACE 在每次工具调用执行前进行中介：1）路径限制（path confinement）对被表示的影响路径做可执行切割；2）能力与效果验证，将模式定义的效果与从已认证请求编译的权限进行比对。论文区分"认证执行契约"与"评估配置"，后者可在拟议阻断后恢复经授权调用或施加声明的修复；限制要求最终动作保留认证切割。

Result: 在八个可执行智能体安全基准、三个目标模型族上，评估配置在 79 个可用攻击列中有 62 列取得严格最低攻击成功率，14 列打平；全基准原生效用相对未防御智能体损失至多 3 分。1167 对配对案例的完整消融显示，多数安全增益归因于效果验证，拒绝控制归因于边界自适应。缩小规模的自适应搜索在越权目标上对防御成功率为 0/30。

Conclusion: 执行前中介配合路径限制与效果验证，可有效防御工具元数据、检索、记忆与技能投毒；消融揭示效果验证为主要增益来源，边界自适应主要贡献于拒绝控制。

Abstract: Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents turn generated text into real side effects, so poisoned tool metadata, retrieved pages, memory, and reusable skills can steer the next call. Vetting an artifact before admission does not settle this. A safe variant and a leaking variant can produce the same admission evidence, and a sound gate then cannot relax that site for either. We make that condition precise, which leaves the last boundary a deployment can still act on. We present Provenance-Aware Capability Enforcement (PACE), which mediates every tool call immediately before it executes. Path confinement proposes an executable cut of represented influence paths, while capability and effect verification checks schema-defined effects against authority compiled from the authenticated request. We distinguish the certified execution contract from the evaluated configuration, which can restore an authorized call after a proposed block or apply a declared repair. Confinement requires the final action to preserve the certified cut. On eight executable agent-security benchmarks with three target-model families, the evaluated configuration gives strictly lowest attack success in 62 of 79 eligible attack columns and ties in 14; full-benchmark native utility loses at most three points relative to the undefended agent. A complete ablation over 1167 paired cases attributes most security gains to effect verification and refusal control to boundary adaptation. A reduced-scale adaptive search succeeds on 0/30 out-of-authority targets against the defense.

</details>


### [322] [Sleeping Secrets: How Fine-Tuning Reawakens Privacy Risks in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01365)
*Jianhong Li,Jiahao Chen,Yuwen Pu,Chunyi Zhou,Oubo Ma,Zhou Feng,Hangtao Zhang,Jichao Bi,Chunqiang Hu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出ReGap，一种无需真实隐私监督的无数据微调攻击，利用LLM自身生成的候选作为监督即可恢复已遗忘的私有关联。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有微调恢复攻击依赖来自原训练分布的"真实隐私监督"，这种假设不切实际，因此作者追问：在没有此类先验知识的情况下，隐私恢复是否仍然可能。

Method: ReGap：以任务结构构造查询、用LLM生成候选答案、按答案token似然筛选监督信号，再通过低秩适配（LoRA）更新目标模型；全程不需要目标答案，也不需要辅助的真实隐私监督。

Result: 在GPT-2、OPT、Qwen3等六类模型上，目标关联恢复率较微调后的目标模型提升6-21个百分点；即便适配身份与所有记忆及评估身份不相交、生成或筛选的监督中不含确切目标答案，恢复仍显著。同一适配器使曾暴露检查点的恢复率由42%升至63%，而在从未见过目标的匹配检查点上无增益。

Conclusion: 仅靠适配本身无法解释观察到的恢复，先前目标暴露程度强烈影响适配后的可恢复性；常规模型定制会重新激活潜在隐私风险，需学界与业界紧急关注。

Abstract: Beyond adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) to specialized applications, fine-tuning has recently been shown to recover private information that is no longer accessible through direct queries. Previous fine-tuning recovery attacks, however, require genuine private supervision drawn from the same distribution, i.e., the previous training dataset. We argue that such recovery remains possible without such impractical knowledge. We show that LLM-generated candidates can provide sufficient supervision to recover previously learned private associations. Based on this, we propose ReGap, a data-free attack that recovers private associations using task structure, filters them by answer-token likelihood, and updates the target model via low-rank adaptation. Specifically, ReGap requires neither target answers nor auxiliary genuine private supervision. Across six GPT-2, OPT, and Qwen3 models, ReGap improves target-association recovery by 6-21 percentage points over the post-training target model. Recovery remains substantial even when the adaptation identities are disjoint from all memorized and evaluation identities, with no exact target answers appearing in the generated or selected supervision. Moreover, the same trained adapters increase recovery from 42\% to 63\% on a previously exposed checkpoint, but produce no gain on a matched checkpoint that never encountered the targets. This contrast shows that adaptation alone is insufficient to explain the observed recovery and that prior target exposure strongly affects post-adaptation recoverability. Our findings highlight that routine model customization can reawaken latent privacy risks, warranting urgent attention from the academic and industrial communities.

</details>


### [323] [High-quality Data Do not Mean Safe! Poisoning LLMs after Data Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01367)
*Kaiyang Li,Jiahao Chen,Yuwen Pu,Chunyi Zhou,Tong Zhang,Bin Cai,Chunqiang Hu,Haibo Hu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 前沿研究发现，安全性对齐的大模型在下游微调时易受少量有害样本攻击，但既有研究忽略了实际训练流水线中的"基于质量的数据筛选"环节。本文系统评估了数据筛选对投毒攻击的防御效果及保留数据的安全性影响，发现部分高质量样本仍可因"类有害"的层级梯度模式而削弱对齐安全性。为此提出 Bi-QSTO 方法，在显式质量约束下优化投毒样本，使其在通过筛选的同时保持安全退化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有投毒研究默认有害/看似无害的投毒样本能直接进入下游微调，而实际训练流水线往往先进行基于质量的数据筛选。这一缺口导致对筛选环节能否作为有效防御的评估缺失，因此需要系统考察筛选对投毒的过滤作用及被保留数据的下游安全影响。

Method: 1) 系统评估质量筛选对投毒样本的过滤效果与被保留数据的下游安全影响；2) 从层级梯度角度分析被保留高质量样本仍能削弱安全对齐的原因（其训练更新模式与有害样本相似）；3) 提出 Bi-Stage Quality-Constrained Safety-Degradation Text Optimization（Bi-QSTO），在显式质量约束下分阶段优化投毒样本，使其既能通过质量筛选又能保留安全退化影响。

Result: 质量筛选可移除大量明显有害样本，但部分被保留的高质量样本仍会削弱模型安全对齐。Bi-QSTO 在多种投毒设置、目标模型与筛选比例下，攻击效果在筛选前后均保持稳定；即便在 90% 筛选率下，有害种子样本的投毒保留率（Poisoning Retention Rate）仍高于 90%，有害分数（Harmful Score）达 3.30–4.01，攻击效果可跨模型强迁移，保留优势也可推广至其他筛选方法。

Conclusion: 基于质量的数据筛选不足以防御投毒攻击：安全退化影响可通过被保留的高质量样本穿透筛选环节。Bi-QSTO 系统性地利用了该漏洞，在严苛筛选条件下仍维持高保留率与高攻击有效性，并具备跨模型迁移性与跨筛选方法的泛化性，揭示了实际训练流水线中一个值得重视的安全风险。

Abstract: Safety-aligned Large Language Models remain vulnerable to fine-tuning on small sets of harmful or benign-looking samples. However, prior studies typically assume that poisoned samples directly enter downstream fine-tuning, overlooking quality-based selection in practical training pipelines. To fill this gap, we systematically evaluate both the filtering effects against poisoning and the downstream safety impact of retained data. The results reveal that selection removes many overtly harmful samples, yet some retained high-quality samples can still degrade model safety alignment possibly due to their harmful-like training-update patterns at the layer-wise gradient level. Together, these findings expose a practical vulnerability: safety-degrading influence can pass through quality-based selection via retained high-quality samples. To examine its systematic exploitability, we propose Bi-Stage Quality-Constrained Safety-Degradation Text Optimization (Bi-QSTO), which optimizes poisoned samples under an explicit quality constraint to survive selection while preserving their safety-degrading influence. Across poisoning settings, target models, and filtering rates, Bi-QSTO maintains attack effectiveness before and after selection. Even at 90% filtering, harmful-seeded samples achieve a Poisoning Retention Rate above 90% and Harmful Score of 3.30--4.01. Their attack effectiveness strongly transfers across models and their retention advantage generalizes to additional selection methods.

</details>


### [324] [Is it Possible to Generate Irreversible PolyProtected Templates from Face Embeddings using System-Specific Keys?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01385)
*Vedrana Krivokuća Hahn,Jérémy Maceiras,Sébastien Marcel*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文验证了在人脸嵌入上使用系统特定密钥运行PolyProtect时能否生成不可逆保护模板，并给出三种可行密钥选取方式，证明系统特定密钥场景不降低模板保护能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PolyProtect传统采用主体特定密钥（每个主体有各自的C、E参数），但该设置与不可链接性冲突，无法在保护域内进行人脸身份去重；因此需要研究能否改用系统特定密钥（所有主体共享同一C、E参数）并仍保持不可逆性与模板保护潜力。

Method: 在人脸嵌入上应用PolyProtect，系统性地构造系统特定密钥：(i) 从预先选定的主体特定密钥中选取；(ii) 将已有密钥选取算法应用于随机向量；(iii) 通过近似“良好”的C/E对分布来构造系统特定密钥。实验为开源可复现。

Result: 证明至少存在三种系统性地选取系统特定密钥的方法，均能产生不可逆的PolyProtected模板。

Conclusion: 可以安全地在系统特定密钥场景下运行PolyProtect而不降低模板保护潜力，从而为PolyProtected域中的身份去重提供了可能性。

Abstract: This work aims to answer the question of whether it is possible to generate irreversible protected templates when the PolyProtect biometric template protection method is applied to face embeddings using system-specific keys (i.e., the same C and E parameters, which define the transform, are applied to all subjects' face embeddings), instead of the traditional subject-specific keys (i.e., each subject has their own C and E parameters). This is important for determining whether we can perform de-duplication of face identities in the PolyProtected domain, which is not possible in the subject-specific key scenario due to the clash with PolyProtect's unlinkability property (i.e., one could generate multiple protected templates belonging to the same identity, using different C and E parameters, such that those templates cannot be linked to each other). We present experiments (reproducible using our open-source code) to prove that there exist at least three ways of systematically selecting system-specific keys that produce irreversible PolyProtected templates: (i) from pre-selected subject-specific keys, (ii) by applying a previously proposed key selection algorithm to random vectors, and (iii) by approximating a "good" C/E pair distribution from which system-specific keys can be constructed. Our findings thus point to the conclusion that it is, indeed, possible to safely operate PolyProtect in the system-specific key scenario without degrading the template protection potential. This opens up the possibility for identity de-duplication in the PolyProtected domain.

</details>


### [325] [Evidence Coverage for Intent-Bound Execution: Scope, Obligations, and Cutoff Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01386)
*Mengting Wu,Lin Wang,Yong Zhang,Jiang Deng*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出一种针对"执行证据义务"回溯覆盖率分析模型：在明确声明的范围（意图、候选、分析尝试、证据边界、阶段视野、义务画像、验证者、评估截止点）内判定义务清单闭合与验证者视图闭合，输出三类结果（COMPLETE_WITHIN_SCOPE、INCOMPLETE、UNKNOWN）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 验证者即便逐一认证了现有全部记录，也仍缺乏依据断言某执行账户"完备"，因为完备性主张必须先有"哪些记录本应存在"的正当依据。为此需要把完备性判定从"记录是否存在"转为"应尽义务是否被覆盖"，并界定其依赖的前提。

Method: 构建分析模型：以九类要素绑定评估范围（Intent、Candidate、选定分析尝试、执行与证据边界、阶段视野、固定记录义务画像、指名验证者、评估截止点）；由分支与触发前提生成义务实例，由来源能力、内容、完整性以及对象与阶段绑定判定可采纳性；区分义务清单闭合与相关验证者视图闭合；给出 COMPLETE_WITHIN_SCOPE、INCOMPLETE、UNKNOWN 三种报告结果。

Result: 以构造的服务主体停用（service-principal-disablement）案例演示：完整的派发与拒绝分支、一条到期却缺失的最终结果记录、迟交后的后续覆盖，以及将单次选定尝试的覆盖外推至全部尝试的局限。执行进度、外部结果知识与历史交付及时性另行报告。

Conclusion: 贡献在于将范围、分支、视野、义务、可采纳性、视图与截止点组合成面向具体执行的完备性判定框架；完备性始终相对于所声明义务画像与评估前提而成立，是有条件的、可追溯的结论而非绝对断言。

Abstract: A verifier may authenticate every available record and still lack grounds to call an execution account complete. Such a claim requires a justified account of which records were due for the execution being assessed. We present an analytical model for retrospective coverage of declared execution-evidence obligations. Its scope binds a structured Intent, an exact Candidate, a selected analytical attempt, an execution and evidence boundary, a stage horizon, a fixed record-obligation profile, a named verifier, and an assessment cutoff. Branch and trigger premises determine obligation instances; source competence, content, integrity, and object and stage bindings determine admissibility. We distinguish closure of the obligation inventory from closure of the relevant verifier view, and define three reporting results: COMPLETE_WITHIN_SCOPE, INCOMPLETE, and UNKNOWN. These results concern current coverage of obligations due at the cutoff. Execution progress, external outcome knowledge, and historical delivery timeliness are reported separately. Constructed service-principal-disablement cases demonstrate complete dispatch and refusal branches, a due but missing final-result record, subsequent coverage after late delivery, and the limits of extending one selected attempt's coverage to all attempts. The contribution is an execution-specific composition of scope, branch, horizon, obligations, admissibility, view, and cutoff. Completeness remains conditional on the declared profile and assessment premises.

</details>


### [326] [Key-Reuse Vulnerability of Phase-Keyed Fourier-Curve Modulation: Relation Leakage and Key-Refresh Cost on Coded Links](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01484)
*Bin Han,Muxia Sun,H. Vincent Poor,Hans D. Schotten*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该论文研究键控调制在密钥复用与谐波耦合波形下的安全性，提出基于模关系格的"关系矩"泄露机制与相应攻击，证明无需枚举密钥空间即可部分恢复密钥，并给出刷新调度所需的密钥速率下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统键控调制的安全性多依据密钥空间大小与无密钥接收机误码率来论证；但当密钥被复用且波形存在谐波耦合时，这一证据失效，需要重新刻画其真实安全边界。

Method: 针对相位键控傅里叶曲线星座（k个音共享一个数据参数），利用谐波索引间的整数关系构造数据抵消的混合矩；用模关系格刻画被暴露的密钥字符，对连续谐波用三阶矩恢复相对相位、四阶矩（系数非零时）将密钥恢复到循环重标号意义下；并提出非数据辅助的关系矩估计器，将泄露转化为无需枚举密钥空间的攻击。

Result: 在规则(3,6)LDPC编码链路上，每168符号码字一个密钥时，中等噪声下窃听者块错误率低于0.04，12个工作点中有11个满足预设的0.1妥协判据；切线人工噪声与四阶以下无关系谐波集可在中等复用长度下提高窃听者误码率，但无法消除单码字脆弱性；在2^128密钥网格、中等噪声下，要维持窃听者块错误率95%置信下界高于0.9，等效刷新调度需每信息比特至少1.52个新密钥比特，是一次一密数据熵率的1.52倍。

Conclusion: 谐波耦合下的键控调制存在由关系矩导致的结构性密钥泄露，密钥复用与短码字场景尤为脆弱；单纯的人工噪声或谐波筛选只能部分缓解，需要足够的密钥刷新速率（至少1.52倍数据熵率）才能保持安全裕度。

Abstract: The security of keyed modulation is often argued from the key-space size and the error rate of a key-less receiver. This evidence fails when the key is reused and the waveform is harmonically coupled. For a phase-keyed Fourier-curve constellation, whose $k$ tones share one data parameter, integer relations among the harmonic indices yield data-cancelling mixed moments of the received tones that expose key characters. A modular relation lattice characterizes the exposed characters; for consecutive harmonics, third-order moments recover the relative phases and a fourth-order moment completes the key up to cyclic relabeling whenever its coefficient is nonzero, as in all evaluated settings. A non-data-aided relation-moment estimator turns this leakage into an attack that never enumerates the key space. On a regular $(3,6)$ LDPC-coded link, one key per 168-symbol codeword leaves the eavesdropper a block error rate below $0.04$ at the middle noise level, and the attack meets a predeclared $0.1$ compromise criterion in eleven of twelve operating points. Tangent artificial noise and a harmonic set without relations below order four raise her measured error rate at intermediate reuse lengths but do not remove the one-codeword vulnerability. For a grid of $2^{128}$ protocol keys at the middle noise level, equal-length refresh schedules that keep a $95\%$ lower confidence bound of her block error rate above $0.9$ consume at least $1.52$ fresh key bits per information bit, $1.52$ times the entropy rate of a one-time pad on the data.

</details>


### [327] [OverAct: Measuring and Mitigating Proactive Over-Authorization in LLM Tool-Calling Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01508)
*Taolin Zhang,Jiuheng Wan,Hanyu Wang,Tingyuan Hu,Chengyu Wang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 论文研究结构化工具调用LLM智能体的"主动过度授权"（proactive over-authorization）行为，提出受控基准OverAct与决策论框架，发现所有模型均显著超出授权范围，且该行为主要源于结构性决策倾向而非解码随机性；同时提出零样本推理时方法SelfAudit，在无预言知识情况下将隐私导向的越权访问降低43%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具备工具调用能力的LLM智能体可访问外部服务与用户私有数据，但可能检索超出用户请求明确所需的信息。该问题不同于文件系统级编码智能体，其核心风险在于对私有数据的不必要访问。作者旨在系统刻画并缓解这一失败模式。

Method: 提出OverAct：覆盖八个隐私敏感领域的受控基准，采用确定性、无需评判者的评分方式；并构建解释性决策论框架，导出三个可检验预测。在来自四个模型家族的七个模型上进行评估，分析请求具体性、工具池规模、解码温度的影响。另提出SelfAudit：零样本推理时方法，生成以请求为依据的理由，并在执行前过滤无正当理由的调用，通过消融验证显式过滤是范围缩减的主要驱动因素。

Result: 所有模型均显著超出授权范围；请求具体性是严重程度的最强预测因子；过度授权随工具池规模呈次线性增长；解码温度影响甚微。这些模式与成本不对称解释一致。SelfAudit在无预言知识条件下将隐私导向的越权访问减少43%，消融显示显式过滤是主要贡献来源。

Conclusion: 过度授权更多源于结构性决策倾向而非解码随机性，属于系统性问题而非采样噪声；通过在执行前引入基于请求的显式正当性过滤，可在无需预言知识的情况下有效降低隐私越权访问。

Abstract: LLM agents with tool-calling capabilities can access external services and private user data, but they may retrieve more information than a user's request explicitly requires. We study this behavior in structured tool-calling agents and term it proactive over-authorization. This setting differs from filesystem-level coding agents because the main risk is unnecessary access to private data. We introduce OverAct, a controlled benchmark spanning eight privacy-sensitive domains with deterministic, judge-free scoring, together with an interpretive decision-theoretic framework that yields three testable predictions. Across seven models from four families, all models significantly exceed authorized scope. Request specificity is the strongest predictor of severity, over-authorization grows sublinearly with tool-pool size, and decoding temperature has little effect. These patterns are consistent with a cost-asymmetry account, suggesting that over-authorization arises more from structural decision tendencies than from decoding randomness. We also propose SelfAudit, a zero-shot inference-time method that generates request-grounded justifications and filters unjustified calls before execution. Ablation shows that explicit filtering is the main driver of scope reduction. SelfAudit reduces privacy-oriented excess by 43% without oracle knowledge.

</details>


### [328] [False Floors: LLM Safety Routing Evaluations Break Under Distribution Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01535)
*Amit Singh Bhatti,Vishal Vaddina*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 安全路由器的评测存在"选择偏差"：基准用评估数据挑最佳单模型作对照，分布偏移下代价可观，且"识别式防御"可被知悉目标模型身份的对手显著削弱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全路由器（safety router）的评测通常以"最佳单模型"为对照，而该对照是在评测数据上选出的。在基准自身设定下无害，但在分布偏移下会引入乐观偏差：此前工作仅证明偏差方向，未定量其规模，也未考察对准确率与"识别式防御"可操纵性的影响。

Method: 在 HELM Safety、AgentDojo 及七个预先用固定规则选定的安全语料上，量化选择成本：比较随机划分与留出类别（held-out categories/suites）下的表现；将偏差上界分解为"乐观项 + 依赖偏移的 regret"；用已注册的区间检验与后置置换零假设检验进行统计验证。另做针对后派发注入的对抗实验：让攻击者知晓所面对的具体模型，并在留出重跑中检验识别判定的可操纵性，以及离线反事实地将其组合进控制器。

Result: HELM Safety 上选择成本为随机划分下 0.003–0.030、留出类别下 0.045–0.113 的有害率，与归因于路由的全部缺口相当，方向在任一已发布评判器下均成立；AgentDojo 留出套件时上升 7–9 倍。七个语料中三个通过注册区间检验，四个击败后置置换零假设；区间未达标的三个中，多为部分模型观测有害为零的语料。诚实的偏移评测下路由收益甚微：多数池单元中嵌套路由器实际服务的是诚实基线所选模型；近乎饱和的 AgentDojo 上，完美预派发路由器最多值 2 个有害率点。对手知情时，可将 GPT-5.4 对晚期注入的判定识别率压低 19.6 点（独立标签确认）；离线反事实组合中，同样攻击因回退模型不同而抬高或降低估计有害率。

Conclusion: 安全路由必须在分布偏移下评测，且对照模型应在不使用测试标签的前提下选定；否则选择成本可与路由整体收益相当甚至更大。基于识别的防御应按"对知晓模型身份的对手所造成的有害率"来评分——因为模型对晚期注入的识别是可被引导的。诚实评测下，这些基准上的路由收益有限。

Abstract: Safety routers send each request to one of several models and are judged against the best single model. A major routing benchmark picks that comparator on the evaluation data. In the benchmark's own setting this is harmless, but under distribution shift it is not. On HELM Safety the selection cost is 0.003-0.030 of harm under random splits and 0.045-0.113 under held-out categories, comparable to the whole deficit attributed to routing, with its direction holding under either published judge alone. It rises seven- to ninefold on AgentDojo when suites are held out. Across seven safety corpora chosen by rules fixed in advance, three meet a registered interval test and four beat a later permutation null, and three of the four interval misses are corpora where some models have zero observed harm. Prior work proves the direction of this bias. We size it on harm and accuracy, show that it is larger under the held-out splits we measure, and bound it by optimism plus a shift-dependent regret. Scored honestly under shift, routing buys little on these benchmarks. In most pool cells the nested router serves the honest baseline's model, and on the nearly saturated AgentDojo corpus a perfect pre-dispatch router is worth at most two points of harm. We also find a model's expressed recognition of a late injection steerable. On held-out reruns an attacker who knows which model it faces lowers GPT-5.4's judged recognition by 19.6 points, confirmed by an independent label. In an offline counterfactual composition into a controller, the same attack raises or lowers estimated harm depending on the fallback model. Safety routing should be evaluated under shift, against a baseline chosen without the test labels, and recognition-based defences should be scored on harm against an attacker who chooses what the model sees.

</details>


### [329] [Chaining Skills to Hijack LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01564)
*Tian Dong,Zixuan Ma,Haodong Zhao,Huaien Zhang,Shaofeng Li,Hao Chen*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出APEX方法，通过构建"对抗性技能链"将攻击者意图植入LLM智能体的多技能协作流程中：上游技能诱导智能体生成一份"用户已批准"的虚假进度记录，下游技能据此执行攻击者指定的动作。在SkillsBench的6个模型上，690次尝试中512次（74.2%）成功触发目标动作；GPT-5.4完整链路成功率84.3%，而合并为单一技能时仅17.4%。提示词防御可将成功率从84.3%降至59.1%，但良性任务通过率也从86.7%降至56.3%，存在明显的安全性—可用性权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体为完成专门任务会按序调用多个技能，前一技能产出的信息会指导后续技能决策。由于技能常来自开源仓库，这一"交接"过程可能把攻击者控制的声明带入后续决策，形成新的安全风险。论文旨在刻画并量化这种跨技能链式攻击的可行性与危害，并评估现有防御的有效性及其副作用。

Method: 提出APEX：针对给定用户任务与攻击者选定目标动作，自动构造并迭代精炼对抗性技能链。核心机制是"可信进度记录"的滥用——由上游技能诱导智能体生成一条包含"用户已批准"虚假声明的真实任务进度记录，下游技能再读取该记录以推动攻击者选定动作。实验覆盖4类目标动作族、6个模型，在SkillsBench上共690次尝试，并与"将工作流合并为单一技能"的对照设置进行比较；同时评估一种要求智能体将技能产出文件与原始请求进行核对的提示词防御。

Result: 跨4类目标动作族与6个模型，对抗技能链在690次尝试中成功诱导选定动作512次（74.2%）。在GPT-5.4上，完整链成功率84.3%，而合并为单一技能时仅17.4%。提示词防御使GPT-5.4的目标动作成功率从84.3%降至59.1%，但在72个良性原生技能任务上，验证通过率从86.7%降至56.3%。

Conclusion: 多技能顺序交接会放大攻击面：仅靠将技能链合并并不能消除风险（反而显著降低攻击成功率），说明攻击依赖跨技能的记录传递而非单纯技能数量。现成提示词防御虽能部分抑制攻击，但以显著牺牲正常任务性能为代价。因此亟需设计既能阻止攻击者导向动作、又能保持合法任务表现的新型防御机制。

Abstract: LLM agents use skills to improve performance on specialized tasks. To complete a user request, an agent may invoke several skills in sequence, allowing information produced under one skill to guide the next. Because skills may come from open-source repositories, this handoff can also carry attacker-controlled claims into later decisions. In this paper, we introduce APEX, which constructs and refines adversarial skill chains tailored to a user task and an attacker-selected action. The key insight is that an agent-written record of genuine task progress can carry a false claim of user approval across skills: an upstream skill induces the agent to create the record, and a downstream skill uses it to direct the attacker-selected action. Across four targeted-action families and six models on SkillsBench, the chains induce the selected action in 512 of 690 attempts (74.2%). On GPT-5.4, the full chain succeeds in 84.3% of attempts, compared with 17.4% when the workflow is merged into one skill. We further evaluate a prompting defense that asks the agent to check skill-produced files against the original request. On GPT-5.4, it lowers targeted-action success from 84.3% to 59.1%, while the verifier test-pass rate across 72 benign native-skill tasks falls from 86.7% to 56.3%. These results highlight the need for defenses that prevent attacker-directed actions while preserving legitimate task performance.

</details>


### [330] [Protocol Integration of Physical Layer Deception into EAP-TEAP Wi-Fi Authentication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01580)
*Moustafa Ibrahim,Bin Han,Hans D. Schotten*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于批处理的物理层欺骗（PLD）二次验证步骤，嵌入企业级Wi-Fi的TEAP/RADIUS/IEEE 802.11认证链，并在开源hostap 2.12上实现服务器、接入点与设备的端到端原型。每次验证包含三轮、至少一轮激活且无专用激活标志；通过1593次尝试评估批量恢复、拒绝朴素凭证攻击、时延与安全-可靠性权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于凭证的EAP认证无法区分合法凭证持有者与使用被窃凭证的攻击者。现有PLD研究仅停留在物理/链路模型层面，且将PLD激活/去激活机制用作认证门会产生认证特有的设计约束：若全部去激活则不会触发任何恢复路径。因此需要面向认证场景重新设计PLD机制。

Method: 在开源hostap 2.12代码库中，跨服务器、接入点与设备端到端实现基于批处理的PLD二次验证步骤，并将其嵌入企业Wi-Fi的TEAP/RADIUS/IEEE 802.11认证链。每次尝试包含三轮、至少一轮激活，且不使用专用激活标志。共设计四个实验活动、合计1593次尝试，评估批量恢复行为、对朴素凭证攻击者的拒绝率、成功路径时延，以及在两种建模恢复机制下分别针对1、2、3轮激活的安全-可靠性权衡。

Result: 原型直接作用于协议与软件MAC行为：在全部30次尝试中成功拒绝所实现的朴素凭证携带攻击者；测得成功路径时延；并给出在两种恢复机制下1/2/3个激活轮次的安全-可靠性权衡结果；同时在软件恢复模型下分析了知情攻击者与重试型攻击者。

Conclusion: 批处理PLD二次验证可作为凭证式EAP认证的补充，在不依赖专用激活标志的前提下暴露欺骗性主对象并沿次信道传输恢复对象，且已在真实开源协议栈上端到端可行；为安全-可靠性权衡提供了可量化的实验依据。

Abstract: Credential-based Extensible Authentication Protocol (EAP) authentication cannot distinguish a legitimate credential holder from an adversary using compromised credentials. Physical Layer Deception (PLD) complements credential-based authentication by exposing a deceptive primary object over a primary transport while a separate recovery object travels with differentiated reliability over a secondary channel. Existing PLD studies remain, to our knowledge, at the physical/link-model level; using PLD's activation/deactivation mechanism as an authentication gate creates an authentication-specific design requirement, since an all-inactive attempt would exercise no recovery path. We present a batched PLD-based re-verification step for Enterprise Wi-Fi's TEAP/RADIUS/IEEE 802.11 authentication chain, implemented end to end across the server, access point, and device in the open-source hostap 2.12 codebase. Each attempt carries three rounds, at least one active, with no dedicated activation flag. Across four campaigns totaling 1593 attempts, the prototype evaluates batched recovery behavior, rejects the implemented naive credential-bearing attacker in all 30 attempts, measures successful-path latency, and evaluates the security-reliability trade-off for one, two, and three active rounds under two modeled recovery regimes. The evaluation exercises the protocol and software-MAC behavior directly and analyzes informed and retry-seeking attackers under the software recovery model.

</details>


### [331] [Combining Homomorphic Encryption and Differential Privacy in Federated Learning for Model Inspection and Availability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01650)
*Ceren Yıldırım,Kamer Kaya,Sinan Yıldırım,Erkay Savaş*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种结合同态加密训练与差分隐私模型检查/发布的联邦学习隐私保护框架，并用MCMC贝叶斯方法估计隐私，实验表明其模型效用与估计隐私均优于纯差分隐私基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习本身不足以充分保护敏感训练数据，常需配合差分隐私、同态加密等技术，但单一机制只能解决部分问题，难以兼顾隐私与效用，因此需要融合多种隐私保护手段的框架。

Method: 提出隐私保护联邦学习框架：以同态加密进行模型训练，结合差分隐私进行模型检查与发布；采用基于马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）的贝叶斯隐私估计方法评估所提框架的隐私水平。

Result: 在FEMNIST数据集上，训练结束时本方法测试损失为1.09，而仅用差分隐私的方法为2.37；本方法估计隐私参数ε的后验均值为4.32，优于纯差分隐私方法的7.26。此外，间歇性模型监控可保持加密训练轨迹，并在其实验设定下提供与纯差分隐私相当或更强的估计隐私。

Conclusion: 将同态加密训练与差分隐私模型检查/发布相结合，能同时提升模型效用与估计隐私，优于仅依赖差分隐私的基线；间歇性模型监控在保持加密训练轨迹的同时可提供具有竞争力的隐私保护。

Abstract: The increasing prevalence of decentralized data has led to a growing interest in federated learning, which enables collaborative model training without clients sharing their sensitive local data. However, FL alone does not sufficiently protect sensitive training data and is generally coupled with privacy-preserving techniques, such as differential privacy and homomorphic encryption. Although powerful, these techniques address separate concerns via different mechanisms, so relying on just one might prove insufficient or impractical for addressing challenges associated with federated learning. In this work, we propose a privacy-preserving federated learning framework that combines homomorphic encryption-based training with differential privacy-based model inspection and release. We adopt a Markov chain Monte Carlo-based Bayesian privacy estimation method to estimate the privacy of our proposed framework. Our results show that this method improves both model utility and estimated privacy over the baseline method that relies solely on differential privacy for training. In our experiments with the FEMNIST dataset, by the end of training, our method reaches a test loss of $1.09$, compared to $2.37$ for the differential privacy-only approach, while providing stronger estimated privacy protection, with the estimated posterior mean of the privacy parameter $ε$ of $4.32$, compared to $7.26$ for the differential privacy-only approach. We also show that intermittent model monitoring can preserve the encrypted training trajectory while, under our evaluated experimental setting, providing estimated privacy comparable to or stronger than the differential privacy-only approach.

</details>


### [332] [The Achilles' Heel of Partial Reconfiguration: Optical Side-Channel Leakage on the 7-Series ICAP](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01736)
*Antonio Saavedra,Jan Caspar Marx,Lars Renkes,Jean-Pierre Seifert*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该论文针对AMD 7系列FPGA提出一种基于部分重配置的非对称密钥比特流保护方案的原型实现，分析其安全性与硬件开销，并通过光子发射显微与电光探测实现光学侧信道攻击，从ICAP接口无接触地恢复明文配置数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流FPGA厂商采用比特流加密保护敏感配置数据，但广泛使用的FPGA系列中硬连线、不可修补的防护方案已被多种攻击绕过或完全破解，因此需要可修补的加密方案；同时需评估此类新方案在物理侧信道层面的实际安全性。

Method: 1) 基于可编程逻辑实现部分重配置，对AMD提出的7系列FPGA非对称密钥比特流保护方案进行概念验证实现；2) 分析该实现的安全影响与硬件开销；3) 提出并演示光学侧信道攻击：利用光子发射显微（PEM）与电光探测（EOP）先定位、再以无接触方式从ICAP接口提取明文数据。

Result: 在AMD XC7A200T器件中定位到ICAP总线，并证明可通过电光探测提取其上的数据，从而在动态重配置过程中恢复明文配置数据。

Conclusion: 即使采用部分重配置与定制密码引擎的高级加密方案，也仍然易受光学攻击，因为重配置只能通过硬连线且存在脆弱性的配置接口进行。

Abstract: Major FPGA manufacturers have incorporated bitstream encryption to protect sensitive configuration data. However, for the most widely used FPGA families, multiple attacks against unpatchable protection schemes hard-wired into the devices can bypass or fully break them, making patchable schemes desirable.
  In this work, we present a proof-of-concept implementation of an AMD-proposed asymmetric key encryption scheme for bitstream protection for 7-Series FPGAs, using partial reconfiguration from the Programmable Logic. We analyze the security implications and hardware overhead of this implementation. We then propose and demonstrate an optical side-channel attack that is able to recover plain-text configuration data during the dynamic reconfiguration process. This attack leverages Photon Emission Microscopy and Electro-Optical Probing to first locate and then contactlessly extract the plain-text data from the ICAP interface, which internally connects the Programmable Logic with the configuration logic.
  We located the ICAP buses in an AMD XC7A200T device and show that the data on it can be extracted with Electro-Optical Probing. We claim that even advanced encryption schemes utilizing Partial Reconfiguration and custom cryptographic engines are vulnerable to optical attacks, as reconfiguration is only possible via hard-wired, vulnerable configuration interfaces.

</details>


### [333] [SoK: Decentralized Agent Economic Infrastructure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01756)
*Rui Sun,Xihan Xiong,Qin Wang,Fei Gao,Zelin Li,Zehua Cheng,Jiahao Sun,Zhipeng Wang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文系统化研究去中心化智能体经济中"各步骤正确但整体结果错误"的保证断裂问题，提出17个属性族、六阶段生命周期框架及"保证闭包"准则，并在可控与真实工作流上验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 去中心化智能体经济常由独立设计与独立安全化的协议拼装成单一任务，导致工作流在每一步看似正确、整体结果却错误。例如，托管机制在授权批准时正确放款，却缺乏证据证明交付物真正满足任务要求。

Method: 将安全与经济需求组织为覆盖六个阶段的17个属性族，单独评估收据的可靠性与完整性；考察12个系统与标准、5类可复用机制族及4种经典基线；提出"保证闭包"这一任务相对性准则，用于判定某阶段建立的保证在后续依赖决策中是否仍然可用并能施加约束；在可控与原生工作流上应用该准则，覆盖840次配对执行，并在有限客观任务域上做11,648用例的穷举检查。

Result: 暴露出验证与结算之间反复出现的失败模式：符合要求的工作可能未被接受，或有效证据被忽略。公共记录与模型判断进一步区分了"已记录的批准"与"任务符合性的证据"，经济分析则识别出这些保证背后依赖的报告、惩罚与共享错误假设。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了端到端保证失效的具体位置，并指出需修复的环节，以使保证能够跨工作流各阶段保持有效与连续。

Abstract: Decentralized agent economies increasingly build a single task from protocols that were designed and secured separately. This creates a simple problem: a workflow can look correct at each step and still produce the wrong outcome. For example, a correct escrow may release payment on an authorized approval that provides little evidence that the delivered work actually satisfied the task.
  We systematize this problem across the full lifecycle of an agent task. Our study organizes security and economic requirements into 17 property families over six stages, with receipt soundness and completeness assessed separately. We examine 12 systems and standards, five reusable mechanism families, and four classical baselines. We introduce guarantee closure, a task-relative criterion for determining whether guarantees established at one stage remain available and constrain the later decisions that depend on them.
  We apply the criterion to controlled and native workflows, covering 840 matched executions and an exhaustive 11,648-case check over a finite objective-task domain. Our results expose recurring failures between verification and settlement, where conforming work can remain unaccepted or valid evidence can be ignored. Public records and model judgments further distinguish recorded approval from evidence of task conformance, while economic analysis identifies the report, penalty, and shared-error assumptions behind these guarantees. These findings show where end-to-end guarantees fail and what must be repaired to preserve them across the workflow.

</details>


### [334] [The Innocent Courier: Covert Exfiltration Through Legitimate LLM Web Fetching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01768)
*Alessandro Pegoraro,Daryan Merx,Phillip Rieger,Ahmad-Reza Sadeghi*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出 LLMLeak，一种利用 LLM 网站抓取工具构建隐蔽信道、将本地机密数据泄露给第三方的攻击向量，在 11 个开放参数模型上取得 79.7% 的攻击成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究主要关注提示注入和向聊天机器人运营商泄露敏感数据等风险，但 LLM 还存在向第三方泄露机密数据的新风险；同时，本地恶意软件无法直接联网，需要借助 LLM 建立外传通道。

Method: 恶意本地软件组件将秘密嵌入 URL，并把该网站伪装成良性任务（如迁移软件库）所需信息的来源；当 LLM 调用其网页抓取工具访问该 URL 时，攻击者通过其控制的 DNS 或 Web 服务器接收编码后的秘密。该方法仅依赖 LLM 获取网页信息的工具，规避了直接生成网络代码的检测与网络库限制。

Result: 在 11 个开放参数模型上进行广泛评估，攻击成功率达 79.7%；并在真实聊天机器人上开展案例研究，验证了 LLMLeak 的现实相关性。

Conclusion: LLMLeak 揭示了 LLM 工具调用能力可被滥用为隐蔽外传信道，构成对机密数据的新型第三方泄露威胁，需引起安全防护方面的重视。

Abstract: With the increasing capabilities of Large-Language-Models (LLMs) and LLM-based agents, users are increasingly using them to solve everyday problems, such as answering e-mails or providing programming support. Existing work has extensively investigated security and privacy risks, such as prompt injections and the disclosure of sensitive data to chatbot providers. While various solutions were developed to address these risks, including input structuring to prevent prompt injections or deploying local LLMs to avoid sharing confidential data with chatbot operators, LLMs also pose the risk of leaking confidential data to third parties.
  In this paper, we demonstrate with LLMLeak a novel attack vector where malicious software that runs locally but cannot communicate directly with the internet abuses LLMs to establish a covert channel. While inputs that instruct the LLM to send data directly via generated code are easy to detect and network libraries are typically restricted, LLMLeak relies only on the LLM's tool to fetch websites for further information. A malicious software component on the client side embeds a secret into a URL. It presents the referenced website as providing information required for a benign task, such as migrating a software library. When the LLM accesses the URL, the attacker receives the encoded secret through an attacker-controlled DNS or web server. We perform an extensive evaluation on eleven open-parameter models, observe an attack success rate of 79.7%, and also conduct a case study on real-world chatbots, demonstrating the relevance of LLMLeak.

</details>


### [335] [Walking the Embedding Space: Datastore Extraction from Multimodal RAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01871)
*Maria Carmen Jica,Ali Satvaty,Suzan Verberne,Fatih Turkmen*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出IM-MRAG——一种针对图像返回式多模态检索增强生成（MRAG）的黑盒自适应数据提取攻击方法，通过将恶意指令嵌入查询图像并结合相关性加权重采样，实现大规模数据窃取。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MRAG虽能降低幻觉、提升生成可靠性，但引入了新的攻击面，如隐私泄露与数据提取攻击。现有提取攻击多以文本提示诱导模型泄露数据，缺乏针对"检索到的视觉产物即响应"这一图像返回式配置的自动化黑盒攻击手段。

Method: IM-MRAG为自适应、自动化的黑盒数据提取攻击。每条查询将攻击者持有的影子图像与已从系统中恢复的图像混合，利用相关性加权重采样引导后续查询朝向嵌入空间中仍能产生新颖检索结果的区域；与现有攻击不同，恶意指令被嵌入用户输入的图像中，而非文本提示。

Result: 在医疗助手、文档助手和通用工具三类真实场景中，针对多种CLIP系列检索器与不同生成器进行评测。单次2500次查询可重建最多611张放射图像、566份文档扫描件和416张通用图像（基于局部特征对应），且数据存储条目数最高为非自适应基线的5.6倍。

Conclusion: 实验表明图像返回式MRAG存在严重的数据提取风险，亟需专门针对多模态数据设计的安全防护措施。

Abstract: Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (MRAG) has emerged as a reliable and cost-effective technique of grounding the generative capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) into relevant, up-to-date, external knowledge. Despite presenting several benefits, such as reducing hallucinatory behavior, they also introduce new attack surfaces, including leakage of private information and vulnerabilities against data extraction attacks.
  In this paper, we introduce $\immrag$, an adaptive and automatic data extraction attack procedure operating in a black box setting against \emph{image-returning} MRAG, a configuration in which the retrieved visual artifact is itself the response. Each query blends an attacker-held shadow image with an image already recovered from the system, and relevance-weighted resampling steers subsequent queries towards regions of the embedding space that still yield novel retrievals. Unlike current extraction attacks that aim to persuade the model towards data leakage by placing a malicious query as a textual prompt, $\immrag$ embeds the malicious instructions inside a user-given input image. We evaluate $\immrag$ on three plausible and distinct real-world scenarios: medical assistant, document-focused helper and general purpose tool. The experiments involve the study of the effectiveness of the attack on multiple CLIP-family retrievers, as well as the impact of various generators. A single 2500-query run reconstructs up to 611 distinct radiology images, 566 document scans and 416 general-purpose images under local-feature correspondence, and reaches up to $5.6\times$ as many distinct datastore items as a non-adaptive baseline. Our results show the urgent need for safeguards specifically designed for multimodal data.

</details>


### [336] [From Network Intrusion Detection to Blockchain-Backed Endpoint Detection and Response: Mapping the Landscape of Decentralized Detection-and-Response Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01872)
*Yahya Shahsavari,Sara Rouhani,Kaiwen Zhang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文是一篇SoK论文，提出三维分类法梳理区块链辅助IoT/IIoT入侵检测研究，并指出端点上区块链锚定的响应闭环仍近乎缺失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有区块链辅助IDS/IPS综述存在两大局限：忽视向EDR/XDR架构的结构性转变，且将区块链的功能角色混为单一类别，无法准确刻画研究现状。

Method: 提出一个三维分类框架，按检测系统类别（NIDS、HIDS、EDR/XDR）、区块链功能角色、响应自动化成熟度对相关方案进行归类；综合2019至2026年间发表于高影响力刊物的研究，并据此开展差距分析。

Result: 差距分析显示，受时延、部署及社区匹配度等因素制约，真正的逐端点、区块链锚定响应闭环几乎不存在；同时识别出跨研究普遍存在的结构性挑战，包括受限设备上的共识时延、后量子密码脆弱性、智能合约攻击面，以及基于大语言模型检测引擎的对抗脆弱性。

Conclusion: 应以链上链下混合编排为核心研究议程，在去中心化信任与快速响应自动化之间建立桥梁，推动逐端点区块链锚定响应闭环的实现。

Abstract: While the literature on blockchain-assisted intrusion detection and prevention systems (IDS/IPS) for Internet of Things (IoT) and Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) networks is mature, existing systematic reviews suffer from two critical limitations: they overlook the structural shift toward modern Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) and Extended Detection and Response (XDR) architectures, and they conflate blockchain's distinct functional roles into a single monolithic category. This Systematization of Knowledge (SoK) addresses these gaps by proposing a three-axis taxonomy that classifies proposals by detection-system class (NIDS, HIDS, EDR/XDR), blockchain functional role, and response-automation maturity. Synthesizing research published in high-impact venues between 2019 and 2026, we provide a rigorous gap analysis exposing why a genuine per-endpoint blockchain-anchored response loop remains nearly nonexistent due to latency, deployment, and community mismatches. Furthermore, we evaluate structural, cross-cutting challenges persisting across the literature, including consensus latency on constrained devices, post-quantum cryptographic vulnerability, smart-contract attack surfaces, and the adversarial vulnerability of evolving LLM-based detection engines. Finally, we outline a comprehensive research agenda centered on hybrid on-chain/off-chain orchestration to bridge the gap between decentralized trust and rapid response automation.

</details>


### [337] [A Structured State Space Sequence Model for Multi-Class Classification of Malware](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01893)
*Emmanuela Andam,Rana Shaaban,Emanuel Grant,Naima Kaabouch*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该研究提出基于结构化状态空间序列（S4）模型的恶意软件检测与分类框架，用于提升IoT系统安全性。这是S4在恶意软件分析中的首次实证应用，并与多种深度学习架构进行了性能对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 到2030年IoT设备预计达400亿台，广泛覆盖工业、医疗、农业、汽车及楼宇/家居自动化等领域，但多数设备缺乏内置安全机制，形成巨大攻击面。现有网络安全措施无法跟上IoT及其每日新增恶意软件变种的快速增长，因此亟需更有效的检测与分类方法以保护设备并增强IoT系统鲁棒性。

Method: 采用结构化状态空间序列（S4）模型，将恶意软件样本表示为序列并进行离散化处理，从而捕获长程依赖关系，识别恶意软件执行流中隐含的"因"与"果"。

Result: 提供了S4模型用于恶意软件分析的首次实证应用，并对其与其他深度学习架构的性能进行了全面对比。

Conclusion: S4模型为恶意软件检测与分类提供了新范式，并为该方向的后续研究奠定基础。

Abstract: By 2030, Internet of Things (IoT) devices are projected to reach 40 billion, with fast-paced technological advancements in fields such as industry, healthcare, agriculture, automobiles, and building/home automation systems. This expansion has created a large attack surface for cybercrime, as the majority of these devices open the door for cybercriminals to exploit vulnerabilities, as they lack adequate built-in security. Cybercriminals launch malware attacks to compromise systems or steal sensitive data, and once a system is compromised, a ransom is typically demanded for its release. Current cybersecurity measures in place are being outpaced by the rapid growth of the IoT, which is accompanied by a subsequent growth in malware variants being created per day. Recognizing this pitfall, this research examines and proposes a novel approach to malware detection and classification to safeguard devices from further attacks and make IoT systems more robust and secure. The framework proposed utilizes a Structured State Space Sequence (S4) model, which discretizes sequences of malware samples in a sequence and captures long-range dependencies, essentially identifying the "cause" and "effect" hidden within malware execution flow. This study presents two novel contributions: the first empirical application of the S4 model for malware analysis, and a comprehensive comparison of its performance against other deep learning architectures, laying the stepping stone for future research in this new paradigm.

</details>


### [338] [Detection and Resolution of Periodic Artifacts in OpenDP's Discrete Laplace Sampler](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01907)
*Cesare Gerolimetto Fabrello,Valeria Rossi,Alberto Trombetta,Massimo Caccia*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文发现OpenDP离散拉普拉斯采样器存在周期性分布失真伪影，通过诊断方法定位到bernoulli_exp1依赖的有理算术库实现缺陷，并提出基于精确有理算术的替代实现予以消除。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 差分隐私的正式隐私保证依赖于对噪声分布的精确采样，而OpenDP离散拉普拉斯采样器中存在系统性伪影，破坏了这一前提，因此需要定位并修复其根源。

Method: 对输出分布进行系统测试以揭示周期性失真；采用诊断方法在嵌套采样层级中逐层隔离出故障组件，最终定位到bernoulli_exp1（实现Bernoulli(e^(-x))采样的底层原语）所依赖的有理算术库的错误实现；随后提出基于精确有理算术的替代实现。

Result: 使用10^6个样本进行统计验证，确认修正后的采样器输出在测试精度下与理论分布无法区分。

Conclusion: OpenDP离散拉普拉斯采样器的伪影源于底层有理算术库缺陷，通过精确有理算术实现可彻底消除该问题，为差分隐私采样器的正确性验证提供了可复用的诊断思路。

Abstract: Differential privacy implementations rely on precise sampling from noise distributions to provide formal privacy guarantees. We report the discovery of systematic artifacts in OpenDP's discrete Laplace sampler that manifest as periodic distortions in the output distribution. Through systematic testing, we trace these artifacts to a faulty implementation in the rational arithmetic library used by the bernoulli_exp1 function, a low-level primitive that implements sampling from Bernoulli(e^(-x)) distributions. We present a diagnostic methodology that isolates the faulty component in the nested sampling hierarchy and propose an alternative implementation based on exact rational arithmetic that eliminates the artifacts. Statistical validation with 10^6 samples confirms that the corrected sampler produces outputs indistinguishable from the theoretical distribution at the tested precision level.

</details>


### [339] [A Hybrid Approach to Malware Detection: Integrating Few-Shot Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning with Autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01949)
*Emmanuela Andam,Yasir Abbas Zaidi,Abdelali Hadir,Emmanuel Grant,Naima Kaabouch*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出一种结合自编码器特征提取器(AFE)与模型无关元学习(MAML)分类器的混合深度学习框架,用于小样本勒索软件检测,在1至50样本设置下均取得高精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 勒索软件攻击频发且危害严重,通常经钓鱼邮件、恶意下载或漏洞利用入侵系统,加密文件并索要加密货币赎金。传统检测方法面对新型或稀缺样本时表现不佳,系统易受攻击,因此需解决小样本条件下的检测难题。

Method: 构建混合深度学习框架:AFE生成紧凑的潜在特征以降低噪声与维度;MAML分类器利用少量标注数据快速适应新威胁。二者结合实现小样本恶意软件检测。

Result: 在Ransomware Dataset 2024上开展二分类实验,在1至50样本(one to fifty shot)设置下,模型始终取得高准确率、F1分数与Matthews相关系数(MCC),即使在极端数据稀缺下仍保持可靠分类性能。

Conclusion: 结果验证了模型的鲁棒性与小样本适应能力,表明特征提取与元学习相结合可增强对恶意软件的抵御能力,在医疗、制造与公共基础设施等网络安全影响重大的领域具有应用潜力。

Abstract: Ransomware has emerged as a major cybersecurity threat, with incidents increasing in frequency and impact across critical sectors. These attacks are typically launched through phishing emails, malicious downloads, or exploitation of software vulnerabilities to gain system access. Once inside, the malware encrypts files and demands a ransom, often in cryptocurrency, for the decryption key. Conventional detection methods often struggle with novel or scarce samples, leaving systems vulnerable. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a hybrid deep learning framework that combines an Autoencoder Feature Extractor (AFE) with a Model Agnostic Meta Learning (MAML) classifier for few shot malware detection. The AFE generates compact latent features that reduce noise and dimensionality, while the MAML classifier rapidly adapts to new threats using limited labeled data. Experiments conducted on the Ransomware Dataset 2024 demonstrate the effectiveness of the framework in binary classification tasks. Across one to fifty shot settings, the proposed model consistently achieves high accuracy, F1 score, and Matthews Correlation Coefficient values, maintaining reliable classification even under extreme scarcity.
