These results highlight the model's robustness and effectiveness in adapting to limited data scenarios, demonstrating the potential of combining feature extraction with meta learning to enhance resilience against malware, particularly in sectors such as healthcare, manufacturing, and public infrastructure, where cyberattacks can cause significant operational and financial disruption.

</details>


### [340] [System-Level Optimization Beyond Cryptographic Kernels: An ML-KEM Case Study on Arm Cortex-M7](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01960)
*Mahmoud Abdelhafeez Sayed,Mostafa Taha,Gurp Nijjer*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 在Arm Cortex-M7上以ML-KEM为案例，研究表明在指令级优化之外，通过内存层次利用、紧耦合内存放置、外设集成、时钟配置和公共数据复用，仍可获得显著性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有嵌入式后量子密码研究主要集中于指令级优化，如算术内核改进、汇编调优、寄存器分配和指令调度，但可能忽视了执行系统中其他层面的优化潜力。

Method: 以Arm Cortex-M7上的ML-KEM为案例，从SLOTHY优化实现出发，评估内存层次利用、紧耦合内存放置、外设集成、时钟配置以及确定性公共数据复用等优化手段，覆盖全部三组ML-KEM参数，且不修改密码算法或标准化线格式。

Result: 在不使用辅助公共状态的配置下，周期数最多减少2.5%；选定的公共数据复用配置使封装和解封装周期分别最多减少74.6%和58.8%。

Conclusion: 算术内核优化之后仍存在可观的部署性能收益，研究据此提出一个同时考察周边执行系统的两阶段方法学。

Abstract: Recent work on embedded post-quantum cryptography has focused primarily on instruction-level optimization, including arithmetic-kernel improvements, assembly tuning, register allocation, and instruction scheduling. Using the Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism (ML-KEM) on an Arm Cortex-M7 as a case study, we examine the additional gains available from memory-hierarchy utilization, tightly coupled memory placement, peripheral integration, clock configuration, and deterministic public-data reuse. The evaluation starts from a state-of-the-art SLOTHY-optimized implementation and covers all three ML-KEM parameter sets. Without modifying the cryptographic algorithm or standardized wire formats, the evaluated profiles without auxiliary public state reduce cycles by up to 2.5%. A selected public-data-reuse profile reduces encapsulation and decapsulation cycles by up to 74.6% and 58.8%, respectively. These results demonstrate that substantial deployment gains remain after arithmetic-kernel optimization and motivate a two-stage methodology that also examines the surrounding execution system.

</details>


<div id='cs.DC'></div>

# cs.DC [[Back]](#toc)

### [341] [Pushing CPU Speech Synthesis to the Wall: Extreme Inference Tuning under Serverless Architecture and Billing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00063)
*Pakorn Nathong,Kunat Pipatanakul*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出面向实例计费无服务器平台的计费感知神经TTS服务方案，通过请求级并发推理与可回收实例生命周期，在Kokoro-82M上实现每音频小时成本从$0.0631降至$0.0153（4.1倍），空闲计费内存从8.7 GB降至1.33 GB。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实例计费的无服务器平台按热实例生命周期的CPU与内存收费，使空闲推理状态成为直接服务成本。传统运行时不适配该场景：逐请求并行在并发下引发CPU争用，而热实例保留数GB可计费的推理状态与页缓存。

Method: 提出请求规模并发推理（request-sized concurrent inference）以限制单请求CPU并行度；并提出可回收实例生命周期（reclaimable instance lifecycle），在空闲期释放推理状态与页缓存内存，同时保留服务进程与编译缓存。

Result: 在Kokoro-82M上达到每CPU秒2.71音频秒（ONNX Runtime默认仅0.89）；每音频小时成本从PyTorch的$0.0631降至$0.0153（4.1倍），空闲计费内存从8.7 GB降至1.33 GB；恢复至首段音频仅需2.2 s，而PyTorch冷启动为7.7 s。

Conclusion: 在无服务器CPU上应优化CPU秒与GB秒而非仅吞吐或延迟。突发流量下，生命周期回收是将推理效率转化为更低无服务器成本的关键。

Abstract: Instance-billed serverless platforms charge for CPU and memory over the lifetime of a warm instance, making idle inference state a direct serving cost. We present billing-aware neural text-to-speech (TTS) serving on serverless CPUs, optimizing CPU-seconds and GB-seconds rather than throughput or latency alone. Conventional runtimes are poorly suited to this setting: per-request parallelism causes CPU contention under concurrency, while warm instances retain gigabytes of billable inference and page-cache state.
  We address these costs with request-sized concurrent inference, which bounds per-request CPU parallelism, and a reclaimable instance lifecycle, which releases inference state and page-cache memory after idle periods while retaining the server process and compile cache. On Kokoro-82M, our system achieves 2.71 audio-seconds per CPU-second versus 0.89 with ONNX Runtime defaults and reduces cost per audio-hour from $0.0631 with PyTorch to $0.0153, a 4.1x reduction. Idle billed memory falls from 8.7 GB to 1.33 GB, while restoration reaches first audio in 2.2 s versus 7.7 s for a PyTorch cold start. Under bursty traffic, lifecycle reclamation is essential for translating inference efficiency into lower serverless cost.

</details>


### [342] [MegaFlux: Skew-Resilient MoE Megakernels via Pipelined Expert Replication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00671)
*Jianzhu Yao,Siva Kumar Sastry Hari,Vignesh Balaji,Sana Damani,Insu Jang,Pramod Viswanath,Christos Kozyrakis*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: MegaFlux 将专家复制变为运行时决策，并在持久化 MoE 执行中流水线化复制引发的通信，在 B200 上实现前向 1.45×、反向 1.28× 的几何平均加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE megakernel 融合专家并行通信与计算，但固定专家放置下路由偏斜会造成 GPU 负载不均（straggler）：过载 GPU 决定层延迟，其余 GPU 空闲。复制热点专家可转移负载，但动态副本带来额外开销——副本需接收专家权重，训练时其部分权重梯度还需在专家属主处归约。

Method: MegaFlux 将专家复制作为运行时决策，并把复制引发的通信流水线化进持久化 MoE 执行。设备端 planner 在每 GPU 副本预算下联合选择副本位置并分配 tile 对齐的 token 块，保持 router 输出不变。前向与反向 megakernel 实现流水线复制：副本在所需权重到达时即开始计算，反向则将副本梯度归约与正在进行的专家计算重叠。工作扩展了 TensorRT-LLM 的 CuTeDSL MegaMoE 前向 kernel，并新增反向 MoE megakernel。

Result: 在 8 张 NVIDIA B200、每方向 147 种配置下，相比固定放置的相同 megakernel，MegaFlux 前向几何平均加速 1.45×、反向 1.28×，峰值分别达 2.14× 与 2.64×。消融显示，流水线隐藏了前向 56–76% 的副本权重传输开销，以及反向 91–100% 的权重传输与副本梯度归约合并开销，较相同复制计划下单独执行这些操作额外降低层延迟 13.2% 与 26.7%。集成到 vLLM 用于 DeepSeek-V4-Pro prefill，端到端中位加速 1.13–1.26×。

Conclusion: 通过将专家复制决策运行时化并流水线化其通信开销，MegaFlux 有效缓解了 MoE megakernel 中的路由偏斜导致的 GPU 负载不均，在不改变 router 输出的前提下显著提升前向与反向性能，并在真实推理框架中取得端到端收益。

Abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) megakernels fuse expert-parallel communication with expert computation. However, under fixed expert placement, routing skew creates GPU stragglers: overloaded GPUs determine layer latency while others sit idle. Replicating hot experts can shift work to underloaded GPUs, but dynamic replicas introduce additional work: replicas must receive expert weights to execute and, during training, their partial weight gradients must be reduced at the expert owners. We present MegaFlux, which makes expert replication a runtime decision and pipelines the communication induced by replication within persistent MoE execution. An on-device planner jointly selects replica locations and assigns tile-aligned token blocks under a per-GPU replica budget, leaving router outputs unchanged. The forward and backward megakernels realize pipelined expert replication: replicas begin computation as their required weights arrive, while backward overlaps replica-gradient reduction with ongoing expert computation. MegaFlux extends TensorRT-LLM's CuTeDSL MegaMoE forward kernel and introduces a new backward MoE megakernel. Across 147 configurations per direction on eight NVIDIA B200 GPUs, MegaFlux achieves geometric-mean speedups of $1.45\times$ for forward and $1.28\times$ for backward over the same megakernels with fixed placement, peaking at $2.14\times$ and $2.64\times$. In ablations, pipelining hides $56$--$76$% of replica-weight transfer cost in forward and $91$--$100$% of combined weight-transfer and replica-gradient-reduction cost in backward, yielding up to $13.2$% and $26.7$% additional layer-latency reductions over the same replication plans with these operations executed separately. Integrated into vLLM for DeepSeek-V4-Pro prefill, MegaFlux delivers $1.13$--$1.26\times$ median end-to-end speedups over fixed placement.

</details>


### [343] [Leto: Fast In-Place Recovery for LLM Training on Surviving Hardware](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00687)
*Geon-Woo Kim,Joon Ha Kim,Daehyeok Kim*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: Leto 是一种容错训练系统，利用存活硬件实现原地恢复，避免检查点重载与进度重算，显著提升有效训练时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 硬件可操作故障（HOFs）会使 LLM 训练中断，但无需重置、修复或更换硬件即可在同硬件上恢复。现有恢复系统仍依赖检查点重载、重算丢失进度并重建进程状态，导致本可继续训练的 GPU 处于空闲状态，造成资源浪费和训练效率下降。

Method: 核心思想是在活动训练进程之外保留或准备恢复所需状态，同时使其驻留于同一硬件。Leto 保留工作模型状态与可复用进程状态，并在影子训练器中预初始化其余状态；采用两级纠删保护与块级事务更新，保证保留的模型状态可恢复且一致；当活动训练需要 GPU 显存时回收影子状态。

Result: 在 6 卡与 72 卡 NVIDIA A100 集群上，Leto 的恢复速度比最佳检查点基线快 3.6–6.5 倍，有效训练时间最多提升 13.7 个百分点；大规模仿真显示在 131,072 卡集群上有效训练时间超过 95%。

Conclusion: Leto 通过影子训练器、状态保留与事务更新机制，实现了硬件可操作故障下的高效原地恢复，避免检查点重载开销，显著提高大规模 LLM 训练的有效时间占比，验证了在超大规模集群上的可扩展性。

Abstract: Hardware-operable failures (HOFs) interrupt large language model (LLM) training but permit recovery on the same hardware without reset, repair, or replacement. Existing recovery systems nevertheless reload checkpoints, recompute lost progress, and rebuild process state, idling GPUs that could otherwise continue training.
  We present Leto, a fault-tolerant training system that leverages surviving hardware to enable efficient in-place recovery. Our key insight is that the state needed to resume training can be retained or prepared outside the active training process while remaining on the same hardware. Leto retains the working model state and the reusable process state, and preinitializes the remaining state in a shadow trainer. We devise two-tier erasure protection and chunk-level transactional updates to keep the retained model state recoverable and consistent, and reclaim the shadow state when active training needs its GPU memory. Evaluation on 6- and 72-GPU NVIDIA A100 clusters shows that Leto recovers 3.6--6.5$\times$ faster than the best-performing checkpointing baselines and improves productive training time by up to 13.7 percentage points. Large-scale simulation shows over 95% productive training time on a 131,072-GPU cluster.

</details>


### [344] [Ditto: Generalized Reconfigurable Linearizable Reads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00702)
*Aleksey Panas*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 该论文对分布式数据存储中保证线性一致性的各类专用读算法进行统一建模与数学分析，揭示读写延迟与网络方差容忍度两组基本权衡，提出新算法Pairwise Quorums并构建可运行时重配置的Ditto，从而在统一模型中涵盖并超越现有算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性一致性代价高昂，而读操作占主导，因此出现了多种专用读算法。但没有一种算法在所有部署场景下都是最优的，缺乏统一框架来解释其原因并指导选择。作者希望揭示算法最优性依赖网络与工作负载条件的根本原因，并弥补现有算法在权衡空间中的覆盖缺口。

Method: 提出一个将现有专用读算法归入同一广义空间的分类框架，并对延迟作为该广义参数的函数进行数学分析；据此推导出两组基本权衡；基于分析发现的缺口设计新算法Pairwise Quorums，并进一步构建可在运行时随条件变化在权衡空间中重配置的Ditto。

Result: 分析暴露出两组基本权衡：读延迟与写延迟之间的权衡，以及读与写对网络方差容忍度之间的权衡，二者共同导致最优算法依赖于随时间变化的网络与工作负载条件。同时发现一个缺口：存在一种在不增加写代价的前提下最小化读与并发写重叠时延的方法，但现有算法只能应用于权衡空间的子集。Pairwise Quorums与Ditto的组合对每个现有算法要么严格更优，要么在真实权衡处重配置以匹配之。

Conclusion: 现有专用读算法并非普适最优，其性能本质上受制于读写延迟与网络方差容忍度的权衡，并随环境变化而改变。Pairwise Quorums填补权衡空间缺口，Ditto实现运行时自适应重配置，二者在统一模型下涵盖了所有现有算法，为线性一致读提供了更优且自适应的解决方案。

Abstract: Linearizability gives developers the illusion that operations on a distributed datastore execute sequentially on a single machine. Providing it is expensive, so numerous specialized reads algo- rithms have been proposed to make reads significantly faster without sacrificing linearizability, which matters because most workloads are read-dominant by orders of magnitude. Yet, none of these algorithms is the best choice for every deployment. We show why with a framework that classifies these algorithms into a generalized space together with a mathematical analysis of their latencies as a function of this generalization. The analysis exposes two fundamental tradeoffs, one between read and write latency and one between read and write tolerance to network variance, which together leave the best algorithm dependent on network and workload conditions that vary over time. It also exposes a gap: there is a way to minimize the delay a read incurs when it overlaps a concurrent write, at no cost to writes, yet exist- ing algorithms can apply it only for a subset of the tradeoff space, forcing any deployment that needs the full space to settle for a strictly worse solution. We close this gap with a new algorithm, Pairwise Quorums, and build a second, Ditto, that reconfigures across the space at runtime as conditions change. Together they subsume every existing algorithm under our model: against each, the combination is either strictly better, or reconfigures to match it where a genuine tradeoff applies.

</details>


### [345] [MANTA: Machine Learning Augmented Tiering Advisor](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00714)
*Johannes Freischuetz,Kiet Pham,Sujay Yadalam,Konstantinos Kanellis,Michael Swift,Shivaram Venkataraman*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出ChOMP离线优化器与MANTA在线策略，利用运行时访问特征预测页面未来有用性并集成到ARMS中，在CXL与Optane内存分层场景下显著优于现有启发式策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 内存分层通过DRAM与CXL等慢速层组合扩展容量，但其效果依赖将有用页面保留在快速层。现有启发式策略在阶段性或突发性工作负载中难以跟上热集变化，导致性能机会被浪费。

Method: 首先提出可扩展的离线优化器ChOMP，最小化放置成本与带宽敏感的迁移成本；进而构建基于迹的模拟器，以ChOMP为参考基准识别在线策略的性能机会；据此设计MANTA，从运行时访问特征预测页面未来有用性，并将轻量学习模型集成进ARMS。

Result: 在模拟CXL的八种工作负载、4 GB快速内存下，MANTA相对ARMS的几何平均加速比在Linux 6.2与6.18上分别为1.12倍与1.08倍；在六种Optane工作负载上为1.69倍。单工作负载最高加速：CXL（Linux 6.2）达1.25倍，CXL（Linux 6.18）达1.21倍，Optane达5.6倍。

Conclusion: 基于学习预测页面有用性的MANTA能有效应对热集动态变化，在CXL与Optane内存分层环境下稳定超越现有启发式策略ARMS，验证了离线参考指导在线策略设计的有效性。

Abstract: Memory tiering has been used to expand memory capacity, particularly in datacenters, by combining fast DRAM with slower tiers, including CXL-attached memory. Its effectiveness depends on keeping useful pages in the fast tier, but existing heuristic policies can lag behind changing hot sets in phased or bursty workloads. To explore these limitations, we introduce ChOMP, a scalable offline optimizer that minimizes placement and bandwidth-sensitive migration costs. We then develop a trace-driven simulator that uses this reference to identify performance opportunities for online policies. Motivated by these results, MANTA predicts future page usefulness from runtime access features and integrates a lightweight learned model into ARMS. Across eight workloads on emulated CXL, MANTA achieves geometric-mean speedups over ARMS of 1.12$\times$ and 1.08$\times$ at 4~GB of fast memory on Linux 6.2 and 6.18, respectively; across six Optane workloads, it achieves 1.69$\times$. On individual workloads, MANTA is up to 1.25$\times$ faster than ARMS with emulated CXL on Linux 6.2, 1.21$\times$ on Linux 6.18, and 5.6$\times$ with Optane.

</details>


### [346] [Seamless Reconfiguration for DAG-BFT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00896)
*Michael Yiqing Hu,Leander Jehl,Paul Franke-Bergmann,Jialin Li,Christian Berger*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了首个面向全异步网络中基于DAG的拜占庭原子广播的"无缝重配置"协议，允许成员集合与法定人数阈值变化时DAG继续增长，无需暂停系统或等待预设纪元边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异步网络下的拜占庭原子广播受FLP不可能性限制，需借助可靠广播与私有硬币实现概率1终止。DAG-Rider提出的DAG抽象将传播与定序分离，引发大量后续工作，但重配置问题基本未被探索：现有DAG型BFT协议一般假设进程集合静态，而实际系统需按运维需求增删节点。已有方案要么暂停系统，要么把成员变更推迟到预定纪元边界，可能不切实际并引入停机。而无缝方案并不平凡——关于何时开始使用新配置的共识可能产生一个已被并发异步传播超越的逻辑轮号。

Method: 提出一种面向异步DAG型拜占庭原子广播的无缝重配置协议。核心在于处理"逻辑轮号冲突"：新配置生效时的逻辑轮号可能已被并发异步传播超越，协议据此设计成员集合与法定人数阈值变更机制，使DAG在重配置过程中持续增长而无需停机。

Result: 实现了成员集合与法定人数阈值变化期间DAG的不间断增长，避免系统暂停与停机，且无需等待预设纪元边界即可完成重配置。

Conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首个在全异步网络下为基于DAG的拜占庭原子广播提供无缝重配置的协议，填补了该方向的研究空白。

Abstract: Byzantine Atomic Broadcast in Asynchronous networks has been studied extensively for decades. The FLP impossibility result rules out deterministic consensus in a fully asynchronous setting, motivating randomized protocols that combine reliable broadcast with private coins to achieve termination with probability one.
  More recently, DAG-Rider popularized a new abstraction in which processes continuously reliably broadcast blocks to construct a directed acyclic graph (DAG) and then locally derive a total order using a randomized perfect coin. This separation of dissemination from ordering has renewed interest in asynchronous DAG-based Byzantine fault tolerance and inspired numerous protocols that improve expected latency or throughput.
  Reconfiguration, however, remains largely unexplored. Existing DAG-based BFT protocols generally assume a static set of processes, whereas deployed systems must occasionally add or remove nodes in response to operational demands. Existing solutions are not seamless; they either pause the system or delay membership changes until a predetermined epoch boundary. This may be impractical and can introduce downtime. However, a seamless solution is non-trivial; agreement on when to start utilizing a new configuration may yield a logical round number that was already surpassed by the concurrent asynchronous dissemination.
  In this work, we present a seamless reconfiguration protocol for asynchronous DAG-based Byzantine atomic broadcast. Our protocol allows the DAG to continue growing while the membership and corresponding quorum thresholds change, without halting the system. To the best of our knowledge, ours is the first protocol to provide seamless reconfiguration for DAG-based Byzantine atomic broadcast in a fully asynchronous network.

</details>


### [347] [The Other Half of Workflow Portability: Evidence-Backed HPC Site Profiles with Agentic Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00971)
*Md Saiful Islam,Douglas Thain*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出“HPC站点画像”——一种结构化、有证据支撑的文档，自动采集站点资源形状、存储配置、网络权限与运行策略等信息，使工作流跨站点部署可从人工试错转为可自动预检。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可移植方案（包管理器、容器、工作流规范如backpacks）只解决“工作流需要什么”这一半问题，未描述“站点必须如何使用”，导致即便工作流本身可移植，迁移到新站点仍需人工调整。站点知识分散于批处理系统、文档散文与路由器配置中，自动化部署工具难以将其转化为部署决策。

Method: 按信息所在位置分三步自动构建画像：1）测量登录节点；2）用有界语言模型代理从文档中抽取类型化字段；3）对仍可解决但未决的字段提交试验作业（pilot jobs）。每个字段须经证据验证，否则丢弃，由规则而非模型决定是否纳入画像。

Result: 在Purdue Anvil、TACC Stampede3与Notre Dame CRC三个站点构建了站点画像，并给出对真实工作流进行预检的案例研究：画像可将工作流预检为执行计划，或提前给出可解释的失败原因。

Conclusion: HPC站点画像补齐了工作流可移植性缺失的一半，将难以利用的站点知识转为可执行文档，并以规则校验保证可靠性，从而实现跨站点自动预检、减少人工试错。

Abstract: Moving a workflow developed and tested at one HPC site to another rarely succeeds without some amount of trial and error. Package managers rebuild software environments, containers ship whole filesystems, and workflow specifications such as backpacks package a workflow with its software, data, and resource requirements. These approaches address one half of workflow portability: what a workflow needs. But none describes how a given HPC site must be used, and that missing half is why even a portable workflow requires manual adjustment at each new site. That gap includes the site's resource shape, storage configuration, network permissions, and operating policies. This information may be explicit in the batch system, hidden in the prose of documentation, or buried deep within a router's configuration, making it difficult for an automated deployment tool to turn site knowledge into useful deployment decisions. We propose the HPC site profile, a structured, evidence-backed document that makes this knowledge actionable. We automatically construct it in three steps that mirror where the information lives: measuring the login node, extracting typed fields from documentation with a bounded language-model agent, and submitting pilot jobs for eligible unresolved fields. Every field is verified against its evidence or discarded, so a rule, not the model, decides what enters the profile. The profile then preflights a workflow into an execution plan or an early, explainable failure. We build profiles at Purdue Anvil, TACC Stampede3, and Notre Dame CRC and present a case study of preflighting a real workflow.

</details>


### [348] [Serving a Revisable World: Versioned Execution for Interruptible Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01160)
*Yanxin Zhang,Rahul Sharma,Nitin Vegesna,Zheyu Fu,Chang Liu,Trivikram Krishnamurthy*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出 Retire，一种面向 LLM 服务系统的"版本化执行"控制平面，将请求资源与执行版本权威解耦，实现废弃工作的快速失效与有效状态的选择性继承。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM agent 在用户改指令、工具失败或新信息改变计划时需要修订正在运行的任务。现有服务器将修订实现为"中止旧请求+提交替代请求"，但分别处理以下两类义务会带来问题：旧执行的缓冲输出与未完成工作仍可能影响应用（过时效果被发布），而已完成的 KV 状态对替代请求仍有价值却被浪费，迫使后继者重建有效状态。

Method: 核心是"版本化执行"：请求拥有调度与内存资源，执行版本拥有"权威"（即发布输出或安装状态为当前执行的许可）。Retire 的流程为：先撤销过时工作，然后对其剩余执行施加边界并认证后继可继承的已完成前缀；后继从该前缀状态继续运行，同时被隔离的旧资源异步回收。从而在单次版本转换中统一了快速失效与选择性保留。作者在 vLLM 中实现 Retire，覆盖输出发布、GPU 执行、KV 交接、分层恢复以及分布式与多租户服务等路径。

Result: 正确性实验验证了各路径上的当前版本输出与有效状态继承。在受控配对实验中，将失效与继承结合使修订到后继的首 token 时间（TTFT）中位数降低 17.1%。对真实编码 agent 中断到达记录的回放显示：不产生任何过时输出，且每个最终版本在反复修订中持续向前推进。

Conclusion: Retire 将传统的"中止并重启"转变为协调式交接：既能迅速停止过时工作，又能为后继保留有用的工作成果。

Abstract: LLM agents revise running tasks when users change instructions, tools fail, or new information changes a plan. Today's servers express a revision as aborting old requests and submitting replacements. Yet the old execution's buffered output and outstanding work must stop affecting the application, while completed KV state may still be useful to its replacement. Handling these obligations separately can leave obsolete effects publishable and force the successor to rebuild valid state.
  We present \retire, a serving control-plane redesign around \emph{versioned execution}. Requests own scheduling and memory resources; execution versions own \emph{authority}, the permission to publish output or install state for the current execution. \retire first revokes obsolete work, then bounds its remaining execution and certifies the completed prefix its successor can inherit. The successor runs from that state while isolated old resources are reclaimed asynchronously. This unifies fast invalidation and selective preservation in one version transition.
  We implement \retire in vLLM across output publication, GPU execution, KV handoff, tiered recovery, and distributed and multi-tenant serving. Correctness experiments verify current-version output and valid state inheritance across these paths. Combining invalidation with inheritance reduces revision-to-successor time-to-first-token by a median 17.1\% in controlled paired experiments. A replay of recorded coding-agent interruption arrivals emits no obsolete output and keeps every final version progressing through repeated revisions. \retire turns abort-and-restart into a coordinated handoff that stops obsolete work quickly and preserves useful work for its successor.

</details>


### [349] [RapidMoE: Exploiting Cross-Asymmetry via Adaptive Residual Offloading for Large-Scale MoE Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01265)
*Wenxun Wang,Likai Ma,Zongle Huang,Chen Tang,Yongpan Liu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: RapidMoE：利用MoE路由负载偏斜与异构硬件差异之间的“跨不对称性”，通过残差拆分的比特级卸载实现大规模MoE高效推理，解码最高3.5倍、预填充2.1倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE广泛部署于异构平台，但大规模MoE的算法需求与硬件特性存在根本性错配。现有CPU-GPU混合推理系统要么在向GPU加载专家时遭遇PCIe带宽瓶颈，要么过度依赖CPU计算，导致资源利用率低，且随参数规模扩大必然违反固定延迟预算。

Method: 提出并利用“跨不对称性”（Cross-Asymmetry），即MoE路由的算法负载偏斜与异构硬件物理差异之间的结构性对齐。设计RapidMoE残差卸载系统，基于残差拆分框架将卸载范式从专家级转向比特级，涵盖三个维度：（1）数据表示，实现紧凑且解耦的存储；（2）路由策略，将计算划分为与硬件能力对齐的双路径；（3）执行并行，在设备间调度均衡的存储-计算负载。此外采用统一多级重要性仲裁，在运行时自适应调整关键专家集合。

Result: 实验表明，RapidMoE相比最先进的卸载系统，解码阶段最高实现3.5倍加速，预填充阶段实现2.1倍加速。

Conclusion: RapidMoE通过挖掘内在的跨不对称性，从根本上打破了算法与硬件的错配，在保证精度-延迟帕累托前沿的同时实现了大规模MoE推理的高效部署。

Abstract: The widespread adoption of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) has created a growing need for deployment on heterogeneous platforms. However, it exposes a fundamental mismatch between the algorithmic demands of large-scale MoE and the disparate characteristics of hardware.Existing CPU-GPU hybrid inference systems fail to resolve this as they either encounter PCIe bandwidth bottlenecks when loading experts to GPUs, or rely heavily on CPU computation. Consequently, this leads to low resource utilization and inevitable violations of fixed latency budgets as parameters scale. In this paper, we identify and exploit Cross-Asymmetry--a structural alignment between the algorithmic workload skew of MoE routing and the physical disparity of heterogeneous hardware. To this end, we introduce RapidMoE, a residual offloading system for efficient large-scale MoE inference. We propose how RapidMoE leverages a residual-split framework to enable offloading paradigm shift from expert-level to bit-level, which unfolds across three key dimensions: (1) data representation, enabling compact and decoupled storage; (2) routing strategy, partitioning computation into dual paths aligned with hardware capabilities; (3) execution parallelism, scheduling a balanced storage-compute workload across devices. We further employ a novel Unified Multi-Level Importance Arbitration to adaptively adjust the critical expert set at runtime, ensuring the accuracy-latency Pareto frontier. These innovations exploit inherent cross-asymmetry, fundamentally breaking the algorithm-hardware misalignment. Experimental results show that RapidMoE achieves up to 3.5x speedup in decoding and 2.1x speedup in prefill compared to state-of-the-art (SOTA) offloading systems.

</details>


### [350] [Blockchain Lifecycle Prediction - Dead Coins](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01379)
*Uwe A. Kuehn,Syed Muhammad Adnan*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文基于LSTM对加密货币资产的“死亡”（失效）进行二分类预测，使用Coin Metrics的日度参考价格与估算市值90天序列（82个资产，41存活/41死亡，2020–2026）。在严格按时间划分的测试集上最佳ROC AUC达0.98，但应用于未见数据时降至0.59–0.65。研究认为价格与市值的时间模式本身含有足以识别趋向经济性停摆资产的判别信号，并指出在当前数据条件下多阶段生命周期建模不可行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自2021年以来发行的代币中超过52%在2025年初前停止交易，加密货币失败现象规模巨大，但对其“死亡”的预测建模研究仍不成熟。主要制约包括：定义含糊（缺乏统一的失败界定）、数据稀缺、以及缺少细粒度的生命周期框架。作者希望验证仅凭公开市场数据与深度学习方法能否预测加密资产的失效。

Method: 采用LSTM循环神经网络，对82个加密资产（41存活、41死亡）的日度参考价格与估算市值的90天序列进行训练，数据来自Coin Metrics，时间跨度为2020至2026年。评估使用严格按时间顺序的train-test划分以避免前视偏差（look-ahead bias）。此外，作者尝试并论证了多阶段生命周期模型的可行性问题，最终转向二分类建模。

Result: LSTM分类器在留出测试集上的最佳ROC AUC达到0.98；但当模型应用于未见数据时，ROC AUC下降至0.59–0.65区间，显示明显的泛化能力衰减。诊断分析表明，失效资产在经济性停摆前的数月内表现为价值渐进侵蚀与波动率升高，而非突发性崩盘。

Conclusion: 价格与市值的时间模式本身即包含足够的判别信号，可用于识别正走向经济性不活跃的资产。研究同时记录了在当前数据条件下构建多阶段生命周期模型的实践不可行性，并据此论证了转向二分类方法的合理性。测试集与真实未见数据之间ROC AUC的巨大落差也提示模型泛化性能仍需进一步验证与改进。

Abstract: The cryptocurrency ecosystem has experienced extraordinary growth alongside an equally remarkable rate of failure, with over 52 percent of all tokens launched since 2021 ceasing to trade by early 2025. Despite the scale of this phenomenon, predictive modeling of cryptocurrency death remains an underdeveloped area of research, constrained by definitional ambiguity, data scarcity, and the absence of granular lifecycle frameworks. This work investigates whether the failure of cryptocurrency assets can be predicted using publicly available market data and deep learning methods. A Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) recurrent neural network was trained on 90-day sequences of daily reference price and estimated market capitalization for 82 cryptocurrency assets (41 alive and 41 dead), sourced from Coin Metrics over the period 2020 to 2026. The model was evaluated using a strictly chronological train-test split to prevent look-ahead bias. The LSTM classifier achieved in best cases a Receiver Operating Characteristic Area Under the Curve (ROC AUC) of 0.98 on the held-out test set. Finally, the model was applied to unseen data, and it was observed that the ROC AUC decreased between 0.59 and 0.65. The findings demonstrate that temporal patterns in price and market capitalization alone contain sufficient discriminative signal to identify assets on a trajectory towards economic inactivity. Diagnostic analyzes reveal that failing assets exhibit gradual value erosion and elevated volatility in the months preceding inactivity, rather than sudden catastrophic collapse. This work also documents the practical infeasibility of a multi-stage lifecycle model under current data conditions and justifies the transition to a binary classification approach.

</details>


### [351] [GPU-Initiated Communication: Dissecting Down to the Bone](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01380)
*Javid Baydamirli,Ismayil Ismayilov,Kaan Oktay,Didem Unat*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 该论文在 GPU-NIC 边界系统剖析 GPU 发起的通信机制，通过最小化传输实现（mini-gda/mini-proxy）将硬件机制成本与库封装成本分离，揭示库开销、队列共享、门铃批处理与连接规模对延迟和吞吐的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GPU 发起的通信支撑 NVSHMEM、NCCL GIN、DeepEP 等库，服务于 MoE 模型细粒度、延迟敏感的通信，但其性能特征与优化方法除源码外鲜有文献记录；且现有多库对比无法区分硬件机制成本与库自身开销。

Method: 分解 GPU 侧网络路径（队列放置、工作请求构造、门铃顺序、完成语义）；提出最小传输 mini-gda 与 mini-proxy，分别对应 GPU 直接提交与 CPU 代理提交路径；在 NVIDIA H100、H200、B200、GB200 平台上与 NVSHMEM IBGDA、NCCL GIN、DeepEP、UCCL-EP、MSCCL++、fabric-lib 进行对比测量。

Result: 最小 GPU 路径下发一次操作耗时 0.7 μs、完成耗时 4.0 μs；各库因队列管理、内存序与完成范围最多额外增加 4.6 μs 下发时间，且下发时间随 SM 时钟缩放。调优的 CPU 代理在空闲时可持平或优于 GPU 路径，代价是占用一个专用核，其运行状态决定延迟与吞吐。与批量流量共享队列会使延迟上升 1–3 个数量级。达到 InfiniBand 平台 260 M msg/s 上限需门铃批处理与队列并行，二者均有资源代价：通信代码即使未使用也会降低 GPU block 驻留；在约 3,000 个活跃连接时，all-to-all 流量损失 59% 的 NIC 消息速率。

Conclusion: 仅凭提交路径无法预测通信性能；硬件机制与库封装成本必须分离评估，队列隔离、门铃批处理与连接规模等系统级因素同样决定实际通信表现。实验代码与结果已开源。

Abstract: GPU-initiated communication lets GPU threads post RDMA operations directly to the NIC. It underpins NVSHMEM, NCCL GIN, and DeepEP, which serve the fine-grained, latency-critical communication of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, yet its performance characteristics and optimizations remain scarcely documented beyond source code, and library comparisons fail to separate the costs of the hardware mechanism from those of the library around it.
  This paper dissects GPU-initiated communication at the GPU-NIC boundary. We first detail the GPU-side network path: queue placement, work-request construction, doorbell ordering, and completion semantics. We then introduce mini-gda and mini-proxy, minimal transports for the GPU and CPU-proxy submission paths, and measure them alongside NVSHMEM IBGDA, NCCL GIN, DeepEP, UCCL-EP, MSCCL++, and fabric-lib on NVIDIA H100, H200, B200, and GB200 platforms. A minimal GPU path issues an operation in 0.7 $μ$s and completes in 4.0 $μ$s; libraries add up to 4.6 $μ$s of issue time through queue management, memory ordering, and completion scope, and issue time scales with the SM clock. A tuned CPU proxy matches or beats the GPU path at idle, at the cost of a dedicated core whose operating state sets its latency and throughput. On either path, sharing a queue with bulk traffic raises latency by one to three orders of magnitude. Reaching the 260 M msg/s ceiling of our InfiniBand platform requires doorbell batching and queue parallelism, and both have resource costs: communication code can reduce GPU block residency even when unused, and all-to-all traffic loses 59% of its NIC message rate at about 3,000 active connections. The submission path alone therefore does not predict communication performance. Our experiment code and results are available at https://github.com/ParCoreLab/Dissecting-GPU-Communication-Experiments.

</details>


### [352] [GridSMR: Causal Compression for Sharded Blockchains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01443)
*Shir Cohen,Adam Alon,Raz Omessi,Amir Sarid,Dana Shamir,Ofir Zohar*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: GridSMR 是一种分片区块链，将原子性定位于账户并异步执行跨账户操作，实现因果压缩，使跨分片延迟不随因果深度增长，单验证者达 1.07M req/s，四验证者达 193K 已提交 req/s。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分片系统通常将协调放置在相互依赖的跨分片步骤之间，导致延迟随因果深度增长，成为水平扩展执行的瓶颈。

Method: 采用 execute-before-agree（先执行后共识）架构：把原子性局部化到单个账户；依赖操作在各分片可用时即异步执行，共识随后验证并提交所生成的调度，从而实现 Causal Compression（因果压缩）。

Result: 单验证者执行达到 1.07M 请求/秒，四验证者执行达到 193K 已提交请求/秒；相比延迟执行（deferred execution），16 跳因果链延迟降低 8.2 倍。

Conclusion: GridSMR 通过账户级原子性与先执行后共识的设计，使跨分片延迟不随因果深度增长，在保持共识验证正确性的同时显著提升分片区块链的横向扩展执行能力与因果链性能。

Abstract: We present GridSMR, a sharded blockchain that scales execution horizontally while allowing dependent cross-shard operations to progress within a single block. Existing sharded systems typically place coordination between dependent cross-shard steps, making latency grow with causal depth. GridSMR localizes atomicity to individual accounts and executes cross-account work asynchronously. Using an execute-before-agree architecture, dependent operations execute across shards as they become available, while consensus later validates and commits the resulting schedule. This enables Causal Compression: cross-shard latency need not grow with the causal depth of a computation. GridSMR scales single-validator execution to 1.07M requests/s and four-validator execution to 193K committed requests/s, while reducing 16-hop causal-chain latency by 8.2x versus deferred execution.

</details>


### [353] [Exploiting the Interplay of Compute- and Memory-Bound kernels in MPI Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01587)
*Ayesha Afzal,Krishna Manda,Georg Hager*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 该论文研究通信稀疏应用中MPI通信停顿对内存带宽竞争的缓解作用，通过光流求解器案例表明自然去同步与计算-内存密集型阶段重叠可带来显著加速，并给出带宽饱和点附近的最优进程配置条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 并行应用通常按同步、锁步方式设计，将通信停顿视为性能危害。作者希望探究在通信稀疏、计算与内存密集阶段交替且无频繁同步点的应用中，通信停顿是否反而能无意中缓解内存带宽竞争。

Method: 以并行光流求解器为案例，该程序由计算密集的光线追踪核与内存密集的光流求解核组成，进程间通信可忽略。通过去同步与自动重叠实现加速，并测量内存带宽饱和点附近的进程数影响；同时考察MPI异步进展对通信开销的影响；进一步开发可调双核微基准以受控方式研究去同步动态；最后用带宽感知的基于模型的模拟器验证结果。

Result: 该程序通过去同步与计算/内存密集阶段自动重叠获得显著加速，表明自然去同步是一种架构感知优化。当并发执行内存密集阶段的进程数接近ccNUMA域带宽饱和点时达到最优加速。使用MPI异步进展减少通信开销反而因过多rank同时争用内存带宽而显著降低性能。微基准显示需要显著的应用或系统噪声（自然或注入）才能实现完全去同步，模拟器验证了这些结果。

Conclusion: 通信停顿在通信稀疏、计算与内存密集交替的应用中可成为有益的去同步机制，自然去同步是一种架构感知优化；最优性能取决于与ccNUMA带宽饱和点匹配的并发进程数，而单纯降低通信开销可能适得其反。

Abstract: Parallel applications are often designed for synchronous, lock-step execution, treating communication stalls as performance hazards. Yet, in a communication-light application without frequent synchronization points that alternates between compute-bound memory-bound execution, an MPI communication stall can act as an unintentional relief on memory-bandwidth contention. We demonstrate this using a Parallel Optical Flow Solver, which combines a compute-bound Ray Tracing kernel with a memory-bound Optical Flow Solver kernel and negligible inter-process communication. This program shows considerable speedup via desynchronization and automatic overlap between compute- and memory-bound phases, showing that natural desynchronization is an architecture-aware optimization. An optimal speedup is achieved when the number of processes concurrently executing the memory-bound phase on a ccNUMA domain is near the bandwidth saturation point. We also show a case where reducing communication overhead using MPI asynchronous progress significantly degrades performance because it allows too many ranks to contend for memory bandwidth simultaneously. In order to study the dynamics under more controlled conditions, we develop a tunable dual-kernel microbenchmark, with which we show that significant application or system noise (natural or injected) is required to achieve full desynchronization. Finally, we also validate these results using a bandwidth-aware, model-based simulator.

</details>


### [354] [Towards a Cloud Fog Edge System for Smart Building](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01647)
*Christophe Cérin,Mamadou Sow,Frédéric Andrès*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出将建筑本身视为数据中心、结合边缘计算实现可持续且隐私保护的智能环境愿景，介绍了面向嵌入式系统的在线机器学习项目、两种新在线算法实验评估，以及基于KOptim与FIWARE的云-雾-边架构耦合方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 外部云基础设施带来隐私泄露风险与依赖性问题，在人道主义等资源受限场景中，数据主权、能效和基础设施约束尤为关键，因此需要去中心化、就近学习的方案。

Method: 倡导"建筑即数据中心"理念，设计轻量级类Kubernetes编排框架以部署AI服务；在Arduino等低成本低功耗微控制器上实现AI算法与就地学习；提出基于KOptim和FIWARE组件的云-雾-边架构及其耦合方法。

Result: 给出了两种新在线算法的实验评估结果，并在真实世界数据轨迹上验证了算法表现。

Conclusion: 该工作有助于在资源受限环境中提供智能服务，促进脆弱或服务不足社区的自主性、韧性与可持续发展。

Abstract: In this article, we present our vision and recent advancements toward creating a decentralized system capable of learning from real-time data within buildings to support sustainable and privacy-preserving smart environments. Our approach promotes the concept of the building itself as the data center, aligning with the principles of edge computing to safeguard confidentiality and reduce reliance on external cloud infrastructure. This is particularly valuable in humanitarian contexts, where data sovereignty, energy efficiency, and infrastructure constraints are critical. We detail a lightweight, "Kubernetes-like" orchestration framework for deploying AI services within such environments and demonstrate our progress in implementing AI algorithms on low-power, cost-effective microcontrollers such as those in the Arduino ecosystem. By enabling in-situ learning directly on sensors or microcontrollers, our work aims to bring intelligent services to resource-limited settings, fostering autonomy, resilience, and sustainable development in vulnerable or underserved communities. The contributions in this article are related, firstly, to our project "Online Machine Learning Algorithms for Embedded Systems" and the evaluation of two new online algorithms. Secondly, we envision a cloud-fog-edge architecture based on the KOptim and FIWARE components, and we propose a methodology for coupling them. Experimental results of the online algorithms are also presented, showcasing real-world traces.

</details>


### [355] [ePACT: Energy-Performance-Aware Commitment Tracking for LLM Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01784)
*You Peng,Youhe Jiang,Chen Wang,Binhang Yuan*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文研究在电力采购存在惩罚性偏差成本的情形下，如何通过调控LLM服务能耗来降低部署成本，提出能量-性能感知的承诺跟踪问题（ePACT），并实现了一个双层控制器，在24小时仿真中将非对称偏差成本较vLLM降低约74%–76%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 降低LLM服务的能耗本身并不必然降低部署成本：当运营商需按小时对电力用量做出承诺，而实际用电偏离承诺会带来（可能非对称的）惩罚成本时，真正需要优化的是偏差成本而非单纯能耗。因此需要将服务性能（请求级SLO）与能量承诺跟踪联合建模。

Method: 形式化“能量-性能感知的承诺跟踪”问题：在满足请求级服务要求的前提下最小化偏差成本，其中超用与欠用具有正值且可能非对称的成本。实现ePACT双层控制器：全局规划器根据实测能耗与剩余小时承诺更新区间能量目标；本地决策器预测候选配置的能耗与完成时间，检测预测的截止时间违约，按非对称目标偏差成本在准入配置中选择，并提供服务优先的回退策略。采用由粗到细的动作搜索，并与服务异步执行。

Result: 通过单小时对比、控制器消融和全天轨迹仿真（H20与H200 GPU池）进行评估。在24小时仿真中，ePACT将非对称偏差成本相对vLLM降低$73.8\%$和$75.7\%$，同时保持接近vLLM的SLO达成率；平均每小时绝对偏差分别为$2.16\%$和$2.31\%$。

Conclusion: 通过双层控制（全局能量目标规划与本地配置决策）联合调节服务容量与GPU频率，可在维持服务SLO的同时显著降低电力承诺偏差成本，验证了能量-性能协同控制在LLM服务部署成本优化中的有效性。

Abstract: Reducing LLM serving energy does not by itself guarantee lower deployment cost when electricity procurement exposes operators to unfavorable deviations from preset commitments. We study hourly commitments with positive, potentially asymmetric costs for overuse and underuse, and formulate energy-Performance-Aware Commitment Tracking: minimize deviation costs subject to request-level service requirements. We implement ePACT, a two-level controller that adjusts serving capacity and GPU clocks as requests arrive. A global planner updates interval energy targets from measured consumption and the remaining hourly commitment. A local decision maker predicts candidate configurations' energy and completion times, checks predicted deadline misses, and selects among admitted configurations by asymmetric target-deviation cost, with a service-first fallback. Coarse-to-fine action search runs asynchronously with serving. We evaluate ePACT through single-hour comparisons, controller ablations, and full-day trace simulations for H20 and H200 GPU pools. In the 24-hour simulations, ePACT reduces the asymmetric deviation cost by $73.8\%$ and $75.7\%$ relative to vLLM while retaining near-vLLM SLO attainment. Mean absolute hourly deviations are $2.16\%$ and $2.31\%$, respectively.

</details>


### [356] [MoE-CORE: Coordinated Expert Offloading and Residency for Memory-Constrained MoE Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01950)
*Ke Yang,Yongji Gao,Xushi Li,Kui Luo,Sicheng Zhang,Tianming Zhou,Keyi Liu,Shufang Lu,Aoxuan Chen,Jie Meng,Jingchun Gao,Dan Li,Xinkai You,Dan Li,Zhixiang Xia,Yan Shi,Yang Liu,Yanjia Zeng,Liangjun Feng*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: MoE-CORE：面向显存受限设备的专家卸载与驻留协同系统，通过分层缓存、路由历史感知替换与跨层预取，将TPOT从秒级降至数十毫秒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏专家激活虽降低MoE计算量，但专家权重总量超出设备显存；卸载虽使推理在小型AI设备上可行，却把主机到设备传输暴露在推理关键路径上，成为主要瓶颈。

Method: 预填充阶段用交替缓冲暂存完整专家层；解码阶段结合非均匀分层缓存容量、领域知识初始化、路由历史感知替换与跨层预取。主路径严格执行路由器选中的专家，可选路径对符合条件的低分未命中专家做基于分数替换。

Result: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-W4A8上平均TPOT为38.0-44.8 ms，对比vLLM Prefetch的1268.9-1269.1 ms；GLM-5.2-W4A8C8上为206.6-220.5 ms对比5941.5-5941.8 ms。84-GB NPU显存上限下，最优DeepSeek GSM8K配置达21.5 ms（近似专家替换+MTP深度2）。

Conclusion: 结果支持在设备显存约束下对专家驻留与传输调度进行协同优化，可显著降低内存受限MoE推理的TPOT。

Abstract: Sparse expert activation reduces MoE models' computation, yet expert weights can exceed limited device memory. Offloading makes inference feasible on a compact AI appliance but exposes host-to-device transfers to the inference path. We present MoE-CORE, a system that coordinates expert offloading and residency for memory-constrained MoE inference. It stages complete expert layers in alternating buffers during prefill. During decode, it combines nonuniform layer-wise cache capacity, domain-informed initialization, routing-history-aware replacement, and cross-layer prefetching. The main configuration executes router-selected experts exactly; an optional score-based substitution path handles eligible low-score misses. The main comparison uses 1K- and 128-token output caps for MoE-CORE and vLLM Prefetch, respectively. Across five workloads per model, MoE-CORE records a mean time per output token (TPOT) of 38.0-44.8 ms versus 1268.9-1269.1 ms for the evaluated vLLM Prefetch configuration on DeepSeek-V4-Flash-W4A8; the corresponding values on GLM-5.2-W4A8C8 are 206.6-220.5 and 5941.5-5941.8 ms. Under an 84-GB NPU-memory cap, the best measured DeepSeek GSM8K configuration achieves a TPOT of 21.5 ms with approximate expert substitution and multi-token prediction (MTP) at depth 2. These results support coordinated expert residency and transfer scheduling under a device-memory constraint. The code is here.

</details>

### [357] [StabilityArc: Decoding Protein Sequence Embeddings into Generalizable Stability Landscapes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00742)
*Aaron L. Feller,Andrew D. Ellington,Claus O. Wilke*

Main category: q-bio.BM

TL;DR: StabilityArc：共享解码器跨蛋白迁移预测突变效应


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蛋白质稳定性景观各异，但突变物理后果受反复出现的生化约束支配，作者希望验证一个共享解码器能否解读未见目标蛋白的约束，实现跨蛋白迁移用于首轮实验预筛。

Method: 将冻结的 ESMC-600M 残基表示通过共享 RoPE transformer 映射为 L×20 替换效应矩阵；引入对称、接触感知的残差项辅助预测同时替换中的上位效应。

Result: 66 次严格留一蛋白评估、134,794 个 ProteinGym 变体下，Spearman 相关为 0.7134，超过最强零样本基线 ProSST-2048（0.6526）0.0608；作为 Kermut 先验时，在三种监督划分方案下 Spearman 为 0.8280，高于 Kermut 报告的 0.8167。

Conclusion: 共享解码器可有效跨蛋白迁移突变效应预测，兼具零样本优势与作为监督模型先验的提升能力。

Abstract: Every protein has a unique stability landscape, but the physical consequences of mutation are governed by recurring biochemical constraints. We test whether a shared decoder, trained on measurements from diverse proteins, can interpret these constraints in an unseen target, enabling cross-protein transfer for initial experimental round prescreening. We present StabilityArc , which maps frozen ESMC-600M residue representations through a shared RoPE transformer to an Lx20 matrix of substitution effects; a symmetric, contact-aware residual aids in predicting epistasis in simultaneous substitutions. In 66 strict leave-one-protein-out evaluations covering 134,794 ProteinGym variants, StabilityArc achieves 0.7134 Spearman correlation, exceeding the strongest zero-shot baseline, ProSST-2048 (0.6526), by 0.0608. We further explore the utility of this method by providing the score as a prior for Kermut, achieving Spearman correlation of 0.8280 across three supervised split schemes, improving on Kermut's reported 0.8167.

</details>


### [358] [Molecular architecture of TE-seeded chromosome-naive initiation networks of protein-protein interactions delineates the Human Protein Map of the assembly of multiprotein complexes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01078)
*Gennadi Glinsky*

Main category: q-bio.BM

TL;DR: 该文基于HPA中154种人类细胞类型的胞内蛋白单体池，解析了PPI级联组分的分子特征与功能，揭示了其可生成51,830种蛋白二聚体，并发现蛋白病蛋白通过螯合44种突触蛋白破坏PPI级联性能、进而参与神经退行性病变机制的潜在路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 阐明起始转录因子结合转座元件来源DNA后，如何通过迭代性蛋白-蛋白相互作用（PPI）级联激活内源性多蛋白复合物（EMC）的杂合组装通路（HAP），并揭示PPI级联组分的分子结构特征及其在细胞类型特异性蛋白组背景下的生物学功能，尤其是其在神经退行性病变中的潜在作用。

Method: 以Human Protein Atlas（HPA）中154种人类细胞类型的胞内蛋白单体池为背景，解析4个PPI级联组分家族的分子特征与推断生物学功能；开展细胞类型分辨的多蛋白复合物参与分析；统计PPI级联组分在各蛋白组可用性背景下可生成的蛋白二聚体数量；分析蛋白病蛋白对突触蛋白的螯合效应及突触结构蛋白回补对二聚体组装的影响。

Result: 记录到PPI级联组分四个家族的若干关键特征：a) 普遍表达且分布均衡；c) 具有普适可用性与参与性；d) EMC呈现组成型（不变）与细胞类型特异性的组装谱。无监督分析可忠实还原EMC的固有谱系结构及谱系特异性主调控多蛋白组装。PPI级联组分在154种人类细胞蛋白组可用性背景下可生成51,830种蛋白二聚体。蛋白病蛋白持续存在可通过螯合44种突触蛋白损害PPI级联性能。

Conclusion: 突触蛋白被螯合会抽离突触的结构-功能组分，提示其可能是神经退行性病变发病机制之一；相反，回补特定突触结构蛋白的可用性可恢复化学计量并重建丢失的突触蛋白二聚体组装。

Abstract: Upon binding to transposable elements seeded DNA, initiator transcription factors are poised to activate the hybrid assembly pathways (HAP) of endogenous multiprotein complexes (EMC) by iteratively engaging protein-protein interaction (PPI) cascade and creating cell type-specific pools of protein dimers. Here, molecular features and inferred biological functions of PPI cascade constituents were elucidated within the context of cell type-specific intracellular protein monomer pools documented in the Human Protein Atlas (HPA) of 154 human cell types. The following key features of the molecular architecture and functional performance of the 4 families of PPI cascade constituents were documented within the HPA contexts of intracellular proteomes: a) the ubiquitous expression and balanced representation; c) the universal availability and engagements; d) constitutive {invariant) and cell type-specific assembly profiles of EMCs. The biological relevance of the PPI cascades is demonstrated by cell-type-resolved multiprotein complex-engagement analysis across the HPA of human body, which faithfully recovers without supervision the intrinsic lineage structures of EMCs and lineage-specific master-regulator multiprotein assemblies. PPI cascade constituents have the capacity to generate 51,830 protein dimers within the proteome availability contexts of 154 types of human cells. Present analyses revealed critical impacts of the persistence of proteinopathy proteins that may cause the damage to the PPI cascade performance by sequestering 44 synaptic proteins. The sequestration of synaptic proteins withdraws structural-functional components of synapses suggesting a mechanism contributing to the pathogenesis of neurodegeneration. Conversely, reconstitution of availability of defined synaptic structural proteins appears to restore stoichiometry and recovers the lost assembly of synaptic protein dimers.

</details>


### [359] [Multi-Scale Temporal Flows for Peptide Trajectory Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01086)
*Xichen Sun,Wentao Wei,Xiaoxi Zhang,Yuedong Yang,Jiahua Rao*

Main category: q-bio.BM

TL;DR: PepTIDE是一个面向肽段（含线性与环肽）动力学的多尺度时间轨迹生成框架：训练窗口步长从连续范围采样，并用自适应物理时间嵌入编码窗口相对间隔与每帧绝对时间，使共享速度场具备时间间隔感知能力；在全帧联合生成的随机插值流与成对不变点注意力下，于PepMD和50个环肽体系基准上取得最优分布一致性与结构有效性，并能恢复稀疏跃迁帧、更忠实复现态间通量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肽段处于极具挑战的动力学区间：短肽缺乏稳定折叠核心、构象系综宽泛，环化还引入闭环约束、非局域残基耦合与立体化学多样性。现有深度生成模型虽能直接模拟分子动力学轨迹，但均在固定间隔切分的窗口上训练，只能观测单一时间分辨率；更关键的是没有任何模型把该间隔作为输入，窗口所跨物理时间从未被表示，致使肽段跨越亚稳态的稀疏帧难以学习。

Method: 提出PepTIDE多尺度时间框架：每个训练窗口的步长从连续范围中采样，使单一模型在多种时间分辨率下观测同一动力学；引入自适应物理时间嵌入（Adaptive Physical-Time Embedding），同时编码窗口的相对间隔与每一帧的绝对时间，使共享速度场具备“间隔感知”能力；所有帧通过随机插值流（stochastic-interpolant flow）联合生成；采用成对感知的不变点注意力（pair-aware invariant point attention）刻画线性肽与环肽的几何与拓扑结构。

Result: 在PepMD数据集与一个含50个体系的环肽基准上，PepTIDE在分布一致性（distribution agreement）与结构有效性（structural validity）方面均达到当前最优水平；按时间顺序读取其生成轨迹，能够恢复稀疏的跃迁帧，并更忠实地复现态间通量。

Conclusion: 对多个时间尺度进行建模是使这些稀有跃迁事件变得可学习的关键；PepTIDE通过连续步长采样与物理时间感知的速度场，同时提升了肽段轨迹生成的分布保真度与动力学真实性。

Abstract: Peptides occupy a particularly challenging regime of biomolecular dynamics. Short peptides lack a stable folded core and populate broad conformational ensembles, while cyclization adds ring closure, non-local residue coupling, and stereochemical diversity. Deep generative models have made remarkable progress in emulating molecular-dynamics trajectories directly, yet each is trained on windows cut at a fixed interval and therefore observes the process at a fixed temporal resolution. More fundamentally, none takes that interval as an input, so the physical time a window spans is never represented, leaving the sparse frames on which a peptide crosses between metastable states difficult to learn. Here, we introduce PepTIDE, a multi-scale temporal framework for peptide trajectory generation. The stride of each training window is drawn from a continuous range, so one model observes the same dynamics at many temporal resolutions, and an Adaptive Physical-Time Embedding encodes the relative interval of a window together with the absolute time of each frame, making the shared velocity field interval-aware. All frames are generated jointly through a stochastic-interpolant flow, and pair-aware invariant point attention captures the geometry and topology of both linear and cyclic peptides. On PepMD and a 50-system cyclic-peptide benchmark, PepTIDE reaches state-of-the-art distribution agreement and structural validity. Read in temporal order, its trajectories recover these sparse transition frames and reproduce inter-state fluxes more faithfully, confirming that modeling multiple temporal scales is what makes these rare events accessible.

</details>


### [360] [Fold'EM: Direct atomic structure inference from Cryo-EM particles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01358)
*Advaith Maddipatla,Märt-Erik Mäeots,Marco Pegoraro,Nikolaus Dräger,Roberto Covino,Sanketh Vedula,Martin Pacesa,Alex M. Bronstein*

Main category: q-bio.BM

TL;DR: Fold'EM提出一种推理期框架，将蛋白质生成模型的先验直接与cryo-EM粒子图像结合，跳过密度重建与原子模型拟合，在小样本条件下直接确定原子结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统cryo-EM流程先由大量粒子图像重建静电势（ESP）密度图，再将原子模型拟合到该图上。该方法样本复杂度高、成本大、通量低，尤其对异质样本不利；且密度图分辨率下降会使下游建模愈发困难。序列导出的结构先验通常在密度重建之后才被引入，未充分利用。

Method: Fold'EM在推理阶段将蛋白质生成模型的先验与cryo-EM粒子图像直接联合，从少量单颗粒图像中推断原子模型，绕过中间密度重建与基于重建图的建模。方法支持已知粒子取向，也可在从头（ab-initio）设定下联合推断取向与结构。

Result: 在合成与实验cryo-EM数据集上，Fold'EM在已知取向和ab-initio取向未知两种情形下均能恢复准确的原子结构；在异质数据集中，可从混合粒子群直接解析不同构象状态，而无需为每个状态分别重建密度图并建模。

Conclusion: 该工作为低样本量条件下的结构确定以及直接从cryo-EM粒子表征低丰度构象状态开辟了新途径。

Abstract: Single-particle cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) has become a widely adopted technique for biomolecular structure determination. The conventional cryo-EM computational pipeline first combines many particle images to reconstruct an electrostatic potential (ESP) map and then fits an atomic model to the recovered map. Density reconstruction has high sample complexity, requiring large numbers of particle images and making structure determination high-cost and low-throughput, particularly for heterogeneous samples. Downstream atomic model building, in turn, becomes increasingly difficult as the resolution of the reconstructed map deteriorates. Protein structure prediction models provide strong sequence-derived priors on atomic structure, and experiment-guided approaches can use these priors to recover structures consistent with experimental measurements. Yet, in cryo-EM, such priors are typically integrated only after density reconstruction during atomic model fitting. We introduce Fold'EM, an inference-time framework that combines priors from protein generative models directly with cryo-EM particle images to determine atomic models from a small number of single particle images, bypassing both intermediate density reconstruction and downstream model building against the reconstructed map. Across synthetic and experimental cryo-EM datasets, Fold'EM recovers accurate atomic structures both with known particle orientations and in an ab-initio setting where orientations are inferred jointly with structure. In heterogeneous datasets, Fold'EM further resolves distinct conformational states from mixed particle populations without separately reconstructing a density map and building an atomic model for each state. We believe these results open new avenues for structure determination in the low-sample regime and for characterizing low-population conformational states directly from cryo-EM particles.

</details>

### [361] [Bounded-Fidelity Sim-as-Demo-Stage: Mocap Handoff for Governance Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00008)
*Xue Qin,Simin Luan,Cong Yang,Zhijun Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 bounded-fidelity sim-as-demo-stage 设计模式：在明确界定的交接包络内抑制接触物理、其余处保留完整动力学，以 MuJoCo mocap-body 原语与 220 行 Python 适配器实现，使 LLM 驱动机器人治理基准的审计链在多次重放中字节级一致（1000/1000），而接触力基线仅 7/1000 一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仿真到现实研究以物理保真度为首要目标，但对 LLM 驱动机器人的治理基准而言，接触保真度反而成为负担：抓取、搬运、放置等物体交接处的接触力积分噪声会引入与所测治理属性无关的审计链分歧，干扰对准入/策略/合约/审计流水线正确性的判定。作者希望获得与治理属性无关、可复现的审计链。

Method: 提出 bounded-fidelity sim-as-demo-stage 设计模式，在显式界定的交接包络（handoff envelope）内抑制接触物理，包络外保留完整动力学。实现上使用 MuJoCo 的 mocap-body 原语，由 220 行 Python 适配器驱动，治理桥通过结构化 intent 调用。形式上把审计链稳定性定义为有哈希事件日志跨重放的字节相等，并给出两个可推出该性质的包络结构属性。实验对比 mocap 变体与接触力基线：每种姿态 N=1000 次重放；时间步扫描 1/2/5/10 ms；包络边缘时序抖动（±10 仿真步，1400 次重放）；以及 K∈{1,2,3} 个顺序交接物体的重放（1500 次）。

Result: mocap 变体在每种姿态下产生单一审计链哈希（1000/1000 字节一致，Wilson 95% CI [0.997, 1.000]）；接触力基线产生 584 个不同哈希（993/1000 分歧，CI [0.987, 0.998]）。时间步扫描（1、2、5、10 ms）显示分歧率为结构性而非调参所致，各时间步均保持 0.985。包络边缘时序抖动（±10 步，1400 次重放）产生 0 分歧；K∈{1,2,3} 顺序交接时审计链仍字节相等（1500 次重放），且每次抓放的额外开销呈次线性。

Conclusion: 该模式以近乎零的工程成本为基准设计者提供审计链可复现性，适用于治理基准等需要与接触物理解耦的场景；同时作者界定了其有害范围——仿真到现实验证、策略训练、接触密集任务——以避免误用。

Abstract: Sim-to-real research pursues physics fidelity as a primary objective: simulators are judged by how closely they reproduce real-world contact dynamics. For governance benchmarking of LLM-driven robots, where the simulator demonstrates that an admission/policy/contract/audit pipeline behaves correctly, contact fidelity at object handoffs (grasp, carry, place) becomes a liability: contact-force integration noise injects audit-chain divergence that is structurally unrelated to the governance property under test. We propose bounded-fidelity sim-as-demo-stage, a design pattern that suppresses contact physics within explicitly bracketed handoff envelopes while preserving full dynamics elsewhere. The construction uses MuJoCo's mocap-body primitive driven by a 220-line Python adapter that the governance bridge invokes via structured intents. We formalise audit-chain stability as byte-equality of the hashed event log across replays and identify two structural envelope properties that imply it. Across N=1000 replays per posture, the mocap variant produces one distinct audit-chain hash (1000/1000 byte-identical; Wilson 95% CI [0.997, 1.000]); the contact-force baseline produces 584 distinct hashes (993/1000 diverged; CI [0.987, 0.998]). A timestep sweep (1, 2, 5, 10 ms) shows the divergence is structural, not a tuning artefact: it stays at 0.985 at every timestep. Envelope-edge timing jitter (+/-10 simulation steps, 1,400 replays) produces 0 divergence, and audit chains remain byte-equal across K in {1, 2, 3} sequentially handed-off objects (1,500 replays) with sub-linear per-pick-and-place overhead. The pattern gives benchmark designers audit-chain reproducibility at near-zero engineering cost; we also map where it is harmful (sim-to-real validation, policy training, contact-rich tasks) so it is not mis-deployed.

</details>


### [362] [Multi-Reference Path Tracking Control for an Agricultural Tractor with Nonlinear Model Predictive Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00057)
*Marcel Moll,Timo Oksanen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该研究提出一种将分段线性参考路径直接嵌入目标函数的非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）路径跟踪控制器，并在田间试验中验证，平均求解耗时3.45 ms，曲线路径平均绝对横向误差为6.1 cm。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 拖拉机沿预定参考路径行驶是精准农业的核心环节，需要高精度、实时性强的路径跟踪控制方法。

Method: 基于非线性模型预测控制构建路径跟踪控制器，将多段分段线性参考路径直接纳入目标函数，并提出从完整路径中选取可用参考路径段的方法；通过田间试验利用Tractor Implement Management转向接口对拖拉机进行控制验证。

Result: NMPC求解器平均3.45 ms收敛；曲线参考路径跟踪的平均绝对横向误差为6.1 cm。

Conclusion: 将分段线性参考路径直接嵌入NMPC目标函数的控制方案具有良好实时性与跟踪精度，适用于精准农业中的拖拉机路径跟踪。

Abstract: Guiding a tractor along a predefined reference path is a key component of precision agriculture. This study develops a path tracking controller based on Nonlinear Model Predictive Control, which incorporates multiple segments of a piecewise-linear reference path directly into the objective function. In addition, methods for selecting viable reference segments from the full path are presented. The control system is evaluated during a field test with a tractor controlled via the Tractor Implement Management steering interface. The NMPC solver converged on average after 3.45 ms and tracked the curved reference path with a mean absolute cross-track error of 6.1 cm.

</details>


### [363] [Probabilistic Plan Legibility with Off-the-shelf Planners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00065)
*Michele Persiani,Thomas Hellström*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种面向任意PDDL域的可读性规划方法，通过二阶心智理论估计观察者视角，无需构建专用规划器，将可读性扩展至经典规划，并在多个基准域验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可读性规划旨在让观察者能从多个候选目标中准确推断规划者的真实目标。已有可读性研究多局限于特定场景或需构建专用规划器，难以推广到任意PDDL域，因此需要一种通用、可复用现有规划器的方法。

Method: 将先前关于可读性的研究扩展到经典规划，提出针对任意PDDL域的可读性规划方法，无需构建ad-hoc规划器；并通过二阶心智理论连接规划者与观察者的任务空间以估计观察者视角。可应用于人-机器人协作场景。

Result: 在多个PDDL规划域上进行基准测试，结果表明可读性与规划效率之间存在权衡关系；不同规划域提升可读性的方式不一致，且需要引入正则化因子来平衡可读性与效率。

Conclusion: 所提方法可通用地实现PDDL域的可读性规划，并通过正则化因子在可读性与效率间取得平衡，适用于人-机器人团队协作中通过可读规划隐式传达目标。

Abstract: Legible planning is the creation of plans that best disambiguate their goals from a set of other candidates from an observer's perspective. In this paper we propose a method for legible planning for arbitrary PDDL domains, by extending previous research on legibility to classical planning without requiring to construct ad-hoc planners. We also discuss how the observer perspective may be estimated through a second order theory of mind that connects the planner's and the observer's task spaces. Our solution can for example be deployed in human-robot teaming scenarios, where an autonomous robot in a team can implicitly communicate its goal by producing legible plans. We present benchmark results on several PDDL planning domains. Our results generally show that plan legibility is a trade-off with plan efficiency, however, not all planning domains allows to increase legibility in the same way and a regularizing factor to balance legibility and efficiency was proved necessary.

</details>


### [364] [HumanoidTTT: Test-Time Capability Reuse for Efficient Humanoid Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00198)
*Jingtai Yang,Yining Wu,Yanjun Li,Zeyu Zhang,Hao Tang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 HumanoidTTT 框架，通过选择性完整动作复用与测试时能力整合，实现持续人形控制中已验证动作能力的安全高效复用。实验实现零不安全接受、16.4倍端到端加速，并在线整合提升避免生成器调用次数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形机器人持续部署中，相同动作能力可能被反复请求，但中间动作会改变机器人进入状态，导致先前成功动作无法盲目重放；同时已验证能力不断累积，而存储受限需决定保留哪些能力。

Method: 提出 HumanoidTTT 框架，包含：1）选择性完整动作复用（Selective Full-Motion Reuse），仅允许从经认证的适用进入状态直接复用已验证完整动作，被接受复用可绕过重新生成；2）测试时能力整合（Test-Time Capability Consolidation），以后续部署复用为反馈，在有界完整动作存储中自适应决定保留哪些合格能力。

Result: 实验显示零不安全接受，相比全新生成实现 16.4 倍端到端加速；在线整合相比冻结版本，每 200 次请求额外避免 13.2 次生成器调用。

Conclusion: HumanoidTTT 能在持续部署中实现已验证动作能力的可靠、高效复用，并自适应保留有用能力。

Abstract: Recent advances in motion generation and whole-body tracking have enabled humanoid robots to execute increasingly diverse motions, yet the same motion capabilities may be requested repeatedly during continual deployment. Reliable reuse is challenging because intervening motions can change the robot's entry state, making previously successful motions unsafe to replay blindly. Meanwhile, validated capabilities accumulate during deployment, while bounded storage requires deciding which ones are worth retaining. To address these challenges, we present HumanoidTTT, a framework for test-time capability reuse in continual humanoid control. Specifically, we introduce Selective Full-Motion Reuse, which authorizes direct reuse of validated complete motions only from certified applicable entry states, allowing accepted reuse to bypass fresh generation. We further introduce Test-Time Capability Consolidation, which adapts which qualified capabilities persist in a bounded Full-Motion Store using subsequent deployment reuse as feedback. Experiments demonstrate zero unsafe accepts and a 16.4$\times$ end-to-end speedup over fresh generation, while online consolidation improves avoided generator calls by 13.2 per 200 requests over its frozen counterpart. Overall, HumanoidTTT enables reliable and efficient reuse of validated motion capabilities while adaptively retaining useful capabilities throughout continual deployment. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/HumanoidTTT. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/HumanoidTTT.

</details>


### [365] [Real-Time Whole-Body Safe Motion Generation for Multi-Segment Tendon-Driven Continuum Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00220)
*Fangju Yang,Siyi Ma,Tonghao Guan,Tingcong Liu,Hang Yang,Zhengqiang Zhang,Jian S. Dai,Ke Wu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向平面多段腱驱动连续体机器人的统一驱动空间框架，结合能量法变曲率模型与多点CBF-QP，实现实时全身避障运动生成，静态/动态场景成功率分别达96%和100%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 腱驱动连续体机器人的实时运动生成需要准确刻画非均匀弯曲并实现全身避障，而传统建模难以处理空间变化的腱间距与弯曲刚度，且避障约束计算量大、难以满足实时性。

Method: 构建统一驱动空间框架：采用基于能量的变曲率模型刻画空间变化的腱间距与弯曲刚度，并推导解析雅可比用于微分逆运动学与安全监测；引入多点控制障碍函数二次规划（CBF-QP）在障碍运动与驱动速度约束下强制主干间隙，其决策维度仅与独立驱动段数相关。

Result: 模型与GVS参考吻合，最大曲率误差为5.223×10⁻² m⁻¹；在100次MuJoCo试验中，静态与动态场景无碰撞成功率分别为96%和100%，无CBF约束时仅约60%和80%；穿洞测试验证了受限环境下的安全运动；使用600个主干监测点时平均控制步时间6.66 ms。

Conclusion: 该驱动空间框架在保证建模精度的同时实现了实时全身安全运动生成，验证了变曲率建模与多点CBF-QP结合的有效性与实用性。

Abstract: Real-time motion generation for tendon-driven continuum robots requires accurate modeling of nonuniform bending and whole-body collision avoidance. This paper presents a unified actuation-space framework for planar multi-segment tendon-driven continuum robots. An energy-based variable-curvature model captures spatially varying tendon spacing and bending stiffness and provides analytical Jacobians for differential inverse kinematics and safety monitoring. A multipoint CBF-QP enforces backbone clearance under obstacle motion and actuation-velocity bounds, while its decision dimension depends only on the number of independently actuated segments. The model closely agrees with GVS references, with a maximum curvature error of $5.223 \times 10^{-2}\,\mathrm{m}^{-1}$. Over 100 MuJoCo trials, the proposed method achieves collision-free success rates of 96% and 100% in static and dynamic scenarios, respectively, compared with approximately 60% and 80% without CBF constraints. Hole-traversal tests further demonstrate safe motion in constrained environments. With 600 backbone monitoring points, the mean control-step time is 6.66 ms, demonstrating real-time whole-body safe motion generation.

</details>


### [366] [DriftOPD: Sequence-Level Reverse-KL Distillation for One-Step VLA Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00317)
*Youngjun Jun,Kyumin Choi,Youngmin Kim,Seonghyun Jin,Sunwoo Park,Jangho Park,Jong Chul Ye*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DriftOPD是一种无需教师、无需在线rollout的序列级在线策略蒸馏框架，可将长时程行为蒸馏进一步式VLA动作专家中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型的动作专家采用滚动时域控制生成短动作块，块级训练虽便于跨机器人本体迁移，但仅优化局部动作似然，未显式考虑长时程任务成功；而序列级强化学习虽可解决该问题，却依赖策略rollout与闭环交互，对真实机器人操作代价高昂。

Method: 作者证明序列级反向KL散度可分解为块级反向KL项与刻画当前动作长时程影响的未来势能项；DriftOPD分别用一步漂移目标优化前者、用从离线示范学习的Q函数评论家优化后者，从而仅凭离线数据和一步动作生成即可实现序列级优化。

Result: 在仿真与真实世界操作的多种VLA架构上，DriftOPD总体优于现有一步蒸馏基线，并取得与多步教师策略相当的任务成功率。

Conclusion: 结果表明，无需在线交互或独立教师，即可将长时程行为有效蒸馏进一步式VLA动作专家。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models increasingly rely on action experts that generate short action chunks under receding-horizon control. While chunk-level training is convenient across robot embodiments, it optimizes local action likelihood without explicitly accounting for long-horizon task success. Sequence-level reinforcement learning can address this limitation, but typically requires policy rollouts and closed-loop interaction, which are costly for real-robot manipulation. We introduce DriftOPD, a teacher-free, rollout-free framework for sequence-level on-policy distillation of continuous VLA action experts. We show that the sequence-level reverse Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence decomposes into a chunk-level reverse-KL term and a future-potential term that captures the long-horizon effect of the current action. DriftOPD optimizes these two terms using a one-step drifting objective and a Q-function critic learned from offline demonstrations, respectively, enabling sequence-level optimization with only offline data and one-step action generation. Across multiple VLA architectures in simulation and real-world manipulation, DriftOPD generally outperforms existing one-step distillation baselines while achieving task success performance comparable to multi-step teacher policies. These results demonstrate that long-horizon behavior can be effectively distilled into one-step VLA action experts without online interaction or a separate teacher.

</details>


### [367] [Retrospective Open-Vocabulary Memory for Long-Term Object Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00330)
*Jiaming Wang,Zhiwei Xue,Chen Jizhuo,Peng Shiqi,Harold Soh*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出回顾性开放词汇记忆问题，将其形式化为删失观测下的概率推断，并提出ECROM方法，通过"按机会加权证据"估计长期概念流行度并直接转化为主动搜索先验；同时构建了受控长期基准，ECROM在AP与搜索SPL上均优于最强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期物体搜索需要从对环境反复但不均匀的观测中学习物体的常见出现位置，而现有记忆方法难以处理观测机会不均导致的有偏证据。

Method: 将回顾性开放词汇记忆形式化为删失观测下的概率推断，核心思想是按每一次观测机会加权证据：一次检测或未检测对信念的影响应正比于机器人观察该位置的机会。提出ECROM，用该原则估计仅在查询时指定概念的长期流行度，并将信念直接转化为主动搜索先验。

Result: 在十个HM3D家庭构建的受控长期基准上（独立变化物体布局与重复遍历中的观测机会），ECROM在留出查询上的support-level AP提升4.5个点，搜索SPL提升4.2个点。基准、数据集与代码将开源。

Conclusion: 按观测机会加权证据的建模能有效缓解不均匀观测偏差，ECROM在开放词汇长期记忆与主动搜索任务上取得一致提升，并提供可复现的受控评测基准。

Abstract: Long-term object search requires learning where objects usually appear from repeated but uneven observations of a changing environment. We formulate retrospective open-vocabulary memory as probabilistic inference from censored observations, where the key idea is to reason with evidence per opportunity: a detection or non-detection should influence belief only in proportion to the robot's opportunity to observe the corresponding location. We introduce ECROM, which uses this principle to estimate long-term prevalence for concepts specified only at query time and converts the resulting belief directly into an active-search prior. To evaluate this problem, we introduce a controlled long-term benchmark in ten HM3D homes that independently varies object placement and observation opportunity across repeated traversals. ECROM improves support-level AP on held-out queries by 4.5 points and search SPL by 4.2 points over the strongest competing memory in each metric. The benchmark, dataset, and code will be open-sourced.

</details>


### [368] [IndoorBEV: A Lightweight Real-Time LiDAR BEV Perception System for Indoor Mobile Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00355)
*Haichuan Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: IndoorBEV：一种轻量级室内LiDAR感知框架，通过高度感知BEV表示与几何条件特征融合，在保持垂直几何信息的同时实现高效计算，兼顾精度、延迟与内存。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 室内LiDAR感知需在严格延迟与内存约束下理解杂乱三维环境。现有point-based与voxel-based方法计算开销大，而传统BEV表示虽高效却丢弃了垂直几何信息，形成效率与精度间的权衡。

Method: 提出高度感知BEV表示，用统计高度特征与多频高度编码汇总每个BEV单元的垂直点分布，使三维线索可由2D卷积高效处理；轻量编码器融合互补几何特征、多尺度局部表示与紧凑全局场景上下文；解耦密集预测头联合输出语义BEV图与有向目标框。

Result: 模型仅0.6M参数、2.3 MB存储。在NVIDIA AGX Orin上单次推理GPU内存21.52 MB，200 ms感知截止期下平均延迟169.6 ms，截止期错失率1.8%。在仿真场景、真实机器人扫描与开源室内点云数据集上均展现精度、延迟与内存的良好权衡。

Conclusion: 在紧凑BEV表示中显式编码垂直几何，是资源高效室内LiDAR感知的有效途径。

Abstract: Efficient indoor LiDAR perception is challenging because mobile robots must understand cluttered three-dimensional environments under strict latency and memory constraints. Existing point-based and voxel-based methods often incur substantial computational overhead, whereas conventional bird's-eye-view (BEV) representations improve efficiency at the cost of discarding vertical geometric information. We present IndoorBEV, a lightweight LiDAR perception framework that mitigates this tradeoff through a height-aware BEV representation and geometry-conditioned feature fusion. IndoorBEV summarizes the vertical point distribution in each BEV cell using statistical height features and multi-frequency height encoding, allowing informative three-dimensional cues to be processed efficiently by two-dimensional convolutions. A lightweight encoder then integrates complementary geometric features with multi-scale local representations and compact global scene context. Decoupled dense prediction heads jointly produce semantic BEV maps and oriented object bounding boxes. IndoorBEV contains only 0.6M parameters and requires 2.3 MB of model storage. On an NVIDIA AGX Orin, it uses 21.52 MB of GPU memory per inference and achieves a mean latency of 169.6 ms under a 200 ms perception deadline, with a deadline miss ratio of 1.8\%. Evaluations on simulated scenes, real-world robot scans, and an open-source indoor point-cloud dataset demonstrate a favorable tradeoff among perception accuracy, latency, and memory consumption. These results indicate that explicitly encoding vertical geometry within a compact BEV representation provides an effective approach to resource-efficient indoor LiDAR perception.

</details>


### [369] [DexPolicy: Scheduled Exploration for Trajectory-Guided Dexterous Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00360)
*Haoyu Wang,Siyuan Qian,Yanjun Li,Zeyu Zhang,Yandong Guo,Boxin Shi,Hao Tang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 DexPolicy，将 RL 探索尺度显式设为训练步数的退火函数，在轨迹引导的灵巧操作中显著提升确定性任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灵巧操作 RL 需先发现手指-物体接触、再精确控制物体，服务于探索的动作噪声反而会干扰精确控制。在 ViViDex 等轨迹引导设定下，基线 PPO 训练 5M 步后仍停留在初始动作噪声水平，说明需要显式控制探索尺度。

Method: 使探索尺度成为训练步数的显式函数，由宽到窄退火，同时固定损失、网络结构、奖励与优化器设置；在三种策略优化设定下验证：PPO、无 critic 的 GRPO 续训、流参数化 PPO 变体（FPO）。

Result: 仿真中五个 YCB 物体、三个随机种子，平均确定性 Target 成功率：FPO 由 49.4%→68.1%，GRPO 由 14.1%→45.4%，PPO 由 32.0%→35.7%。真机 RealMan RM75 配 Inspire/RH56 手，三个物体共 360 次试验：FPO 由 25.0%→85.0%，GRPO 由 10.0%→63.3%，PPO 由 8.3%→43.3%（每个物体-方法条件仅一个训练模型）。PPO 组件筛选显示噪声控制优于所测优化器收缩；所选 PPO 调度在三个测试物体上平均 Target 成功率高于相同端点的线性衰减。

Conclusion: 训练回报、确定性 Target 成功率与执行噪声容忍度三者相互解离；调度应以目标执行条件下的最终任务成功率为评判标准，并需按任务与策略优化设定分别评估。代码与网站已公开。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) for dexterous manipulation must discover finger-object contacts and then control the object precisely; the action noise that serves the first goal can interfere with the second. In trajectory-guided settings such as ViViDex, where RL refine hand-object trajectories from human video, our baseline PPO runs end near their initial action noise after 5M steps, motivating explicit control of exploration scale. DexPolicy makes that scale an explicit function of training steps, annealing from broad to narrow exploration while holding loss, architecture, reward, and optimizer settings fixed. We study three policy-optimization settings: PPO, critic-free GRPO continuation, and a flow-parameterized PPO variant (FPO). Across five YCB objects and three training seeds, mean deterministic Target success rises from 49.4% to 68.1% (FPO), 14.1% to 45.4% (GRPO), and 32.0% to 35.7% (PPO). On a RealMan RM75 arm with an Inspire/RH56 hand, 360 trials over three objects raise mean Target success from 25.0% to 85.0% (FPO), 10.0% to 63.3% (GRPO), and 8.3% to 43.3% (PPO), with one trained model per object-method condition. PPO component screening favors noise control over the tested optimizer contraction; the selected PPO schedule yields higher mean Target success than linear decay with the same endpoints on three tested objects. Training return, deterministic Target success, and tolerance to execution noise dissociate; schedules should therefore be judged by terminal task success under the intended execution conditions, per task and policy-optimization setting. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/DexPolicy. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/DexPolicy.

</details>


### [370] [DeepJEPA: Scaling World Models from Within](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00368)
*Zijian Jin,Yunbei Zhang,Yuanzhe Liu,Ming Liu,Baian Chen,Weirui Ye,Shilong Liu,Marco Pavone*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DeepJEPA将世界模型中每次转移的计算深度视为可自适应的测试时扩展轴，通过权重共享的联合嵌入预测模型学习在每个候选与轨迹步上"何时值得再算一次"，仅在决策关键事件上加深计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型规划器主要通过滚得更远、采样更多轨迹或优化更久来扩展计算，并对每一个想象转移分配相同的计算量。作者指出这种"均匀加深"是浪费的，甚至可能损害规划，因为有用的精细化集中在少数决策关键事件上。

Method: 提出DeepJEPA：一种权重共享（weight-tied）的联合嵌入预测世界模型。它将转移深度作为内部的测试时扩展轴，学习对每个候选轨迹及每个 rollout 步骤判断是否需要再做一次循环更新（额外计算）。

Result: 在五个视觉控制任务上，DeepJEPA 优于或匹配最强的固定深度规划器，同时平均每个转移仅需 1.00–1.26 次更新。额外计算集中在接触发生（contact onset）与持续物体交互阶段，此时潜空间的修正能够改变进入精英集合的候选以及最终选择的动作。表征探针显示，规划性能的提升并不依赖于对所有物体状态解码能力的一致提升。

Conclusion: DeepJEPA 重新定义了世界模型的计算扩展问题：不再是让每个 rollout 均匀地更深或更长，而是把内部计算分配给能够改变规划器决策的地方——在决策关键的转移上"想得更深"。

Abstract: World-model planners typically scale outward by rolling farther, sampling more trajectories, or optimizing longer, while assigning the same computation to every imagined transition. We show that making every transition uniformly deeper wastes computation and can degrade planning because useful refinement is concentrated at a small set of decision-critical events. We introduce DeepJEPA, a weight-tied joint-embedding predictive world model that treats transition depth as an inner test-time scaling axis and learns when another recurrent update is worth computing for each candidate and rollout step. Across five visual-control settings, DeepJEPA improves or matches the strongest fixed-depth planner while averaging only 1.00-1.26 updates per transition. Its additional computation concentrates at contact onset and sustained object interaction, where latent corrections can change which candidates enter the planner's elite set and which action is selected. Representation probes further show that improved planning does not require uniformly better object-state decodability. DeepJEPA therefore reframes world-model scaling as a problem of allocating internal computation where it can change the planner's decision: think deeper at decision-critical transitions instead of making every rollout uniformly deeper or longer.

</details>


### [371] [Whole-Body Aerial Grasping and Lifting via Partial Visual Observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00404)
*Jiaye Jin,Rui Jin,Xinhang Xu,Haotian Jin,Ruiyang Liu,Yi Wang,Jiayan Zhao,Kun Cao,Lihua Xie*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出循环教师-学生框架，用单一策略在仿真中联合控制飞行、机械臂运动与夹爪闭合，无需显式任务阶段输入；特权教师经强化学习与关键状态课程训练后蒸馏为循环视觉学生，仿真全任务成功率最高达99.97%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空中抓取-举升任务需在部分可观测条件下完成接近、抓取与举升的全身协调。训练中早期接近失败会减少后续阶段的状态暴露，而执行时目标可见性变化又给对准与闭合时机带来困难，因此需要一种不依赖显式阶段输入、能处理部分观测的闭环策略。

Method: 采用循环教师-学生框架：特权教师通过强化学习训练，并使用关键状态课程，先暴露抓取与举升状态，再与正常接近轨迹衔接；随后将教师行为蒸馏为循环视觉学生，用双视角点云与本体感受替代特权目标状态，并整合观测历史实现闭环控制；另设专门闭合目标，依据持续性的模型定义就绪序列监督闭合时机。训练与主要评估基于带条件触发锁存、虚拟附着和基于力旋量的负载加载的仿真抓取-负载模型，用于短距离举升。

Result: 在该模型的8,996个完整仿真回合中，冻结后的学生策略在标称、物理/控制随机化以及附加相机随机化条件下，全任务成功率分别为99.97%、97.14%与95.84%；标称条件下按锁存次数加权的每种子90百分位抓取对准误差均值为8.12 mm。

Conclusion: 结果表明，关键状态课程与教师蒸馏相结合，可使循环视觉学生策略在无显式阶段输入的情况下完成空中抓取-举升全任务，并在物理、控制与相机随机化下保持较高成功率与对准精度。

Abstract: Aerial grasp-and-lift tasks require whole-body coordination across approach, acquisition, and lifting under partial target observations. Early approach failures can limit exposure to later task stages during training, while changing visibility complicates alignment and closure timing during execution. We present a recurrent teacher-student framework that learns a single policy in simulation to jointly command flight, arm motion, and gripper closure without an explicit task-phase input. A privileged teacher learns through reinforcement learning with a critical-state curriculum that exposes acquisition and lifting states before connecting them to normal approach trajectories. Its behavior is distilled into a recurrent visual student that replaces privileged target states with dual-view point clouds and proprioception, integrating observation history for closed-loop control. A dedicated closure objective supervises closure timing from sustained model-defined readiness sequences. Training and primary evaluation use a simulated acquisition-and-payload model with condition-triggered latching, virtual attachment, and wrench-based payload loading for short-distance lifting. Across 8,996 completed simulation episodes under this model, the frozen student achieves full-task success rates of 99.97%, 97.14%, and 95.84% under nominal, physics/control-randomized, and additional camera-randomized conditions, respectively. The nominal latch-count-weighted mean of per-seed 90th-percentile alignment errors at acquisition is 8.12 mm.

</details>


### [372] [ALFRED: Requirement-driven development of an open-source mobile manipulator for long-term plant monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01477)
*Ciarán Miceal Johnson,Christopher Quail,Garry Ellard,Alistair McConnell,Steve Tonneau,Fernando Auat Cheein*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出开源移动操作机器人ALFRED，经四次迭代设计满足六项长期野外部署要求，机械臂可用姿态比例由34.0%提升至66.1%，并完成一年528次森林月度调查任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跟踪作物与森林的季节性变化需对同一植株重复观测，地面机器人适合近距离作业，机械臂可提供更多视角。但长期野外数据集背后的机器人很少公开设计文件，且机器人自身结构对机械臂可达范围与传感器遮挡的影响鲜有在不同版本间比较。

Method: 基于商用组件构建开放源代码移动操作机器人ALFRED：Ackermann转向底盘上搭载六自由度机械臂、LiDAR、RGB-D相机、RTK GNSS与IMU，采用可重构铝型材框架与容器化ROS软件；围绕耐用性、模块化、可维修性、感知可达性、续航与可复现性六项要求进行四次迭代，并对后三个版本开展基于模型的分析（可达姿态可用比例）与光线投射遮挡分析。

Result: 后三个版本机械臂可达姿态的可用比例依次为34.0%、60.0%和66.1%；光线投射显示仅最终版本使框架安装的LiDAR前后水平视野均保持无遮挡。ALFRED完成一年月度森林调查（528次穿越）且未遗漏任何计划采集，期间经历电池退化、为其他研究重新配置以及并行开发面向自主作物行作业的ALFRED 2.0，每次版本切换约需六小时。

Conclusion: 模块化机械设计能否可靠运行，取决于与之同步维护的机器人描述模型；仅有机身模块化而缺乏准确的URDF等描述文件支撑，长期部署的可维护性难以保证。

Abstract: Tracking seasonal change in crops and forests requires observing the same plants repeatedly. Ground robots can do this at close range, and a manipulator gives their sensors more viewpoints. Yet the robots behind long-term field datasets are rarely released with their design files, and how a robot's own structure limits arm reach and occludes its sensors is seldom compared between builds. We present ALFRED, an open-source mobile manipulator built from commercially available components. It carries a six-degree-of-freedom arm, LiDAR, RGB-D cameras, RTK GNSS and an IMU on an Ackermann-steered base, all mounted on a reconfigurable aluminium strut frame, and runs containerised ROS software. It was developed through four builds against six requirements for repeated outdoor deployment: durability, modularity, repairability, sensing reach, endurance and reproducibility. Model-based analysis of the last three builds shows the usable share of the arm's reachable poses rising from 34.0% to 60.0% and then 66.1%, and ray casting shows that only the final build keeps the frame-mounted LiDAR's horizontal view clear both forwards and backwards. ALFRED completed a year of monthly forest surveys (528 traversals) without missing a scheduled collection. This was despite battery degradation, reconfiguration for another researcher's study, and the parallel development of ALFRED 2.0 for autonomous crop-row operation, with each switch between builds taking about six hours. The deployment also showed that mechanical modularity is only as dependable as the robot description that tracks it.

</details>


### [373] [Towards a General Humanoid Loco-Manipulation Model via Egocentric Whole-Body Human Data Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00438)
*Chongyang Xu,Zhao Wu,Jin Chen,Yiming Jiang,Jinhui Ye,Yuming Jiang,Shifeng Zhang,Ziliang Feng,Mu Xu,Yilun Chen,Li Lu,Steven C. H. Hoi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出 HumanVerse-500（500 小时人类全身移动操作数据集）与 λ₀（全身人形视觉-语言-动作策略），通过三阶段训练将自我中心人类视频经验迁移到人形机器人，在 SIMPLE 与 4 项真实任务上取得 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形全身操作发展迅速，但监督信号稀缺：现有自我中心人类视频对全身运动及手-物交互协调的覆盖有限，而通过人形遥操作采集数据成本高、难以规模化。因此作者探索如何利用人类经验支持可扩展的人形移动操作学习。

Method: 1) 构建 HumanVerse-500：用轻量可穿戴系统同步采集自我中心视频与身体、手部运动，覆盖开放世界中的多样人类移动操作行为，共 500 小时。2) 提出 λ₀ 全身人形 VLA 策略，采用三阶段训练：先在多样自我中心数据集上学交互，再用 HumanVerse-500 协调身体与手部运动，最后适配下游任务与机器人本体。3) 学习共享表示空间以迁移人类经验，并用域特定接口处理人与机器人状态/动作差异。

Result: 在 SIMPLE 基准与 4 项真实世界移动操作任务上达到 SOTA，并分析了规模化行为、泛化性及各训练阶段的贡献。

Conclusion: 人类经验可有效支持下游全身人形控制的规模化学习；作者将开源代码、模型与数据以推动后续研究。

Abstract: Humanoid whole-body manipulation has advanced rapidly, enabling policies to coordinate locomotion, posture, bimanual interaction, and dexterous hand movements. Meanwhile, egocentric human videos provide diverse examples of everyday interactions across objects and scenes, offering scalable supervision without robot operation. However, existing supervision from these videos provides limited coverage of whole-body movement and coordination with hand-object interaction, while obtaining such supervision through humanoid teleoperation is also costly and difficult to scale. We therefore explore how human experience can support scalable learning of humanoid loco-manipulation. To support this study, we introduce HumanVerse-500, a 500-hour dataset of diverse human loco-manipulation behaviors in open-world environments, collected with a lightweight wearable system that synchronizes egocentric video with body and hand motion.
