Building on this dataset, we develop $λ_0$, a whole-body humanoid vision-language-action policy, through three-stage training that first learns interaction from diverse egocentric datasets, then coordinates body and hand motion using HumanVerse-500, and finally adapts the policy to downstream tasks and robot embodiments. Across these stages, $λ_0$ learns a shared representation space for human experience transfer, while domain-specific interfaces handle differences between human and robot states and actions. We evaluate $λ_0$ on SIMPLE and 4 real-world loco-manipulation tasks, achieving state-of-the-art performance, and further analyze its scaling behavior, generalization, and training-stage contributions to understand how human data support downstream whole-body humanoid control. We will release our code, models, and data to support further research.

</details>


### [374] [ScaffoldM3C: A Multimodal Sequential Monte Carlo Framework for Generative Stable Construction Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00487)
*Gadiel Sznaier Camps,Chengyang He,Guillaume Sartoretti,Eduardo Montijano,Mac Schwager*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出 ScaffoldM3C，将积木式 3D 结构构建建模为多模态条件下的概率式下一块生成任务，并显式引入脚手架以实现稳定构建，结合顺序蒙特卡洛维持多条装配序列，实现更小、更快且稳定性更高的自主构建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主构建物理可实现 3D 结构面临组合动作空间大、组件可互换、装配序列多解（equifinality）以及构建过程中的严格稳定性要求等挑战。现有基于大语言模型微调的文本生成式构建方法存在三方面不足：不支持多模态（文本、图像、草图）条件输入；忽视脚手架对稳定中间结构的实际作用；推理速度慢。

Method: 将构建问题形式化为具有多种潜在装配动作和多种任务条件模态的概率式下一块生成任务；引入辅助脚手架块 token 显式建模脚手架效用；提出 ScaffoldM3C——一种多模态、轻量级、自回归的块式稳定构建模型，用于生成下一步候选块集合；基于候选块使用顺序蒙特卡洛（SMC）维护可能装配序列的种群，以同时考虑多条潜在且不同的装配方向；通过扩展 StableText2Brick 数据集，加入图像条件提示和脚手架稳定化的构建序列进行训练。

Result: ScaffoldM3C 相比竞争基线模型小 4 倍，推理速度提升 5 至 20 倍，同时构建质量与最先进方法相当，整体稳定性更高；并通过仿真和真实机器人装配演示验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过多模态条件建模、显式脚手架机制与基于 SMC 的多序列搜索，可在保证构建质量的同时显著降低模型规模与推理成本，并提升构建过程稳定性，为自主、稳定的物理 3D 结构构建提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Autonomously constructing physically realizable 3D structures remains a significant challenge due to combinatorial action spaces, interchangeable components, equifinal assembly sequences, and strict stability requirements during construction. State-of-the-art methods fine-tune large language models for text-based generative construction. However, these approaches do not allow for Multimodal (text, image, sketch) conditioning, overlook the practical role of scaffolding for stabilizing intermediate structures, and suffer from slow inference speeds. Therefore, we formulate construction as a probabilistic next-block generation task with multiple potential assembly actions and multiple potential task conditioning modalities. Concurrently, we explicitly consider the utility of scaffolding by introducing an auxiliary scaffold block token. We present Scaffold Multimodal Monte Carlo (ScaffoldM3C), a multimodal, lightweight, auto-regressive model for stable block-based construction, that proposes a set of next-step candidate blocks. Leveraging these candidates, we utilize Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) to maintain a population of possible assembly sequences, allowing us to consider multiple, potentially different, assembly directions simultaneously. We train our multimodal architecture by extending the StableText2Brick dataset to contain image conditioning prompts and scaffold-stabilized build sequences. ScaffoldM3C is 4x smaller than competing baselines, yielding a 5x to 20x speedup during inference, while achieving comparable construction quality to state-of-the-art methods and higher overall stability. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach through simulations and real-world robot assembly demonstrations.

</details>


### [375] [Same Scene, Different Task: Skill Alignment for Compositional Generalization in VLAs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00524)
*Taegeun Yang,Youngju Na,Yoonki Cho,Sung-Eui Yoon*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 CRAFT，通过反事实指令对与技能表示实现监督迁移，缓解 VLA 模型的视觉捷径问题，从而提升未演示技能组合的泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA 模型难以泛化到微调演示中未出现的技能组合，即使每个组成技能都已被演示过。作者将其归因于一种失败模式——视觉捷径：微调时视觉观测可能成为指令的代理，策略倾向于执行与相似观测关联的已演示组合，而非指令所要求的组合。

Method: 构造反事实对：固定演示中的观测，将指令替换为未演示的技能组合，以此迫使模型关注指令而非视觉代理。由于这些反事实对缺少对应的示范动作目标，且同一技能在不同观测下所需动作不同，无法直接复用动作。CRAFT 利用可在同一技能不同执行间复用的技能表示，将已演示执行中的监督迁移到反事实对上。

Result: 在三个 VLA 模型和两个仿真基准上，CRAFT 提升了未演示组合的成功率，同时保持在已演示组合上的高成功率；并在真实机器人上改善了组合泛化能力。

Conclusion: 通过技能表示实现监督迁移的反事实训练，可有效抑制视觉捷径，是提升 VLA 模型组合泛化能力的一条可行路径。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models often struggle to generalize to skill combinations absent from their fine-tuning demonstrations, even when every constituent skill has been demonstrated. We focus on a vision shortcut as one failure mode: during fine-tuning, visual observations can serve as a proxy for the instruction, so a policy may execute a demonstrated combination associated with similar observations rather than the instructed combination. This motivates training with counterfactual pairs formed by holding a demonstration observation fixed while changing the instruction to specify an undemonstrated combination. These pairs, however, lack corresponding demonstrated action targets. Crucially, the currently required skill has already been demonstrated, but actions from those executions cannot serve as direct targets because the same skill can require different actions across observations. We propose CRAFT, which transfers supervision from demonstrated executions of the required skill to counterfactual pairs using skill representations that can be reused across executions of the same skill. Across three VLA models and two simulation benchmarks, CRAFT improves success on undemonstrated combinations while maintaining high success on demonstrated ones; it also improves compositional generalization on a real robot. Project website: https://taegeunyang.github.io/craft/

</details>


### [376] [Does Continual Imitation Learning Remain Grounded? A Language-Perturbed Benchmark for Robotic Task Retention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00542)
*Siddeshwar Raghavan,Ziqin Yuan,Fengqing Zhu,Byung-Cheol Min*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基准测试协议，用于研究机器人策略在连续学习多个任务时，语言引导行为如何变化，并将任务能力与语言敏感性分离评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续模仿学习通常只关注是否遗忘已学技能，但保留任务性能并不代表行为真正由语言引导，策略可能依赖场景线索、物体关联或记忆化的任务结构。因此需要新的诊断方法来检验技能是否仍被指令正确引导。

Method: 为LIBERO的Goal、Spatial、Object、Long套件构建保持语义与改变语义的指令变体；策略实验聚焦LIBERO-Goal，在每个连续学习阶段后评估原始指令与改写指令；在原始假设下比较代表性连续模仿学习方法，并将任务能力与语言敏感性分离，测量语义鲁棒性、目标适应性与语言敏感性。

Result: 结果表明，强连续学习性能并不总能转化为可靠的语言接地；所提出的诊断指标有助于判断保留下来的技能是否仍被指令正确引导，并补充了标准的学 习与遗忘指标。

Conclusion: 语言接地应作为连续模仿学习的独立评估维度，仅凭任务性能不足以说明机器人真正理解并遵循语言指令。

Abstract: Continual imitation learning evaluates whether a robot can learn new knowledge without forgetting previously learned skills. However, retaining task performance does not ensure the behavior remains grounded in language because policies may rely on scene cues, object associations, or memorized task structure. We introduce a benchmark protocol to study how language-guided behavior changes as robotic policies learn successive tasks. We construct meaning-preserving and meaning-changing instruction variants for the Goal, Spatial, Object, and Long suites of LIBERO. Policy experiments focus on LIBERO-Goal, evaluating Original and Paraphrase instructions after each continual-learning stage. We compare representative continual imitation learning methods under their original assumptions while separating task competence from language sensitivity. The proposed diagnostics complement standard learning and forgetting metrics by measuring semantic robustness, goal adaptation, and language sensitivity. Results show that strong continual-learning performance does not always translate to reliable language grounding, and our diagnostics help determine whether retained skills remain correctly guided by their instructions. Additional materials are available at https://sites.google.com/view/stillgrounded

</details>


### [377] [Token-World: World Modeling in Vision-Language Model Token Space for Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00575)
*Chuyao Fu,Xiaowei Chi,Yuhan Rui,Yu-kai Wang,Zezhong Qian,Xiaojie Zhang,Yunfan Lou,Kevin Zhang,Kuangzhi Ge,Chak Wing Mak,Zhiyang Chen,Athena Zhuoming Zhong,Hongyang Chen,Haoran Li,Yike Guo,Sirui Han,Shanghang Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Token-World 提出了一种面向 VLA 策略的紧凑状态世界模型，将 VLM 视觉 token 压缩为低维 token 状态并在该空间进行动作条件动力学建模，再映射回原策略表示，提升开环保真度、闭环策略一致性并降低仿真延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLA 世界模型仿真通常先预测未来 RGB 观测再重新编码为策略输入，导致仿真与下游策略执行之间存在间接接口。作者希望直接在由 VLM 视觉 token 导出的紧凑、面向策略的状态空间中建模世界动力学。主要挑战在于原始 VLM 视觉 token 维度高，直接自回归建模难以兼顾效率与精度。

Method: 提出 Token-World：动作条件世界模型。首先将 VLM 特征压缩为紧凑 token 状态，在该降维空间中学习未来动力学，再将预测状态映射回原策略面向的表示以供下游使用，从而避免 RGB 预测-重编码的间接接口。

Result: 在操作类基准上，Token-World 相较近期世界模型仿真器提升了开环特征保真度与策略-动作一致性，并在长时域 rollout 中退化更慢。闭环评测中，其仿真策略性能与参考策略性能的相关性高于 Ctrl-World（r=0.794 vs. 0.583），同时仿真延迟更低。消融实验表明紧凑表示设计与维度对未来状态预测有显著影响。

Conclusion: 在策略导向的紧凑 VLM token 状态空间中建模世界动力学是可行且有效的，可同时改善开环保真度、闭环策略一致性和效率。紧凑表示的设计与维度选择是关键因素。代码将公开。

Abstract: A common approach to world-model simulation for vision-language-action (VLA) systems is to predict future RGB observations and then re-encode them into policy inputs, introducing an indirect interface between simulation and downstream policy execution. We instead investigate whether world dynamics can be modeled in a compact, policy-oriented state derived from VLM visual tokens. A key challenge is that raw VLM visual tokens are high-dimensional, making efficient and accurate autoregressive dynamics modeling challenging. To address this, we introduce Token-World, an action-conditioned world model that compresses VLM features into a compact token state, learns future dynamics in this reduced space, and maps predicted states back to the original policy-facing representation for downstream use. Across manipulation benchmarks, Token-World improves open-loop feature fidelity and policy-action consistency over recent world-model simulators, with slower degradation over long rollout horizons. In closed-loop evaluation, its simulated policy performance correlates more strongly with reference policy performance than Ctrl-World ($r=0.794$ vs.\ $0.583$), while requiring lower simulation latency. Ablations further show that compact-representation design and dimensionality substantially affect future-state prediction. Code will be available at https://chuyaofu.github.io/Token-World/.

</details>


### [378] [When Reasoning Helps Action: Monitoring and Steering Chain-of-Thought in Vision-Language-Action Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00601)
*Sathwik Karnik,Joseph JR. Lee,Aryaman Gupta,Somil Bansal*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出评估VLA策略中CoT推理作为运行时安全接口的两个维度——可纠正性(correctability)与可行动性(actionability)，并引入TRUST方法（离线训练的价值模型，通过部分前缀预测推理正确性并选择性引导生成），在驾驶与操作两类VLA上验证。结果显示：推理正确性的提升并不必然带来具身性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具备推理能力的VLA策略会输出CoT轨迹，看似能解释并引导动作，由此形成了通过推理监控与纠正来实现运行时安全的潜在接口。然而，该接口在何时能真正改善具身行为尚缺乏明确的评估框架，需要定义可度量的评估维度来判断其有效性。

Method: 作者定义并操作化两个评估轴：(1) 可纠正性(correctability)，衡量不可靠推理能否在生成过程中被检测并改进；(2) 可行动性(actionability)，衡量推理纠正是否能产生朝预期方向的行为性有意义变化。为实现可纠正性，提出TRUST（Token-level Reward for Utility-Steered Chain-of-Thought）：一个离线训练的价值模型，从部分推理前缀预测最终推理正确性，并据此监控与选择性引导冻结VLA策略的推理生成。

Result: 在Alpamayo 1.5驾驶VLA上：TRUST监控正确性准确率88.9%，将推理正确率从75.9%提升至90.0%；在AlpaSim的困难子集上，碰撞率降低30.4%、最大轨迹误差降低11.5%，优于算力匹配的Best-of-4基线。在DeepThinkVLA操作VLA上：抓取状态判断正确率由69.3%提升至90.2%，动作选择判断由68.8%提升至85.9%，但LIBERO-Plus闭环任务性能基本不变。经验分析显示Alpamayo 1.5存在意图一致的行为效应，而DeepThinkVLA效应有限，解释了二者任务级结果的差异。

Conclusion: 推理正确性的提升并不自动意味着具身性能的提升。使用CoT作为运行时安全接口时，应同时评估可纠正性与可行动性，以判断推理层面的改进是否能转化为实际行为收益。

Abstract: Reasoning-enabled VLA policies expose chain-of-thought (CoT) traces that appear to explain and guide their actions, creating a potential interface for runtime safety through reasoning monitoring and correction. In this work, we define and operationalize two evaluation axes for assessing when this interface can improve embodied behavior: correctability, which measures whether unreliable reasoning can be detected and improved during generation, and actionability, which measures whether reasoning corrections produce behaviorally meaningful changes in the intended direction. To enable correctability, we introduce Token-level Reward for Utility-Steered Chain-of-Thought (TRUST), an offline-trained value model that predicts eventual reasoning correctness from partial prefixes and uses these estimates to monitor and selectively steer reasoning generation in frozen VLA policies. On the Alpamayo 1.5 driving VLA, TRUST monitors correctness with 88.9% accuracy and improves reasoning correctness from 75.9% to 90.0%. On a baseline-defined challenging subset in AlpaSim, TRUST reduces collision rate by 30.4% and maximum trajectory error by 11.5% relative to the unsteered policy, outperforming a compute-matched Best-of-4 baseline. On the DeepThinkVLA manipulation VLA, TRUST improves the correctness of grasp-state claims from 69.3% to 90.2% and action-choice claims from 68.8% to 85.9%, yet closed-loop task performance on LIBERO-Plus remains largely unchanged. Empirical analysis reveals intent-consistent behavioral effects in Alpamayo 1.5 but limited effects in DeepThinkVLA, helping interpret these different task-level outcomes. Together, our results show that gains in reasoning correctness do not automatically imply gains in embodied performance, motivating evaluation of correctability and actionability when using CoT as a runtime safety interface.

</details>


### [379] [TacDyn-WAM: Learning Implicit Tactile Dynamics in a Heterogeneous Visuo-Tactile World Action Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00638)
*Enyi Wang,Mingxin Wang,Quan Shi,Hetian Guo,Hongyu Wang,Xi Wang,Bin Qian,Yupeng Zheng,Wenxuan Song,Houde Liu,Yong Xu,Cheng Chi,Wenchao Ding,Yilun Chen,Yan Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: TacDyn-WAM 提出一种异构视触觉世界动作模型，预测隐式触觉动力学而非重建未来触觉观测，在 UniVTAC 上以仅示范数据达到 81.5% 平均成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有触觉世界动作模型多沿用视频生成式流程，通过迭代去噪重建未来触觉观测；部署漂移下接触位置或力的微小变化即可显著改变触觉像素，导致预测不可靠，即使底层接触演化本身仍可预测。

Method: 学习 TacRep 动力学感知触觉目标空间，通过触觉片段上的掩码时空预测训练，并以关系结构蒸馏正则化；视觉专家与隐式触觉动力学专家在各自目标空间预测未来视觉与触觉表征，通过联合注意力交互；触觉专家单次前向预测多时间尺度的未来表征及其变化，只读触觉记忆提供当前触觉状态。

Result: UniVTAC 上仅用提供示范平均成功率 81.5%，达到 SOTA 级别，且与大规模视触觉轨迹预训练模型竞争；消融验证两条触觉通路与 TacRep 优于像素重建和静态方案。五个真机任务平均成功率 71.0%，小规模预训练提升至 85.0%。

Conclusion: 以隐式触觉动力学预测替代像素级重建，可提升世界动作模型在触觉模态下的鲁棒性与数据效率，真机实验进一步验证其有效性。

Abstract: World action models improve robotic manipulation by conditioning actions on predicted futures, yet existing tactile variants largely inherit video-generation pipelines that reconstruct future tactile observations through iterative denoising. Such prediction can become unreliable under deployment drift: small changes in contact position or force may substantially alter tactile pixels even when the underlying contact evolution remains predictable. We introduce TacDyn-WAM, a heterogeneous visuo-tactile world action model that predicts implicit tactile dynamics rather than reconstructing future tactile observations. It learns TacRep, a dynamics-aware tactile target space trained through masked spatio-temporal prediction on tactile clips and regularized by relational structure distillation. A visual expert and an Implicit Tactile Dynamics Expert predict future visual and tactile representations in separate target spaces while interacting through joint attention; the tactile expert predicts future representations and their changes at multiple horizons in a single forward pass, and a read-only tactile memory supplies the current tactile state. On UniVTAC, TacDyn-WAM achieves an average success rate of 81.5% using only the provided demonstrations, reaching state-of-the-art-level performance and remaining competitive with models pretrained on large-scale visuo-tactile trajectories. Ablations confirm the benefits of both tactile pathways and TacRep over pixel-reconstruction and static alternatives. On five real-robot tasks, TacDyn-WAM reaches 71.0% average success, and modest-scale pretraining raises it to 85.0%, further validating our method.

</details>


### [380] [Toward Humanoid Robots in Construction: A Teleoperation Feasibility Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00718)
*Parastoo Ali Pour,David R. Martin,Chang Min Hur,Bo Zhang,Tommy Zhou,Brandon Thomas Lichter,Shane Stanfield,Pramod Khargonekar,Mohammad Abdullah Al Faruque*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种面向Unitree G1人形机器人的遥操作系统，将XR上半身控制与脚踏式移动结合，使单操作者能同时操作与行走，并在两项建筑施工任务上验证，成功率分别为100%与80%，但耗时显著高于人工。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对持续存在的劳动力短缺、危险作业环境以及人形机器人自主性不足的问题，探索遥操作作为近期可行方案，以减轻工人身体负担，同时采集高质量示范数据。

Method: 构建单人遥操作系统：基于扩展现实（XR）的上半身控制，配合踏板驱动的移动方式，实现操作与移动的并行执行；在Unitree G1人形机器人上部署，并选取O*NET职业数据库中的两项代表性施工任务进行评测。

Result: 工具搬运任务成功率达100%，表面喷漆任务成功率为80%；与人工直接执行的手动基线相比，遥操作耗时明显更长。报告了任务成功率与完成时间。

Conclusion: 遥操作在该场景下具备可行性，能完成代表性施工任务，但效率仍显著低于人工，后续需在控制映射与移动方式上优化以缩小时间差距。

Abstract: We present a teleoperation system that enables a single operator to perform construction tasks on a Unitree G1 humanoid, combining extended reality (XR) based upper body control with pedal-based locomotion to enable simultaneous manipulation and locomotion. Motivated by persistent labor shortages, hazardous working conditions, and challenges in humanoid autonomy, we investigate teleoperation as a practical near-term approach for reducing physical strain on workers while generating high quality demonstration data. We evaluate the system on two representative construction tasks drawn from O*NET occupational database, and report task success and completion time relative to a manual baseline. The system achieved 100% success on tool transport and 80% success on surface painting, with teleoperation requiring substantially more time compared to manual execution.

</details>


### [381] [CF-JEPA: Improving Robustness of JEPA World Models via Controllability Factorization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00727)
*Morgan Byrd,Robert Wright,Sehoon Ha*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出CF-JEPA，将JEPA世界模型潜空间分解为可控与不可控子空间，将干扰信息归入不可控区域，从而在2D/3D控制任务中提升抗干扰能力并避免潜空间坍缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于视觉的智能体控制需要从无关背景中分离有用信息。JEPA式潜世界模型因不做像素级重建而被视为自然方案，但仍对干扰信号敏感，且存在潜空间坍缩问题。

Method: CF-JEPA将潜空间划分为可控子空间与不可控子空间：不可控区域用于捕获全部干扰信息，可控区域保留与控制相关的潜信息并用于任务决策。

Result: 在2D与3D控制任务中，标称条件下性能与基线相当；在含干扰条件下性能更优，且是唯一未出现潜空间坍缩的模型。仿真机器人任务验证了该方案的实际应用价值。

Conclusion: 通过可控性因子化分解潜空间，CF-JEPA能有效隔离干扰并缓解潜空间坍缩，为视觉控制提供了一种抗干扰的世界模型方案。

Abstract: Controlling an agent with vision requires being able to separate useful information from irrelevant background information. JEPA-style latent world models seem like a natural approach for this, as they do not perform pixel-level reconstruction; however, they are still sensitive to these distractor signals and experience latent collapse. In this work, we introduce Controllability Factorized JEPA (CF-JEPA), a JEPA-style world model which splits the latent space into controllable and uncontrollable subspaces. This factorization allows us to capture all the distractor information into the uncontrollable region, while we use the control-relevant latent information for our task. With this, we show comparable performance across 2D and 3D control tasks under nominal conditions and improved performance under distracted conditions, where CF-JEPA is the only model that does not experience latent collapse. We also validate our model under distracted conditions for a simulated robot task, highlighting the practical application of such a scheme.

</details>


### [382] [Measuring Asset and Scene Reconstruction Effects in Real-to-Sim Robot Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00731)
*Sanya Verma,Luca Cilio,Velissarios Christodoulou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文测试其重建流程（度量尺度几何、人工物理参数、场景重建）能否缩小仿真与真机策略评分的差异。十个任务-策略单元各自在两套仿真中运行二十次：自建重建与开源默认重建。与真机评分相比，自建重建相关系数 r=0.90、平均误差 6.97 个百分点；默认为 r=0.51、17.54 个百分点，误差降低 10.56 个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仿真评估因成本低、易重复而被广泛用于机器人策略评估，但其价值取决于仿真结果能否真实反映真机表现。因此需要验证：提升重建质量是否能降低仿真与真机评分的不一致，即缩小 sim-to-real gap。

Method: 构建同一双臂机器人工作单元的两套仿真环境：一是自建重建，采用估计度量尺度的物体几何、投影纹理、人工设定物理参数及自研场景 splat；二是默认重建基线，采用开源流程，即单图生成式网格、引擎默认物理和 Gaussian-splat 场景。两者使用相同的物体照片与场景视频。两个策略各跑五个任务，共十个任务-策略单元（cell），每个单元在每套重建中各运行二十次，其余设置固定。两套重建均以同一批真机试验为基准，由第三方评估者打分。

Result: 十个单元仿真与真机均值的 Pearson 相关系数：自建重建 r=0.90，默认重建 r=0.51。平均评分误差：自建重建 6.97 个百分点，默认重建 17.54 个百分点，降低 10.56 个百分点。

Conclusion: 通过更高视觉保真度、人工设定物理参数与度量尺度来提升环境重建质量，可使仿真更贴近真实世界并缩小 sim-to-real gap。作者公开了评测框架、逐次试验评分、所有报告运行的配置，以及两套重建的资产与场景。

Abstract: Simulated evaluation is increasingly used alongside real-world evaluation of robot policies because it is cheaper and easier to repeat; however, its value depends on how closely its outcomes track the real robot's. We test whether our reconstruction pipeline, combining metrically scaled object geometry, authored physical parameters and scene reconstruction, reduces disagreement between simulated and real robot scores relative to a default open-source recipe. We constructed two simulated versions of one bimanual robot cell: an authored reconstruction, using object geometry at estimated metric scale, projected textures, authored physics and our own scene splat; and a baseline, referred to as the default reconstruction, using the open-source recipe of a generative single-image mesh, engine-default physics and a Gaussian-splat scene. Both reconstructions use the same object photographs and scene video. Two policies ran five tasks each, giving ten task-policy pairs, which we call cells; each cell was run twenty times in each reconstruction with all other settings held fixed. Both reconstructions were scored against the same real trials, graded by a third-party evaluator. Pearson correlation between the ten simulated and real cell means is r = 0.90 for the authored reconstruction and 0.51 for the default. Mean score error is 6.97 percentage points for the authored reconstruction and 17.54 for the default, a reduction of 10.56 percentage points. These results show that improving the quality of the environment reconstruction through higher visual fidelity, authored physics and metric scale makes the simulation more faithful to the real world and narrows the sim-to-real gap. We release the harness, the per-trial scores, every reported run's configuration, and the assets and scenes of both reconstructions.

</details>


### [383] [DITTO-X: Forward and Reverse Teleoperation for Dexterous Manipulation and Human Intervention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00781)
*Zhanpeng He,Joaquin Palacios,Zhangyu Wang,Chenhao Li,Katelyn Lee,Matei Ciocarlie,C. Karen Liu,Jiajun Wu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DITTO-X是一种手部无关的灵巧遥操作接口，利用机器人手部现有传感器渲染关节力矩与指尖接触事件，无需逐手重设计即可驱动三款商用灵巧手，并支持反向遥操作，使操作者在接管时已处于与机器人匹配的状态，从而提升演示质量与采集效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有遥操作系统多以视觉闭环为主，且围绕平行夹爪构建，限制了机器人可执行动作与操作者可表达的意图。在共享自主场景中问题尤为突出：操作者仅能通过被遮挡的相机观察场景，且往往需要在已抓取物体的状态下中途接管灵巧手。

Method: 提出DITTO-X，一种手部无关（hand-agnostic）的灵巧遥操作接口：基于机器人手上已有的传感，渲染关节级力反馈与指尖接触事件；在不做逐手重新设计的前提下驱动Sharpa、Wuji、Inspire三款商用灵巧手；由于外骨骼具备驱动能力，还支持反向遥操作，由机器人反向驱动操作者手指进入其自身构型，从而在控制权转移前使人类与所继承的状态相匹配。

Result: 在常规数据采集以及策略部署过程中针对接触丰富操作任务的人工干预两种场景下，DITTO-X相较商用动作追踪手套均提升了演示质量与吞吐量。

Conclusion: DITTO-X通过力/接触反馈与手部无关的通用接口，改善了灵巧遥操作的演示质量与效率；反向遥操作有助于人在接管时状态对齐，对共享自主与接触丰富任务具有实用价值。更多信息见 https://tml.stanford.edu/ditto-x/。

Abstract: Teleoperated demonstrations are a primary source of data for robot manipulation, and teleoperated interventions are a primary mechanism for correcting policies at deployment. Yet most teleoperation systems close the loop through vision alone and are built around parallel-jaw grippers, limiting both what the robot can execute and what the operator can express through it. This is most damaging in shared autonomy, where the operator sees the scene only through occluded cameras and must take over a dexterous hand mid-task, often with an object already grasped. We present DITTO-X, a hand-agnostic dexterous teleoperation interface that renders joint-level force and fingertip contact events from sensing already on the robot hand, and drives three commercial dexterous hands (Sharpa, Wuji, and Inspire) without per-hand redesign. Because the exoskeleton is actuated, DITTO-X also supports reverse teleoperation, in which the robot back-drives the operator's fingers into its own configuration before control is transferred, so the human enters the loop already matched to the state they inherit. Our results show that DITTO-X improves demonstration quality and throughput over a commercial hand-tracking glove, both in regular data collection and in human intervention during policy deployment for contact-rich manipulation tasks. More information can be found from our website: https://tml.stanford.edu/ditto-x/.

</details>


### [384] [ECoMEM: Explicit Concept Memory for Memory-Dependent Robot Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00801)
*Yize Liu,Ke Wang,Mac Schwager,Yiqing Xu,Jiajun Wu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出显式概念记忆（ECoMEM），将“维护任务相关历史的证据化记录”与“学习如何基于记忆行动”解耦，用可复用的接地概念库表征历史，在16项RoboMME任务中领先15项，真机任务成功率86.1%对比无记忆VLA的8.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程机器人任务中，动作所需信息常从当前观测中消失（如物体离开视野、需回忆演示、追踪已完成步骤），而现有VLA策略一旦信息不可见即失效。已有方案依赖更长历史输入或从观测-动作轨迹中隐式学习记忆，但动作监督只告诉策略“如何行动”，不指明“应记住哪些事实、以及这些事实如何随新证据更新”，因此记忆内容缺乏明确约束。

Method: 将记忆维护与动作学习解耦：一是维护基于证据的过去状态记录，二是学习如何据此行动。据此设计ECoMEM，用可复用的接地概念库表征任务相关历史；由基于证据的Writer负责选择与更新这些记录，由学习得到的Reader将其转化为记忆token，直接作为VLA的条件输入。

Result: 在16项RoboMME任务中，ECoMEM在15项上优于所评估的机器人策略；在两项新的真机任务上，同一记忆库可直接迁移或仅需新增一个概念，成功率达86.1%，而无记忆VLA仅8.6%。

Conclusion: 显式概念为机器人控制提供了一种可复用、可扩展的记忆接口，说明将记忆内容显式化、接地化并解耦于动作学习，是提升长程VLA行为有效性的可行路径。

Abstract: A robot may lose sight of an object it must later retrieve, need to recall what a person demonstrated earlier, or track which steps of a task it has already completed. Current vision-language-action (VLA) policies often fail once the information needed for action disappears from the current observation, making memory critical for long-horizon robot behavior. Existing approaches typically provide longer histories or learn implicit memory from observation-action trajectories. But action supervision tells a policy how to act, not what to remember: it does not specify which past facts should persist or how they should change as new evidence arrives. We therefore separate maintaining an evidence-grounded account of the past from learning how to act on it. This insight motivates Explicit Concept Memory (ECoMEM), which represents task-relevant history with a reusable library of grounded concepts. An evidence-based Writer selects and updates these records, while a learned Reader turns them into memory tokens that directly condition the VLA. Across 16 RoboMME tasks, ECoMEM leads the evaluated robot policies on 15 tasks. On two new real-robot tasks, the same memory library either transfers directly or requires only one new concept, achieving 86.1% success versus 8.6% for a no-memory VLA. These results show that explicit concepts provide a reusable and extensible memory interface for robot control. Project website: https://ecomem.github.io/

</details>


### [385] [Getting Out and Getting Back: World and Behavior Grounding in Real2Sim2Real Co-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00821)
*Samuel Liu,Youngsun Kim,Martin Matak,Gilwoo Lee*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出real2sim2real流水线，区分"世界接地"（仿真对齐真实系统）与"行为接地"（仿真轨迹对齐人类动作），在动态灵巧抓取分拣任务中验证二者对co-training策略性能的贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仿真可扩充稀缺的真实示范用于co-training，但"世界保真度"与"与人类行为的相似度"如何影响策略性能尚不清晰，需要解耦并量化这两类接地因素的作用。

Method: 构建real2sim2real流水线，独立调整世界接地与行为接地两个维度生成数据用于co-training，并在动态灵巧pick-and-sort任务上评估；通过潜在空间分析刻画部署策略的行为模式。

Result: 完全接地的co-training将成功率从52%提升至86%；平均而言，世界接地提升成功率18个百分点，行为接地提升10个百分点。部署策略表现为真实来源与仿真来源策略的混合：在真实示范覆盖的状态中模仿真实示范，其余状态依赖仿真行为。

Conclusion: 世界接地使策略能利用超出真实数据覆盖范围的仿真经验，行为接地主要在世界接地不完善时起作用，二者作用互补；在co-training基础模型时，接地仿真仍然有益。

Abstract: Simulation can expand scarce real demonstrations for co-training, yet how world fidelity and similarity to human behavior affect policy performance remains unclear. We distinguish world grounding, which aligns simulation with the real system, and behavior grounding, which aligns simulated trajectories with human motion. We build a real2sim2real pipeline that varies these axes independently to generate data for co-training. On a dynamic dexterous pick-and-sort task, fully grounded co-training raises success from 52% to 86%; averaged across configurations, world grounding improves success by 18 percentage points and behavior grounding by 10. Deployed policies behave like a mixture of real-derived and simulation-derived policies, imitating real demonstrations in covered states and relying on simulated behavior elsewhere, which we examine through latent-space analysis. Together, these results suggest complementary roles: world grounding lets policies use simulated experience beyond real-data coverage, while behavior grounding matters mainly when world grounding is imperfect. Grounded simulation remains beneficial when co-training foundation models.

</details>


### [386] [TRACE: Privacy-Preserving Next-Best-View Selection over Distributed 3D Gaussian-Splat Maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00822)
*Amirhossein Mollaei Khass,Athanasios Cosse,Qiyu Sun,Nader Motee*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出TRACE协议：多机器人各自维护私有3DGS地图，仅通信射线透射率与前向辐照度的深度分箱聚合量及其位姿导数，实现分布式下一最佳视角选择，无需共享地图且消息量不随地图规模增长。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多机器人团队中，各机器人构建的3D高斯溅射地图往往因隐私或通信带宽限制不能共享，但下一最佳视角选择所需的期望信息增益取决于所有地图的联合体（遮挡与背景辐射耦合），单机无法计算。因此需要一种在保持地图私有的前提下分布式求解EIG的机制。

Method: 证明EIG的跨机器人耦合只经由两个射线量：某溅射点前方的透射率与其后方的辐照度，且二者均为沿射线命中点的求和，从而可按机器人分解。各机器人沿候选视角射线对本机地图按深度分箱求和，并将聚合值及其对位姿的导数发送给规划机器人；规划机器人据此还原EIG并在SO(3)上求梯度。协议命名为TRACE（Transmittance and Radiance Aggregates）。

Result: 理论上证明当某溅射点后方的深度分箱不混合来自两个机器人的命中点时重构精确，否则给出误差上界。在Habitat-Sim中超过100次NBV决策中，TRACE所选朝向在83.3%的情况下与集中式方案相差15度以内，其视角EIG达到集中式方案的97.9%。

Conclusion: TRACE以极小的、与地图规模无关的通信开销实现了接近集中式的分布式NBV性能，同时保持各机器人溅射地图私有，为大团队隐私受限的协同主动重建提供了可证明的近似方案。

Abstract: Share the light, not the map. We study next-best-view selection for a team of robots, each of which builds its own 3D Gaussian Splatting map and keeps it private. A robot picks the view with the largest expected information gain (EIG) about the splats along its own path. This gain depends on the other maps. Their splats occlude its own and shine behind them, so the gain has to be evaluated against the pooled map. No robot has this map. We show that the coupling passes through only two ray quantities, the transmittance in front of a splat and the radiance behind it, and that both are sums over the hits of the ray. Hence, they decompose across the robots, and each robot sums them over depth bins in its own map, along the rays of a candidate view, and sends the sums with their pose derivatives. The robot planning the view turns them into its EIG and gradient on SO(3). Transmittance and Radiance Aggregates, communicated for the EIG, give the protocol its name: TRACE. No robot shares its splats, and the message size does not grow with a map. We prove that the reconstruction is exact unless a depth bin behind a splat mixes hits of two robots, and we bound the error otherwise. Over 100 next-best-view decisions in Habitat-Sim, TRACE picks a heading within 15 degrees of the centralized one in 83.3% of the cases, and its views reach 97.9% of the centralized EIG.

</details>


### [387] [Reactive Humanoid Multi-Contact Using Learned Stability Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00823)
*Stephen McCrory,Beomyeong Park,Nicholas Kitchel,Nehar Poddar,Robert Griffin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种利用手部接触的反应式规划与控制方法，用于提升人形机器人在低稳定性场景下的平衡能力，通过学习的CoP区域模型快速评估候选接触点，实现两阶段支撑点规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在人形机器人低稳定性场景中，仅依靠足部接触可能导致摔倒，因此需要利用手部接触（支撑）来增强稳定性。传统基于优化的方法评估候选接触点耗时较长，难以满足反应式规划需求。

Method: 在机器人可达工作空间内采样候选接触点，通过滚动展开质心动力学（预碰撞、碰撞、后碰撞三个阶段）进行预览，并基于后碰撞阶段的CoP控制能力对采样点打分。核心是学习一个后碰撞阶段机器人CoP区域的模型，以实现候选接触点的快速评估。规划器分两阶段：先选择最优支撑区域，再在区域内计算最优支撑点。

Result: 仿真结果显示，相比无手部接触的恢复策略，冲量韧性平均提升89%；相比朴素规划策略（最近可达区域）提升17%。硬件实验中，站立推挤测试相比朴素手部放置平均缩短43%的稳定时间；行走测试相比基线恢复（无手部接触）缩短18%。

Conclusion: 该方法能有效利用手部接触提升人形机器人的抗扰动能力，学习的CoP区域模型支持快速反应式规划，并在仿真与硬件实验中均验证了其优于基线和朴素策略的性能。

Abstract: We present a planning and control approach to reactively use hand contacts to stabilize a humanoid in low stability scenarios, where only using feet contacts may result in a fall. Candidate contacts are sampled within the robot's reachable workspace, and a preview is computed by rolling out the centroidal dynamics through pre-impact, impact and post-impact phases. Sampled points are scored based on the Center of Pressure (CoP) control authority at the post-impact phase. Central to our approach is a learned model of the robot's CoP region during post-impact, which enables rapid evaluation of candidate contact points compared to traditional optimization-based methods. The presented planner has two stages: the first selects an optimal bracing region and the second computes an optimal bracing point within the region. Our simulation results demonstrate an average increase in impulse resilience of 89% over recovery without hand contacts and 17% over a naive planning strategy (closest reachable region). We validate our framework on hardware, performing push tests while standing and walking. The standing trials show an average 43% reduction in stabilization time compared to naive hand placement and the walking trials demonstrate a 18% reduction compared to baseline recovery (without hand contacts).

</details>


### [388] [Are Frontier VLM Agents Ready to Be Robot Generalists? An Empirical Study with the Embodied Agent Arena](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00854)
*Haojian Huang,Pukun Zhao,Zexi Li,Yehang Zhang,Yangkai Wei,Wenqian Li,Han Yang,Kaiwen Zhou,Ying-Cong Chen,Yinchuan Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出"具身智能体竞技场"（Embodied Agent Arena），通过1000个案例（来自32个来源及新基准GeoProbe）系统评估视觉语言模型在Geometry、Spatial Reasoning、Affordance、Task Planning、Manipulation五维度上的能力，揭示局部能力与完整任务成功之间的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿视觉语言模型（VLM）融合了场景估计、交互接地和可执行动作等能力，但其作为机器人通用智能体的就绪程度尚不明确。需要理解这些能力如何支撑完整机器人任务，以评估其在局部能力上的优势是否能转化为完整的任务成功。

Method: 构建Embodied Agent Arena，包含1000个案例，源自32个既有数据源及新基准GeoProbe（针对Blender渲染与真实场景图像的几何估计）。采用最小化测试框架（minimal harness），在保留源观测与操作的同时，分离度量精度（metric precision）、功能接他（functional grounding）和原生目标完成（native goal completion）。评估7个VLM，分析Astra的任务特定优势，并比较更丰富观测的执行协议与多轮审查机制。

Result: 在五个维度上评估7个VLM。Astra的优势在精确估计和可用接触定位（usable-contact localization）上最为显著；但在协调的、目标导向的动作完成方面表现不足。

Conclusion: VLM的局部能力（如精确估计、接触定位）不足以支撑完整任务成功，完成协调的目标导向动作仍是通向机器人通用智能体的关键差距。

Abstract: Frontier vision-language models (VLMs) combine scene estimation, interaction grounding, and executable actions. Understanding how these abilities support complete robotic tasks is central to evaluating their readiness as robot generalists. We introduce Embodied Agent Arena to examine where local competence supports, or falls short of, complete task success across Geometry, Spatial Reasoning, Affordance, Task Planning, and Manipulation. The arena contains 1,000 cases drawn from 32 established sources and GeoProbe, our new benchmark for geometric estimation on Blender renders and real-scene images. A minimal harness preserves source observations and operations while separating metric precision, functional grounding, and native goal completion. We evaluate seven VLMs, analyze Astra's task-specific advantages, and compare richer-observation execution protocols and multi-round review. Across the arena, Astra's advantage is strongest in precise estimation and usable-contact localization; completing coordinated, goal-directed actions remains the key gap to robot generalism.

</details>


### [389] [Kinematic MeanFlow: One-Step Action Generation Policy for Robotic Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00864)
*Jiawei Fan,Sifeng Wang,Yuqing Hou,Anbang Yao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出Kinematic MeanFlow(K-MF)，通过运动学恒等式解耦MeanFlow中的时间导数项，实现机器人基础模型的一步动作生成，显著降低推理延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多步flow matching推理延迟高；直接应用MeanFlow会导致性能崩溃，根源在于RFM速度场的两种动态特性：局部加速度前期稳定但去噪末期急剧增大，且其幅值跨样本的离散度随去噪进程扩大。

Method: 基于运动学恒等式，将MeanFlow公式中的时间导数项解耦为以中间点为界的两段子区间项，分别捕捉早期与晚期去噪动态，同时缓解误差沿过程的放大。

Result: 在从零训练与微调范式、多种任务上实现一步动作生成，多数设置下优于多步flow matching；将GR00T-N1.6动作头延迟降低67.5%~74.4%（L40与Jetson Orin，eager与compiled模式），端到端延迟降低30.3%~54.9%。

Conclusion: K-MF为RFM提供高效的一步动作生成方案，兼顾性能与推理效率。

Abstract: In this paper, we study how to achieve one-step action generation in Robotic Foundation Models (RFMs), aiming to overcome the high inference latency of multi-step flow matching. MeanFlow provides a promising framework for this goal, yet its direct application leads to performance collapse. We discover that this stems from two distinctive dynamics exhibited in the RFM velocity field: (1) the ``local acceleration" exhibits stability early on, but surges sharply towards the end of the denoising process, and (2) the spread of its magnitudes across samples widens as denoising progresses. To address these issues, we introduce Kinematic MeanFlow (K-MF), a novel one-step action policy tailored for RFMs. Specifically, grounded in a kinematic identity, K-MF decouples the time derivative term in the MeanFlow formulation into two sub-interval terms separated by an intermediate point. This decoupled formulation enables the two terms to capture early-stage and late-stage denoising dynamics, respectively, while mitigating the error amplification across the process. As a result, our K-MF empowers RFMs to achieve one-step action generation in both training from scratch and fine-tuning paradigms across diverse tasks, while outperforming multi-step flow matching in most settings. In terms of inference efficiency, K-MF reduces action-head latency of GR00T-N1.6 by 67.5%~74.4% across L40 and Jetson Orin in eager and compiled modes, yielding end-to-end latency reductions of 30.3%~54.9%. Code will be available at https://github.com/IntelChina-AI/K-MF.

</details>


### [390] [UniTrackPLA: Unified Panorama-Language-Action Model for Instruction-Guided Navigation and Dynamic Person Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00878)
*Pengfei Qi,Haoran Lin,Sizhuang Chen,Kai Luo,Sirui Zhang,Xinqi Liu,Fei Cheng,Wenrui Chen,Liming Yin,Kailun Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出统一全景-语言-动作模型 UniTrackPLA，用单一策略同时完成指令导航与动态人员跟踪，并发布 OmniTrackNav-Bench 基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有具身机器人方法多依赖前向视角观测，且将导航与人员跟踪分别用独立策略处理，限制了全向感知与统一闭环控制能力；而通用机器人需在任意初始目标方位下同时支持语言指定目的地导航与动态目标跟踪。

Method: 1) Panoramic-Aware Encoding (PAE)：保留全景投影各透视视图的时间与方位结构，使透视预训练视觉编码器可处理全向观测；2) 共享视觉-语言主干：在全景上下文中对齐指令，预测机器人中心连续航点块，统一服务两个任务；3) World-Action Consistency (WAC)：预测动作条件下的未来视觉状态并在线校验航点前缀，一致时复用可靠动作，不一致时触发重规划；4) 构建 OmniTrackNav-Bench：5000 条仿真跟踪轨迹、10000 条仿真 VLN 路线、96 条真实路线，共 919,978 个航点监督实例。

Result: 整体跟踪成功率由 23.50% 提升至 35.00%；Omni-VLN 的 SR/SPL 由 13.00%/12.77% 提升至 19.75%/19.29%；加入 76 条真实路线后，留出集 EP@0.2m 由 42.92% 提升至 92.08%；在 Go2-W 机器人上的闭环实验验证了室内外统一的全身全景跟踪与导航。

Conclusion: UniTrackPLA 通过全景感知编码、统一视觉-语言-动作骨干与动作一致性校验，实现了指令导航与动态人员跟踪的统一闭环控制，配合 OmniTrackNav-Bench 显著提升性能，并在真实机器人上完成室内外验证。

Abstract: General-purpose embodied robots should support both navigation toward language-specified destinations and dynamic person tracking under arbitrary initial target azimuths. However, existing methods typically rely on forward-facing observations and address these tasks with separate policies, limiting omnidirectional perception and unified closed-loop control. We present UniTrackPLA, a unified panorama-language-action model for instruction-guided navigation and dynamic person tracking. Its Panoramic-Aware Encoding (PAE) preserves the temporal and azimuthal structure of perspective views projected from each panorama, enabling perspective-pretrained visual encoders to process omnidirectional observations. A shared vision-language backbone grounds instructions in the panoramic context and predicts continuous robot-centric waypoint chunks for both tasks. World-Action Consistency (WAC) further predicts action-conditioned future visual states and verifies waypoint prefixes online, allowing reliable actions to be reused while triggering replanning upon inconsistency. We also introduce OmniTrackNav-Bench, comprising 5,000 simulated tracking trajectories, 10,000 simulated VLN routes, and 96 verified real-world routes, providing 919,978 waypoint-supervision instances. UniTrackPLA improves overall tracking SR from 23.50% to 35.00% and Omni-VLN SR/SPL from 13.00%/12.77% to 19.75%/19.29%. Incorporating 76 real-world routes further improves held-out EP@0.2m from 42.92% to 92.08%. Closed-loop experiments on a Go2-W robot demonstrate unified panoramic tracking and navigation across indoor and outdoor environments. The project page is at https://tw5775.github.io/UniTrackPLA.

</details>


### [391] [Real-Time Human-Adaptive Task Allocation for Multi-Human Multi-Robot Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00897)
*Seabin Lee,Sujeong Park,Nayoung Kim,Sungjin Park,Haechan Jung,Changjoo Nam*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种考虑人因的机器人监督任务分配方法，动态调节每位操作员的监督容量，用贪心策略结合任务优先级，最小化估计工作负荷，实现多操作员间的负荷均衡并防止过载，在用户研究中优于忽略人因的基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在多操作员偶尔远程操控多机器人的场景中，任务分配需考虑各操作员实时的认知状态。然而现有方法多假设每位操作员的监督容量固定，忽略工作负荷与疲劳等人因波动，导致负荷分配不均衡——部分操作员过载而其他人闲置。

Method: 提出人因感知的监督任务分配方法：动态调节监督容量，采用贪心策略，结合任务优先级，最小化估计的操作员工作负荷；将机器人分配给操作员时，依据其当前监督容量，且所需投入取决于任务类型。

Result: 用户研究中，按预设时间区间分析表明，与不考虑人因的基线方法相比，所提方法持续获得更高的绩效并表现出更低的行为疲劳迹象。

Conclusion: 自适应容量调节是一种有效的预防机制，能够在长时间、高需求场景下维持操作员的绩效。

Abstract: We propose a human-factor-aware method of allocating robot supervision tasks to multiple human operators. In scenarios where multiple operators occasionally teleoperate multiple robots to help the robots overcome difficulties, the allocation of the supervisory control tasks to humans needs to consider the real-time cognitive states of individual operators. However, most existing methods assume fixed supervisory capacity per operator and overlook fluctuations in the human factors such as workload and fatigue. As a result, workload distribution can be unbalanced where some operators become overloaded while the others remain underused. Our method dynamically regulates supervisory capacity and allocates tasks in a way that maintains balanced mental workload, prevents overload, and improves overall team performance. The allocation method uses a greedy strategy that minimizes estimated operator workloads with task prioritization. Robots are assigned to operators by reflecting their current supervisory capacity where the required effort depends on the types of tasks. In the user study, the analysis across predefined time intervals shows that the proposed method consistently achieves higher performance and lower behavioral signs of fatigue compared to a baseline method that does not consider human factors. These results highlight adaptive capacity adjustment as an effective preventive mechanism for sustaining operator performance in long-duration, high-demand settings.

</details>


### [392] [TOAST: Stochastic Robot Action Tokenization for Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00899)
*Keisuke Shirai,Tomohiro Motoda,Hanbit Oh,Ryoichi Nakajo,Roman Mykhailyshyn,Ryo Hanai,Shotaro Miwa,Yukiyasu Domae*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出TOAST，一种随机动作token化方法，通过在策略训练中采样同一量化动作序列的不同token表示来提升自回归VLA策略学习效率，在数据稀缺时效果尤为显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FAST等动作token化方法虽通过压缩减少动作token数量，但并未提升从有限示教中学习策略的效率。其原因在于FAST对每个量化动作序列只赋予单一确定性token化，而实际上同一机器人运动可由多个token序列表示和解码得到，这一表征冗余未被利用。

Method: 提出TOAST（TOkenization of Action sequences with STochastic sampling）：一种随机动作token化方法，在策略训练过程中对同一量化动作序列采样多种替代token化，从而多样化离散监督信号，同时保持底层机器人动作不变，且无需额外示教数据。

Result: 在LIBERO上，TOAST持续优于确定性基线，且训练数据越少提升越明显，仅用1/16训练数据时成功率提升6.8个百分点；在四个真实机器人操作任务上，平均成功率较确定性方法提升15.8个百分点。

Conclusion: 实验表明，随机动作token化对自回归机器人策略学习有效，尤其在训练数据有限时优势突出，为利用动作表征冗余提供了新思路。

Abstract: Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action models often represent continuous robot actions as discrete token sequences, enabling action prediction with standard next-token objectives. FAST has substantially improved this representation by compactly encoding action containing diverse temporal frequencies into relatively few tokens. However, while such compression reduces the number of action tokens required for autoregressive prediction, it does not necessarily improve the efficiency of policy learning from limited demonstrations. In particular, FAST typically assigns a single deterministic tokenization to each quantized action sequence, although multiple token sequences can represent and decode to the same robot motion. We investigate whether exploiting this representational redundancy can improve policy learning. In this paper, we propose TOkenization of Action sequences with STochastic sampling (TOAST), a stochastic action tokenization method that samples alternative tokenizations of the same quantized action sequence during policy training. This diversifies the discrete supervision while preserving the underlying robot action and requires no additional demonstrations. Experiments on LIBERO show that TOAST consistently improves over its deterministic counterpart, with the improvement increasing as training data decreases, achieving a 6.8 point gain in success rate when only 1/16 of training data is available. Across four real-robot manipulation tasks, TOAST further improves mean success rate by 15.8 points over the deterministic counterpart. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of stochastic action tokenization for autoregressive robot policy learning, particularly when training data are limited.

</details>


### [393] [Screw Attention: Rigid-Body Algebra Inside a Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00904)
*Aly Magassouba*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 Screw Attention：一种以“体”为 token、以相对位姿（机器人关节为螺旋）为关系的 transformer 层，消息经关系变换传输并保证等变性，在 LIBERO-Spatial 等任务上以极少参数超越更大基线，并对坐标系约定、位姿噪声与关节偏置鲁棒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习型操作策略从数据中重新发现刚体力学本可闭式给出的空间关系，代价是大量数据，且策略对场景几何变化脆弱。作者试图把几何关系（相对位姿/关节螺旋）作为网络结构先验直接引入注意力机制，以提升数据效率与几何泛化性。

Method: Screw Attention：每个 token 是一个带位姿的刚体；每对 token 携带相对位姿，机器人关节则携带关节螺旋（screw）。消息沿该空间关系变换到接收者坐标系，注意力分数只使用坐标系不变（frame-invariant）量。由构造保证消息对每个 token 的独立坐标系变化等变，且单层即可表达刚体速度递推。可与解析控制器结合作为门控残差。

Result: 在仿真操作任务上，与同规模图网络、transformer 与扁平网络持平或更优（LIBERO-Spatial）；以 16,162 参数从物体位姿（无图像、无语言）达到 97.3%，优于参数多 27 倍的扁平网络。改变连杆坐标系约定时成功率不变，而其他学习网络均降至 3% 以下；作为解析控制器的门控残差使插入成功率提升 17.3 个百分点；对 10 mm 以内位姿噪声与 Franka 出厂标定范围内的关节偏置不敏感。

Conclusion: 结果提示一条判据：当任务需要系统其他部分无法提供的坐标系间关系时，几何是决定性的；将几何以等变结构内嵌于注意力中，可同时获得高数据效率、强几何泛化与鲁棒性。代码与训练策略将公开。

Abstract: Learned manipulation policies rediscover from data the spatial relations that rigid-body mechanics supplies in closed form. This costs data, and it leaves the policies fragile to geometric changes in the scene. We present Screw Attention, a transformer layer in which the relation between two bodies is a spatial transform rather than a graph edge. Every token is a body with a pose. Each pair of tokens carries the relative pose and, for robot joints, the joint screw. Messages are transported along this relation into the receiver's frame, while the attention scores see only frame-invariant quantities. By construction, the messages are equivariant to an independent change of frame at every token, and a single layer can express the velocity recursion of rigid-body mechanics. On simulated manipulation tasks, Screw Attention matches or outperforms controls of the same size, including graph, transformer and flat networks on LIBERO-Spatial. With 16,162 parameters it reaches 97.3% on LIBERO-Spatial from object poses (without images or language), above a flat network with 27x more parameters. Under a change of per-link frame convention its success is unchanged, while every other learned network falls below 3%. Placed on an analytic controller as a gated residual, it raises insertion success by 17.3 points. It is unaffected by pose noise up to 10,mm and by joint offsets within the factory calibration of a Franka arm. These results suggest a criterion: geometry is decisive when the task requires relations between frames that no other part of the system supplies. Code and trained policies will be released.

</details>


### [394] [eRLT: Efficient VLA Reinforcement Learning via Action-Relevant Token Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00913)
*Dehao Huang,Jianbang Liu,Jianpan Gao,Chao Tang,Zilang Cen,Zedong Dan,Jiaheng Wang,Tingguang Li,Yue Wang,Hong Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 eRLT，通过在冻结 VLA 的 token 与层间路由任务相关的动作相关信息，构建高效 RL 状态表征，显著提升样本效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将 VLA 模型高效适配下游机器人操作任务仍具挑战。现有通过在线强化学习适配冻结 VLA 的方法，其样本效率取决于 actor 与 critic 所用状态表征的质量；而现有表征要么使用与 VLA 无关的视觉编码器，要么对 VLA 内部表征进行固定压缩，均未显式提取对下游动作优化与动作价值估计最有用的、任务特定的动作相关 VLA 特征。

Method: eRLT 在冻结 VLA 的 token 和层两个维度上路由任务特定的动作相关信息：可学习的路由 token 动态聚合多个深度的视觉-语言特征，轻量级层路由器将这些摘要组合为固定维度的 RL token。路由模块先用专家演示初始化以捕捉可预测专家动作的特征，再通过在线交互中的 critic 反馈进行精炼，用于动作价值估计。

Result: 在七个 LIBERO 与 RoboTwin 任务上，eRLT 相比代表性基线将平均归一化学习曲线 AUC 最高提升 23.7%；在 USB 连接器插入与主板排线插入的真机实验中，AUC 分别较最强基线提升 108.9% 和 46.7%。

Conclusion: 通过跨 token 与层的任务相关动作信息路由构建 RL 状态表征，可有效提升冻结 VLA 在线强化学习的样本效率，并在仿真与真机任务上取得显著性能增益。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide strong behavioral priors for robotic manipulation, yet efficiently adapting them to downstream tasks remains challenging. Recent work addresses this challenge by adapting frozen VLAs through online reinforcement learning (RL), whose sample efficiency depends on the quality of the state representation used by the actor and critic. Existing methods construct such representations either with VLA-independent visual encoders or through fixed compression of internal VLA representations. Neither design explicitly extracts the task-specific action-relevant VLA features most useful for downstream action refinement and action-value estimation, therefore limiting sample efficiency. To address this limitation, we introduce eRLT, which constructs an effective state representation by routing task-specific action-relevant information across both tokens and layers of the frozen VLA. Specifically, learned routing tokens dynamically aggregate visual-language features at multiple depths, while a lightweight layer router combines these summaries into a fixed-dimensional RL token. The routing module is initialized using expert demonstrations to capture features predictive of expert actions and then refined using critic feedback from online interactions for action-value estimation. Across seven LIBERO and RoboTwin tasks, eRLT improves mean normalized learning-curve AUC by up to 23.7% over representative baselines. Real-robot experiments on USB connector insertion and motherboard ribbon-cable insertion further show AUC improvements of 108.9% and 46.7%, respectively, over the strongest baseline.

</details>


### [395] [A Survey on End-to-End Autonomous Driving Training from the Perspectives of Data, Strategy, and Platform](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00926)
*Chengkai Xu,Yiming Cui,Jiaqi Liu,Yicheng Guo,Cheng Qin,Geyuan Zhang,Xinwei Dong,Shiyu Fang,Peng Hang,Jian Sun*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文对端到端自动驾驶（E2E-AD）的训练方法与生态系统进行了全面综述，提出"数据-策略-平台"三层分类体系，系统梳理数据管线、学习范式与训练基础设施的进展及其相互作用，并展望从数据量向数据价值、从孤立优化向基础模型泛化、从静态训练向训练-测试闭环融合的未来方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端自动驾驶通过统一可微模型直接将多模态感知输入映射为驾驶动作，已成为变革性范式；但其效果最终取决于训练生态系统的质量，而现有研究对该训练生态缺乏系统性梳理与整体视角的分析。

Method: 采用综述方法，提出 Data-Strategy-Platform（数据-策略-平台）三层分类法，将训练概念化为相互依存的系统：数据层界定"可学什么"，策略层决定"如何使学习对齐驾驶目标"，平台层支撑可扩展性与持续演进。在此框架下综述以数据为中心的管线、学习范式与训练基础设施，并分析三者在模型性能、鲁棒性与可部署性上的相互作用。

Result: 构建了统一的训练生态系统分析框架，系统归纳了数据管线、学习范式与训练基础设施的最新进展，并揭示了各层之间的耦合关系及其对模型性能、鲁棒性和部署能力的影响；同时维护了持续更新的文献与工作追踪仓库。

Conclusion: 总结当前局限并提出前瞻性愿景：从数据数量转向数据价值，从孤立优化转向基础模型驱动的泛化，从静态训练转向训练-测试一体化闭环，最终迈向鲁棒、可扩展且可信的自动驾驶系统。

Abstract: Autonomous driving is a cornerstone technology for the future of intelligent transportation, where end-to-end learning has emerged as a transformative paradigm that directly maps multimodal sensory inputs to driving actions through unified differentiable models. While offering advantages, the effectiveness of end-to-end autonomous driving (E2E-AD) is ultimately determined by the quality of its training ecosystem. This paper provides a comprehensive review of training methods and ecosystem for E2E-AD. We introduce a Data-Strategy-Platform taxonomy that conceptualizes training as an interdependent system. The data layer defines what can be learned, the strategy layer governs how learning aligns with driving objectives, and the platform layer supports scalability and continuous evolution. Within this framework, we survey recent advances across data-centric pipelines, learning paradigms, and training infrastructures, and analyze their interplay in shaping model performance, robustness, and deployability. Finally, we reflect on current limitations and articulate a forward-looking vision that emphasizes a shift from data quantity to data value, from isolated optimization to foundation-driven generalization, and from static training to integrated training-testing loops, aiming toward robust, scalable, and trustworthy autonomous driving systems. We maintain a continuously updated repository tracking cutting-edge literature and works at \href{https://github.com/Jiaaqiliu/Awesome-Training-Ecosystem-for-E2E-AD}{Our Project Page}.

</details>


### [396] [ShowerFlex: Achieving Pseudo-Static Balancing in a Continuum Shower Hose](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00936)
*Zhiyu Ren,Girish Krishnan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于辅助老年人洗浴的高自由度、伪静态平衡连续体机构，结合摩擦锁定球窝关节与弹簧回卷重力补偿，实现无需外部电力的"推即停"交互，并通过运动学、静力学分析与实验验证其稳定性与低操作力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全球人口老龄化背景下，老年人维持日常生活活动（ADL）独立性（尤其洗浴）成为关键挑战。现有坐姿洗浴装置（固定顶喷或需持续握持的手持软管）操作不便、易致跌倒风险，亟需低成本、本质安全的辅助方案。

Method: 提出模块化连续体架构，由摩擦锁定球窝关节（loc-line）组成，集成弹簧回卷轮实现重力补偿，形成"推即停"交互逻辑；建立递归正运动学框架构建几何模型，并进行覆盖51自由度结构的静力平衡分析；采用蒙特卡洛数值模拟验证形态适应性与稳定性；通过物理实验验证样机性能。

Result: 数值模拟验证了系统在标准浴室空间内多种极端位姿下的形态适应性与稳定性；物理实验证实样机在重力下具有内在静态稳定性，操作力处于老年人人体工程学能力范围内。

Conclusion: 该研究提供了一种低成本、本质安全的淋浴喷头设计，可减少身体负担，恢复老年人个人卫生护理中的尊严与自主性。

Abstract: With the global population rapidly aging, maintaining independence in Activities of Daily Living (ADLs), particularly bathing or showering, has become a critical challenge. Older adults who sit while showering currently have limited options, often relying on rigid overhead showerheads or flexible hand-held hoses that require continuous gripping and precarious user maneuvers, increasing the risk of falls. To address this need, this paper introduces a highly articulated, pseudo-static balanced continuum mechanism designed specifically for accessible bathing assistance. The proposed mechanism features a modular continuum architecture composed of friction-locked ball-and-socket joints (loc-line), seamlessly integrated with a retractable spring-loaded reel for effective gravity compensation. This hybrid design achieves an intuitive "Push-and-Stay" interaction logic, maintaining an approximate static equilibrium with ergonomically low actuation force, without any external electronic power, while significantly minimizing the force needed for repositioning. Theoretically, we established a recursive forward kinematics framework to construct the geometric model of the structure, coupled with a comprehensive static equilibrium analysis to evaluate the system's holding capacity across its 51-DOF structure. Numerical simulations utilizing Monte Carlo methods validate the system's morphological adaptability and stability at various extreme positions within a standard bath space. Physical experiments further validate the prototype's real-world performance, confirming its intrinsic static stability against gravity and ensuring that the actuation force remains well within the ergonomic capabilities of older adults. Ultimately, this research provides a low-cost, intrinsically safe showerhead design that reduces physical strain, restoring dignity and autonomy in personal hygiene.

</details>


### [397] [NarrativeFlow: Flow-Based Vision-Language-Action Model Using Robot Velocity Fields](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00981)
*Shota Kobayashi,Koki Seno,Daichi Yashima,Komei Sugiura*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 NarrativeFlow，将机器人流建模为语言条件下的连续速度场（基于流匹配），实现跨本体、运动中心的操作表征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言条件操作对实用机器人系统至关重要，但机器人基础模型的扩展受限于本体特定数据的采集成本。跨平台数据复用需要与本体无关的运动中心表征，而现有方法或用稀疏关键点位移粗略近似机器人流，或无法处理语言条件操作。

Method: NarrativeFlow 将机器人流（机器人速度场）建模为连续的机器人速度场，采用以语言为条件的流匹配（flow-matching）形式。由此生成的机器人流与真实世界操作在物理上保持一致。

Result: 在语言条件操作的标准数据集上，NarrativeFlow 在标准评价指标上优于代表性基线方法；在真实世界实验中，其在多项操作任务上取得高于基线的成功率。

Conclusion: 以语言条件的连续速度场建模机器人流，是一种有效的跨本体、运动中心表征方式，可在仿真/标准数据集与真实操作任务中同时取得性能优势。

Abstract: We focus on language-conditioned flow-based manipulation, where robot flows (robot velocity fields) serve as embodiment-agnostic, motion-centric representations for leveraging data collected from multiple robot platforms. This task is crucial because language-conditioned manipulation is essential for practical robotic systems, yet scaling robot foundation models remains limited by the labor-intensive collection of embodiment-specific data. Existing methods either coarsely approximate robot flows with sparse keypoint displacements, or cannot handle language-conditioned manipulation. To address this limitation, we propose NarrativeFlow, which models robot flows as continuous velocity fields using a flow-matching formulation conditioned on language. Accordingly, NarrativeFlow generates robot flows that are physically consistent with real-world manipulation. To validate NarrativeFlow, we have conducted experiments on standard datasets for language-conditioned manipulation. The experimental results show that NarrativeFlow outperforms representative baseline methods on standard evaluation metrics. Furthermore, through real-world experiments, we show that NarrativeFlow achieves higher success rates than baseline methods across multiple manipulation tasks. The project page is available at https://shota0520.github.io/NarrativeFlow-project-page/

</details>


### [398] [Divide-and-Remember: Recursive Action-Relevant Memory for Long-Horizon VLA Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00982)
*Xuehui Yu,Eason Yu,Meiyi Wang,Haozhe Du,Stefano V. Albrecht,Harold Soh*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文将VLA模型在历史依赖操作任务中的“记忆内容选择”建模为优化问题，基于POMDP推导出最优记忆应最大化 I(a_t; m_t | o_t)，并提出递归记忆方法Divide-and-Remember (D&R)，在仅64 token预算下于RoboMME基准取得SOTA且四个套件均有稳定增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型在历史依赖的操作任务上表现不佳，仅凭当前观测无法确定动作，需要历史记忆。已有记忆方法依赖人工设计规则（如保留像素变化大的帧），跨任务增益不稳定，因此作者希望从优化角度重新定义“该记住什么”。

Method: 从模仿学习的POMDP表述出发，证明最优记忆应最大化给定当前观测下动作与记忆的条件互信息 I(a_t; m_t | o_t)，即保留历史中尚未被当前观测覆盖的动作相关信息。据此提出D&R递归记忆方法，学习记忆函数 m_t = M(h_t)：1）将全历史上的选择递归拆分为2K个token上的top-K选择子问题，使固定大小的轻量选择器可端到端训练并支持任意长历史；2）所有递归块共享同一选择器，以捕捉各块通用的选择规则并保持高效。

Result: 在RoboMME（包含16个长时程操作任务、需记住何时/何地/做什么/如何行动的基准）上，D&R在仅64 token预算下取得SOTA平均成功率，并在全部四个套件上均有稳定增益；真实机器人实验也显示相同收益。

Conclusion: D&R通过优化视角定义记忆选择，以递归+共享选择器的方式实现轻量、可扩展的长上下文记忆，在仿真基准与真实机器人上均验证了其有效性与稳定性。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models struggle on history-dependent manipulation tasks, where the current observation alone does not determine the action, and the policy needs a memory of the history. Existing memory methods decide what to remember by design, for example, keeping frames with large pixel changes, and show inconsistent gains across tasks. We view what to remember as an optimisation problem. From the POMDP formulation of imitation learning, we show that the optimal memory maximises the conditional mutual information $I(a_t; m_t \mid o_t)$ between the action and the memory given the current observation. Intuitively, this means preserving the action-relevant information in the history that is not already contained in the current observation. Based on our analysis, we propose Divide-and-Remember (D&R), a recursive memory method that learns a memory function $m_t = M(h_t)$ and scales to long contexts while staying compute-light. It involves two strategies: (1) the selection over the full history is divided recursively into subproblems of top-$K$ selection over $2K$ tokens, so that fixed-size, lightweight selectors learned end-to-end support an unbounded history; (2) all recursion blocks share one selector, which captures the selection rule common to every block and keeps the method efficient. On RoboMME, a benchmark of 16 long-horizon manipulation tasks that require remembering when, where, what, and how to act, D&R achieves a state-of-the-art average success rate with consistent gains across all four suites under a budget of only 64 tokens; real-robot experiments show the same gain. Code, checkpoints and more results are at https://dnr-memory.github.io/

</details>


### [399] [Online Planning for Sparse Ground Target Search from a High-Altitude UAV under Partial Observability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01067)
*Ashik E Rasul,Hyung-Jin Yoon*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文将无人机利用PTZ相机的序贯探索过程建模为POMDP，用POMCP求解，并将感知可靠性与目标尺度关联、引入选择性集成检测，在仿真中实现变尺度地面目标的快速探测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高空无人机搜索地面目标时，目标虽在视场内但因表观尺度小而难以观测；常规检测器受分辨率下采样和上下文不足影响性能差。主动目标搜索虽可通过移动改变位姿获取更多信息，但城市空域飞行管制限制了这种物理机动，因此需要一种不依赖大幅机动的替代主动感知方案。

Method: 将PTZ相机的序贯探索建模为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程，agent维护目标真实位置的信念状态；采用部分可观测蒙特卡洛规划（POMCP）求解；将感知可靠性条件化于目标物体尺度，并在候选位置确定后加入选择性集成检测作为额外推理步骤。

Result: 在照片级真实感仿真器中，针对不同环境条件与飞行器状态进行实验，结果表明该方法能在变尺度下探测地面目标，相比基线方法所需步数显著减少，且对传感器分辨率的依赖极小。

Conclusion: 利用PTZ机制的主动感知结合POMCP规划与选择性集成检测，可在受限机动条件下高效完成高空地面目标搜索，降低步数与分辨率依赖。

Abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) searching for ground targets from a high altitude face a unique challenge, particularly when the target is already within the field of view but effectively unobservable because of its small apparent scale. Standard object detectors often underperform in such scenarios because of resolution downscaling and limited context. In contrast, active object search frameworks address this challenge by directing the agent to a suitable pose to gather richer visual information. However, flight regulations in urban airspace often restrict such physical movements for UAVs. As an alternative active sensing approach, the UAV can leverage the pan-tilt-zoom (PTZ) mechanism of the onboard camera to dynamically adjust its field of view and sequentially gather enhanced visual information from specific regions of interest. Once the candidate locations of the target are identified, it can deploy more expensive object detection schemes, such as an ensemble of multiple models, to get better reasoning at a fixed scale. In this work, we formulate the sequential exploration with PTZ operation as a partially observable Markov decision process (POMDP), in which the agent maintains a belief state over the target's true location. To solve the POMDP, we deploy partially observable Monte Carlo planning (POMCP), where we condition the sensing reliability on target object scale and deploy selective ensemble detection as an additional reasoning step.
  We validate our methodology with experiments in a photorealistic simulator under different environmental conditions and vehicle states, showing detection of ground targets at variable scales with significantly fewer steps and minimal dependence on sensor resolution compared to baseline methods.

</details>


### [400] [quARtet Marker: A 3D-Printable Multi-Tag Fiducial for Robust Near-Frontal Pose Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01072)
*Araki Wakiuchi,Hikaru Sasaki,Takamitsu Matsubara*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出3D打印基准标记quARtet：在紧凑平面内倾斜布置四个AprilTag，使正面视角下仍保留透视线索，从而提升透明/反光实验器材的位姿估计精度并兼顾可抓取性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 透明或反光实验器材的识别与定位困难；编码平面基准标记易打印、不凸出标记面、便于夹持，但单一平面标签在近正面视角下透视线索退化、位姿估计最不可靠。非平面几何虽能恢复透视线索，却会侵占平行夹爪需接触的平面区域。

Method: 核心思路是在同一紧凑足迹内倾斜布置多个标签，使标记正对相机时各标签仍处于非正面视角。据此设计可3D打印的quARtet基准标记：其四个倾斜AprilTag的全部检测角点统一进入一次Perspective-n-Point求解，并由同一共享配置同时定义加工几何与检测器模型。因倾斜消耗平面面积，设计了三种布局，在位姿估计一致性与可抓取性之间权衡。

Result: 在机器人参考系、同配置固定相机实验中，三种布局将平均正面朝向误差由单一平面标签的2.18°降至0.24–0.47°，均方根位置误差由1.50 mm降至0.17–0.20 mm；机器人搭载相机位姿保持测试在闭环视觉反馈下验证了同样的差异。同条件摆落试验中，两种带平面接触条的布局仅约2 mm抓取内滑移，而无平面条布局滑移约100 mm。

Conclusion: 在测试条件下结果支持一条选择规则：当位姿估计一致性优先时选用无平面条布局；当标记面必须保持可抓取时选用带平面条布局。

Abstract: Robotic manipulation of labware is difficult when transparent or reflective objects must be identified and localized. Coded planar fiducials are a practical retrofit: easy to print, they leave the marked face flat and graspable. Yet a single planar tag is least reliable in near-frontal views, where perspective cues fade. Non-planar geometries restore those cues but intrude on the flat face that a parallel-jaw gripper must contact. Our idea is to tilt multiple tags within one compact footprint, so that each tag is seen at a non-frontal angle even when the marker faces the camera. We propose the quARtet marker, a 3D-printable fiducial embodying this idea: all detected corners of its four tilted AprilTags enter one Perspective-n-Point solve, and a shared configuration defines the fabricated geometry and the detector model. Because tilting consumes flat area, its three layouts trade pose-estimation consistency against graspability. In robot-referenced, same-setup fixed-camera experiments, all three layouts reduced the mean frontal orientation error from 2.18 degree for a single planar tag to 0.24-0.47 degree and the root-mean-square position error from 1.50 to 0.17-0.20 mm. A robot-mounted-camera pose-hold test confirmed this separation under closed-loop visual feedback. In swing-down trials under identical conditions, the two layouts with flat contact strips retained the object with about 2 mm of in-grasp slip, whereas the layout without flat strips slipped by roughly 100 mm. For the tested conditions, the results support a rule: the layout without flat strips when pose-estimation consistency dominates, a layout with flat strips when the marked face must remain graspable.

</details>


### [401] [WBAG: A Whole-Body and Attached-Geometry Safety Framework for Vision-Language-Action Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01083)
*Samuel Zhen,Siwon Jo,Yanze Zhang,Wenhao Luo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: WBAG是一个推理时安全框架，通过建模机器人全身与抓取相关的附着几何，构建抓取条件下的安全集并转为可微CBF约束，最小化修改VLA动作以避免碰撞，在SafeLIBERO上达到97.38%场景安全率和59.38%安全成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA策略在通用机器人操作上表现优异，但实际部署仍受碰撞风险制约，涉及机器人各部位、被操作物体及周围环境。现有推理时VLA安全框架多依赖简化的末端执行器中心表示，未显式建模完整的关节式机器人几何与附着物体几何，因此安全性保障不足。

Method: 提出WBAG安全框架，建模机器人全身及依赖抓取的附着几何。其构建抓取条件安全集，随物体被抓取而自适应调整受保护几何，再将该动态几何转换为可微CBF约束，对VLA原生六维操作空间动作进行最小修改，实现机器人、场景与附着几何间的碰撞规避。

Result: 在SafeLIBERO基准（为安全评估加入障碍物的LIBERO变体）上，采用监控所有非任务物体的场景级安全评估器，WBAG在评估方法中取得最佳整体安全性与安全任务成功率，达到97.38%的总体场景安全率和59.38%的安全成功率。

Conclusion: WBAG通过显式建模全身与抓取相关附着几何并结合可微CBF约束，在推理阶段有效提升VLA策略的碰撞安全性，同时保持任务成功率，验证了整体几何建模对VLA安全部署的必要性。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies have demonstrated impressive capabilities in generalizable robotic manipulation, but their deployment in the real world remains challenging due to potential collisions involving different parts of the robot, manipulated objects, and the surrounding environment. Existing inference-time VLA safety frameworks typically rely on simplified end-effector-centered representations that do not explicitly model the full articulated robot and attached-object geometry. In this paper, we present WBAG, a safety framework that models the robot's whole-body and grasp-dependent attached geometry. WBAG constructs a grasp-conditioned safe set that adapts the protected geometry as objects are grasped, then converts this evolving geometry into differentiable CBF constraints that minimally modify the VLA's native six-dimensional operational-space action for collision avoidance across robot, scene, and attached geometry. On the SafeLIBERO benchmark, a variant of LIBERO augmented with obstacles for safety evaluation, WBAG achieves the best overall safety and safe task success among the evaluated methods under a scene-level safety evaluator that monitors all eligible non-task objects, reaching 97.38\% aggregate Scene Safety and 59.38\% Safe Success.

</details>


### [402] [OrbitTAMP: Grounding Language Models for Task and Motion Planning in Spacecraft Rendezvous](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01093)
*Yuji Takubo,Daniele Gammelli,Marco Pavone,Simone D'Amico*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出一个分层框架，将LLM的语义推理与可复用行为图和领域规划模块结合，用于航天器交会与近距离操作（RPO）的任务与运动规划（TAMP），实现自然语言指令到动力学可行轨迹的转化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 航天器RPO目前依赖专家密集型流程，工程师需将高层操作意图转化为安全且动力学可行的轨迹，这成为规模化操作的瓶颈。LLM智能体可提供直观交互界面，但其输出缺乏轨道动力学、操作约束和标称机动结构的物理依据，因此需要一种方法在保留语义推理能力的同时保证生成计划的物理有效性。

Method: 提出用于航天器TAMP的分层框架，将LLM推理锚定在可复用行为图和领域专用规划模块上。预训练LLM将自然语言指令映射为部分任务规格；相关规划器在允许操作空间内解析未指定决策；轨迹优化将完整任务规格转化为动力学可行轨迹。引入验证器引导的修订与更广的行为计划搜索，以及测试时计算策略。

Result: 数值实验表明，该架构相较于直接LLM生成显著提升意图恢复能力：在前沿LLM支持下，所有评估划分上对部分任务规格的精确恢复率达98%。测试时计算实验显示，对于紧凑的9B模型，验证器引导的修订将精确恢复率从75%提升至88%，而更广的行为计划搜索可独立改善可行轨迹实现的选择。

Conclusion: 该结果为语言驱动的航天器RPO智能体规划建立了可扩展且可审计的基础，验证了将LLM语义推理与领域规划模块结合的有效性与可行性。

Abstract: Spacecraft rendezvous and proximity operations (RPO) are currently planned through an expertise-intensive process in which engineers translate high-level operational intent into safe, dynamically feasible trajectories, creating a bottleneck to scalable operations. Large language model (LLM)-based agents could offer an intuitive interface for this process, although their outputs are not inherently grounded in orbital dynamics, operational constraints, or the structure of admissible spacecraft maneuvers. To exploit their semantic reasoning while ensuring the generated plan's physical validity, this paper presents a hierarchical framework for spacecraft task-and-motion planning (TAMP) that grounds LLM reasoning in a graph of reusable behaviors and domain-specific planning modules. Within this framework, a pretrained LLM maps a natural-language command to a partial mission specification. The associated planners then resolve unspecified decisions within the admissible operational space. Finally, trajectory optimization converts the completed mission specification into a dynamically feasible trajectory. Numerical experiments demonstrate that this architecture substantially improves intent recovery over direct LLM generation, achieving 98% exact recovery of partial mission specifications across all evaluated splits when backed by frontier LLMs. Additional test-time-compute experiments show that, for a compact 9B model, verifier-guided revision increases exact recovery from 75% to 88%, while broader behavior-plan search independently improves selection among admissible trajectory realizations. Overall, these results establish a scalable and auditable foundation for language-driven agentic planning of spacecraft RPO.

</details>


### [403] [MASkillBlender: Decentralized Whole-Body Coordination for Multi-Humanoid Loco-Manipulation via Skill Blending](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01102)
*Yifan Hu,Luhang Hong,Mingkang Long,Danning Wang,Chengfeng Jia,Rong Su,Junjie Fu,Guanghui Wen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出MASkillBlender，一种通用多智能体强化学习框架，通过在可复用的预训练单人形技能之上学习共享的分散式高层策略，实现去中心化多人类形全身协调，并仅依赖任务级奖励。引入基于置换的数据增强并理论证明其保持策略梯度方向。多任务与两种人形机体实验验证了有效性与泛化性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多人类形协同的移动-操作（loco-manipulation）具有应用前景，但面临高维全身控制、去中心化决策与可扩展性三大挑战。现有强化学习方法多聚焦单人形全身控制，扩展到多人类形场景往往需要大量奖励工程或任务特定设计，缺乏通用性。

Method: 1) 分层技能化框架：先在单人形上预训练可复用的底层技能，再在技能空间上学习共享的去中心化高层策略，实现多人类形全身协调，仅需任务级奖励，无需任务特定的运动参考。2) 针对同构多人类形系统，提出基于置换（permutation）的数据增强策略，以缓解多智能体联合状态-动作空间巨大带来的样本低效。3) 在同构马尔可夫博弈（homogeneous Markov game）形式化下，理论证明置换后的样本保持与原样本一致的策略梯度方向。

Result: 在两种人形机体、多个多人类形协调任务上评估：框架在不同任务与不同机体上均能稳定取得较强任务表现，并产生协调行为，体现出跨任务与跨机体的泛化能力，且无需任务特定运动参考或大量奖励工程。

Conclusion: MASkillBlender 提供了一种通用的去中心化多人类形全身协调方案：以共享高层策略组合预训练单人形技能，配合面向同构系统的置换数据增强及其策略梯度不变性理论保证，有效应对高维控制、去中心化决策与可扩展性问题，为多人类形协同移动-操作提供了可扩展的范式。

Abstract: Coordinated multi-humanoid loco-manipulation is promising yet challenging due to high-dimensional whole-body control, decentralized decision making, and scalability. While recent reinforcement learning methods have improved single-humanoid whole-body control, extending them to the multi-humanoid setting remains nontrivial and often requires substantial reward engineering or task-specific design. We propose MASkillBlender, a general multi-agent reinforcement learning framework to achieve decentralized multi-humanoid whole-body coordination. By learning a shared decentralized high-level policy over reusable pre-trained single-humanoid skills, MASkillBlender enables coordinated behaviors using only task-level rewards, without requiring task-specific motion references. To improve learning efficiency, we further introduce a permutation-based data augmentation strategy for homogeneous multi-humanoid systems, and theoretically show that the permuted samples preserve the policy-gradient direction of the original samples under the homogeneous Markov game formulation. We evaluate MASkillBlender on multiple multi-humanoid coordination tasks across two humanoid embodiments. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently achieves strong task performance and enables coordinated behaviors across different tasks and humanoid embodiments.

</details>


### [404] [Extreme Length Generalization in a Compact Recurrent Architecture for One-Shot Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01105)
*Izen Thornton,Aaron Shey,William Su*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: FRANK：507K参数递归架构，结合tau门控递归模块、内容可寻址记忆与前馈反射通路，在远超训练长度的长程序列任务上保持高精度，并实现仿真到实车的导航迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主机器人一次性任务的时间跨度远超训练轨迹长度，且机载算力预算固定，现有递归、状态空间及模块化架构在极长序列上难以维持性能。

Method: 提出FRANK（507K参数）递归架构，集成tau门控递归模块、内容可寻址记忆与前馈反射通路；在四个算法序列任务上与参数匹配的递归、状态空间、缩减模块化基线对比，训练长度5-20，评测延伸至200万token；并开展四任务定向损伤实验；另训练仿真策略驱动物理地面车辆穿越障碍到达指定航点。

Result: 在10万倍最大训练长度处，10个FRANK种子中6个保持100.0%准确率，50个基线配置（5种架构×10种子）无一达到（Fisher精确检验，双侧p=4.2E-6）；定向损伤呈现四种不同组件依赖模式，表明任务依赖的递归、记忆与反射通路分配；仿真训练的FRANK策略无需遥操作即可驱动实车穿越障碍到达指令航点。

Conclusion: FRANK以极小参数规模在极端长程序列上显著优于主流基线，其多通路结构支持任务自适应的组件依赖分配，并具备从仿真到物理平台的导航迁移能力，适用于长时程自主机器人任务。

Abstract: Autonomous robots on one-shot missions run over horizons far longer than the trajectories seen during training, under a fixed onboard compute budget. We present FRANK, a 507K-parameter recurrent architecture that combines tau-gated recurrent modules, content-addressable memory, and a feedforward reflex pathway. We evaluate it against recurrent, state-space, and reduced modular baselines at matched parameter count on four algorithmic sequence tasks, trained at length 5-20 and evaluated out to two million tokens. At 100,000x the maximum training length, 6 of 10 FRANK seeds retain exactly 100.0% accuracy, while none of the 50 baseline configurations does, five architectures at ten seeds each with none left incomplete (Fisher exact, two-sided p = 4.2E-6. Targeted lesions across the four tasks yield four distinct component-reliance profiles, consistent with task-dependent allocation across the recurrent, memory, and reflex pathways. Separately, a FRANK policy trained in simulation drives a physical ground vehicle to commanded waypoints through obstacles without teleoperation.

</details>


### [405] [Experience-Based Feasibility-Aware Generative Adversarial Imitation from Observation under Embodiment Mismatch](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01171)
*Yoshiki Takebayashi,Giovanni Perantoni,Hikaru Sasaki,Matteo Saveriano,Takamitsu Matsubara*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出EF-GAIfO（基于经验的可行性感知生成对抗式观察模仿），利用机器人自身经验估计纯状态演示的可行性，避免依赖显式动力学模型或大规模先验探索数据，并让可行性随策略学习动态扩展，在仿真locomotion与真实四足机器人抓取任务上验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无动作标签的示教接口日益普及，使"从观察模仿"（IfO）成为学习机器人行为的重要途径。但人与机器人在具身结构与动力学上存在差异，人类演示的运动对机器人未必可行，直接使用会降低策略性能。现有方法多依赖显式动力学模型或大量先验探索数据来判断可行性，代价高且缺乏适应性。

Method: EF-GAIfO（Experience-Based Feasibility-Aware GAIfO）在GAIfO框架下，用机器人自身经验而非显式动力学模型来估计纯状态演示的可行性。核心设计是可行性的动态演进：随策略改进、机器人经历更广的状态转移，可行域逐步扩展，更多演示被纳入学习，从而形成随策略学习阶段自适应调整的可行性感知模仿机制，而非预设固定可行性准则。

Result: 在仿真locomotion任务和真实四足机器人"物体接近与抓取"任务上验证了EF-GAIfO的有效性。

Conclusion: 可行性无需预先给定，可由机器人自身经验在线估计并随策略提升而扩展，这为跨具身差异下的观察模仿提供了一种自适应、低先验依赖的解决方案，并具备向真实机器人任务迁移的可行性。

Abstract: With the increasing use of robot-free demonstration interfaces that provide state trajectories without action labels, imitation from observation has become a promising approach for learning robot behaviors from human demonstrations. However, due to differences in embodiment and dynamics between humans and robots, demonstrated human motions may not be feasible for the robot, potentially degrading policy performance. In this study, we propose Experience-Based Feasibility-Aware Generative Adversarial Imitation from Observation (EF-GAIfO), which estimates the feasibility of state-only demonstrations from the robot's own experience rather than relying on explicit dynamics models or large prior exploration datasets. A key feature of EF-GAIfO is that the notion of feasibility evolves with policy learning: as the policy improves and the robot experiences a broader range of state transitions, the feasible region is progressively expanded, allowing additional demonstrations to be incorporated into learning. This enables feasibility-aware imitation that adapts to the current stage of policy learning, rather than relying on a pre-designed feasibility criterion. We validate the effectiveness of EF-GAIfO on a locomotion task in simulation and on a real quadruped robot performing a object-reaching-and-grasping task.

</details>


### [406] [Recova: Agent-Guided Failure Recovery for Autonomous Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01178)
*Isabella Liu,An-Chieh Cheng,Johan Bjorck,Zhiding Yu,Hongxu Yin,Jan Kautz,Linxi Fan,Yuke Zhu,Sifei Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Recova：智能体引导的“数字孪生+真机验证”框架，将操作失败转化为可复用的恢复能力，显著提升成功率并降低人工干预。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 操作失败会使场景进入任务策略无法恢复的状态，而学习纠错行为需要可扩展的失败探索与物理接地（真实环境验证）。

Method: 在重建的数字孪生中联合发展任务执行与恢复：智能体诊断失败、测试纠正程序，并为任务策略与恢复策略分别收集成功轨迹；部署时监控进度、调用学习式或程序化恢复、验证场景是否复原后继续执行；无可用恢复时由人类演示解决并将该演示纳入学习闭环。物理轨迹与人类演示按来源路由至对应策略进行 DAgger 训练。

Result: 在六个 LIBERO-Pro 设置与四个 MolmoSpaces 类别上平均成功率为 78.8% 与 64.9%（最强基线为 71.7% 与 38.0%）；在四台真机工作站并行采集下，DAgger 微调将平均成功率从 23.8% 提升至 77.5%，加入恢复技能后进一步升至 87.5%；单任务四轮采集中，观测到的人工干预从 87.5% 降至 0%。

Conclusion: 智能体引导的恢复机制能把失败转化为可复用能力，在提升鲁棒性的同时逐步减少人工干预。

Abstract: Manipulation failures can leave scenes in states from which a task policy cannot recover. Learning corrective behaviors requires scalable failure exploration and physical grounding. We present Recova, an agent-guided framework that jointly develops task execution and recovery in a reconstructed digital twin, then verifies and refines both through real-world experience. In the twin, the agent diagnoses failures, tests corrective programs, and collects successful task and recovery rollouts for separate policies. During deployment, it monitors progress, invokes a learned or programmatic recovery, verifies scene restoration, and resumes execution. When no suitable recovery is available, a human demonstration resolves the failure and enters the learning loop, allowing the system to expand its recovery capabilities. Physical rollouts and human demonstrations are routed to the corresponding policy for DAgger training. Across six LIBERO-Pro settings and four MolmoSpaces categories, Recova achieves 78.8% and 64.9% mean success, compared with 71.7% and 38.0% for the strongest baselines. With parallel collection across four real-robot workstations, DAgger fine-tuning raises mean success from 23.8% to 77.5%, and recovery skills further raise it to 87.5%. Over four collection rounds on one task, observed human intervention falls from 87.5% to 0%. Together, these results show how agent-guided recovery turns failures into reusable capabilities, improving robustness while progressively reducing human intervention. Project page: https://www.liuisabella.com/Recova

</details>


### [407] [AFD-CAMLs: Agile Force-Distribution-Aware Planning and Control for Cable-Suspended Aerial Multi-Lifting Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01185)
*Antreas Kourris,Sihao Sun*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种混合规划-控制框架，通过全局规划器探索力分配零空间生成负载轨迹与缆绳力参考，并结合集中式局部规划器与导纳滤波器，实现多无人机协同搬运中更均衡的张力分配。
