Method: 提出形式化框架与基准。形式化将状态、动作与外生输入分离，区分连续型、模式型与事件型动作，并引入机制一致性指标：基于已声明方向的动作-状态关系（如升压药升高血压），检验动作改变是否使预测沿声明方向移动。基准整合八个来自工程基础设施与临床护理的真实动作公开数据集，在七个骨干网络、五个随机种子上变化预测空间、计划融合与计划编码。

Result: 第一，冻结的隐预测空间较观测空间平均降低MAE 9.9%，门控输出融合较输入拼接平均降低12.7%，二者在八个数据集上均有改善；时序计划编码使平均MAE变化至多2.2%。第二，预测误差与机制一致性出现背离：最低误差配置在五个含声明机制数据集中的四个上，其一致性处于或低于随机水平，且无任何设计选择可避免。第三，方向性监督——对动作偏移响应中符号错误部分施加惩罚的损失——在受罚机制上显著提升一致性，而MAE不变。

Conclusion: 为TSWM给出配方：以冻结隐空间与输出侧融合保证精度，以面向机制一致性的训练目标保证对计划变化的正确响应。

Abstract: A time series world model (TSWM) predicts a controlled system's state from its observed history and planned actions and exogenous inputs. Current approaches build forecasters with actions as covariates, trained and evaluated on prediction error under the executed plan. Yet world models compare unexecuted plans, but their responses to changed plans remain untested. We ask which design choices matter and whether accurate forecasters respond to changed plans as real systems do. We address both with a formalization and benchmark. The formalization separates state, actions and exogenous inputs, distinguishes continuous, mode and event actions, and introduces mechanism consistency, a metric built on declared action-state relations with known directions, such as a vasopressor raising blood pressure: it checks whether shifting an action moves the forecast in the declared direction. The benchmark consolidates eight public datasets with real actions from engineered infrastructure and clinical care, varying prediction space, plan fusion and plan encoding across seven backbones and five seeds. First, a frozen latent prediction space lowers MAE by 9.9% over observation space and gated output fusion lowers it by 12.7% over input concatenation on average, with both improving all eight datasets; temporal plan encoding changes average MAE by at most 2.2%. Second, prediction error and mechanism consistency diverge: the lowest-error configuration is at or below chance in consistency on four of five datasets with declared mechanisms, and no design choice avoids this. Finally, directional supervision, a loss penalizing the wrong-signed part of the response to a shifted action, significantly raises consistency on penalized mechanisms with no change in MAE. Together they give TSWMs a recipe: a frozen latent space and output-side fusion for accuracy, and a training objective for mechanism consistency.

</details>


### [577] [Temporal-Difference Learning for Dragonchess](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01845)
*Jim O'Connor,Annika Hoag,Sarah Goyette,Gary B. Parker*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文在三维棋类Dragonchess环境中比较两种自适应AI方法——进化迁移学习与TD(λ)，评估其更新评价启发式的效果。作者将引擎从PyGame重写为C++以提升速度，从而完成含置信区间与显著性检验的10,000局对局，而非小规模单次锦标赛。两种自适应方法在循环赛中均优于其他智能体，且进化与学习所得评价之间无显著性能差异，表明自适应方法在结构复杂的新颖博弈领域中有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Dragonchess具有独特棋盘结构与较高计算负载，是研究自适应方法能否在新颖环境中更新评价启发式的理想场景；同时原PyGame实现速度受限，难以支撑具有统计效力的实验规模。

Method: 将Dragonchess引擎由PyGame重新实现为C++以获得更快对局速度；采用进化迁移学习与TD(λ)两种自适应方法，并在循环赛（round-robin tournament）中与其他智能体对比，共运行10,000局并施加置信区间与显著性检验。

Result: 两种自适应方法在循环赛中均优于所有其他智能体；进化所得评价与学习所得评价之间的性能差异不显著。

Conclusion: 研究确立了自适应方法在结构复杂、新颖博弈领域中的有效性，并说明进化与学习式评价在该设定下可达到相当水平。

Abstract: Our research investigates how two adaptive AI methods, evolutionary transfer learning and TD(lambda), perform in the three-dimensional chess environment Dragonchess. The game challenges players with its unique board structure and computational load, making it an ideal setting to study how adaptive methods can update evaluation heuristics in novel environments. In this work we re-implement the Dragonchess engine, changing it from a PyGame engine to C++. This enables faster gameplay, allowing us to run 10,000 games with confidence intervals and significance tests, rather than a single small tournament. Both adaptive methods outperform all other agents in the round-robin tournament. Our results showed that there is no significant difference in the performance between the evolved and learned evaluations. This research establishes the efficacy of adaptive methods in structurally complex, novel game domains.

</details>


### [578] [AVSD-Scenes: A Dataset for Audio-Visual Description of Urban Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01861)
*Dhanunjaya Varma Devalraju,Arshdeep Singh,Mark D. Plumbley*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 AVSD-Scenes，一个面向城市环境的成对视听场景描述数据集，包含 12,291 条描述，通过多模态大模型生成与融合，并进行了语义对齐、跨模态检索、场景分类等多维度基准评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然语言可提供丰富的视听城市场景语义表征，但同时描述听觉与视觉信息的联合数据集仍然稀缺，制约了视听多模态理解与跨模态检索等研究。

Method: 基于 TAU Urban Audio-Visual Scenes 数据集，先用 Qwen2-Audio-7B 和 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 分别生成音频与视觉模态描述，再用 Qwen3-14B、Mistral-Small-3.2-24B-Instruct-2506 和 Gemma-3-27B-it 等大语言模型融合为多模态描述；随后通过语义对齐、跨模态检索、场景分类、LLM-as-a-judge 评测与人工主观评估进行基准测试。

Result: 多模态描述相比单模态描述在语义对齐和跨模态检索上更优，同时保留较强的场景判别信息；生成描述在城市场景分类上最高达 94.5% 准确率，融合音频、视觉与描述嵌入后进一步提升至 95.4%；在提示指令中移除场景标签后描述仍具强判别性。

Conclusion: AVSD-Scenes 填补了视听联合场景描述数据集的空白；多模态描述能有效整合视听互补信息并提升下游性能，且其语义来源于音视频内容本身而非标签泄漏。

Abstract: Natural language descriptions can provide rich semantic representations of audio-visual urban scenes, yet datasets that jointly describe both auditory and visual information remain limited. In this paper, we introduce AVSD-Scenes, a paired audio-visual scene description dataset for urban environments. The dataset contains 12,291 audio-visual scene descriptions generated from the TAU Urban Audio-Visual Scenes dataset. To construct the dataset, we first generate audio- and visual-based descriptions using Qwen2-Audio-7B and Qwen2.5-VL-7B, respectively. These modality-specific descriptions are then combined using large language models, namely Qwen3-14B, Mistral-Small-3.2-24B-Instruct-2506, and Gemma-3-27B-it, to produce multimodal descriptions that capture complementary information from both modalities. We benchmark AVSD-Scenes using semantic alignment, cross-modal retrieval, scene classification, LLM-as-a-judge evaluation, and human subjective assessment. Results show that multimodal descriptions improve semantic alignment and cross-modal retrieval performance compared with modality-specific descriptions while preserving strong scene-discriminative information. The generated descriptions achieve up to 94.5% accuracy in urban scene classification, while combining audio, visual, and description embeddings further improves accuracy to 95.4%. Furthermore, the descriptions remain highly scene-discriminative even when scene labels are removed from the prompting instructions, indicating that they capture semantic information derived from the audio-visual content rather than merely reflecting label information.

</details>


### [579] [Mapping the RAG Landscape: A Four Axis Taxonomy of Efficiency, Defense, Interactivity, and Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01936)
*Meghana Sunil,Shravya V,Shravan Venkatraman,Joe Dhanith PR*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文是一篇RAG综述，提出四轴分类法（检索效率、鲁棒性与安全、用户驱动交互工作流、多步复杂推理），系统梳理RAG框架组件、方法、评估、应用与架构变体，并指出挑战与机遇。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM受限于静态参数化知识且易产生幻觉；RAG通过引入外部检索将输出锚定于可验证、最新的来源。既有综述多聚焦核心架构与标准流程，缺乏对近期更广泛挑战与能力的整合梳理。

Method: 构建四轴分类法组织当代RAG研究；形式化RAG框架关键组件；综述稠密与稀疏检索、融合策略、嵌入优化、基于强化学习的检索策略；综合评估实践、领域应用及Naive/Advanced/Modular等架构变体。

Result: 形成结构化的RAG研究图景，揭示上述方法对实际部署与系统设计的影响，并归纳评估方法与领域应用现状。

Conclusion: RAG仍面临检索质量、可靠性、领域适配、可扩展性与可解释性等持续挑战；未来机会在于构建更可靠、可适配、透明的RAG系统。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable fluency across many tasks but remain limited by their static, parameter bound knowledge and their susceptibility to hallucinating information. Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) addresses these issues by incorporating external retrieval into the generation process, grounding model outputs in verifiable and up to date sources. While prior surveys primarily focus on core RAG architectures and standard pipelines, recent research explores broader challenges and capabilities that extend beyond these foundational designs. This survey provides a consolidated and structured examination of contemporary RAG developments, organizing the field into a four axis taxonomy: improving retrieval efficiency, strengthening robustness and security, supporting user driven and interactive workflows, and enabling multi step or complex reasoning. We formalize key components of the RAG framework and review methods spanning dense and sparse retrieval, fusion strategies, embedding optimizations, and reinforcement learning based retrieval policies, highlighting how these advances influence practical deployment and system design. We also synthesize evaluation practices, domain specific applications, and architectural variants such as Naive, Advanced, and Modular RAG. Finally, we outline persistent challenges related to retrieval quality, reliability, domain adaptation, scalability, and explainability, and identify opportunities for building RAG systems that are more reliable, adaptable, and transparent.

</details>


### [580] [Counterfactual Auditing of Bias in Open-Source Large Language Models for Clinical Triage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01963)
*Manar Aljohani,Brandon Ho,Kenneth McKinley,Dennis Ren,Xuan Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 对十个开源大模型进行儿科急诊分诊（ESI）反事实审计，发现模型规模与医学预训练并不能稳定降低对人口学/社会背景信息的敏感性，经QLoRA微调的Qwen2.5-7B反事实漂移最低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 急诊分诊是高风险的优先级判定任务，人口学、社会经济与系统背景信息可能不当影响分诊等级；开源大模型被越来越多用于本地化、隐私保护的临床决策支持，但其反事实偏见在不同模型家族、参数规模、医学领域模型与领域适配模型间的差异尚不明确。

Method: 构建配对反事实样本：以真实与手册式临床情景为起点，仅改变一项注入的人口学、社会经济、医疗可及性、行为、社会或系统背景变量，保持临床表现不变。审计十个开源模型（Qwen2.5-7B、Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct、QLoRA微调的Qwen2.5-7B、MedGemma系列、MedLLaMA2-7B、GPT-OSS-20B、GPT-OSS-120B）。指标包括任一分诊漂移率、分诊不足、分诊过度、超过一个ESI等级的漂移、平均漂移与平均绝对漂移。

Result: 反事实敏感性差异显著，且未随模型规模增大或医学领域预训练而稳定下降。QLoRA微调的Qwen2.5-7B总体敏感性最低（任一漂移率5.27%，平均绝对漂移0.0534），基座模型分别为16.02%与0.1706。若干更大规模或医学领域模型反而表现出更明显的漂移。分层与相关分析进一步揭示了聚合指标掩盖的临床重要方向性与共有失效模式。

Conclusion: 反事实审计可作为轻量、具临床可解释性的框架，用于在临床部署前比较开源大模型的公平性风险。

Abstract: Emergency department (ED) triage is a high-stakes prioritization task in which demographic, socioeconomic, and system-context information may improperly influence acuity assignment. Although open-source large language models (LLMs) are increasingly considered for local and privacy-preserving clinical decision support, it remains unclear how counterfactual bias varies across model families, sizes, medical-domain models, and domain-adapted models. We present a comparative counterfactual audit of ten open-source LLMs for pediatric Emergency Severity Index (ESI) prediction. Starting from real and handbook-style clinical vignettes, we construct paired counterfactual variants that change only one injected demographic, socioeconomic, healthcare-access, behavioral, social, or system-context variable while holding the clinical presentation fixed. Models include Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct, a QLoRA fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B, MedGemma variants, MedLLaMA2-7B, GPT-OSS-20B, and GPT-OSS-120B. We measure any counterfactual shift, undertriage, overtriage, shifts greater than one ESI level, mean shift, and mean absolute shift. Counterfactual sensitivity varied substantially and did not consistently decrease with larger model size or medical-domain pretraining. The fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B showed the lowest overall sensitivity, with a 5.27% any-shift rate and mean absolute shift of 0.0534, versus 16.02% and 0.1706 for the base model. Several larger or medical-domain models showed more significant shifts. Stratified and correlation analyses further revealed clinically important directionality and shared failure patterns hidden by aggregate rates. These findings support counterfactual auditing as a lightweight, clinically interpretable framework for comparing fairness risks in open-source LLMs before clinical deployment.

</details>


### [581] [Mingbird: A Local-First Agent Harness Enabling Small Open Models to Complete Real Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02001)
*Hao Wang,Ting Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出本地优先的智能体执行框架 Mingbird，认为小模型（2-9B）在云端式框架下的失败主要源于框架而非模型本身，并通过受控实验予以验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小参数量开源模型（2-9B）可在普通笔记本上运行，但在云端规模的智能体框架（harness）下几乎无法完成真实任务：工具预填充溢出上下文、自纠偏发散、工具示例循环、任务被静默放弃。作者认为这些失败中有相当一部分应归因于框架而非模型本身，因此需要一个针对小模型失败模式逐项补偿的本地优先框架。

Method: 提出 Mingbird——面向 Windows 与 Ollama 的本地优先智能体框架，含十项机制，逐点补偿小模型失败形式；其中三项代表性机制为：字节级净零预填充预算、在接收完成前重读任务的 finish gate、签名级循环检测。评测采用受控单机对比加一个第三方基准：LRAB（固定机器、模型、预算与评分，4 个框架 × 4 个开源模型（2B-35B）× 18 个真实任务，确定性产物评分）与 τ²-bench（278 任务、三臂、单一协议），并做前沿模型探针与留一机制消融。

Result: LRAB 上 Mingbird 总体得分为 0.886，对比 goose 0.631、opencode 0.479、agent-mini 0.405，全部 288 个单元格均已公开；τ²-bench 上为 0.856，对比 0.791 与 0.737；同一 18 个任务的前沿模型探针在不同框架间跨度为 0.997 至 0.478，而结构良好的脚手架彼此差距在 0.072 以内。留一机制消融仅作方向性报告：同一臂同夜复现的均值波动最高达 0.069，与每个名义单次试验增量相当；唯一批次匹配比较（完整机制栈 vs 仅文本重读）显示可执行完成守卫配对提升 +0.10（三次复现）。

Conclusion: 证据表明大量失败可归因于框架而非模型，针对性机制设计能显著提升小模型在真实任务上的完成度；但结论受限：自建基准、单机环境、单次试验评分。

Abstract: Small open-weight models (2-9B) run on ordinary laptops, but under cloud-scale agent harnesses they rarely complete real tasks: tool prefill overflows the context, self-correction diverges, tool demonstrations loop, and tasks are silently abandoned. We present evidence, from a controlled single-machine comparison and one third-party benchmark, that a substantial share of these failures is attributable to the harness rather than the model. We introduce Mingbird, a local-first agent harness for Windows and Ollama whose ten mechanisms compensate point-by-point for small-model failure forms, three of them representative: a byte-level net-zero prefill budget, a finish gate that re-reads the task before accepting completion, and signature-level loop detection. On LRAB, a controlled comparison holding machine, models, budgets, and scoring fixed (4 harnesses $\times$ 4 open models (2B-35B) $\times$ 18 real tasks, deterministic artifact scoring), Mingbird reaches 0.886 overall against 0.631 (goose), 0.479 (opencode), and 0.405 (agent-mini), with all 288 cells published; on $τ^2$-bench (278 tasks, three arms, one protocol) it totals 0.856 against 0.791 and 0.737; and a frontier-model probe on the same 18 tasks spans 0.997 to 0.478 across harnesses, with well-formed scaffolds staying within 0.072 of each other. A leave-one-mechanism-out ablation is reported as directional only: same-night replications of the same arm move its mean by up to 0.069, the size of every nominal single-trial delta, and the one batch-matched comparison (full mechanism stack versus text re-read alone) gives the executable completion guards a paired +0.10 across three replications. The evidence carries stated limits: a self-built benchmark, a single machine, and single-trial scoring.

</details>


### [582] [Counting Moves, Weighing Voices: Bayesian Dialectical Argumentation for Calibrated Multi-LLM Councils under Persistent Adversaries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02005)
*Ionel Eduard Stan,Paolo Napoletano*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出贝叶斯辩证论证（BDA），将多LLM议会的类型化对话行为建模为带个体可靠度的标注者模型，通过推理智能体可靠度实现校准的正确概率估计与对抗鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多LLM议会系统被广泛用于推理任务，但其置信度应表示校准的"正确概率"，且在部分智能体持续不可靠时决策仍应保持鲁棒。现有议会聚合方法在这两方面均存在缺陷：其置信度衡量的是决断程度而非正确性，也无法识别或折减持续不可靠的智能体。

Method: 提出贝叶斯辩证论证（BDA），将议会中的类型化动作（谁提出、质疑或让步于哪个答案）视为经典标注者模型的观测，并为每个智能体赋予独立可靠度。该形式化把多智能体审议重构为可靠度估计问题，利用审议轨迹在持续对抗行为下推断智能体可靠度。随后依据推断的可靠度对证据加权，得到候选答案上的校准后验概率，使持续不可靠的智能体可被"反转"而非仅被多数票压制。

Result: 在二分类与多分类基准上，BDA在零额外成本（无需额外LLM调用）的议会聚合方法中取得最佳校准表现；在持续对抗联盟下鲁棒性提升，同时在无对抗的干净场景中保持竞争力。

Conclusion: 将多智能体审议建模为带个体可靠度的贝叶斯标注者模型，可同时获得校准的正确概率估计与对持续不可靠智能体的鲁棒折减，且不增加LLM调用开销。

Abstract: A multi-LLM \emph{council} lets several large language models (LLMs) deliberate on a question and return an answer together with a confidence estimate. As these systems become increasingly used for reasoning, that confidence should represent a calibrated \emph{probability of being correct}, and the decision should remain robust when some agents are persistently unreliable. Existing \emph{council aggregation} methods fail on both fronts: their confidence estimates measure decisiveness rather than correctness, and they cannot identify or discount persistently unreliable agents. We introduce Bayesian Dialectical Argumentation (BDA), which treats the council's \emph{typed} moves---who proposed, challenged, or conceded which answer---as observations of a classical annotator model with \emph{per-agent} reliabilities. This formulation recasts multi-agent deliberation as a reliability estimation problem, using the deliberation trace to infer agent reliability under persistent adversarial behavior. By weighting evidence according to inferred agent reliability, BDA yields calibrated posterior probabilities over candidate answers while allowing persistently unreliable agents to be inverted rather than merely outvoted. Across binary and multi-class benchmarks, BDA achieves the best calibration among zero-cost council aggregation methods, requiring no additional LLM calls, and improves robustness under persistent adversarial coalitions while remaining competitive in clean settings.

</details>


### [583] [Atoms to Processes: The Role of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Chemical Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02014)
*Michael Baldea,Linda J. Broadbelt,Marianthi G. Ierapetritou,Akhilesh Jain,Ankur Kumar,Thomas A. Kwan,Fèlix Llovell,Andrew J. Medford,Ilias Mitrai,Joel Paulson,Junyi Qiao,Matthew P. Rivera,Kirti C. Sahu,Lev Sarkisov,Zachary P. Smith,Calvin Tsay,Ching-Mei Wen,Victor M. Zavala,Huacheng Zhang,Dan Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文是一篇观点综述，指出AI/ML正深刻改变化学工程的问题建构与求解方式，覆盖原子尺度模拟到工业运行等多个应用；核心趋势是从纯黑箱方法转向融合第一性原理的物理信息/混合框架，以应对精度、数据稀缺、外推、可解释性等挑战。结论强调AI/ML并非替代化学工程原理，而是放大它，需与领域知识审慎整合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI/ML的快速成熟、算力提升、数据可得性增强与学习算法进步，使化学工程问题的建模与分析方式发生根本转变。作者希望梳理方法学进展与代表性应用，回应预测精度、数据稀缺、外推能力、可解释性与模型生命周期管理等实际需求。

Method: 采用perspective（观点/评述）形式，跨领域考察AI/ML在原子尺度模拟、材料与催化剂发现、传递与热力学、分离、过程系统工程及工业运行中的应用，重点分析AI/ML与第一性原理模型/机理模型的整合方式，并归纳从纯黑箱走向物理信息与混合建模的统一趋势。

Result: AI/ML已在化学工程多个尺度与场景取得实质影响；混合与物理信息框架通过显式遵循守恒律、热力学一致性和结构约束，提升了模型的鲁棒性与可靠性，并能在合适的抽象层次上提供信息，支持有效的人机协作。

Conclusion: AI/ML不是取代化学工程核心原理，而是对其的增强。面向日益自主、自适应与可持续的系统，将AI/ML与第一性原理理解及领域专业经验有机结合，是释放其在科研与工业实践中全部潜力的关键。

Abstract: The rapid maturation of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) has catalyzed a profound shift in how chemical engineering problems are formulated, analyzed, and solved. Advances in computing, data availability, and learning algorithms have enabled AI/ML methods to impact applications spanning atomic-scale simulations, materials and catalyst discovery, transport and thermodynamics, separations, process systems engineering, and industrial operations. This article provides a perspective on recent methodological developments and representative applications, emphasizing how AI/ML tools are being integrated with first-principles models to address challenges of predictive accuracy, data scarcity, extrapolation, interpretability, and model lifecycle management. Across domains, a unifying trend is the move away from purely black-box approaches toward hybrid and physics-informed frameworks that explicitly respect conservation laws, thermodynamic consistency, and known structural constraints. These approaches not only improve robustness and reliability, but also enable meaningful human-AI collaboration by providing information at an appropriate level of abstraction for the task and decision context. We conclude that AI and ML are not replacing the core principles of chemical engineering; rather, they are amplifying them. As the field advances toward increasingly autonomous, adaptive, and sustainable systems, the thoughtful integration of AI/ML with first-principles understanding and domain expertise will be essential to realizing their full potential across both research and industrial practice.

</details>


### [584] [SPHERE: Adaptive VR Indoor Scene Generation via LLM-Enhanced Spatial Preference Learning and Human-in-the-Loop RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02023)
*Hyeonmin Lee,Zheng Wei,Kyungmin Kwon,Jumin Seo,Jiwon Park,Hayoung Oh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SPHERE：面向VR 3D室内场景生成的自适应框架，通过多模态交互提取持久化空间偏好，实现连续的人机共创。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM驱动的3D室内场景合成流水线无法跨会话保留用户特定偏好，导致沉浸式创作过程重复且造成身体疲劳。

Method: 从语音与手柄编辑等自然多模态交互中提取持久化空间偏好，将原始编辑抽象为同时刻画局部功能与全局拓扑上下文的分层约束；并采用人在回路强化学习机制，依据用户最终编辑场景动态更新检索策略。

Result: 混合设计用户研究（N=42）与离线消融实验表明，SPHERE显著减少修正性编辑与体力负荷，避免偏向浅层物体级特征，生成几何上鲁棒且与用户画像对齐的布局。

Conclusion: SPHERE证明捕获用户演示的空间逻辑可实现受控的空间自适应，为沉浸式创作建立了可靠、可治理的人机协作框架。

Abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) advance 3D indoor scene synthesis, current pipelines fail to retain user-specific preferences across sessions, making immersive authoring a repetitive and physically fatiguing process. We present SPHERE, an adaptive VR generation framework that transforms isolated synthesis into continuous human-AI co-creation. SPHERE extracts persistent spatial preferences from natural multimodal interactions (speech and controller edits). To ensure geometric resilience against spatial distortions, it abstracts these raw edits into hierarchical constraints modeling both local functional and global topological contexts. Furthermore, a human-in-the-loop reinforcement learning mechanism dynamically updates retrieval policies based on the user's final edited scenes. A mixed-design user study ($N=42$) and an offline ablation demonstrate that SPHERE significantly reduces corrective edits and physical demand, preventing bias toward shallow object-level traits to yield geometrically resilient, profile-aligned layouts. Ultimately, SPHERE demonstrates how capturing demonstrated spatial logic enables controlled spatial adaptation, establishing a reliable, governed human-AI collaboration framework for immersive authoring. Project page and source code will be available at: https://github.com/hyeonmin11/SPHERE

</details>


### [585] [Global Coherence: When Every Agent Is Right and the Team Is Still Wrong - A Local-to-Global Semantic Foundation for Multi-Agent Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02036)
*Xin Heng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"全局一致性"问题——AI智能体各自做出局部有效决策却产生无效联合结果——并给出观测混叠不可能性定理界定其精确边界（可保证有效行动当且仅当同一观测的所有世界共享可采纳行动，k个不可区分世界需两两互斥行动时随机最坏成功率为1/k），进而提出局部到全局运行时语义 X=(H,C,G,F;D)，经九项研究验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI智能体可各自做出局部有效决策，却联合产生无效结果。作者将此界定为全局一致性问题，即共享状态的失效，而非单纯的模型智能不足，并希望给出该失效的可判定边界与运行时框架。

Method: 提出观测混叠不可能性定理刻画保证有效行动的精确条件与k个不可区分世界下的随机最坏成功率上界；提出局部到全局运行时语义 X=(H,C,G,F;D)，其中拓扑H记录重叠作用域，范畴C约束改变状态的动作，群胚G保留可逆翻译，层F检验局部视图能否粘合为同一世界，最小历史D只保留影响合法未来的区分；模型仅提议，共享状态由harness持有并掌管提交。

Result: 九项研究同时检验该失效及其边界。受控修订基准上，同一前沿模型在决定性事件可见时得40/40，事件隐藏时各测试臂仅12–17/40，与随机水平(1/3)一致，恢复单一权威事实后回到40/40。TeamBench中普通团队5/5次超支，可见实时计数仍有4/5违规，提交强制后0/5违规。tau2-bench Telecom中静默回滚后当前状态检查得分0.07，而harness得1.00。当传统求解器已持有完整相关状态时，其表现与harness相当，符合预测。

Conclusion: 反直觉的结论是：局部智能无法替代缺失的全局状态。更多的推理、角色、消息或采样都不能恢复被混叠抹去的区分；更强的模型只能在自身上下文内推理更好，却无法看到上下文之外。

Abstract: AI agents can each make locally valid decisions yet jointly produce an invalid result. We call this the global coherence problem: a failure of shared state, not merely of model intelligence.
  Our Observation-Aliasing Impossibility Theorem gives the exact boundary. A policy can guarantee a valid action exactly when all worlds producing the same observation share an admissible action. If k indistinguishable worlds require pairwise-disjoint actions, the best randomized worst-case success is 1/k; more reasoning, roles, messages, or samples cannot recover the missing distinction. A stronger model can reason better within its context, but it cannot see beyond it.
  We then give local-to-global runtime semantics X = (H, C, G, F; D): topology H records overlapping scopes; category C governs state-changing actions; groupoid G retains reversible translations; sheaf F tests whether local views glue into one world; and minimal history D keeps only distinctions that alter legal futures. Models propose; the harness owns shared state and governs commit.
  Nine studies test both the failure and its boundary. On a controlled revision benchmark, the same frontier model scores 40/40 when the deciding event is visible; when it is hidden, tested arms score 12--17/40, consistent with chance (1/3); restoring one authoritative fact returns 40/40. On TeamBench, ordinary teams exceed a shared budget in 5/5 runs, a visible live count leaves 4/5 violations, and commit enforcement leaves 0/5. In tau2-bench Telecom, current-state checks score 0.07 after silent reverts, while the harness scores 1.00. Where a conventional solver already owns the complete relevant state, it ties the harness as predicted. The counterintuitive conclusion is that local intelligence cannot substitute for missing global state.

</details>


### [586] [Mimir: Physics-Grounded LLM Agents for Long-Horizon Irrigation Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02038)
*Yimeng Liu,Mi Zhang,Younsuk Dong,Zhichao Cao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出Mimir——一个物理约束下的LLM智能体，用于灌溉这一长周期物理控制场景，通过快/慢双时间尺度的修复机制实现安全执行与经验驱动的自我改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有关于LLM智能体结合推理、工具使用与行动的证据多来自回合制、反馈即时且失败可重置的任务；而长时程物理控制处于不同机制：行动改变未来状态、误差跨决策累积，且智能体必须从经验中改进却不得改写保障执行安全的物理规则。作者选择灌溉作为研究场景，因为其每日决策与整个生长季的土壤-水分动态相互作用。

Method: Mimir围绕两个修复时间尺度组织：快时间尺度上，通过结构化物理接口与确定性模拟器将LLM输出转化为提案，经数值检查、修订，并在执行前经受有界的确定性动作选择；慢时间尺度上，将反复出现的失败模式固化为持久的上下文原则以约束未来提案，同时物理模型、评估器与执行约束保持不可变。

Result: 在跨多个站点、作物与年份的同一回顾性评估器下，Mimir取得了所评估参照中最低的总体控制成本，用水量比历史调度回放减少约51%。消融实验显示，移除前向模拟、经校验的修订或持久上下文均会提高控制成本；模型规模与模型家族研究显示，增大LLM规模并无单调增益。

Conclusion: 持久的物理智能体可将语义推理与有界、证据驱动的自我改进相结合，同时将物理真值与执行器权限保留给明确的数值机制。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly combine reasoning, tool use, and action, but most evidence comes from episodic tasks with relatively immediate feedback and reset failures. Long-running physical control operates in a different regime: actions alter future states, errors compound across decisions, and an agent must improve from experience without being allowed to rewrite the physical rules that make execution safe. We study this regime through irrigation, where daily decisions interact with soil-water dynamics over entire growing seasons. We present Mimir, a physics-grounded LLM agent organized around two repair timescales. At the fast timescale, a structured physical interface and deterministic simulator turn an LLM output into a proposal that we numerically check, revise, and subject to bounded deterministic action selection before execution. At the slow timescale, recurrent failure patterns are consolidated into persistent contextual principles that condition future proposals, while the physical model, evaluator, and execution constraints remain immutable. Under a common retrospective evaluator across multiple sites, crops, and years, Mimir attains the lowest reported aggregate control cost among the evaluated references and uses about 51% less irrigation than the historical schedule replay. The ablation study show higher control cost when forward simulation, verified revision, or persistent context is removed; model-scale and model-family studies show no monotonic gain from increasing LLM size. The resulting lesson show that persistent physical agents can combine semantic reasoning with bounded, evidence-driven self-improvement while reserving physical truth and actuator authority for explicit numerical mechanisms.

</details>


### [587] [HydroJEV: A one-second, training-free screen for cyber-attack and fault attribution in water distribution networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02048)
*Tianwei Mu,Shengyan Jiang,Mingzhe Yuan,Qing Luo,Min Xiao,Wenhong Wang,Jun Li,Manhong Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 无训练的Jev模型可在约1秒内给出类别概率，可作为SCADA告警分诊的第一层筛选，接管约三分之一复核负载并保持精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水分配网络SCADA告警需快速判定是网络攻击、物理故障、正常瞬变还是传感器故障，但监督分类器缺乏标注事件，前沿LLM每次决策耗时数十秒。

Method: 在EPANET的C-Town网络上构建四分类成因归因基准，将Jev与手写规则树、监督分类器及七个云端LLM在相同证据下，于四个密封、预注册轮次中比较；仅采用无标签先验校正；并设计由规则树确认良性Jev裁决的门控级联，迁移至另外两个网络验证。

Result: Jev与规则树相当（分布内macro-F1为0.62-0.64对0.56-0.61），在标签中缺失的事件子类型上超出监督分类器0.36-0.42（四轮均成立），且每类标注事件少于约四个时优于该分类器；决策速度比前沿LLM快20-40倍；门控级联在全新密封集上为LLM复核者节省35-38%窗口且无macro-F1损失，迁移至两个网络后在四个集合上均处于非劣效边界内。

Conclusion: 快速、免训练的第一层筛选可接管SCADA异常分诊约三分之一的复核负载，同时保持人工审慎复核的准确率。

Abstract: When a SCADA alarm is raised in a water distribution network, operators must decide quickly whether it reflects a cyberattack, a physical fault, a normal transient or a faulty sensor. Supervised classifiers need labelled incidents that utilities rarely have, and frontier large language models (LLMs) take tens of seconds per decision. We tested whether Jev, a training-free model that returns class probabilities in about one second, can serve as the first tier of this triage. On a four-class cause-attribution benchmark built on the C-Town network in EPANET, Jev was compared with a hand-written rule tree, a supervised classifier and seven cloud LLMs on identical evidence in four sealed, pre-registered rounds. With only a label-free prior correction, Jev matched the rule tree (macro-F1 0.62-0.64 against 0.56-0.61 in distribution) and exceeded the supervised classifier by 0.36-0.42 on event subtypes absent from its labels, in all four rounds, and it outperformed the classifier whenever fewer than about four labelled events per class were available. Jev also decided 20-40 times faster than frontier LLMs. Accepting only benign Jev verdicts confirmed by the rule tree spared an LLM reviewer 35-38% of windows on fresh sealed sets without loss of macro-F1. Transferred unchanged to two further networks, this gated cascade stayed within the non-inferiority margin of its reviewer on all four sets. A fast, training-free screen can therefore take over about a third of the review load in SCADA anomaly triage while preserving the accuracy of deliberate review.

</details>


### [588] [External Observers May See More Clearly: Cross-Model Span-Level Hallucination Detection in Large Language Models via Hidden State Probing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02066)
*Kingshuk Gupta,Davide Buscaldi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于LLM内部隐状态的片段级幻觉检测框架，可定位幻觉起始与延续token，并进一步提出跨模型检测框架，发现外部观察者（甚至更小的模型）能达到或超过生成模型的自检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM作为基础推理引擎时，幻觉仍是关键脆弱点。现有基于内部状态的探针方法虽比慢速外部检索更优，但大多将幻觉检测简化为token级二分类，无法刻画语义漂移的结构化、序列化边界，因此需要更细粒度的片段级检测。

Method: 引入内部隐状态框架进行细粒度、片段级幻觉检测：检查逐层激活模式，定位LLM生成中确切的幻觉起始与延续token。并进一步提出跨模型检测框架，让一个模型观察另一模型生成时诱发的内部表征。

Result: 该方法成功隔离幻觉起始点，在极端类别不平衡下相比随机基线在Precision-Recall AUC上取得显著提升。跨模型检测中，外部观察者可匹配或超过生成模型对自身幻觉起始的检测，包括观察者为更小模型的情形。

Conclusion: 片段级内部隐状态方法可实现细粒度幻觉起始定位；自检测并非幻觉起始定位的性能上限，外部观察模型甚至更小模型也能达到或超越自检测效果。

Abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly serve as foundational reasoning engines, their tendency to hallucinate remains a critical vulnerability. While recent internal state probes offer a promising alternative to slow external retrieval systems, they largely reduce hallucination detection to a token-wise binary classification task, failing to capture the structured, sequential boundaries of semantic drift. Here, we introduce an internal hidden state framework for fine-grained, span-level hallucination detection. By inspecting layer-wise activation patterns, we attempt to detect the exact hallucination onset and continuation tokens in an LLM generation. Our experiments show that this approach successfully isolates hallucination onsets, achieving substantial improvements in Precision-Recall AUC over random baselines despite extreme class imbalance. Ultimately, we propose a novel cross-model detection framework in which one model observes the internal representations elicited by another model's generation. We find that an external observer can match or exceed a generator's self-detection of its own hallucination onsets, including when the observer is the smaller model, suggesting that self-detection is not the ceiling for onset localisation.

</details>


### [589] [Causal Memory Policy: Making Memory Utility Identifiable by Intervening on Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02070)
*Arman Behnam,Binghui Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出因果记忆策略（CMP），通过干预检索过程恢复记忆效用的可识别性，解决记忆增强大模型中"检索层面阳性违背"问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有记忆增强大模型通过估计每个记忆对任务性能的影响来决定保留哪些记忆，但这类估计完全依赖已检索到的记忆。当某记忆从未被检索时，存储层面的干预产生完全相同的结果，其效用无法被识别，形成"检索层面阳性违背"，而仅检查记忆操作的诊断方法无法发现这一问题。

Method: 提出CMP因果框架：对检索过程本身进行干预，保留固定数量的上下文槽位，以已知倾向性对记忆进行采样，从而恢复可识别性。采用平衡分配设计下的自归一化逆倾向加权（IPW）来估计记忆效用。理论证明记忆效用经检索的因果分解、估计量的无偏性与精确方差，以及不可逆操作下的最优决策规则。

Result: 在LongMemEval上54%、LoCoMo上67%的所需记忆存在识别失败，且该失败在已部署的记忆系统中依然存在。CMP将所需与非所需记忆的区分度从0.54提升至0.66 AUC。此外发现，即使效用被识别，单个查询的效用对该查询可达0.78 AUC，但保留策略可用的任何聚合方式都无法预测记忆在未见查询上的价值。

Conclusion: 记忆效用的可识别性需要通过检索层面的因果干预来恢复，仅基于存储操作的诊断不足。然而，即使效用被正确识别，其对未见查询的泛化能力仍然缺失，说明识别记忆效用本身不足以支撑保留决策。

Abstract: Memory-augmented large language models must decide which memories to retain, and recent systems do so by estimating each memory's effect on task performance. However, these estimates rely entirely on retrieved memories. When a memory is never retrieved, store-level interventions produce identical outcomes, leaving its utility unidentified. This is a retrieval-level positivity violation, invisible to diagnostics that examine only memory operations. We introduce Causal Memory Policy (CMP), a causal framework that restores identification by intervening on retrieval itself, reserving a fixed number of context slots for memories sampled with known propensities. CMP estimates memory utility by self-normalized inverse propensity weighting under a balanced assignment design. We prove the causal factorization of memory utility through retrieval, the unbiasedness and exact variance of the estimator, and the optimal decision rule under irreversible operations. Empirically, identification fails for 54% of required memories on LongMemEval and 67% on LoCoMo, and the failure persists in a deployed memory system. CMP improves discrimination between required and non-required memories from 0.54 to 0.66 AUC. Finally, we show that identified memory utility alone is insufficient for retention decisions: per-query utility reaches 0.78 AUC on the query for which it is estimated, yet no aggregation available to a retention policy predicts a memory's value on unseen queries. Code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/cmp-release-D0C3/.

</details>


### [590] [PyPottery: an AI-powered end-to-end suite for pottery processing and publication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02072)
*Lorenzo Cardarelli*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文介绍了PyPottery——一套开源的AI驱动工具套件，用于半自动化陶瓷文档制作流程，在真实数据上验证其可大幅节省时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 陶瓷材料研究是考古学的基石，但陶器文档的后期制作流程劳动密集，造成严重的发表瓶颈，亟需自动化辅助手段。

Method: 提出PyPottery套件，包含四个集成模块：PyPotteryScan（自动图像提取与手写识别）、PyPotteryInk（铅笔图自动上墨）、PyPotteryTrace（语义感知矢量化）、PyPotteryLayout（自动排版生成）。在意大利Terramara di Montale的50张手绘图纸（含240个陶器绘图）上评估，并结合可用性研究。

Result: 框架实现了显著的时间节省，可用性研究参与者报告相对传统工作流的中位感知加速为40倍（范围17.5×–120×）。

Conclusion: AI辅助工具在考古文档制作中具有潜力，论文强调应将认知劳动进行战略性再分配，趋向于增强（augmentation）而非完全替代（automation）。

Abstract: The study of ceramic materials constitutes a cornerstone of archaeological research, yet the post-production workflow for pottery documentation remains labor-intensive and creates significant publication bottlenecks. This paper presents PyPottery, an open-source, AI-powered suite designed to semi-automate the complete ceramic documentation pipeline. The suite comprises four integrated modules: PyPotteryScan for automated image extraction and handwriting recognition; PyPotteryInk for automatic inking of pencil drawings; PyPotteryTrace for semantically-aware vectorization; and PyPotteryLayout for automated layout generation. Evaluated on 50 hand-drawn sheets containing 240 pottery drawings from the Terramara di Montale (Italy), the framework achieved substantial time savings confirmed by usability study participants, who reported a median perceived speedup of 40$\times$ over traditional workflows (range: 17.5$\times$--120$\times$). These results highlight the potential of AI-assisted tools in archaeological documentation, while the paper addresses the strategic redistribution of cognitive labor toward augmentation rather than automation.

</details>


### [591] [A Comparative Explainability Framework for DeBERTa-v3 in Zero-Shot Medical Abstract Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02116)
*Javier Diaz Esteban-Herreros,David Muñoz-Valero,Raquel Martínez-España,Jose M. Juarez,Juan Moreno-Garcia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个比较性可解释性框架，用于审计DeBERTa-v3在医学摘要零样本分类中的表现，通过五种归因方法的成对一致性与错误机制分析，揭示解释稳定性与预测确定性的一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决可解释人工智能中的"分歧问题"，即不同归因方法对同一输入和预测产生不一致的解释，尤其在医学文本分类这类高风险场景中需要审计Transformer模型的可信度。

Method: 基于Medical Abstracts语料构建自然语言推理引擎，每个诊断类别配五个丰富假设，每类均衡采样一千篇文本；比较五种解释方法（SHAP、LIME为模型无关方法，遮挡与Input x Gradient为深度学习专用方法，Attention x Gradient为Transformer专用方法）；通过top-token归因标准化解释，并使用Jaccard指数量化成对一致性。

Result: 在定义明确的临床领域取得高预测准确率，语义高度模糊时性能下降；解释稳定性直接映射预测确定性，单义类别中收敛性强，诊断不确定性下显著下降；定性错误审计发现三种系统性失效机制：词汇过度敏感、语义重叠、归因连贯性丧失。

Conclusion: 支持在医学文本分类中审计Transformer模型时联合使用多种解释方法与定量一致性指标，并建议优先采用具体临床本体而非宽泛诊断标签。

Abstract: A comparative explainability framework is presented to audit DeBERTa-v3 under zero-shot classification of medical abstracts. The work addresses the disagreement problem in Explainable Artificial Intelligence, where different attribution methods produce divergent explanations for the same input and prediction. A natural language inference engine is implemented over the Medical Abstracts corpus with five enriched hypotheses per diagnostic category and a balanced sample of one thousand texts per class. Five explanation methods are compared: SHAP and LIME as model-agnostic approaches, occlusion and Input x Gradient as deep-learning-specific approaches, and Attention x Gradient as a transformer-specific approach. Explanations are standardized through top-token attribution, and pairwise agreement is quantified using the Jaccard index. High predictive accuracy is achieved across well-defined clinical domains, whereas performance degrades under high semantic ambiguity. Explanatory stability directly mirrors predictive certainty, exhibiting strong convergence in univalent categories and a marked drop under diagnostic uncertainty. Furthermore, qualitative error auditing uncovers three systemic failure mechanisms: lexical hypersensitivity, semantic overlap, and loss of attribution coherence. The results support the combined use of several explanation methods and quantitative agreement metrics when auditing transformer-based models in medical text classification, and suggest prioritizing specific clinical ontologies over broad diagnostic labels.

</details>


### [592] [VISTA: A Visual Harness for Reasoning in an Interactive World](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02200)
*Qiushi Han,Keya Hu,Linlu Qiu,Cathy Wu,Kaiming He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出视觉外挂框架 VISTA，使通用多模态模型具备长时程视觉能力，在 ARC-AGI-3 上将相对人类动作效率从 40.68 提升至 100.00，并在多个视觉环境基准上显著超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态模型本身具备较强推理能力，但在复杂交互式视觉环境中缺乏有效机制来支撑长时程视觉感知与记忆，其潜力未被充分释放。因此需要一种能够解锁该潜力的"外挂"式框架。

Method: VISTA 是一种视觉外挂（visual harness）：让通用多模态模型通过视觉观测直接感知环境，并维护无损视觉记忆，以原始形式保留历史观测；模型可在推理过程中主动检索这些观测并重新组织自身视觉输入。其设计保持简洁，以便以极小适配扩展到多样视觉环境。

Result: 在 ARC-AGI-3 上，VISTA 将 Claude Opus 5.0 的相对人类动作效率（Relative Human Action Efficiency）从 40.68 提升至满分 100.00，且在完成全部 25 个公开游戏时所需动作比首次参与的人类玩家少 57.4%。在涵盖多样视觉游戏与谜题的另外三个基准上，相比使用同一底层模型但仅有极简外挂的基线，VISTA 均大幅领先。

Conclusion: 结果表明 VISTA 有望成为通用视觉外挂，用于推动多模态智能体在复杂视觉环境中的表现，并具备良好的跨环境泛化与扩展能力。

Abstract: We show that multimodal models possess strong reasoning abilities and that an appropriate harness can unlock their potential to solve tasks across diverse interactive environments. We introduce VISTA, a visual harness that gives a general-purpose multimodal model long-horizon vision. VISTA allows the model to directly perceive the environment through visual observations and maintains a lossless visual memory that preserves past observations in their original form. The model can actively retrieve these observations and reorganize its visual input as it reasons. On ARC-AGI-3, VISTA improves Claude Opus 5.0's Relative Human Action Efficiency score from 40.68 to a perfect 100.00, with the model completing all 25 public games using 57.4% fewer actions than first-time human participants. VISTA's simple design also allows it to extend naturally to diverse visual environments with minimal adaptation. Across three additional benchmarks covering a diverse range of visual games and puzzles, it substantially outperforms baselines using the same underlying model with minimal harnesses. Our results highlight VISTA's potential as a general-purpose visual harness for advancing multimodal agents in complex visual environments.

</details>


### [593] [ScholarCatalyst: A Benchmark for Retrieving Papers That Inspire New Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02202)
*Sohyeon Kim,Yoonho Lee,Bo Liu,Dayoon Ko,Rulin Shao,Seungone Kim,Graham Neubig,Pang Wei Koh,Aakanksha Chowdhery,Akari Asai,Omar Khattab,Yejin Choi,Gunhee Kim,Chelsea Finn*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 ScholarCatalyst：由 184 位第一作者为 207 篇近期计算机科学论文标注其项目所受启发的先验工作（含理由），并构建“给定研究问题、仅用项目起始时可得文献”的检索任务。结果显示 agentic 检索并不优于嵌入检索（R@20 0.42 vs 0.48），即使基于 Claude Fable 5.1 的 agent 也仅达 0.51，凸显模型需要具备专家式检索直觉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学家在“判断某个新问题需要哪些既有想法”这一能力上仍远超 AI。要研究该能力，需获取研究者本人对哪些先前工作真正推动了其已完成项目的权威判断，但此类标注难以规模化，现有检索基准也缺乏作者视角的评判。

Method: 构建可规模化的自动化作者标注流水线；邀请 207 篇近期计算机科学论文的 184 位第一作者，对候选文献逐一标注“是否/本可推动其项目”并给出详细理由，形成 ScholarCatalyst 数据集。据此设计检索任务：输入初始研究问题，仅从项目开始时已存在的文献中检索相关论文，并以作者提供的判断作为评价依据。对比嵌入检索、agentic 检索及基于 Claude Fable 5.1 的 agent 表现。

Result: agentic 检索（0.42 R@20）不及嵌入检索（0.48 R@20），尽管前者调用了同一检索器作为工具；基于可能已在训练中见过已完成论文的 Claude Fable 5.1 的 agent 也仅达到 0.51 R@20。

Conclusion: 现有模型缺乏在广域语料中复现专家直觉的检索能力，需要新的训练范式。ScholarCatalyst 是迈向“能接收半成型想法并指向所需先验研究”的科学 agent 的一步。

Abstract: What makes great scientists great? Even as AI systems start to make progress on open problems, scientists remain far ahead of them at sensing which prior idea, buried in an ever-growing archive of research, a new problem needs. To study this skill, we draw on researchers who know firsthand which earlier work advanced their completed projects, with papers serving as pointers to the ideas within. Using our automated pipeline that makes author annotation scalable, we build ScholarCatalyst by having 184 lead authors of 207 recent computer science papers label which candidates did or could have advanced their project, each with a detailed rationale. We introduce a retrieval task with author-provided judgments: given an initial research question, retrieve these papers from only the literature available when the project began. Agentic search does no better than embedding retrieval (0.42 vs. 0.48 Recall@20) despite calling that same retriever as a tool. Even an agent built on Claude Fable 5.1, which may have seen the completed papers during training, reaches only 0.51 R@20. These results highlight the need for new training recipes that equip models with expert intuition for searching broad corpora. We envision ScholarCatalyst as a step toward scientific agents that can take a half-formed idea and point to the prior research it needs.

</details>


### [594] [A2Z GameSpec-Bench: How Faithfully Can Coding Agents Generate Games from Game Design Specifications?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39564)
*Seonho Lee,Wonryeol Jeong,Alberto Cereser,Inha Kang,Hyeonjong Kim,Seungmin Kwak,Dongmin Park*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 A2Z GameSpec-Bench，一个包含 100 份长篇游戏设计文档（GDD）的基准，用于评估智能体端到端游戏开发的规格遵循能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将完整应用开发交给编码智能体，需要保留原设计意图，而非仅通过朴素提示生成看似合理的输出。游戏开发是严苛的测试场景：长篇 GDD 描述的各类需求需在游戏逻辑、视觉渲染与玩家交互间协同工作。但现有基准多使用精简规格，且对长篇 GDD 中跨方面相互依赖需求的评估支持有限。

Method: 将每份 GDD 转化为依赖感知契约，包含规则、约束与前置关系；结合源码检查与智能体生成的测试策略，进行基于场景的回放与自适应玩测。契约在不同智能体与修订轮次间保持固定，与同一需求关联的判断和证据支持一致比较与故障检测。

Result: 评估显示，当前智能体难以在代码实现与实际游玩中同时满足相互依赖的需求。相比自我修订，需求特定反馈在两轮后使 GDD Fidelity 提升 10.9%。

Conclusion: A2Z GameSpec-Bench 超越实现层面的判断，评估端到端规格遵循能力，并提供针对性反馈以支持更忠实的游戏开发。

Abstract: Delegating complete application development to coding agents requires preserving the intended design rather than simply producing plausible outputs through naive prompting. Game development provides a demanding testbed, as long-form Game Design Documents (GDDs) describe requirements that must work together across game logic, visual rendering, and player interactions. However, existing game-development benchmarks typically use compact specifications and provide limited support for evaluating interdependent requirements across these aspects in long-form GDDs. We introduce A2Z GameSpec-Bench, a benchmark of 100 long-form GDDs for evaluating end-to-end game development by agents. We measure faithfulness by checking whether the game satisfies the GDD requirements and preserves the relationships among them. Each GDD is turned into a dependency-aware contract that contains rules, constraints, and prerequisite relations. Following game-development practices, we combine source-code inspection with agent-generated test policies for scenario-based replay and adaptive playtesting. The contract remains fixed across agents and revision rounds, while judgments and evidence linked to the same requirements support consistent comparison and failure detection. Our evaluations show that current agents struggle to jointly satisfy interdependent requirements across code implementation and actual play. Requirement-specific feedback improves GDD Fidelity by 10.9% relative to self-revision after two rounds. A2Z GameSpec-Bench assesses end-to-end specification-following ability beyond implementation judgments and provides targeted feedback to support more faithful game development. Code and datasets are available at https://a2z-gamespec-bench.github.io.

</details>

### [595] [Improving scoring functions for protein-protein docking with LambdaLoss](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00191)
*Richard Zhu,Darren Xu,Lee-Shin Chu,Jeffrey J. Gray*

Main category: q-bio.QM

TL;DR: 本文提出通用框架，将Learning-to-Rank中的LambdaLoss用于改进蛋白-蛋白相互作用打分函数，通过在290万诱饵构象上微调DFMDock能量预测头，得到LambdaDockScore，在CAPRI基准上优于EuDockScore。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蛋白-蛋白相互作用建模需要精确的打分函数，以对复合物构象进行排序，区分近天然构象与错误构象。现有方法在top-1/top-5识别正确构象及特定类型复合物（如抗体-抗原、极大或极小结合界面）上仍有不足。

Method: 提出一个通用框架，将Learning-to-Rank领域的LambdaLoss损失函数引入生物分子相互作用建模。具体做法是在基于DIPS数据集构建的290万诱饵构象增强数据集上，用LambdaLoss微调DFMDock的能量预测头，得到排序模型LambdaDockScore。

Result: 在CAPRI score set基准的靶标上，LambdaDockScore在top-1和top-5预测中识别正确构象的能力优于当前最优方法EuDockScore；同时相比基线DFMDock，在抗体-抗原复合物以及结合界面极大或极小的蛋白-蛋白复合物打分上均有提升。

Conclusion: LambdaLoss可作为一种通用损失函数有效提升蛋白-蛋白构象排序及其他生物分子相互作用模型的性能，LambdaDockScore在多个场景下验证了该框架的有效性和泛化能力。

Abstract: Modeling protein-protein interactions requires accurate scoring functions that can rank potential poses (conformations) of a protein-protein complex to differentiate near-native poses from incorrect ones. Here, we propose a general framework for improving protein-protein pose ranking and other biomolecular interaction models using the LambdaLoss loss function from the Learning-to-Rank field. We test this framework by fine-tuning the energy prediction head of DFMDock with the LambdaLoss on an augmented dataset of 2.9M decoy poses derived from the DIPS dataset. On targets from the CAPRI score set benchmark, our fine-tuned ranking model LambdaDockScore is better at identifying correct poses in its top-1 and top-5 predictions compared to EuDockScore, a state-of-the-art method. LambdaDockScore also improves upon baseline DFMDock ranking performance for scoring antibody-antigen complexes and protein-protein complexes with very large or small binding interfaces.

</details>

### [596] [Field closure, ice neurons, and when a dendrite is a motif](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00184)
*Nima Dehghani*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 该文将"冰神经元"（树突状冰晶）视为一个界面生长系统的零增益极限，构建了FitzHugh–Nagumo态在移动前沿上并与驱动场双向耦合的模型，用以区分"形态相似"与"功能相同"，并阐明生物神经元=主动电缆+场闭合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 树突状轮廓（冰晶、DLA、最省布线树突、生物神经元）可以共享同一分支统计量，仅因共享生长不稳定性，而非功能相似。作者将此观察作为建模约束：仅凭形状（spandrel）无法说明神经元的本质，需要区分几何、动力学与场的耦合三者。

Method: 构建界面系统模型：FitzHugh–Nagumo状态生活在移动前沿上，并反向写入驱动它的场，耦合由无量纲增益γ控制。分析γ=0与有限γ时的谱结构；在γ=0生长并冻结的枝晶上引入场闭合，检验其对远端持续性的影响，并与传递、再生电缆事件做非线性比较。

Result: γ=0时形态与内部动力学解耦，退化为Mullins–Sekerka生长带与阻尼振荡器；有限γ使谱形变、移动被选择的不稳定性，并在孤立Hopf阈值以下开启振荡区。在冻结枝晶上，场闭合在不改变几何的前提下增加远端持续性，其一阶效应在多次实现中保持为正，且定位于少量非电缆场短路。线性不稳定之外非线性动力学有限：阈值以下场闭合近似等于透射；在尖峰幅度下则是对再生电缆事件的修正。

Conclusion: 树突树本身并非内在的结构性副产物（spandrel）。仅有形状而无内部状态与源项的，是冰神经元的树突轮廓；加入可兴奋性构成主动电缆；再加上场闭合这一生物物理混合体（神经元参与书写作用于自身的场，并雕塑其动力学与生长中的结构），才是生物神经元。

Abstract: Dendritic silhouettes are cheap. Pond ice neurons, diffusion-limited aggregates, wiring-minimizing arbors, and biological neurons can share a branching statistic because they share a growth instability, not because they are functionally similar. We take that observation as a modeling constraint. The ice neuron only structurally resembles a biological neuron. A biological neuron carries an internal state and a field that it helps generate, letting geometry, dynamics, and field co-sculpt one another. In our construction, the ice neuron is the zero-gain limit of an interfacial system in which a FitzHugh--Nagumo state lives on the moving front and writes back into the field that drives it, with dimensionless gain $γ$. At $γ=0$, morphology and internal dynamics decouple into a Mullins--Sekerka growth band and a damped oscillator. Finite $γ$ deforms the spectrum, shifts the selected instability, and opens an oscillatory region below the isolated Hopf threshold. On a dendrite grown at $γ=0$ and then frozen, field closure increases distal persistence without changing the geometry; its first-order effect remains positive across repeated realizations of the same growth rule and localizes to a small set of non-cable field shortcuts. Nonlinear dynamics remain finite beyond the linear instability: below threshold, closure is almost the transmission; at spike amplitude, it is a correction to a regenerative cable event. A dendritic tree therefore is not intrinsically a structural spandrel. Shape alone is morphology without an internal state or a source term. That is the dendritic silhouette of the ice neuron. Excitability adds an active cable. Field closure is the biophysical mélange in which the neuron helps write the field that acts back on it, sculpting its dynamics and, during growth, its structure. That is a biological neuron.

</details>


### [597] [Stochastic dynamics and synchronization in motif-based neuronal networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00597)
*Gurpreet Jagdev,Yifei Lu,Richard Bertram,Na Yu*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文将六类代表性结构基元嵌入脉冲神经元网络，系统考察噪声、耦合强度、基元间连接、网络规模与神经元异质性对同步的影响，发现基元与网络一致性均呈相干共振，双向耦合对（M2）与2型递归前馈环（M3c）一致性最高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实证研究显示神经元网络含反复出现的子图（基元），但不同基元类型嵌入大规模随机网络后的集体影响尚不明确，需厘清局部连接排布在嵌入后是否仍具动力学意义。

Method: 构建含六类代表性结构类的脉冲神经网络，考察本征噪声、耦合强度、基元间连接性、网络规模与神经元异质性对同步的作用；并以保留局部突触数量与强度的重连操作、以及度与权重匹配的随机网络作为对照。

Result: 基元级与网络级一致性均在中等噪声强度处达峰，符合相干共振；M2与M3c持续表现高基元级一致性；重连这些基元造成网络一致性的显著下降，表明连接排布的作用超出强局部耦合本身；M2与M3c频繁出现尖峰双峰，短峰间距与高一致性相关；相较匹配随机对照，基元网络在较弱噪声下即达更高一致性；增大网络规模提升一致性直至饱和；外加电流异质性降低峰值一致性并将最优噪声推向更强，但不改变各基元类的相对差异。

Conclusion: 局部连接排布在嵌入后仍具动力学后果，可在群体层面塑造噪声驱动的相干性，基元结构是决定同步的关键因素之一。

Abstract: Neuronal networks exhibit complex dynamics shaped by connectivity and stochastic input. Empirical studies show that neuronal networks contain recurring subgraphs, or motifs, but the collective influence of different motif types after embedding in large stochastic networks remains less well understood. We construct a spiking network composed of six representative structural classes and examine how intrinsic noise, coupling strength, inter-motif connectivity, network size, and neuronal heterogeneity shape synchronization. Both motif- and network-level coherence peak at intermediate noise intensities, consistent with coherence resonance. Bidirectionally coupled pairs (M2) and the type-2 recurrent feed-forward loop (M3c) consistently exhibit high motif-level coherence. Rewiring these motifs while preserving local synapse number and strength produces some of the largest reductions in network coherence, showing that connection arrangement contributes beyond strong local coupling alone. M2 and M3c also exhibit frequent spike doublets, linking short inter-spike intervals with elevated coherence. Relative to a degree- and weight-matched random control, the motif-structured network reaches greater coherence at weaker noise. Increasing network size enhances coherence until the response begins to saturate, whereas applied-current heterogeneity lowers peak coherence and shifts the optimum toward stronger noise without erasing the relative differences among motif classes. These results show that local connection arrangement remains dynamically consequential after embedding and can shape noise-driven coherence at the population level.

</details>


### [598] [Stochastic Dynamics of Large-Scale Motif-Embedded Spiking Neuronal Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00616)
*Gurpreet Jagdev,Richard Bertram,Na Yu*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 该研究揭示局部模体结构与全局网络拓扑（ER/SF）对脉冲神经网络同步放电的互补贡献：模体嵌入提升噪声诱导相干性，SF拓扑凭借枢纽节点实现更高相干性与更快、更可靠的信号传递。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究多分别关注局部连接模体或全局拓扑，但二者如何共同塑造神经网络的脉冲动力学尚不清楚，缺乏在同等突触数量条件下的系统性比较。

Method: 构建Izhikevich神经元网络，背景连接分别采用Erdős-Rényi（ER）与无标度（SF）拓扑；在突触数匹配条件下对比嵌入模体网络与无模体对照网络，施加噪声驱动和刺激驱动协议；开展模体重连实验（随机化模体骨架、重连非递归前馈环与双平行模体）及靶向消融实验（去除高度数兴奋性神经元并与随机节点/边删除对照）。

Result: 模体嵌入在两种拓扑中均提升噪声诱导相干性，对信号传输改善较小；SF网络相比ER网络具有更高绝对相干性，且信号传递更快、更可靠。模体收益取决于模体内连接的具体排布而非单纯的强局部连接：随机化模体骨架整体降低相干性，但重连非递归前馈环和双平行模体可提升相干性。靶向消融表明SF优势部分依赖枢纽完整性，去除高度数兴奋性神经元对相干性和信号传输的损害大于匹配的随机节点或边删除。

Conclusion: 局部模体与全局枢纽对相干脉冲动力学作出不同且互补的贡献，提示网络动力学需从局部与全局结构两个层面联合理解。

Abstract: We examine how local motif structure and global network topology jointly shape spiking dynamics in stochastic neuronal networks. Using networks of Izhikevich neurons with Erdős-Rényi (ER) and scale-free (SF) background connectivity, we compare motif-embedded networks with synapse-count-matched, non-motif controls under noise- and stimulus-driven protocols. Motif embedding increases noise-induced coherence in both topologies and provides a smaller improvement in signal transmission, while SF-based networks attain greater absolute coherence and transmit signals faster and more reliably than ER-based networks. Motif-rewiring experiments show that this benefit depends on the specific arrangement of intra-motif connections rather than on strong local connectivity alone: randomizing the motif skeleton reduces coherence overall, although rewiring the non-recurrent feed-forward loop and bi-parallel motif can increase it. Targeted ablation shows that the SF advantage depends in part on hub integrity; removing high-degree excitatory neurons impairs coherence and signal transmission more than matched random node or edge removal. Together, these results indicate that local motifs and global hubs make distinct, complementary contributions to coherent spiking dynamics.

</details>


### [599] [Synaptic placement reflects shared input in Drosophila descending neurons](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00690)
*Xizhe Zhang*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 该研究揭示果蝇下行神经元中，三神经元拓扑关系（共享突触前来源）与接收神经元上突触输入的相对空间位置相对应，表明网络连接性与神经元内部空间组织之间存在系统性映射。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网络拓扑描述神经元间的连接关系，而突触定位描述这些连接在单个细胞内的空间排布，这两个组织层级如何对应尚不清楚。作者旨在探究拓扑连接性是否能反映在接收神经元的输入空间排布上。

Method: 利用独立重建的MaleCNS和FlyWire脑数据，分析成千上万个下行神经元（DN）单向连接；比较来自同时接触伙伴DN的来源输入与其他非DN输入沿接收者神经突的相对位置；在固定来源输入位置并标准化参考集大小后比较有/无记录来源输入的伙伴；并结合BANC与MaleCNS数据评估共享输入与空间重叠对DN互联的预测信息。

Result: 在MaleCNS和FlyWire中，来自也接触伙伴DN的来源输入，平均分别比非DN输入沿接收者神经突更靠近该伙伴输入9.4μm和8.0μm；固定来源位置后该排序仍成立；在BANC与MaleCNS中，共享输入与测得空间重叠对DN互联提供互补预测信息；两个互联且共享上行来源的DN在已识别的索输出上存在差异。

Conclusion: 三神经元拓扑关系与输入相对放置相关联，揭示了网络连接性与接收神经元内部空间组织之间的对应关系。

Abstract: Network topology describes connections between neurons, whereas synaptic placement specifies how those connections are arranged within individual cells. How these levels of organization correspond remains incompletely understood. Here we show that connectivity between presynaptic neurons is reflected in relative input placement within Drosophila descending neurons (DNs). Across thousands of one-way DN connections in the independently reconstructed MaleCNS and FlyWire brains, inputs from sources also contacting the partner DN lay on average 9.4 and 8.0 μm nearer that partner's inputs along the receiver's neurites than other non-DN inputs. The same ordering held when source-input positions were fixed and partners with and without recorded source input were compared after standardizing reference-set size. In BANC and MaleCNS, shared input and measured spatial overlap provided complementary predictive information about DN interconnection. Two interconnected DNs sharing an ascending source differed in their identified cord outputs. Together, these findings link a three-neuron topological relationship to relative input placement, revealing a correspondence between network connectivity and the internal spatial organization of a receiving neuron.

</details>


### [600] [MEG-Mamba: A Scalable State-Space Foundation Model for Magnetoencephalography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00746)
*Chetan Gohil,SungJun Cho,Oiwi Parker Jones,Mark Woolrich*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文提出MEG-Mamba，一种基于Mamba架构的生成式基础模型，用于源重建、分区的MEG神经活动，通过预测离散化MEG信号的下一token实现生成，其生成保真度超过Transformer基线的MEG-GPT，且预训练时间更短、上下文更长，并可用LoRA生成未参与预训练的任务诱发响应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MEG数据日益丰富，为借鉴AI领域的自监督基础模型提供了契机；但现有MEG（及EEG）基础模型均基于Transformer架构，可能存在预训练成本高、上下文长度受限等问题，因此作者希望探索Mamba架构作为神经基础模型骨干的可行性。

Method: 构建MEG-Mamba：一种基于Mamba架构的生成式基础模型，输入为源重建并分区的MEG信号。训练目标为在给定脑区和记录session的条件下，预测离散化MEG信号的下一token。评估方法包括考察生成数据的时空谱特性、解释学习到的embedding，并使用轻量级刺激条件化（LoRA）生成未包含在预训练中的任务诱发响应。

Result: MEG-Mamba在生成保真度上超过基于Transformer的MEG-GPT；预训练仅需22 GPU-hours，而MEG-GPT需400 GPU-hours；建模上下文长度达4秒，而MEG-GPT为0.32秒。同时，LoRA条件化能够生成真实的、未在预训练中出现的任务诱发响应。

Conclusion: Mamba是扩展神经基础模型的一个有前景的骨干架构，MEG-Mamba在保真度、训练效率和长上下文建模方面均优于Transformer基线。

Abstract: Magnetoencephalography (MEG) is an imaging technique that offers a non-invasive, millisecond-resolution view of human brain activity. The increasing availability of MEG data presents an opportunity to take advantage of a recent advance in artificial intelligence, namely self-supervised foundation models. Existing foundation models for MEG (and electroencephalography) have been built on a transformer architecture. Here, we introduce MEG-Mamba: a generative foundation model for neural activity (source reconstructed, parcellated MEG) built on a Mamba architecture. MEG-Mamba is trained to predict the next token of a discretised MEG signal, conditioned on a brain region and recording session. MEG-Mamba surpasses the generative fidelity of a transformer-based alternative (MEG-GPT) while pre-training in less time (22 vs 400 GPU-hours) and modelling a longer context (4 vs 0.32 s). We evaluate MEG-Mamba by examining the spatio-spectral characteristics of the data it generates and by interpreting its learned embeddings. Furthermore, we demonstrate that lightweight stimulus conditioning (LoRA) can be used to generate realistic task-evoked responses that are not included in pre-training. Our results suggest that Mamba is a promising backbone for scaling neural foundation models.

</details>


### [601] [One Inference, Four Failure Modes: Formal Models of Why Pain Location Fails](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00866)
*Adam Y. Shavit*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 该文将疼痛定位的临床失败统一为一个贝叶斯生成模型在不同节点上的失效：似然、模型类、似然的群体/情境依赖性，以及报告环节。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 患者报告的疼痛位置对某些表现具有诊断决定性，对另一些却几乎无信息量。前作认为这不是一个诊断效用梯度，而是三种不同的定位失败；本文旨在为这些失败建立数学表述，并说明它们实为同一对象，同时补充第四种失败。

Method: 以单一贝叶斯生成模型为框架，将各类失败对应到不同节点：解剖复用建模为非可识别的逆问题（秩亏转诊矩阵将不同病因映射到同一报告）；去定位放大建模为生成模型改变，其动力学为神经场分岔、空间范围为序参量；转诊与非典型位移建模为呈现似然的群体/情境依赖（属概率而非损失），其后果位于下游的决策阈值，随群体患病率和成本变化；重复观察无法降低关于固定推断目标的可恢复信息，这是链式法则的精确恒等式。第四节点为报告本身：空间贝叶斯模型将错定位分解为转诊模糊、解剖偏移与精度加权认知覆盖，并以同一方程的不同机制复现幻肢、镜像箱与卒中后中枢性报告；同时给出可估计性的必要或充分条件及第8节的设计。

Result: 该模型在第8节所述条件下可估计；此外报告了一项不利于论文自身结论的对照：最初用于测量迁移的传输统计量，会将一个平稳扩散的剖面错误评分为已发生位移。

Conclusion: 疼痛定位的诊断困难可按推断节点分类，并可由一个贝叶斯生成模型统一描述；可估计性依赖明确的设计条件，方法上的自控对照提示某些迁移度量存在误判风险。

Abstract: Patient-reported pain location is diagnostically decisive for some presentations and nearly uninformative for others. A companion paper argues this is not one gradient of diagnostic utility but three distinct failures of localization. This paper gives those failures their mathematics and shows they are one object: a single Bayesian generative model failing at different nodes - the likelihood, the model class, and group- or context-dependence in that same likelihood. The count is not in dispute: the first three are failures of the inference that produces a felt location, and the fourth, added here, is a failure of reporting it.
  Anatomical multiplexing is a non-identifiable inverse problem: a rank-deficient referral matrix sends distinct causes to one report. Delocalized amplification is a change of generative model whose dynamics are a neural-field bifurcation, with spatial extent as the order parameter. Referred and atypical displacement is group- or context-dependence in the presentation likelihood - a probability, not a loss - whose consequence sits one layer downstream, in a decision threshold varying with group prevalence and cost. Repeated observation cannot reduce recoverable information about a fixed inferential target, an exact chain-rule identity, while practical value can fall.
  The fourth node is the report itself. A spatial Bayesian model factorizes mislocalization into referral blur, an anatomical offset and a precision-weighted cognitive override, and reproduces phantom-limb, mirror-box and central-post-stroke reports as regimes of one equation. It is estimable under conditions the paper states as necessary or sufficient rather than assuming them; Sec. 8 gives the design that meets them. One control is reported against the paper's own interest: the transport statistic first used to measure migration scores a stationary, spreading profile as though it had travelled.

</details>


### [602] [A High-Density EEG Dataset for Stimulus-Driven Auditory Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01303)
*Ruofan Yan,Na Lu,Shu Peng,Wenlong You,Zhige Chen,Yuxuan Yan,Yan Liu,Kay Chen Tan,Jibin Wu*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 该论文研究无需指令的听觉竞争选择，提出融合刺激驱动声音优先级与单试次EEG证据的神经生理学启发框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 刺激驱动的听觉注意决定多声源竞争时哪种声音优先，但既有计算研究多聚焦声学显著性，或仅解码预设被注意目标，缺乏对无指令竞争选择的统一计算解释。

Method: 采用SAAD范式，行为上用Bradley-Terry模型从先前竞争估计声音优先级；模型先估计各竞争声音的潜在优先级并以其差值构成相对刺激证据，再通过多尺度EEG通路（含符号与功率读出的互补机制）提取单试次神经证据，经门控决策级整合；采用镜像约束与配对留出协议及多类基线、消融评估。

Result: 声音优先级可泛化到未见过配对，留出预测AUC从0.577提升至0.718；EEG显示与报告选择侧相关的中晚期中央-颞侧化，且在声学不对称之外仍具预测力；框架相对声学、EEG、多模态基线及消融均获支持。

Conclusion: 自发听觉选择可被解释为可泛化的刺激优先级与单试次神经变异性之间的交互作用。

Abstract: Stimulus-driven auditory attention determines which sound gains priority when multiple sources compete without an explicit listening goal, yet most computational studies focus either on acoustic salience or on decoding predefined attended targets. This study investigates instruction-free auditory competition using the Stimulus-driven Auditory Attention (SAAD) paradigm and develops a neurophysiologically informed framework that integrates stimulus-derived sound priority with trial-specific EEG evidence. Behavioral analysis using a Bradley--Terry model showed that sound priority estimated from previous competitions generalized to unseen sound pairings, improving held-out prediction from an AUC of 0.577 to 0.718. EEG analysis further revealed mid-to-late centro-temporal lateralization associated with the reported selection side, with neural information remaining predictive beyond acoustic asymmetry. Guided by these findings, the proposed model first estimates a latent priority for each competing sound and forms relative stimulus evidence from their difference. A multi-scale EEG pathway with complementary signed and power-based readouts then extracts trial-specific neural evidence, which is incorporated through gated decision-level integration. The framework is evaluated using mirror-constrained and pairing-held-out protocols, together with representative acoustic, EEG, multimodal baselines, and systematic ablations. The results support a computational account in which spontaneous auditory selection reflects the interaction between generalizable stimulus priority and trial-specific neural variability.

</details>


<div id='cs.AR'></div>

# cs.AR [[Back]](#toc)

### [603] [SyntheticHLS: Building Diverse Synthetic High-Level Synthesis Datasets using LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00106)
*Stefan Abi-Karam,Miaoyan Zhou,Callie Hao*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 该论文提出 SyntheticHLS 框架，利用大语言模型（LLM）迭代反馈引导变异，结合 HLS 设计复杂度与设计空间可扩展性量化指标，生成大规模、复杂、多样的合成 HLS 数据集，并验证其可迁移性与训练泛化优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 半导体设计中深度学习与 LLM 应用日益广泛，训练数据需求激增。现有工作多集中于硬件描述语言（HDL），而面向高层综合（HLS，常用于领域专用加速器）的设计数据集稀缺。已有 HLS 数据集工作偏重人工整理或参数化设计，较少关注基于 LLM 的高质量生成，也缺乏在代码长度、层次结构、设计空间规模、时延、资源利用率与应用领域等维度的多样性，可能限制模型泛化能力。

Method: SyntheticHLS 的两个核心思想：1）迭代反馈引导的变异循环（iterative feedback-guided mutation loop），利用配对的 HLS 源代码与设计空间规格，将种子设计逐步转化为更复杂、可扩展的设计；2）定义 HLS 设计复杂度与设计空间可扩展性的量化指标，作为 LLM 引导变异的可度量优化目标。

Result: 通过系统交叉验证 HLS QoR（Quality-of-Results）深度学习模型，在常见 HLS 基准、零样本合成设计及迭代变异合成设计上训练与测试：合成设计能良好迁移至常见基准测试集，而反向迁移不成立；SyntheticHLS 的迭代变异设计在所研究数据集中提供最具泛化性的训练语料。变异过程与数据集分析表明，指标引导的轨迹能持续改善目标复杂度与可扩展性指标，且不引起非目标指标退化；变异设计覆盖的设计空间显著更广、更多样，优于零样本生成设计。

Conclusion: 该框架、数据集与评估均已开源（https://github.com/sharc-lab/synthetic-hls），为 HLS 领域 LLM 驱动的合成数据生成与模型泛化研究提供可复现基础。

Abstract: Deep learning and large language models (LLMs) are rapidly gaining adoption in semiconductor design, driving demand for training datasets. Most efforts focus on hardware description languages (HDLs) while designs for high-level synthesis (HLS), a popular approach to domain-specific accelerators, remain scarce. HLS dataset efforts emphasize manual curation or design parameterization, seldom addressing high-quality LLM-based generation or diversity in code length, hierarchy, design-space size, latency, resource utilization, and application domain, potentially limiting model generalization.
  We propose SyntheticHLS, a framework for generating large-scale, complex, diverse synthetic HLS datasets using LLMs. Its two key ideas are: 1) an iterative feedback-guided mutation loop that uses paired HLS source code and design-space specifications to incrementally transform seed designs into more complex, scalable designs; and 2) quantitative metrics of HLS design complexity and design-space scalability that serve as measurable objectives for LLM-guided mutation.
  We systematically cross-validate an HLS Quality-of-Results (QoR) deep learning model trained and tested across common HLS benchmarks, zero-shot synthetic designs, and iteratively mutated synthetic designs. Synthetic designs transfer well to common benchmark test sets while the reverse does not hold. SyntheticHLS's iteratively mutated designs provide the most generalizable training corpus among the datasets studied. Analysis of the mutation process and dataset shows that metric-guided trajectories consistently improve targeted complexity and scalability objectives without regressing non-target metrics. Mutated designs span a substantially broader, more diverse design space than zero-shot generated designs.
  Our framework, dataset, and evaluation are open-source: https://github.com/sharc-lab/synthetic-hls.

</details>


### [604] [ShatterQuant: Breaking Uniform Precision with Block-Wise Mixed-Precision on a Systolic Transformer Hardware Accelerator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00207)
*Mikolaj Walczak,Edward Humes,Chao Fang,Marian Verhelst,Tinoosh Mohsenin*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: ShatterQuant 是一个软硬件协同设计框架，通过将精度粒度与 PE 配置耦合，实现张量内部的混合精度量化，在 16nm 工艺下达到 1.5 TOPS 性能并保持较高精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统加速器对张量内部异构精度支持有限，导致神经网络量化大多局限于按张量级别的精度分配，无法在张量内部实现更细粒度的混合精度。

Method: 提出硬件感知的量化方法，基于块级标准差和权重敏感度为权重投影的各个块分配独立位宽，并将精度粒度与 PE 配置耦合使每种精度对应一个有效的块高度；同时设计支持 1/2/4/8-bit 权重的 ShatterQuant Transformer 加速器，具备精度相关的 PE 配置、块级重缩放以及集成的 softmax 和分段线性非线性单元。

Result: 在 TSMC 16nm PDK、1 GHz 下实现 1.5 TOPS、760 GOPS/mm² 面积效率和 2.8 TOPS/W 能效；在 DeiT 和 ImageNet-1K 上精度与 SOTA 混合精度方法相差 3.3% 以内且有效位宽低 2 bit，在 PixelDiT 上生成质量相当。

Conclusion: ShatterQuant 表明通过软硬件协同设计可实现细粒度的张量内部混合精度量化。

Abstract: Due to limited support for intra-tensor heterogeneous precision in conventional accelerators, neural network quantization remains largely restricted to per-tensor precision assignment. We present ShatterQuant, a hardware-software co-designed framework enabling mixed-precision quantization within each tensor by assigning independent bit-widths to blocks of a weight projection. ShatterQuant couples precision granularity with PE configuration, such that each precision determines an effective block height. We introduce (1) a hardware-aware post-training method that assigns intra-tensor precision based on block-level standard deviation and weight sensitivity; (2) the ShatterQuant Transformer Accelerator supporting 1/2/4/8-bit weight precision, precision-dependent PE configuration, block rescaling, and integrated softmax and piecewise-linear nonlinearities; and (3) an evaluation of model-hardware tradeoffs using an implementation in the TSMC 16nm PDK operating at 1 GHz, achieving 1.5 TOPS, 760 GOPS/$mm^2$ area efficiency, and 2.8 TOPS/W energy efficiency. On DeiT and ImageNet-1K, ShatterQuant achieves accuracy within $3.3\%$ of state-of-the-art mixed-precision techniques while using a 2 bit lower effective bitwidth, while for PixelDiT demonstrates comparable generation quality. ShatterQuant demonstrates how fine-grained intra-tensor mixed-precision can be realized through hardware-software co-design.

</details>


### [605] [EdgeDAE: Acceleration of Diffusion Action Experts for Real-Time Physical AI with Tiny VLAs on Edge FPGA-GPU Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00311)
*Zhiheng Chen,Ye Qiao,Mohammad Abdullah Al Faruque,Sitao Huang*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出异构FPGA-GPU系统EdgeDAE，将视觉Transformer卸载至GPU、将扩散动作专家(DAE)推理加速于FPGA片上完成，消除DRAM参数重复加载瓶颈，显著降低延迟并提升能效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA架构依赖大规模Transformer骨干与扩散式动作解码器实现通用机器人策略。边缘GPU擅长并行化视觉Transformer等计算密集负载，但DAE的迭代去噪需多步反复从DRAM加载参数，呈内存受限特征，GPU算力大量闲置。DAE的I/O密集特性与GPU计算中心架构不匹配，因此需要异构加速。

Method: EdgeDAE按计算特性划分负载：将感知密集的视觉Transformer卸载到GPU，DAE推理在FPGA上加速，通过BRAM/URAM实现参数完整片上存储。协同设计量化策略、定点算术与面向FPGA架构的高效随机数生成，以消除内存瓶颈。

Result: 相比边缘GPU基线，端到端推理延迟在Octo-Small上降低52.5%、Octo-Base上降低38.7%，吞吐最高提升2.10倍；相比消费级GPU(RTX 4090)，实现约17倍更高的能效。

Conclusion: 针对DAE内存受限特性，异构FPGA-GPU分区与片上参数存储的协同设计可有效突破DRAM带宽瓶颈，在边缘具身智能场景中兼顾低延迟与高能效。

Abstract: Physical AI models such as Vision-Language-Action (VLA) architectures enable generalist robotic policies through large-scale transformer backbones and diffusion-based action decoders. While edge GPU platforms excel at parallelizing the compute-intensive vision-transformer workloads, they exhibit fundamental limitations for the Diffusion Action Expert (DAE) module: the iterative denoising process requires repeated parameter loading from DRAM across multiple steps, resulting in memory-bound performance where the GPU's massive computational throughput remains underutilized. This mismatch between DAE's I/O-intensive characteristics and GPU's compute-centric architecture motivates a heterogeneous acceleration approach. This paper presents \textbf{EdgeDAE}, a heterogeneous FPGA-GPU system that strategically partitions workloads based on computational characteristics. We offload the perception-heavy vision-transformer to GPU while accelerating DAE inference on FPGA through complete on-chip parameter storage in BRAM/URAM. This architecture eliminates the memory bottleneck by co-designing quantization strategies, fixed-point arithmetic, and hardware-efficient random number generation for the FPGA fabric. Compared to an edge GPU baseline, EdgeDAE reduces end-to-end inference latency by 52.5\% for Octo-Small and 38.7\% for Octo-Base, with up to $2.10\times$ higher throughput; compared to a consumer GPU (RTX~4090), it achieves ${\sim}17\times$ higher energy efficiency.

</details>


### [606] [From Physical Devices to RTL Models: Abstraction and Validation in Hardware Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01186)
*Wolfgang Ecker,Natalie Simson,Johannes Ecker,Endri Kaja*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文论述硬件工程模型以抽象为核心特征：抽象必然舍弃细节、导致模型“局部不正确”，但却是管理复杂度、加速仿真的关键；文中梳理了数字设计中的集总模型、离散值模型与离散时间模型等抽象方法，并结合约束与设计准则构成设计学科，进而联系晶体管、门、寄存器、传递函数等预聚类元件，说明其定义抽象层级并提升设计生产率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 阐明硬件工程模型的根本性质，解释为何抽象既是模型固有局限（不完整、局部错误）又是应对复杂度的必要手段，并为数字设计中的各类抽象方法与抽象层级提供统一的原理性框架。

Method: 概念性分析与归纳：以“抽象即模型的定义性特征”为出发点，援引George Box“所有模型都是错的，但有些是有用的”观点；系统考察数字设计中的多种抽象方法（集总模型、离散值模型、离散时间模型），并将其与定义抽象有效性的约束及设计准则相结合，构成设计学科；进一步将这些抽象形式与预聚类设计元件相对应。

Result: 抽象在舍弃细节、限定可构建范围的同时带来简化与更快的仿真速度；集总、离散值、离散时间等抽象方法连同约束和设计准则共同确立设计学科；晶体管、门、寄存器、传递函数等预聚类元件定义了门级等抽象层级。

Conclusion: 抽象是硬件工程模型的核心，模型因抽象而必然在特定方面不完整，但正是这种抽象实现了复杂度管理与仿真效率；预聚类设计元件作为抽象层级的具体载体，是提升设计生产率的关键使能因素。

Abstract: This paper introduces the foundational principles underlying hardware engineering models and argues that abstraction is their defining characteristic. Because abstraction necessarily omits detail and constrains what engineers can build, models are inherently incomplete in specific respects - or, as George Box famously observed, "All models are wrong, but some are useful". At the same time, abstraction is essential for simplification, which is key to managing complexity. More abstract models also tend to simulate faster because fewer details must be considered.
  This paper subsequently examines a range of abstraction methods in digital design - sometimes referred to as design disciplines - including lumped models, value-discrete models, and time-discrete models. Together with constraints that define the validity of the abstraction and design guidelines, these abstraction methods establish design disciplines. This paper further relates these forms of abstraction to pre-clustered design elements such as transistors, gates, registers, and transfer functions. These pre-clustered elements define abstraction levels, such as the gate level, and are presented as a key enabler of increased design productivity.

</details>


### [607] [U-Sonic: An Open-Source 8-Channel Ultrasound Transmit IP in a 130 nm RISC-V SoC](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01603)
*Federico Villani,Nico Canzani,Marc-André Wessner,Philippe Sauter,Enrico Zelioli,Andrea Cossettini,Christoph Leitner,Luca Benini*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出U-Sonic，一个集成于32位RISC-V SoC的开源数字超声发射（TX）外设，支持可编程多通道激励，并在FPGA与IHP 130 nm工艺上完成验证与实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小型化超声探头需要多阵元间可编程且同步的发射激励，而现有紧凑平台多依赖受限的MCU脉冲发生器或闭源固定功能脉冲器件，缺乏开放、可编程的解决方案。

Method: 将数字超声TX外设集成到32位RISC-V SoC中，实现8个pulser核心，参数化架构可扩展至16通道；每个核心支持周期、占空比、脉冲数、极性、空闲电平等可编程的单/双频脉冲串，并可选反向停止脉冲实现主动阻尼；通过共享内存映射OBI实现任意通道子集的同步启停，支持复合双极性、门控与三电平激励。采用Verilator对照Python黄金模型验证4379个周期，在DE10-Lite FPGA上确认，并在IHP 130 nm完成综合与布局布线。

Result: 功能正确性经Verilator与Python黄金模型在4379个校验周期内验证，并在Terasic DE10-Lite FPGA上确认。布局后面积按1.65 kGE加每通道1.66 kGE缩放；8通道实例占14.9 kGE，约为104 kGE SoC的14.3%。

Conclusion: U-Sonic为小型化超声系统提供了开源、可编程且同步的多通道数字TX解决方案，其面积开销可接受，RTL、寄存器描述、验证材料及软件支持均已开源发布。

Abstract: Miniaturized ultrasound (US) probes require programmable and synchronized transmit (TX) excitation across multiple elements, while existing compact platforms often rely on limited microcontroller (MCU) pulse generators or closed-source fixed-function pulser devices. We present U-Sonic, an open-source digital US TX peripheral integrated into a 32-bit RISC-V system-on-chip (SoC). The implemented SoC integrates 8 pulser cores, while the parameterized architecture supports up to 16 channels. Each core generates single- or dual-tone bursts with programmable period, duty cycle, pulse count, polarity, and idle level, together with optional inverted stop pulses for active damping. A shared memory-mapped Open Bus Interface (OBI) enables synchronous start and stop of arbitrary channel subsets and supports composite bipolar, gated, and three-level excitation schemes. Functional correctness was verified in Verilator against a Python golden model over 4379 checked cycles across directed and randomized configurations, and confirmed on a Terasic DE10-Lite field-programmable gate array (FPGA). The design was synthesized and placed-and-routed in IHP 130 nm. The post-layout area in kilo gate equivalents (kGE), scales as 1.65 kGE plus 1.66 kGE per channel. The 8-channel instance occupies 14.9 kGE, corresponding to approximately 14.3% of the 104 kGE SoC. The register-transfer level (RTL), register descriptions, verification collateral, and software support are released as open source.

</details>


### [608] [Open-Source Multi-Wire SPI Readout for Wearable Ultrasound Probes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01623)
*Federico Villani,Soumyo Bhattacharjee,Lisa Odermatt,Cédric Hirschi,Luca Benini,Andrea Cossettini*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 该工作提出一种开源多线SPI读出接口，用于解决TinyProbe可穿戴超声系统FPGA与无线控制器之间的数据传输瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可穿戴超声探头需在紧凑、低功耗条件下传输日益增大的采集数据，而TinyProbe当前瓶颈位于采集FPGA与无线系统控制器之间的数据传输环节。

Method: 设计多线SPI读出接口：串行命令与地址阶段后接构建期可选的双通道或四通道载荷阶段；接口模拟串行闪存以兼容多种MCU及现有外设接口；FPGA数据通路通过跨时钟域、样本重塑和32位打包连接采集FIFO与SPI接口；在IGLOO2/SiWG917架构中集成Dual-SPI，并用Kria K26测试平台独立表征。

Result: 在TinyProbe架构中以5 MHz SCLK验证Dual-SPI；独立测试平台在SCLK最高66 MHz下实现无误传输；测得SiWG917多线SPI为下一带宽限制组件。

Conclusion: 该开源SPI读出接口可提升传输带宽并保持架构兼容性，同时指出现有无线控制器为后续升级方向，HDL与MCU实现以宽松开源许可证发布。

Abstract: Wearable ultrasound probes must transfer increasingly large acquisition payloads while maintaining compact, low-power electronics. In TinyProbe, the current bottleneck in data transfer occurs between the acquisition FPGA and the wireless system controller. This work presents an open-source, multi-wire SPI readout interface that uses serial command and address phases followed by a build-time-selectable dual- or quad-lane payload phase that is intended to address this bottleneck by increasing the potential bandwidth over the wifi limit while retaining compatibility with the Microcontroller-centric wearable US architecture. The interface emulates a serial flash memory, enabling compatibility with a broad range of microcontroller families and their existing peripheral interfaces. On the FPGA, the data path connects the existing acquisition FIFOs to the SPI interface through clock-domain crossing, sample reshaping, and packing into 32-bit words. Dual-SPI readout is integrated into the existing IGLOO2/SiWG917 TinyProbe architecture and verified at an SCLK frequency of 5 MHz. A separate Kria K26 testbed is used to characterize the FPGA SPI interface independently of the acquisition and wireless subsystems, demonstrating error-free transfers at SCLK frequencies up to 66 MHz. These measurements identify the SiWG917 multi-lane SPI implementation as the next bandwidth-limiting component and motivate a future upgrade of the system controller. The HDL and MCU implementations are released under a permissive open-source license.

</details>


### [609] [ZTA-Q: an Open-source RISC-V Platform for Accurate Quantized CNN Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01867)
*Yike Li,Ajay Kumar M,Vishnu PS,Dimitrios S. Nikolopoulos,Bo Ji,Hans Vandierendonck,Deepu John*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: ZTA-Q：基于RISC-V的开源平台，支持TensorFlow Lite INT8 CNN端到端部署，并提供可配置后处理数据通路以研究电路级近似对精度的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘AI广泛采用低精度推理以降低计算开销和内存占用，但现有开源加速器平台对标准TensorFlow Lite整型推理方案的CNN端到端支持有限。

Method: 提出ZTA-Q开源RISC-V平台，扩展算子支持，并设计可配置后处理数据通路，用于研究降低乘法器精度、共享移位缩放、简化舍入等电路级近似对模型精度的影响；系统在Digilent Arty A7-100T FPGA上实现，工作频率83.3 MHz。

Result: 在代表性CNN模型上评测，LUT、寄存器、DSP开销分别为26.3%、12.6%、150%，top-1与top-5精度下降均控制在0.25个百分点以内。

Conclusion: ZTA-Q实现了TFLite INT8模型的精确部署，并为电路级近似与精度权衡研究提供了开源可配置的RISC-V实验平台。

Abstract: Low-precision inference is widely adopted in edge AI to reduce computational cost and memory footprint.
