Together, these results position spectral operator learning as a practical framework for recovering stochastic dynamics under distribution shift and unlock applications across machine learning and the physical sciences.

</details>


### [812] [Exact Distinguishability in Non-Markovian Decision Processes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01527)
*Kabir Murjani,Nisarg Patel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究离线数据在固定行为策略下能否区分两个候选RDP（正则决策过程），证明了观测等价候选间的后验几率在任何样本量下始终等于先验几率，刻画出该等价关系并给出线性时间的判定算法PEC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RDP用于建模非马尔可夫环境（动力学通过有限自动机依赖交互历史）。已有离线保证依赖行为策略的可区分性假设，但无法验证该假设；一旦假设被违反，不同模型可能同样好地解释数据。

Method: 将非马尔可夫环境建模为RDP；研究固定行为策略下数据区分两个候选RDP的条件；用Lean 4形式化验证后验几率与先验几率相等的结论；刻画观测等价关系，并据此提出PEC算法，在乘积自动机规模上以线性时间判定等价。

Result: 证明即使策略访问每个自动机状态，观测等价候选之间的后验几率在每个样本量下仍等于先验几率，并在Lean 4中完成形式化验证；精确刻画了该等价关系；PEC算法以线性时间判定。四个测试环境中，先前工作的可区分性假设在三个上失效，而PEC识别出的实验在每个情形下都恢复了该假设。

Conclusion: 固定行为策略下某些RDP本质不可区分，可区分性假设并非总能验证；PEC提供了一种高效判定手段，并能识别出可恢复可区分性的实验设计。

Abstract: Non-Markovian environments are often modeled as Regular Decision Processes (RDPs), where dynamics depend on the interaction history through a finite automaton. Existing offline guarantees for RDPs rely on a distinguishability assumption on the behaviour policy but provide no means of verifying it. When the assumption is violated, distinct models may explain the data equally well. We study when data collected under a fixed behaviour policy can distinguish two candidate RDPs. We prove that the posterior odds between observationally equivalent candidates remain equal to the prior odds at every sample size, even when the policy visits every automaton state, and verify both results formally in Lean 4. We then characterize this equivalence exactly and derive PEC, an algorithm that decides it in time linear in the size of the product automaton. The distinguishability assumption of prior work fails on three of our four test environments, and the experiment identified by PEC restores it in each case.

</details>


### [813] [Calibrating Prediction Timeliness Through Multi-Objective Hyperparameter Optimization for Remaining Useful Life Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01530)
*Tugrul Cabir Hakyemez,Ener Uras Gokhan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将优化目标本身视为设计变量，在五种架构、三种优化策略下评估RUL预测，证明多目标搜索可降低方向性偏差、改善早晚预测校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预测性维护中，过早与过晚的RUL预测误差代价不对称，但超参数优化通常只针对单一精度指标，对两个方向同等对待，忽略了这种非对称性。

Method: 把优化目标当作设计变量。评估MLP、LSTM、XGBoost、TCN、Transformer五种架构在三种策略下的表现：最大化R²的单目标、最小化NASA评分函数的单目标，以及联合优化两者的多目标。多目标搜索采用NSGA-II，并用Entropy-CRITIC加权进行Pareto选择。在NASA C-MAPSS涡扇发动机和BackBlaze硬盘基准上考察75个"模型-数据集-策略"组合。

Result: 在C-MAPSS上，各策略精度相当（R²≈0.89），但多目标优化将方向性不平衡降低约33%，改善了早/晚预测的校准。模型排名依赖配置，简单架构常优于更深的时序模型。在BackBlaze上，两个目标从互补转为冲突，导致Entropy-CRITIC权重分歧，并出现显著泛化差距（最佳R²≈0.34）。

Conclusion: 优化目标会实质性地塑造预测行为；多目标搜索为RUL建模中校准预测及时性提供了实用机制。

Abstract: In predictive maintenance, early and late RUL prediction errors carry asymmetric consequences, yet hyperparameter optimization typically targets a single accuracy metric that treats both directions equally. This study treats the optimization objective itself as a design variable. Five architectures (MLP, LSTM, XGBoost, TCN, and Transformer) are evaluated under three regimes: single-objective maximization of $R^2$, single-objective minimization of the NASA scoring function, and a multi-objective formulation that jointly optimizes both criteria. The multi-objective search employs NSGA-II with Entropy-CRITIC weighting for Pareto selection. Seventy-five model-dataset-strategy combinations are assessed on the NASA C-MAPSS turbofan and BackBlaze hard-disk drive benchmarks. On C-MAPSS, all strategies achieve comparable accuracy ($R^2 \approx 0.89$), yet multi-objective optimization reduces directional imbalance by approximately 33%, improving calibration of early versus late predictions. Model rankings prove configuration-dependent, with simpler architectures frequently outperforming deeper temporal models. On BackBlaze, the objectives shift from complementary to conflicting, producing divergent Entropy-CRITIC weights and a substantial generalization gap (best $R^2 \approx 0.34$). These results demonstrate that the optimization objective materially shapes prognostic behavior and that multi-objective search provides a practical mechanism for calibrating prediction timeliness in RUL modeling.

</details>


### [814] [FedFit: Federated Fine-Tuning of LLMs via Vector-Bank Parameterization and Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01537)
*Hang Zou,Chao Zhang,Yuzhi Yang,Yu Tian,Samson Lasaulce,Mérouane Debbah*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FedFit，通过不相交共享向量库参数化与交替优化调度，解决联邦LoRA中SoP与PoS的聚合困境，在保持困惑度性能的同时实现最高100倍的压缩比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习可支持大语言模型的隐私保护微调，但通信开销是核心瓶颈。将LoRA应用于联邦场景时存在"聚合困境"：精确的"乘积之和"（SoP）与通信高效的"和之乘积"（PoS）难以兼得，需要在精度与通信效率间权衡。

Method: 1）提出不相交共享向量库参数化，用两个紧凑且不相交的全局向量库重建高维适配矩阵以降低通信；2）设计交替优化调度，在解耦的单库更新（可精确聚合）与联合更新（经残差谱聚合机制校正）之间循环，化解SoP与PoS冲突；3）结合分块量化与客户端误差反馈进一步压缩传输向量；4）给出理论收敛性保证。

Result: 在Qwen2.5模型上的大量实验表明，FedFit的困惑度性能与标准联邦LoRA方法相当，同时压缩比最高可达100倍。

Conclusion: FedFit通过向量库参数化与交替优化，有效缓解联邦LoRA的通信瓶颈与聚合困境，在性能不损失的前提下大幅提升压缩效率，并具备理论收敛保障。

Abstract: Federated Learning (FL) enables privacy-preserving fine-tuning of Large Language Models (LLMs), yet the massive communication overhead remains a critical bottleneck. Furthermore, applying Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) in FL faces a fundamental "aggregation dilemma" between the accurate Sum-of-Products (SoP) and the communication-efficient Product-of-Sums (PoS) implementations. To tackle these challenges, we propose FedFit. First, to significantly reduce communication overhead, we introduce a disjoint shared vector-bank parameterization that reconstructs high-dimensional adapter matrices from two compact and disjoint global vector banks. Second, to address the aggregation dilemma, we devise an alternating optimization schedule. By cycling between decoupled single-bank updates (which allow for accurate aggregation) and joint updates corrected by a Residual Spectral Aggregation mechanism, we resolve the conflict between SoP and PoS. Additionally, we integrate blockwise quantization with client-side error feedback to further compress the transmitted vectors. Furthermore, we establish theoretical convergence guarantees for the proposed algorithm. Extensive experiments on Qwen2.5 models demonstrate that FedFit achieves perplexity performance comparable to standard federated LoRA methods, while providing compression ratios up to 100x higher.

</details>


### [815] [Range-GRPO: Policy Optimization via Pairwise Relations among Reward Intervals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01548)
*Ryunyi Lee,Kangjun Noh,Somin Kim,Heedong Kim,Kyungwoo Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Range-GRPO半监督后训练框架，将LLM-as-a-Judge的伪奖励表示为保形校准的奖励区间，并在GRPO中通过区间成对比较构建学习信号，在分布内/外评测中取得最优平均性能且训练资源消耗更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM后训练需要可靠监督，但在缺乏参考答案或可执行验证器的领域监督成本高昂。LLM-as-a-Judge虽可提供可扩展的伪奖励，但单点分数无法显式表达奖励不确定性。

Method: 将伪奖励建模为保形校准的奖励区间（reward ranges）；在GRPO框架下提出半监督后训练目标，将同一rollout组内的奖励区间进行成对比较，而非归约为点奖励，使区间不确定性同时影响优势信号的幅度与方向。理论分析刻画了该目标与点奖励情形的差异，并证明当所有奖励区间收缩为点时，该目标可退化为Dr.GRPO的优势函数。

Result: 在所评估的半监督方法中，Range-GRPO取得了最高的分布内与分布外平均性能，同时所需训练资源更少。

Conclusion: 以保形奖励区间替代点式伪奖励，并在组内进行区间成对比较，是一种兼顾不确定性与性能的高效半监督后训练方案。

Abstract: As the use of large language models (LLMs) expands, post-training has become increasingly important for adapting them to downstream tasks. However, obtaining reliable supervision remains costly, especially in domains without reference answers or executable verifiers. LLM-as-a-Judge provides scalable pseudo-rewards for unlabeled responses, but a single point score does not explicitly represent reward uncertainty. This motivates representing pseudo-rewards as conformally calibrated reward ranges. We propose Range-GRPO, a semi-supervised post-training framework that combines limited labeled data with unlabeled prompts. In Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), learning signals depend on relative reward comparisons within each rollout group. The proposed objective compares reward ranges pairwise rather than reducing them to point rewards, allowing interval uncertainty to affect both the magnitude and direction of these signals. Our theoretical analysis characterizes this distinction and shows that the proposed objective recovers the Dr.GRPO advantage when all reward ranges collapse to points. Empirically, Range-GRPO achieves the highest in-distribution and out-of-distribution average performance among the evaluated semi-supervised methods while requiring fewer training resources.

</details>


### [816] [Towards Optimal Policy Improvement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01566)
*Yaniv Oren,Viliam Vadocz,Wiktor Zabka,Thomas Evers,Jan Robine,Wendelin Böhmer,Matthijs T. J. Spaan,Martha White,Hendrik Baier,Fenghui Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将"最优策略改进"定义为在给定约束下单次更新所能达到的最优策略，证明受限状态集上的最优改进等价于求解一个诱导MDP，并将近似评估下的greedification建模为不确定性下的概率决策，推导出最优算子，在多种RL算法上验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际RL算法依赖带有近似评估的迭代策略改进，但"策略改进"本身缺乏第一性原理的定义，且在实际核心约束——近似评估下如何实现最优greedification尚不清晰。

Method: 从第一性原理定义最优策略改进；证明其等价于求解诱导MDP，将基于显式或隐式模型的规划视为通往最优改进的路径；把近似评估下的greedification形式化为不确定性下的概率决策，并推导该目标下最优的新算子及其基于梯度的实用近似。

Result: 在GumbelAlphaZero、SAC、ReBRAC和广义策略迭代上，该算子及其梯度近似提升了整体性能，实验涵盖离散与连续动作、基于模型与无模型、在线与离线RL。

Conclusion: 最优策略改进可归约为诱导MDP求解，近似评估下的最优greedification可由不确定性下概率决策导出的算子实现，且具有跨算法、跨设定的实用增益。

Abstract: Practical Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithms learn to solve Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) through iterative policy improvement in the presence of approximate evaluation. We study policy improvement from first principles, defining optimal policy improvement as producing the best policy attainable in a single update under specified constraints. We show that optimal improvement restricted to a set of states is equivalent to solving an induced MDP, characterizing planning with an explicit or implicit model as a path towards optimal policy improvement. Because practical methods commonly solve such induced problems through iterative improvement in the form of greedification, we take steps towards optimal greedification under the central practical constraint of approximate evaluation. We formulate greedification under this constraint as probabilistic decision-making under uncertainty and derive a novel operator that is optimal with respect to the resulting objective. Empirically, the operator and its practical gradient-based approximations improve aggregate performance across GumbelAlphaZero, SAC, ReBRAC and Generalized Policy Iteration, in experiments spanning discrete and continuous actions, model-based and model-free, online and offline RL.

</details>


### [817] [Beyond Pointwise Error: A Multi-Metric Evaluation of Spatial Climate Downscaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01579)
*Loys Masquelier,Etienne Le Naour*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出多指标基准，比较五种空间降尺度方法在ERA5温度、风速与降水场上的表现，发现空间保真度与精细尺度变率之间存在系统性权衡，且方法排名随指标和变量变化，说明不存在单一最优降尺度方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 气候降尺度旨在从粗分辨率输入重建精细尺度空间场，但其质量评估存在困难：逐点误差低可能以牺牲精细尺度变率为代价，而合理的空间变率也可能伴随不准确的局部结构，因此评估指标的选择会改变哪种方法看起来最优。

Method: 构建多指标基准，在ERA5温度、风场和降水场上比较五种空间降尺度方法，并采用五类互补评价准则：逐点误差、结构相似性、分布误差、谱误差与梯度误差。

Result: 结果揭示了空间保真度与精细尺度变率之间的系统性权衡：部分方法在逐点和空间对齐指标上表现最佳，但丢失高频内容；另一些方法保留了显著更多的谱变率，却以局部结构定位不够准确为代价。因此，方法排名会随指标和变量而变化。

Conclusion: 不存在单一的“最佳”降尺度方法，多指标评估对于判断气候场的哪些属性得以保留至关重要。

Abstract: Climate downscaling aims to reconstruct fine scale spatial fields from coarse resolution inputs. Evaluating the quality of these reconstructions is challenging: low pointwise error can come at the cost of fine scale variability, while realistic spatial variability can be achieved with inaccurate local structures. The evaluation metric can therefore change which method appears to perform best. This work presents a multi metric benchmark comparing five spatial downscaling methods on ERA5 temperature, wind, and precipitation fields. Five criteria assess complementary properties: pointwise error, structural similarity, distribution error, spectral error, and gradient error. The results reveal a systematic trade off between spatial fidelity and fine scale variability. Some methods perform best on pointwise and spatially aligned metrics, but lose high frequency content, while others preserve substantially more spectral variability at the cost of less accurately positioned local structures. Consequently, method rankings change across metrics and variables. These results show that there is no single best downscaling method. Multi metric evaluation is therefore essential for assessing which properties of a climate field are preserved.

</details>


### [818] [Two Routes to the Middle: Placement Search and Brain Readouts Converge on Where Continual Learners Should Specialize](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01590)
*Yuan Huang,Zihan Chen,Runbin Zhang,Hongwei Ding,Changzeng Fu,Shiqi Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究任务特定适配器在预训练ViT中应放置于哪些层（即"放置位置"问题）。算法上，连续四层放置的准确率呈倒U形，峰值在中间深度；而基于权重谱或激活统计的廉价准则偏好最深层。受视觉皮层层级组织启发，作者提出LS-B：用冻结的人类视觉区fMRI编码模型观察首批任务，一次性将任务特定容量分配到"跨任务最易变、结构最稳定"的块。LS-B在多个骨干网络上给出稳定分配，所选块与搜索找到的中间层区域重叠，在同等存储和观测预算下优于最浅和最深的四层配置；在Split ImageNet-R上仅用60%全量BiLoRA存储，最终准确率差距在1.5 pp以内，无需标签或反向传播，运行时开销低于0.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续学习者在ViT每个块中都保留任务特定适配器会导致存储随任务数线性增长；只在少数块中保留适配器可抑制该增长，但随之产生"应放在哪些块"的放置问题。现有廉价准则（基于权重谱或激活统计）偏好最深层，而训练搜索显示中间深度更优，二者不一致；作者希望找到一种无需放置搜索、由外部测量（神经科学启发）引导层特化的方法。

Method: 1）算法分析：穷举训练所有连续四块放置配置，观察准确率随深度的变化；并对比基于权重谱与激活统计的廉价放置准则。2）神经科学启发：借鉴视觉皮层的层级组织与中间阶段可塑性。3）提出LS-B：使用冻结的、涵盖12个人类视觉区的fMRI编码模型观察首批任务，衡量各块读出在任务间的变异程度相对于其稳定结构，从而一次性、不可逆地将任务特定容量分配到最"任务敏感"的块；分配过程无需标签与反向传播。

Result: 在三个ViT-B/16骨干网络上，LS-B产生稳定且随骨干而异的分配。在AugReg和iBOT两个可进行放置搜索的骨干上，LS-B所选块与搜索识别的中间深度区域重叠。在匹配存储与观测预算下，所选块优于最浅和最深的四块配置。在Split ImageNet-R上，LS-B仅使用全量BiLoRA适配器存储的60%，最终准确率与全量方案相差不超过1.5 pp；分配运行时开销低于0.6%，并呈现骨干特异的皮层特征。

Conclusion: LS-B表明，可以用学习者外部的神经科学测量（fMRI编码模型的跨任务读出变异性）来引导ViT持续学习中的层特化，无需昂贵的放置搜索、标签或反向传播，即可在显著降低适配器存储的同时保持接近全量微调的准确率，并揭示骨干特异的皮层对应特征。

Abstract: Continual learners that keep a task-specific adapter in every block of a pre-trained vision transformer accumulate storage linearly with the number of tasks; keeping task-specific adapters in only a few blocks curbs this growth but raises the question of where to place them. We investigate this question from two perspectives. Algorithmically, training all contiguous four-block placements yields an inverted U: final accuracy peaks at intermediate depth and varies by up to 3.5 percentage points (pp), while inexpensive criteria based on weight spectra or activation statistics favor the deepest blocks. From neuroscience, the hierarchical organization and intermediate-stage plasticity of the visual cortex motivate us to ask whether a measurement taken outside the learner can guide layer specialization without placement search. LS-B observes the first tasks through a frozen fMRI encoding model of twelve human visual areas and commits task-specific capacity once to the blocks whose readouts vary most across tasks relative to their stable structure. Across three ViT-B/16 backbones, LS-B yields stable, backbone-specific allocations. On the two backbones with placement search, AugReg and iBOT, the selected blocks overlap the intermediate-depth region identified by search. Under matched storage and observation budgets, the selected blocks outperform the shallowest and deepest four-block configurations. On Split ImageNet-R, LS-B uses 60% of full-BiLoRA adapter storage while remaining within 1.5 pp of its final accuracy. The allocation requires no labels or backpropagation, adds under 0.6% runtime, and exhibits backbone-specific cortical signatures.

</details>


### [819] [Permutation-Robust Decision Modeling with Candidate-Independent Block-Causal Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01601)
*Guy Amit*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出候选独立的分块因果注意力（candidate-independent block-causal attention），通过阻断候选间信息流动并重置候选位置，降低决策模型对候选序列排列顺序的敏感性，同时保持竞争性的决策质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 决策模型需对可变数量的候选动作打分，这类设定在生成式系统的System 1组件中日益重要，候选在不同运行中可能以不同顺序被提出。标准因果交叉编码虽表达力强，但会使候选得分依赖序列化顺序而非决策问题本身，损害排序/评分的一致性。

Method: 提出候选独立的分块因果注意力机制：在共享上下文与各候选内部保留因果计算，同时阻断跨候选的信息流动并重置候选位置编码。在Gemma 3 1B、Qwen3 1.7B、Qwen3 4B三个骨干模型上，与标准因果注意力和互补的不变性基线进行对比，并进行消融实验。

Result: 候选独立注意力在保持竞争性决策质量的同时，一致性地降低了排列敏感性。消融表明候选隔离是效果的主要来源，位置重置则补全了预期的对称性。在Qwen3-4B上以更多训练数据开展的更大规模研究进一步考察了该架构的行为。

Conclusion: 候选独立的分块因果注意力是一种有效提升决策模型排列不变性、且不显著牺牲决策质量的方法，其核心贡献来自候选间信息隔离与位置重置。代码与模型工件已开源发布。

Abstract: Decision models often score a variable-sized set of candidate actions encoded in a single sequence. This setting is increasingly relevant for System 1 components inside generative systems, where candidates may be proposed or ordered differently across runs. Standard causal cross-encoding is expressive, but it can make a candidate's score depend on serialization order rather than on the underlying decision problem. We introduce candidate-independent block-causal attention, which preserves causal computation within the shared context and each candidate while blocking cross-candidate information flow and resetting candidate positions. We compare this architecture with standard causal attention and complementary invariant baselines across Gemma 3 1B, Qwen3 1.7B, and Qwen3 4B backbones. Candidate-independent attention consistently reduces permutation sensitivity while retaining competitive decision quality; ablations indicate that candidate isolation is the primary source of the effect, with position resetting completing the intended symmetry. A larger Qwen3-4B study further examines the behavior of the proposed architecture with substantially more training data. Code is available at the \href{https://github.com/guyAmit/ci-decision-models}{\textcolor{blue}{project repository}}, and the \href{https://huggingface.co/Guy-Amit/qwen3-4b-ci-decision-4096-poc}{\textcolor{blue}{Qwen3-4B model artifact}} is available on Hugging Face.

</details>


### [820] [Exposing the Cost of Deep Learning Audio Development](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01619)
*Constance Douwes,Paul Magron,Romain Serizel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于计算平台活动日志的方法，用于估算深度学习项目开发阶段（架构原型设计与密集实验）的能耗与碳排放，并以LORIA实验室Multispeech团队的4个音频项目为案例。结果显示，开发阶段能耗是训练最优模型能耗的3至256倍，呼吁对深度学习音频项目全生命周期进行系统性能耗报告。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 过去十年深度学习的环境影响日益受到关注，但现有研究主要聚焦于模型训练与推理的能耗与碳排放，而整个开发阶段常被忽视。然而该阶段需进行架构原型设计与大量密集实验，能耗需求极高，因此亟需对该阶段成本进行量化评估。

Method: 提出一种估算开发阶段能耗的方法，数据来源为LORIA实验室所使用的Grid5000共享计算平台的活动日志；以Multispeech研究团队开发的音频项目为案例，评估4个项目的总体能耗，并将其与所报告模型的训练能耗进行对比。

Result: 4个音频项目开发阶段所需能耗是单独训练其最佳性能模型所需能耗的3至256倍。

Conclusion: 开发阶段的能耗在深度学习项目总能耗中占据显著且常被忽略的比重，研究结果倡导对基于深度学习的音频项目在其整个生命周期内进行更系统化的能耗报告。

Abstract: The environmental impact of deep learning has attracted increasing attention over the past decade. Existing studies mainly focus on the energy and carbon emissions of model training and inference, while the whole development phase is often overlooked. Yet, architecture prototyping and intensive experiments are conducted during this stage, which is highly energy-demanding. In this article, we propose a methodology to estimate these costs, based on activity logs from the Grid5000 shared computing platform used by the LORIA laboratory. As a case-study, we focus on audio projects developed in the Multispeech research team. We evaluate the overall energy cost of four projects, and we compare them to those of training the reported models. Our results show that the energy required for the development phase is 3 to 256 times greater than that required to train the best-performing model alone. These results advocate for a more systematic reporting of energy consumption across the entire life cycle of deep learning-based audio projects.

</details>


### [821] [Generalization in Neural Networks Through the Lens of Magnitude Potential](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01633)
*Sahel Torkamani,Henry Gouk,Rik Sarkar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"量级势能"(magnitude potential)这一基于度量量级理论的量,用以刻画任意点被给定集合表征的程度,并将其应用于分析神经网络的泛化与训练动力学。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络中的泛化与训练动力学仍缺乏统一解释,已有方法从不同侧面研究相关现象,但需要新的几何量来刻画表征质量与决策边界的结构变化。

Method: 基于度量量级理论定义量级势能,衡量某点被给定集合表征的程度;在logit层计算"相对某一类的量级势能"与"相对整个数据集的量级势能"之比,用以反映该点的表征;并对训练点的比值进行聚合分析。

Result: 训练点的量级势能比值与Feldman记忆分数相关;跨点聚合的量级势能比值可检测决策边界的结构性变化,并为模算术中的grokking提供几何指标;即使显式抑制神经崩塌(neural collapse),量级势能比值仍具有信息量。

Conclusion: 量级势能比值是一种有效的几何分析工具,可刻画表征质量、记忆与决策边界变化,且在神经崩塌被抑制时依然保持信息量,为理解泛化与训练动力学提供了新视角。

Abstract: Explaining generalization and training dynamics in neural networks remains a challenge, and various approaches have been developed to study different aspects of these phenomena. In this paper, we introduce the idea of {\em magnitude potential} -- a quantity based on the theory of metric magnitude -- that reflects how well an arbitrary point is represented by a given set. We find that this basic quantity can be applied to examine various features in neural generalization. The ratio between the magnitude potential with respect to a class and with respect to the entire data, computed at the logit layer, is informative of the representation of the point. In experiments, these ratios for individual training points are found to be correlated with the Feldman memorization scores. Magnitude potential ratios aggregated across points detect structural changes in the decision boundaries and provide a geometric indicator of grokking in modular arithmetic. Although the magnitude potential ratio and neural collapse are both closely associated with intra-class and inter-class geometric structure, the magnitude potential ratio remains informative even when neural collapse is explicitly suppressed.

</details>


### [822] [FedSAP: Federated Learning with Structured Adaptive Partitioning for Multi-Domain Heterogeneous Edge Devices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01638)
*Wentao Yue,Tianyou Lai,Hongji Li,Qingyu Mao,Qilei Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FedSAP：将结构化剪枝建模为预算约束的三态通道分配，实现域感知异构联邦学习，兼顾资源异构与域偏移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘设备上的联邦学习需同时应对资源预算不均与本地数据域偏移。现有资源自适应方法只决定客户端训练多少模型，却不决定保留容量所在位置及其共享方式；联邦域泛化方法又通常假设共享完整架构。导致统一压缩会丢弃高价值通道，单一聚合路径会混合可迁移特征与域敏感更新。

Method: 提出FedSAP域感知异构联邦学习框架：将结构化剪枝转化为预算约束的三态通道分配。把每个保留比例转换为非均匀层预算，通道分为三态——稳定通道归入Global池、有用但域敏感的通道归入伪域专属Private池、低效用通道置为Dropped。通过Domain-Guided Assignment基于浅层梯度相似度推断伪域；通过Type-Matched Aggregation限制每个通道仅在其既定共享范围内聚合。

Result: 在三个随机种子下，FedSAP在Digits和Office-Caltech上分别达到76.00%和72.67%的平均全局准确率，较最强基线高出1.70和4.92个百分点，同时支持异构客户端高达80%的剪枝比例。

Conclusion: FedSAP通过三态通道分配与类型匹配聚合，使通用特征受益于跨客户端池化，同时将域敏感更新与不兼容客户端隔离，在资源异构与域偏移并存的场景下显著优于现有方法。

Abstract: Federated learning (FL) on heterogeneous edge devices must jointly accommodate unequal resource budgets and domain-shifted local data. Existing resource-adaptive methods decide how much of a model each client trains but not where retained capacity should reside or how it should be shared, whereas federated domain-generalization methods usually assume a shared full architecture. Uniform compression can therefore discard high-utility channels, and a single aggregation path can mix transferable features with domain-sensitive updates. We propose FedSAP, a domain-aware heterogeneous FL framework that casts structured pruning as budget-constrained tri-state channel allocation. FedSAP converts each keep ratio into non-uniform layer budgets, assigns stable channels to a Global pool, useful domain-sensitive channels to pseudo-domain-specific Private pools, and low-utility channels to a Dropped state. This partition lets broadly useful features benefit from cross-client pooling while isolating domain-sensitive updates from incompatible clients. Domain-Guided Assignment infers pseudo-domains from shallow-gradient similarity, while Type-Matched Aggregation restricts each channel to its intended sharing scope. Across three random seeds, FedSAP reaches 76.00% and 72.67% mean global accuracy on Digits and Office-Caltech, exceeding the strongest baseline by 1.70 and 4.92 percentage points while supporting client pruning ratios of up to 80% across heterogeneous clients.

</details>


### [823] [MCIR: A Feature Dependence-Aware Explainability Method with Reliability Guarantees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01641)
*Poushali Sengupta,Sabita Maharjan,Frank Eliassen,Shashi Raj Pandey,Yan Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出依赖感知的全局特征重要性方法 MCIR-M，通过互相关影响比 (MCIR) 量化特征在依赖邻域之外贡献的独特预测信息，以缓解多重共线性下特征归因排名不稳定的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代机器学习模型常含强依赖或冗余特征，共享的预测信息会在相关预测变量间分散，导致 SHAP、LIME、HSIC、MI/CMI、SAGE 等方法在多重共线性或近重复预测变量下产生不稳定的重要性排名。

Method: MCIR-M 将每个特征以其强依赖邻居为条件，计算条件信息与块级信息的归一化比值即 MCIR，取值于 [0,1]，在完全条件冗余时为零；并引入轻量估计流程，仅用部分数据计算 MCIR，再通过排名、头部集合与忠实性诊断评估其与全数据解释的一致性。

Result: 在受控合成冗余实验与 UCI HAR 基准上，MCIR 表现出依赖感知的排名行为，在注入近重复预测变量时优势最明显；与独立/条件 SHAP、SAGE、HSIC、MI 类分数及 CIR 族基线的比较在真实数据指标上结果不一；缩减解释样本在评估配置中降低了计算负担。

Conclusion: MCIR-M 为强特征依赖下的全局解释提供了一种实用的依赖感知诊断工具，但其相对现有方法的优势主要体现在近重复特征场景，真实数据上的表现仍具混合性。

Abstract: Modern machine-learning models often contain strongly dependent or redundant features, making feature attribution difficult because shared predictive information can be distributed across correlated predictors. Existing methods such as SHAP, LIME, HSIC, MI/CMI, and SAGE may therefore produce unstable rankings under multicollinearity or near-duplicate predictors. We propose the Mutual Correlation Impact Ratio Method (MCIR-M), a dependence-aware global feature-importance approach that quantifies the unique predictive information contributed by each feature beyond a selected dependence neighbourhood. MCIR-M introduces the Mutual Correlation Impact Ratio (MCIR), which conditions each feature on strongly dependent neighbours and computes a normalized ratio of conditional to block-level information. The population score lies in [0,1] and equals zero under exact conditional redundancy. We also introduce a lightweight estimation procedure that computes MCIR using a fraction of the available data and evaluates agreement with full-data explanations. Across controlled synthetic redundancy experiments and the UCI HAR benchmark, MCIR shows dependence-aware ranking behaviour, with its clearest advantage under injected near-duplicate predictors. Comparisons with independent and conditional SHAP, SAGE, HSIC, MI-based scores, and CIR-family baselines are mixed across real-data criteria. Reduced explanation samples lower computational burden in the evaluated configurations, while agreement with full-data explanations is assessed separately through ranking, head-set, and faithfulness diagnostics. Overall, MCIR-M provides a practical dependence-aware diagnostic for global explanation under strong feature dependence.

</details>


### [824] [Beyond Demographic Balance: Multi-Metric and Intersectional Evaluation of Fairness in MIMIC-IV Mortality Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01645)
*Abdullah Al Noman,Fahmid Al Rifat,Tahrima Hashem,Syed Muhammad Ibne Zulfiker,Rishov Paul,Tanzima HAshem*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在MIMIC-IV的ICU死亡率预测任务上，比较多种公平性干预在预测效用与子群误差指标上的表现，并引入一种不依赖结局条件、联合平衡种族—性别—保险代表性的轻量适配策略，分别在边际与三重交叉子群层面评估，并考虑细粒度估计的统计支持度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床预测中的公平性结论高度依赖所报告的指标以及评估性能时采用的人口学分辨率；边际人口学汇总可能掩盖其组成交叉子群内部的异质误差，因此需要重新审视评估选择。

Method: 在MIMIC-IV的ICU死亡率预测上，比较多种公平性干预在预测效用指标与子群误差指标上的表现；引入一种轻量适配策略，在不以死亡率结局为条件的情况下联合平衡种族—性别—保险的表示；在边际层面与相应的三重交叉子群层面评估其行为，并纳入对更细粒度估计的统计支持度考量。

Result: 干预在准确率/AUROC、敏感性和假阳性率下可获得显著不同的评价；边际人口学汇总会掩盖其组成交叉子群内部的异质误差分布，且该现象在较大子群中同样存在。

Conclusion: 评估公平性干预时需同时覆盖互补的指标维度与子群分辨率，并考虑干预目标及子群估计的可靠性。

Abstract: Fairness conclusions in clinical prediction can depend strongly on both the metrics reported and the demographic resolution at which performance is evaluated. We revisit these evaluation choices for ICU mortality prediction on MIMIC-IV, comparing predictive-utility and subgroup-error metrics across several fairness interventions. As a complementary case study, we introduce a lightweight adaptation strategy that jointly balances ethnicity--gender--insurance representation without conditioning on mortality outcomes, allowing demographic representation balancing to be examined separately from outcome-conditioned or direct error-rate interventions. We evaluate its behavior at both marginal and corresponding three-way intersectional subgroup levels, while accounting for the statistical support of finer-grained estimates. The results show that interventions can receive substantially different assessments across accuracy/AUROC, sensitivity, and false-positive rate, and that marginal demographic summaries can conceal heterogeneous error profiles within their constituent intersections, including among larger subgroups. These findings highlight the importance of evaluating fairness interventions at both complementary metric and subgroup resolutions, while accounting for the intervention target and the reliability of subgroup estimates.

</details>


### [825] [CrossGMN: Graph Metanetworks for Cross-Architecture Weight-Space Transformations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01649)
*Adir Dayan,Yam Eitan,Haggai Maron*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出跨架构权重空间算子的问题设定，主张用"源网络+目标网络初始化"双输入形式重构算子，从而在源/目标置换作用空间不同的情况下定义恰当的等变性与不变性。基于此提出CrossGMN图元网络，通过保持对称性的跨网络消息传递联合处理两网络，并证明其通用性。实验在模型压缩和知识蒸馏加速上取得显著效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有等变权重空间架构主要针对保持网络架构不变的变换（如神经元置换）进行设计。但模型压缩、升尺度等实际变换会将源网络映射到架构不同的目标网络，此时源与目标的置换对称作用在不同参数空间，等变性难以直接表述，缺少合适的理论框架与架构。

Method: 核心思想是将跨架构算子重新表述为双输入算子：输入一个已训练的源网络和目标网络的一个初始化。由此定义等变跨架构算子——利用源网络信息去精化目标网络的初始化，同时对源网络置换保持不变、对目标网络置换保持等变。据此提出CrossGMN：一种图元网络，通过保持对称性的跨网络消息传递联合处理两个网络。并给出理论证明：在紧集与一般位置假设下，CrossGMN对连续跨架构算子具有通用性。

Result: 在模型压缩任务中，用CrossGMN预测更小网络的参数以加速后续知识蒸馏。在2-D与3-D隐式神经表示（INR）以及基于MLP、CNN、Vision Transformer的图像分类任务上：蒸馏最高加速8.89倍；无需重训练即可跨数据集迁移（3.78倍）；单个模型可支持从异构源架构压缩到同一目标架构。

Conclusion: 通过双输入重构跨架构算子并借助图元网络实现对称性保持的跨网络消息传递，可在源/目标置换空间不一致时正确刻画等变性，且具备通用性保证；该方法为跨架构模型压缩与蒸馏加速提供了有效且可迁移的方案。

Abstract: Weight-space networks operate directly on parameters of other neural networks, enabling tasks such as predicting model properties, editing trained models, and generating weights. Weight-space symmetries such as neuron permutations make equivariance a key design principle. However, existing equivariant weight-space architectures have primarily been studied for transformations that preserve the network architecture. In contrast, many practical transformations, including model compression and upscaling, map a trained source network into a target network with a different architecture. In this setting, the source and target permutation symmetries act on different parameter spaces, making equivariance less straightforward to formulate. Our key idea for addressing this mismatch is to reformulate cross-architecture operators with two inputs: a trained source network and an initialization of the target network. This lets us define equivariant cross-architecture operators that refine the initialization of the target network using information from the source network, while being invariant to source-network permutations and equivariant to target-network permutations. Based on this formulation, we introduce CrossGMN, a graph metanetwork that jointly processes both networks through symmetry-preserving cross-network message passing. We prove CrossGMN is universal for continuous cross-architecture operators on compact sets under a general-position assumption. We evaluate CrossGMN for model compression, predicting a smaller network's parameters to accelerate subsequent knowledge distillation. Across 2-D and 3-D INRs and image classification with MLPs, CNNs, and Vision Transformers, CrossGMN speeds up distillation by up to 8.89x, transfers across datasets without retraining (3.78x), and a single model can accelerate compression from heterogeneous source architectures into a common target architecture.

</details>


### [826] [Iterative Policy Refinement through Semantic Rollout Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01652)
*Feiyu Gavin Zhu,Qi Xu,Zhifei Deng,Zhigang Hua,Luke Simon,Jean Oh,Reid Simmons*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出闭环框架，用LLM分析rollout表格数据诊断并迭代修正结构化策略，自动生成策略结构以提升模仿学习性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构化策略通过引入任务相关的归纳偏置，提升了模仿学习的效率、鲁棒性和可解释性，但现有结构生成方法依赖大量人工输入或LLM中静态领域知识，可能与专家演示不一致。

Method: 闭环框架：将策略rollout记录为语义上有意义的表格数据，提示LLM生成诊断分析代码，从而识别策略结构中的次优之处并迭代修正，无需人工指令。在赛车和开门任务上验证。

Result: 模仿学习性能较零样本LLM生成结构提升最高15%；达到相同强化学习性能所需计算量减少75%。

Conclusion: 表格化rollout分析提供了有效反馈信号，使LLM生成的策略结构与专家演示对齐，可自动生成优质策略结构。

Abstract: Structured policies improve efficiency, robustness, and interpretability in imitation learning by introducing task-specific inductive bias, but existing structure generation methods rely either on extensive human input or on static domain knowledge encoded in LLMs, which may be inconsistent with the expert demonstrations. We propose a closed-loop framework that iteratively refines structured policies using LLM-guided analysis of policy rollouts. By logging rollouts as semantically meaningful tabular data and prompting the LLM to generate diagnostic analysis code, our method identifies suboptimalities in the policy structure and iteratively corrects them without requiring human instruction. Experiments on car racing and door opening tasks show that our approach improves imitation learning performance by up to 15% over zero-shot LLM-generated structures and requires 75% less compute to achieve the same reinforcement learning performance. These results demonstrate that tabular rollout analysis provides an effective feedback signal to align LLM-generated policy structures with expert demonstrations, and we can utilize it to generate good policy structures automatically.

</details>


### [827] [pCoMole: Pareto-Constrained Molecule Editing with Discrete Flows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01663)
*Tong Chen,Maximilian Holsman,Lin Zhao,Pranam Chatterjee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出pCoMole，一个基于离散流匹配的Pareto约束分子编辑框架，通过Tchebycheff效用与Doob-h变换实现对预训练Edit Flow的偏好引导，在保证终端可行性的同时完成多目标、变长生物序列的定向编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物分子治疗药物通常从已知序列出发，需要通过靶向编辑在满足严苛的生化与可制造性硬约束下同时改善多个性质。然而现有生成方法无法在离散、变长生物空间中同时支持多目标优化、硬可行性保证与序列编辑。

Method: 提出pCoMole框架，构建于离散流匹配之上：利用增广Tchebycheff效用定义可行性门控的终端分布，并通过底层编辑过程的Doob-h变换实现偏好倾斜；为便于实现，采用短Monte Carlo rollout近似所需调和函数，得到高效且具可证明偏好一致性的引导编辑器。

Result: 在缩短GFP并保留荧光相关性质、缩短多种Cas9直系同源物并保持PAM特异性、将肽结合物压缩为短肽模拟物并在硬约束下优化七项药物相关性质等任务上验证了pCoMole。湿实验中，两个由pCoMole设计的229残基eGFP变体在10处缺失（伴随1或2处替换）后，于BL21细胞中仍保持明显绿色荧光。

Conclusion: pCoMole实现了离散、变长空间中约束感知且Pareto对齐的生物分子序列编辑。

Abstract: Biomolecular therapeutics often start from known sequences and require targeted editing to improve multiple properties while satisfying hard biochemical and manufacturability constraints. However, existing generative methods do not jointly support multi-objective optimization, hard feasibility, and sequence editing in discrete, variable-length biological spaces. In this work, we introduce Pareto-Constrained Molecule Editing (pCoMole), a framework built on discrete flow matching that steers a pre-trained Edit Flow toward user-specified preferences while enforcing terminal feasibility. pCoMole defines a feasibility-gated terminal distribution using an augmented Tchebycheff utility and realizes the resulting preference tilt through a Doob-h transform of the underlying edit process. To make this construction practical, we approximate the required harmonic function using short Monte Carlo rollouts over candidate edits, yielding an efficient guided editor with provable preference consistency. We validate pCoMole by shrinking GFP while retaining fluorescence-related properties, shortening diverse Cas9 orthologs while preserving PAM specificity, and compressing peptide binders into short peptidomimetics that optimize seven drug-related properties under hard constraints. In wet lab testing, two 229-residue pCoMole-designed eGFP variants retained clear green fluorescence in BL21 cells after 10 deletions, with either one or two substitutions. Together, pCoMole enables constraint-aware, Pareto-aligned editing of biomolecular sequences in discrete, variable-length spaces.

</details>


### [828] [Invent a Dataset: Measuring dataset generation abilities with zero seed](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01674)
*Shivalika Singh,Andrija Djurisic,Gbemileke Onilude,Sudip Roy,Sara Hooker*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Invent-A-Dataset：一个基于提示的系统，可在零数据条件下从数据集描述直接生成大规模、真实的后训练数据集，并在八类任务、最高 2 万样本规模下全面优于五家前沿模型 API。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据集构建是 AI 开发中最依赖人工且最脆弱的环节。现实中最极端却也最常见的场景是零数据机制——开发者对目标能力没有任何数据。本文旨在解决零数据条件下如何获得高质量、多样化且可扩展的后训练数据集这一问题。

Method: Invent-A-Dataset 是一个基于提示（prompt-based）的系统，输入为数据集描述，输出为真实、大规模的后训练数据集。评估中将其与五家前沿模型 API（Anthropic、Google、OpenAI、DeepSeek、Zai）对比，覆盖八类任务，数据集规模最高达 20K 样本，并以质量与多样性为核心指标。

Result: Invent-A-Dataset 同时取得最高质量（相对提升 17%）与最高多样性（相对提升 19%），显著优于对比基线。多样性优势随训练数据集规模扩大而增强：在 200 样本时与基线持平，到 20K 样本时相对提升达 37%。该优势转化为可观的下游训练收益，使后训练模型性能显著更强；在不同后训练模型架构上，Invent-A-Dataset 微调模型的排名始终高于其他生成器微调模型。

Conclusion: 在零数据机制下，Invent-A-Dataset 能生成更高质量、更具多样性且可扩展的后训练数据集，并带来稳定的下游性能提升，且该收益在不同模型架构间具有一致性。

Abstract: Building datasets remains one of the most manual and brittle parts of AI development. In this technical report, we focus on the most extreme but also most prevalent setting real world practitioners face: a zero data regime. Here, practitioners don't have any data for the capability they want to learn. We introduce Invent-A-Dataset which is a prompt based system to go from dataset description to realistic and large scale post-training datasets. We evaluate Invent-A-Dataset against five frontier model APIs including Anthropic, Google, Open AI, DeepSeek, Zai. Across eight task types and dataset sizes up to 20K samples, Invent-A-Dataset significantly outperforms with both the highest quality (17% relative gains) while simultaneously producing the most diverse samples (19% relative gains). Its diversity advantage widens with scale of training dataset size (from parity at 200 samples to 37% relative gains at 20K samples). This translates into considerable downstream training gains, resulting in far more performant post-trained models. Invent-A-Dataset fine-tune consistently ranks higher compared to other generator fine-tunes across different post-trained model architectures.

</details>


### [829] [SIEVE: Selective attention-value Suppression for Vision-Language Models Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01962)
*Si Qi Goh,Cap Dang Xuan Kiet,Tat-Jen Cham,Kwok-Yan Lam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出SIEVE框架，通过正则化注意力值表示并结合序列级监督，实现VLM对个人身份信息的选择性遗忘，同时保留允许的知识，达到最优遗忘性能与可用的保留效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM能够将视觉身份与个人生平信息关联，因此需要对其中的个人可识别信息(PII)进行选择性遗忘，同时保留关于同一人物的允许信息。这一设定具挑战性，因为敏感信息与需保留信息往往共享相同的视觉输入和中间表示，难以在不损害保留知识的前提下实现定向遗忘。

Method: 提出SIEVE框架：一方面将forget样本的注意力值(attention-value)抑制至常量零，另一方面通过对齐冻结的参考模型来保持retain样本的表示；并将其与序列级的forget/retain监督相结合，实现定向遗忘。

Result: 在多种模型-模态设定下，SIEVE在遗忘任务上取得最优性能，同时保持有竞争力的保留效用。消融实验表明，值抑制与负交叉熵提供了互补的遗忘信号，而基于参考模型的值匹配显著降低了效用退化。

Conclusion: 当敏感知识与保留知识高度相关时，注意力值是实现选择性多模态遗忘的有效干预点。

Abstract: The ability of vision-language models (VLMs) to associate visual identities with biographical information creates a need for selective unlearning of personally identifiable information (PII) while preserving permitted knowledge about the same individual. This setting is challenging because both sensitive and retained information can share the same visual inputs and intermediate representations. We introduce SIEVE, a simple and effective framework for selective VLM unlearning. SIEVE directly regularizes attention-value representations while also controlling model outputs. SIEVE suppresses attention values for forget examples toward a constant zero, while preserving retain-example representations by matching them to a frozen reference model. These objectives are combined with sequence-level forget and retain supervision, enabling targeted forgetting without largely affecting retained knowledge. Extensive experiments show that SIEVE achieves state-of-the-art performance on unlearning with multiple model-modality settings, while maintaining competitive retained utility. Ablation studies further show that value suppression and negative cross-entropy contribute complementary forgetting signals, while reference-based value matching substantially reduces utility degradation. These results demonstrate that attention values provide an effective intervention point for selective multimodal unlearning when sensitive and retained knowledge are closely related.

</details>


### [830] [MiLoop: Selective Memory Propagation for Neural Combinatorial Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01685)
*Changliang Zhou,Yuanyao Chen,Rongsheng Chen,Zhiyun Lin,Zhenkun Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MiLoop：一种纯强化学习的构造式神经组合优化框架，通过在多步rollout中传播历史表示（记忆环），使浅层策略无需外部标签或训练时剪枝即可学到有效动态嵌入。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动态嵌入类构造式NCO方法虽泛化性好，但每步需用深层注意力栈从头重建子问题表示；且高效训练常依赖解标签/伪标签，或依赖RL中的激进搜索空间剪枝。这些限制了方法的简洁性与独立性。

Method: 提出MiLoop，纯RL构造框架：复用rollout本身已有多步计算进行选择性记忆传播。具体做法是在注意力层之前将当前嵌入与历史记忆融合，之后施加自适应门控更新，更新后的表示同时支持当前决策与逐步复用，从而使浅层策略学到有效动态嵌入。

Result: 在四类组合优化问题上进行大量实验，MiLoop在100至1000万节点规模的实例上均能稳定生成高质量解，表现出强泛化能力。

Conclusion: MiLoop证明：借助rollout内的记忆传播，构造式NCO可在不依赖外部解标签与训练时搜索空间剪枝的前提下，兼顾训练效率与解质量，并具备大规模与跨问题泛化能力。

Abstract: Constructive neural combinatorial optimization (NCO) has emerged as a promising paradigm that learns to construct solutions to combinatorial optimization problems (COPs) step by step, which reduces reliance on handcrafted rules and enables fast inference. While many methods with dynamic embeddings generalize well, they typically rebuild subproblem representations from scratch at each step using deep attention stacks. Many high-performing methods in this category rely on solution labels or pseudo-labels for efficient training, or on aggressive search space pruning during reinforcement learning (RL). To address these limitations, we propose Memory-in-the-Loop (MiLoop), a purely RL-based constructive framework that leverages the multi-step computation already required by a rollout for selective memory propagation. Each rollout provides solution-quality feedback for learning while propagating historical representations, thereby enabling a shallow policy to learn effective dynamic embeddings without external solution labels or training-time search-space pruning. Specifically, MiLoop fuses current embeddings with historical memory before the attention layers and applies adaptive gated updates afterward. The updated representations support both current decisions and stepwise reuse. Extensive experiments across four COPs demonstrate that MiLoop consistently produces high-quality solutions on instances ranging from 100 to 10 million nodes, highlighting its strong generalization ability.

</details>


### [831] [Artifact Annotations Partially Substitute for Per-User Calibration: SAFE-EDA and a Normalization-Controlled Evaluation of Wrist-EDA Affect Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01692)
*Haochen Chai,Xinbi Luo,Zining Liu,Fangfang Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文考察手腕皮肤电活动（EDA）情感识别中归一化统计量来源对预训练收益的影响，发现用被试自身记录计算统计量会大幅削弱甚至消除预训练的收益，且多数已发表WESAD研究未报告这一选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手腕EDA信号幅度存在显著个体差异，情感识别模型通常需归一化输入，但此类模型在留出被试上测试时，归一化统计量的来源往往未被报告；若统计量来自留出被试自身记录，模型便获得了设备首次佩戴时不具备的信息，从而可能高估预训练的实际收益。

Method: 采用紧凑卷积网络SAFE-EDA，先在43名被试的专家伪迹标注上预训练，再在WESAD数据集（15名被试，留一被试交叉验证）上与从零训练的同一网络对比；交叉设置两种归一化统计量来源（仅训练被试 vs. 留出用户完整记录）与四种窗口跳步，并在第二个数据集（26名被试）上验证，共13种配置；同时比较伪迹监督预训练与自监督预训练，并统计文献中归一化来源的报告情况。

Result: 统计量仅来自训练被试时，预训练使macro-F1提升0.078至0.227；统计量来自留出用户完整记录时，增益降至0.020至0.050且不再显著。伪迹监督预训练远优于同批记录上的自监督预训练（0.078 vs. 0.008）。13种配置中预训练网络在12种更优；但在第二个数据集上，按用户归一化反而增大增益，说明该交互作用依赖于数据。50篇已发表WESAD研究中仅5篇说明归一化所用数据。

Conclusion: 归一化统计量的来源会显著影响预训练收益的测量结果，报告的增益可能主要反映校准后性能而非首次使用性能；因此研究者必须明确报告归一化所用数据，以区分首次使用性能与校准后性能。

Abstract: Wrist electrodermal activity (EDA) differs in amplitude from one person to the next, so affect-recognition models normalize their input before classification. Studies that test such models on held-out subjects seldom report where the normalization statistics come from, yet statistics computed from the held-out subject's own recording give the model information that a device does not have when it is first worn. We asked how this choice alters the measured benefit of pretraining. A compact convolutional network, SAFE-EDA, was pretrained on expert artifact annotations from 43 subjects and compared with the same network trained from scratch on the Wearable Stress and Affect Detection (WESAD) dataset (15 subjects, leave-one-subject-out), with two normalization sources crossed with four window hops. When the statistics came only from training subjects, pretraining raised macro-F1 by 0.078 to 0.227; when they came from the held-out user's full recording, the gain fell to between 0.020 and 0.050 and was no longer significant. Artifact supervision was far more useful than self-supervised pretraining on the same recordings (0.078 versus 0.008). Across 13 configurations in two datasets, the pretrained network was better in 12, but on the second dataset (26 subjects) per-user normalization increased the gain instead of reducing it, so the interaction depends on the data. Only five of 50 published WESAD studies state which data were used for normalization. Reporting this choice is necessary to separate first-use performance from performance after calibration.

</details>


### [832] [Learning PDE Dynamics between Submanifolds Using Green's Observation Operators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01697)
*Jan Tauberschmidt,Jephte Abijuru,Samuel Okon,Naukshatro Bose,Sophie Fellenz,Marius Kloft,Jonas Latz,Sebastian Josef Vollmer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出Green's Observation Operator (GObO)，将固定环境介质一次性映射为线性PDE在源与观测子流形上的Green核，新源仅需一次低维积分即可获得响应，无需网络评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多物理系统的驱动与观测仅发生在更大空间域的低维子流形上，动力学由占据该域的固定环境介质决定（如红外相机成像的激光加热部件、传感平面测得的地面排放）。全域求解器对每个新源都要计算整个体积，而实际只需观测子流形；黑箱代理模型也未利用环境介质保持不变这一结构。

Method: 构建Green's Observation Operator：将环境介质一次性映射为线性PDE的Green核，并将其限制在源与观测子流形上。新源响应通过低维积分计算，不进行网络评估。利用核的指数性质导出精确的有限流式状态，内存与时间视界无关；证明该状态的稳定性并给出受限热核的逼近率。在三维热传导与对流-扩散问题上验证，涵盖源与观测几何同位与异位两种情形。

Result: 在静态源上训练的GObO可零样本预测运动源的响应，误差比黑箱代理低4--8倍，单次条件化后每次查询仅1.4 ms。同一核可跨分辨率迁移，并在无需重训练的情况下支持对轻微非线性的修正，包括辐射损失与温度相关电导率，代价是分布内精度有所下降。

Conclusion: GObO通过将固定环境介质预计算为受限于源/观测子流形的Green核，实现了高效、可迁移且支持零样本外推的物理系统响应预测，并具备对轻度非线性扩展的潜力。

Abstract: Many physical systems are driven and observed only on lower-dimensional submanifolds of a larger spatial domain, while their dynamics are governed by the ambient medium occupying that domain. Examples include laser-heated parts imaged by an infrared camera, and ground-level emissions measured on a sensor plane. Full-domain solvers, however, compute the entire volume for every new source although only the observation submanifold is needed, and black-box surrogates do not exploit that the ambient medium remains fixed. We introduce the \emph{Green's Observation Operator (GObO)}, which maps the ambient medium once to the Green's kernel of a linear PDE restricted to the source and observation submanifolds. New sources then cost one lower-dimensional integral and no network evaluation. Exponential rates in the kernel yield an exact finite streaming state with horizon-independent memory; we prove its stability and an approximation rate for the restricted heat kernel. On three-dimensional heat conduction and advection--diffusion with collocated and distinct source and observation geometries, GObO trained on static sources predicts responses to moving sources zero-shot with 4--8$\times$ lower error than black-box surrogates, at 1.4\,ms per query after a single conditioning pass. The same kernel transfers across resolutions and admits corrections for mild nonlinearities, including radiative losses and temperature-dependent conductivity, without retraining, at the cost of lower in-distribution accuracy.

</details>


### [833] [In-context Learning of Single-index Targets: Comparing Kernel and Feature Learners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01712)
*Haotian Gu,Yizhou Xu,Lenka Zdeborová*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文用复本方法比较两种单层注意力架构（核学习器与特征学习器）在单指标任务上的记忆与泛化误差，给出与数值实验吻合的理论预测及相图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有上下文学习（ICL）理论多聚焦线性目标函数，非线性情形下架构选择如何与数据交互尚不清楚，需要理论刻画。

Method: 针对同一族单指标任务，对比两种单层注意力架构：核学习器（固定非线性特征映射+线性注意力）与特征学习器（对原始输入做注意力+可学习非线性读出）；用复本方法推导记忆与泛化误差预测，保留预训练规模、任务池多样性及训练/推理上下文长度的影响。

Result: 理论预测在广泛区间内与数值实验高度吻合；得到刻画两种架构优劣随预训练数据量、任务多样性和上下文长度变化的相图，并发现两者在上下文长度缩放关系上存在质的差异。

Conclusion: 架构选择与数据集（预训练规模、任务多样性、上下文长度）的交互共同决定非线性ICL表现，为理解非线性ICL提供了理论依据。

Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) enables a pretrained model to infer a task from demonstrations without updating its parameters. While much of the existing theory focuses on linear target functions, in this paper we study nonlinear cases by comparing two one-layer attention architectures on the same family of single-index tasks. A kernel learner first maps inputs through a fixed nonlinear feature map and then applies linear attention, whereas a feature learner applies attention to the original input, followed by a learned nonlinear readout. We derive predictions for their memorization and generalization errors using the replica method, retaining the effects of pretraining size, task-pool diversity, and training and inference context lengths. The resulting predictions closely match numerical experiments across a broad range of regimes. Our analysis yields phase diagrams that characterize when each architecture is advantageous as the amount of pretraining data, task diversity, and context lengths vary. We further identify qualitatively different context-length scalings for the two learners. Together, these results clarify how architectural choices interact with the dataset and govern nonlinear in-context learning.

</details>


### [834] [Anomaly Detection and Localization for the Pantograph-Catenary System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01721)
*Francesco Vitale,Hangli Ge,Francesco Flammini*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一个将受电弓-接触网系统（PCS）高度/之字形测量与路线名义GPS坐标对齐进行定位，并采用集体异常检测评估PCS健康状态的新框架，并在意大利铁路真实工业数据集上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于视频监控与卷积神经网络的工业方案虽能追踪PCS接触线高度与之字形，但未考虑列车所在的地理位置，导致监测数据缺乏空间定位信息，难以准确评估PCS健康状态。

Method: 框架包含两部分：1）通过与参考路线的名义GPS坐标对齐，对PCS高度/之字形进行定位；2）采用集体异常检测方法评估PCS健康状态。基于某铁路运输公司提供的真实工业数据集（涵盖意大利多条铁路路线的多次列车行程）进行案例验证。

Result: 在基于真实工业数据集的案例研究中，对该方法的定位与检测性能进行了应用与评估。

Conclusion: 该框架将PCS监测数据与地理定位相结合，并引入集体异常检测，为PCS健康状态评估提供了新思路，并在真实铁路数据上验证了其定位与检测性能。

Abstract: Monitoring the Pantograph-Catenary System (PCS) provides insight into the health conditions of the pantograph and the railway infrastructure. Recent industrial solutions trace the pantograph's contact wire height and stagger (PCS height/stagger) using video monitoring through convolutional neural networks. However, these solutions do not account for the train route's geographic location. Therefore, in this paper we propose a novel framework for 1) localization of the PCS height/stagger by alignment with the nominal GPS coordinates of the reference route, and 2) collective anomaly detection to evaluate the health conditions of the PCS. We apply and assess the localization and detection performance of the methodology to a case-study based on a real-world industrial dataset provided by a railway transportation company, which includes the PCS height/stagger of several train journeys across Italian railway routes.

</details>


### [835] [RelICL: Training-free Relational Learning with Tabular Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01725)
*Simon Forbat,Rainer Gemulla*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出关系学习中深度特征合成（DFS）存在特征爆炸和交互盲区两个问题，提出RelICL方法，通过在图模式上逐步传播与融合信息来缓解这两个问题，并在RelBench上取得了与最强DFS方法相当的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格基础模型在单表任务上无需训练即可达到最优性能，近期工作表明它们也适用于关系学习，方法是通过深度特征合成将关系模式展平为单表。该思路的优点在于可以直接受益于底层表格基础模型的改进或定制。但DFS存在两个关键问题：一是特征爆炸，即随着模式复杂度提高，DFS特征数量快速增长，限制了可扩展性与性能；二是交互盲区，即按列聚合无法考虑特征之间的交互，从而限制性能。

Method: 作者提出并探索了名为RelICL的替代方法，在保留DFS优势的同时缓解上述两个问题。其核心思想是：沿模式图逐步传播并融合信息，并且使用最终用于预测的同一个表格基础模型来完成这一信息传播与融合过程。

Result: 在基于RelBench任务的实验研究中，RelICL与最强的深度特征合成方法表现相当。

Conclusion: RelICL为关系学习提供了一种可行替代方案，保留了DFS的可受益特性并缓解了特征爆炸与交互盲区问题，性能与最强DFS方法持平。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models achieve state-of-the-art performance on single-table tasks without any training. Recent work suggests that they are also well-suited for relational learning via deep feature synthesis (DFS), which flattens a relational schema into a single table by adding aggregates of the other tables' columns as features. This approach is appealing because it directly benefits from improvements to or customization of the underlying tabular foundation model. In this paper, we identify two key problems with DFS: feature explosion and interaction blindness. The first problem arises because the number of DFS features grows quickly as the schema becomes more complex, limiting scalability and performance. The second problem arises because column-wise aggregates do not account for feature interactions, limiting performance. We propose and explore an alternative method termed RelICL, which keeps the benefits of DFS but alleviates these two problems. At its heart, RelICL propagates and fuses information step by step through the schema graph, using the same tabular foundation model that is eventually used for prediction to do so. In our experimental study using RelBench tasks, RelICL was on par with the strongest approach based on deep feature synthesis.

</details>


### [836] [Removing spurious minima for planar features by skip connections](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01728)
*Jakob Paul Zimmermann,Moritz Grillo,Andrei Balakin,Georg Loho*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了无偏置浅层ReLU网络在高斯总体损失下的损失景观。核心发现是：加入可学习的线性跳跃连接（skip）在过参数化条件下可消除全部虚假局部极小；而无skip时，即使无限加宽，虚假极小仍可持续存在。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 损失景观结构对解释神经网络训练至关重要，但即使在简单模型中其结构也仅被部分理解。本文借助teacher-student框架下的高斯总体损失，为研究特征学习与过参数化等核心问题提供简化模型。

Method: 研究无偏置浅层ReLU网络的高斯总体损失；采用teacher-student设定，教师网络具正输出权重与平面特征；在有无可学习线性skip两种情形下，分析学生网络局部极小与临界点结构，并考察学生宽度、特征方向数与教师神经元数的关系。

Result: 1）含可学习skip且学生网络宽度不小于教师时，所有非负输出权重对应的虚假局部极小被消除；2）无skip时，构造输入维度为2、仅3个隐神经元的固定教师，其虚假极小在学生宽度≥3的任意宽度下均持续存在；3）正输出权重学生网络总学到教师特征张成的子空间，局部极小处学生特征落在教师特征张成空间内；4）二维ReLU网络中，即便高度过参数化，有效宽度受教师宽度控制，任意正输出权重临界点的不同学生特征方向数至多为教师神经元数的两倍；5）良性结果可迁移到任意指定半径参数球上的经验极小，所需采样精度依赖该半径。

Conclusion: 可学习线性skip能消除在任意过参数化下仍持续的虚假极小；过参数化并不必然带来良性景观，学生有效宽度受教师宽度约束；良性性质可在限定半径的参数球上以相应采样精度迁移到经验损失。

Abstract: Understanding loss landscapes is central to explaining neural-network training, yet their structure remains only partially understood even in simple models. We study the Gaussian population loss of shallow, bias-free ReLU networks in the teacher--student setting. This provides a simple model for studying essential aspects such as feature learning and overparameterization. For teacher networks with positive output weights and planar features, we show that including a learned linear skip removes all spurious local minima with non-negative student output weights once the student network is at least as wide as the teacher network. In contrast, without the skip, we construct a fixed teacher network with positive output weights and only three hidden neurons in input dimension two whose spurious local minima persist at every student width at least three. Thus, a learned linear skip can remove spurious minima that persist under arbitrary overparameterization. Furthermore, we show that a positive output weight student network always learns the subspace spanned by the teacher features: student features at local minima with non-negative student output weights lie in the span of the teacher features. For ReLU networks in two dimensions, even heavily overparameterized student networks have effective width controlled by the teacher width: every critical point with positive student output weights has at most twice as many distinct student feature directions as teacher neurons. Finally, we transfer the benignity result to empirical minima over parameter balls of any prescribed radius, with the required sampling accuracy depending on that radius.

</details>


### [837] [Function-Structured Reinforcement Learning with Executable Verifiers for Mathematical Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01729)
*Zihan Liu,Xurong Xie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FSG-RL框架，将子问题图与Python实现通过多验证器反馈连接，用GRPO优化策略，在数学推理基准上将最终答案准确率从43.25%提升至67.50%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 算法数学推理需要可靠的分解、计算与聚合，但仅用最终答案的奖励对中间错误指导有限，且代码成功执行并不等于数学正确。因此需要能对中间步骤提供细粒度反馈、并以验证器判定数学正确性的强化学习框架。

Method: FSG-RL将子问题图与Python实现及多验证器反馈相连接。策略先通过SFT学习从函数图生成代码，再用GRPO结合答案门控奖励与片段级信用分配进行优化，并支持教师监督与结构化记忆。基准由GSM8K、MathQA、MATH、Omni-MATH整理，公开函数图配私有验证规格，统一评测协议。

Result: 相比SFT，GRPO将最终答案准确率从43.25%提升到67.50%，完整解成功从32.25%提升到52.25%；在教师监督下继续RL可获额外增益，且收益不仅限于生成格式正确的代码。

Conclusion: 结果支持以验证器引导的强化学习用于数学推理，表明结构化图与多验证器反馈能有效提升分解、计算与聚合的可靠性。

Abstract: Algorithmic mathematical reasoning requires reliable decomposition, computation, and aggregation. Final-answer rewards provide limited guidance on intermediate errors, while successful execution does not guarantee mathematical correctness. This work proposes Function-Structured Graph Reinforcement Learning (FSG-RL), connecting subproblem graphs and Python implementations with multi-verifier feedback. The policy first learns to generate code from function graphs through supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) then optimizes the policy using answer-gated rewards and span-level credit assignment. The framework also supports teacher supervision and structured memory. A benchmark curated from Grade School Math 8K (GSM8K), MathQA, MATH, and Omni-MATH pairs public function graphs with private verification specifications. Under a unified evaluation protocol, GRPO improves final-answer accuracy from 43.25% to 67.50% and full solution success from 32.25% to 52.25% over SFT. Continued reinforcement learning (RL) with teacher supervision yields additional gains. The gains extend beyond producing correctly formatted code, supporting verifier-guided reinforcement learning for mathematical reasoning. Code is available at https://github.com/ZihanLiummyycc/FSG-RL.

</details>


### [838] [Fixed-point neural samplers on discrete spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01739)
*Jiajun He,Denis Blessing,Mouyang Cheng,Yuanqi Du,Carles Domingo-Enrich*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出离散 Gibbs 迭代神经采样器（DGINS），一种基于不动点训练的神经采样框架，可缓解模式坍缩、提升可扩展性，并支持条件摊销采样与合金相图估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从离散、未归一化分布中采样且无法访问数据是一类困难问题。现有离散神经采样器存在三方面不足：(1) 易于发生模式坍缩；(2) 以不动点迭代训练时缺乏收敛保证；(3) 通常绑定于特定参考过程（如掩码扩散或均匀扩散）。本文旨在同时解决这些局限。

Method: 提出 Discrete Gibbs Iterative Neural Sampler（DGINS）：一个不动点（fixed-point）神经采样器，仅依赖密度评估进行训练。框架建立在掩码扩散（masked diffusion）之上，并可推广至成对分布之间的传输（transport between pairs of distributions）。

Result: 实验表明：方法在高维系统上具有良好的可扩展性；支持跨不同条件的摊销采样（amortized sampling）；能够准确估计合金相图；并在实践中显著减少模式坍缩。同时实现了高效、可扩展的学习。

Conclusion: DGINS 通过不动点范式与掩码扩散的结合，缓解了离散神经采样器的模式坍缩问题，并拓展到分布间传输任务，在高效学习、可扩展性、条件摊销采样及相图估计等场景中展现了有效性。

Abstract: Sampling from discrete, unnormalized distributions without access to data is a challenging problem. Neural samplers offer a promising approach by training generative models from density evaluations directly. Despite recent progress, existing discrete neural samplers are prone to mode collapse, come without convergence guarantees when trained via fixed-point iterations, and are often tied to a specific reference process such as masked or uniform diffusion. In this work, we introduce Discrete Gibbs Iterative Neural Sampler, a fixed-point neural sampler that addresses these limitations, enabling efficient, scalable learning, substantially reducing mode collapse in practice. Our framework builds on masked diffusion and also extends to transport between pairs of distributions. We demonstrate that the resulting method scales effectively to high-dimensional systems, supports amortized sampling across different conditions, and enables accurate estimation of alloy phase diagrams.

</details>


### [839] [Evidence-Gated Research: Statistically Controlled Model Adoption in Adaptive Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01751)
*Yifan Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 Evidence-Gated Research (EGR)：在"移动现任"的自适应模型搜索中引入统计采纳层，通过证据门控与在线控制器控制全环境采纳目标的 FDR，强调模型替换是自适应开发中独立的统计控制点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应模型搜索具有路径依赖性：一旦某候选被采纳为新现任，它就成为后续候选生成的参照基准。因此一个缺乏统计支持的替换会改变尚未被提出的假设，使错误沿路径传播。现有做法未将"模型替换"本身作为独立的统计控制点来处理。

Method: EGR 作为移动现任搜索的统计采纳层：在决策证据揭示前冻结每个挑战者；在预声明环境集合上构建 anytime-valid 证据；将证据可预测地路由到未解决组件；组合出持续的候选 e-value；并将该 e-value 交给在线控制器进行采纳决策。理论分析给出显式条件有效性（conditional validity）与可预测性（predictability）条件下 FDR 控制的保证。

Result: 在 5,000 条轨迹的闭环基准中，仅开发集的 e-LOND 持续 FDR 为 0.621，而受审计的 EGR 变体在该有限运行中未观察到持续的误采纳路径。在 600 对挑战者—现任的匹配回放中，Stagewise EGR 在保持固定 anytime 替代交叉决策的同时，在代表性阈值上减少 56.1% 的决策证据量。三环境公开数据研究与 40,000 样本的受控神经基准复现了证据效率模式。

Conclusion: 结果表明，即使在早期采纳会改变后续挑战者的情况下，该过程仍能控制所声明全环境采纳目标的 FDR。模型替换应被视为自适应模型开发中一个独立的统计控制点。

Abstract: Adaptive model search is path dependent: once a challenger is adopted, it becomes the reference from which later candidates are generated. A statistically unsupported replacement can therefore alter hypotheses that have not yet been proposed. We introduce Evidence-Gated Research (EGR), a statistical adoption layer for moving-incumbent search. EGR freezes each challenger before decision evidence is revealed, builds anytime-valid evidence across a predeclared set of environments, routes evidence predictably toward unresolved components, composes a persistent candidate e-value, and passes that e-value to an online controller. Under explicit conditional-validity and predictability conditions, the resulting procedure controls false discovery rate for the declared all-environment adoption target even though earlier adoptions change later challengers. In a 5,000-trajectory closed-loop benchmark, development-only e-LOND attains persistent FDR 0.621, whereas no persistent false-adoption path is observed for the audited EGR variants in that finite run. In matched replay over 600 challenger--incumbent pairs, Stagewise EGR preserves fixed-anytime alternative crossing decisions while using 56.1% less decision evidence at the representative threshold. A three-environment public-data study and a 40,000-sample controlled neural benchmark reproduce the evidence-efficiency pattern. These results identify model replacement as a distinct statistical control point in adaptive model development.

</details>


### [840] [Physics-Refined Spatiotemporal Forecasting on Open-Boundary Hydrologic Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01765)
*Haoyang Jiang,Zhengui Wang,Shenghan Gao,Y. Joseph Zhang,Xingquan Zhu,Yi He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对开放边界水文图上的时空预测不稳定问题，提出由"幽灵节点代理"与两个物理精炼器组成的计算框架，在真实水文图上取得更高精度与长时程稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放边界系统中，预测域与未观测外部存在通量交换，边界节点受上游入流、潮汐信号等外部强迫驱动，而该信息在预测时刻通常不可得。信息缺失会在自回归预测中累积误差，导致长时程性能显著下降。

Method: 框架包含两部分：（1）从边界节点与内部节点学习"幽灵节点代理"（ghost node proxies），以近似未观测的外部输入，补偿边界强迫；（2）引入两个物理精炼器控制误差累积——其一通过将幽灵代理与其两跳邻居（边界节点及其直接内部节点）对齐来施加局部一致性约束；其二借助物理引导的图神经算子校正模型预测，抑制长时程数值漂移，提升全局稳定性。

Result: 在两个真实水文图上开展实证评估，对比实验表明该方案在学习型与物理信息型基线模型之上均获得更高的预测精度与更优的长时程稳定性。

Conclusion: 通过显式建模缺失的边界强迫并施加局部一致性与全局稳定性约束，可有效缓解开放边界水文图自回归预测中的误差放大与数值漂移问题。

Abstract: Spatiotemporal forecasting on hydrologic graphs is especially prone to instability in open-boundary systems, where the forecast domain exchanges fluxes with an unobserved exterior. In such systems, boundary nodes receive external forcing, e.g., upstream inflows in rivers or tidal signals in coastal regions, that is typically unavailable at prediction time. The absence of this information can compound errors as forecasts unfold in an autoregressive fashion, leading to inferior long-horizon performance. This paper dissects this instability issue by exploring two questions. 1) What boundary forcing enters the forecast domain when information beyond the boundary is missing? 2) How should this forcing propagate through the domain without incurring error amplification under autoregressive rollout?
  To address both, we propose a new computing framework comprising two key components. First, to compensate for the boundary forcing, our framework learns ghost node proxies from the boundary and interior nodes, striving to approximate unobserved external inputs. Second, to control error accumulation from these learned proxies, we leverage two physics refiners. In particular, one refiner enforces local consistency by aligning ghost proxies with their two-hop neighbors (i.e., boundary nodes and their immediate interiors). The other refiner enhances global stability by correcting the model forecasts through a physics-guided graph neural operator, reducing long-horizon numerical drift. Two real-world hydrologic graphs are employed for empirical evaluation. Comparative results show that our proposal enjoys higher prediction accuracy and long-horizon stability over both learning-based and physics-informed model competitors.

</details>


### [841] [iADD: Improving Alignment and Diversity in Diffusion Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01789)
*Ashok Prasad Neupane,Saugat Adhikari,Pramish Paudel,Ajad Chhatkuli,Danda Pani Paudel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对扩散模型强化学习后训练中奖励优化牺牲多样性与质量的问题，从理论与方法两方面改进，提出基于Feynman-Kac的增量训练方法，在三个任务上实现更优的对齐-多样性权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散模型强化学习后训练方法（如DDPO）在反向扩散过程上以奖励函数为目标进行优化，但这类奖励优化会以牺牲样本多样性和生成质量为代价。作者希望在对齐（奖励）与多样性之间取得更好的权衡，并纠正前人对更新时间步作用的错误结论。

Method: 1）理论分析：建立理论框架，数学上证明"仅后期时间步"（only-latter timestep）更新可能损害多样性，与前人结论相悖；2）方法设计：基于坚实的理论基础，提出增量Feynman-Kac训练（incremental Feynman-Kac training），以改进对齐-多样性权衡。

Result: 在三个不同任务上与相关扩散策略优化方法进行大量对比实验，并对每个组件提供充分消融实验，验证了在对齐和多样性两方面均有显著性能提升。

Conclusion: 本文通过理论分析与方法设计，证明了仅后期时间步更新对多样性可能有害，并提出增量Feynman-Kac训练方法，在多个任务上实现了当前最优的对齐-多样性权衡。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning based post training of diffusion models, such as Denoising Diffusion Policy Optimization (DDPO), optimizes a reverse diffusion process under a reward function. However, current approaches to reward optimizations do so at the cost of diversity and quality. In this paper, we provide better tradeoffs through careful theoretical considerations and method design. We analyze the theoretical framework and mathematically demonstrate that \emph{only-latter timestep} updates of diffusion model may be harmful for diversity contrary to the conclusions presented in a previous work. Additionally, we propose an incremental Feynman-Kac training based on strong theoretical foundations in order to achieve the best-yet alignment-diversity tradeoffs. We perform extensive experiments and compare our method against related diffusion policy optimization approaches in three different tasks and also provide strong ablations for each component, thus validating strong performance gains in both alignment and diversity.

</details>


### [842] [SkillEvoLean: Mutation-enhanced skill evolution for Lean provers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01799)
*Kuo Zhou,ZiXion Yang,Lu Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种"变异增强的技能自进化"框架，用于构建技能增强的Lean证明器，在不更新模型参数的前提下联合演化高层求解策略与参考知识，在MiniF2F、PutnamBench、IMO 2025、USAMO 2026上取得优于基线的证明成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 技能进化可在不更新参数的情况下提升LLM智能体，但在形式化定理证明中探索不足。现有技能进化方法面向自然语言推理，依赖对成功与失败轨迹的分析来增量修正策略；当所有采样轨迹均失败时，缺乏成功轨迹以推断有效更新方向。此外，现有方法主要关注根指令文件，忽视了数学概念与证明技巧等参考知识的演化。

Method: 提出变异增强的技能自进化框架，联合演化高层求解策略及其参考知识，采用渐进式更新与基于变异的更新。渐进式进化从成功和失败轨迹中提取局部改进；当无法生成完整证明时触发变异，采样数学概念以生成并选择新的技能候选，并以验证器反馈作为选择依据。

Result: 在相同骨干模型、轨迹采样预算和测试时计算下，使用GPT-5.5时，在MiniF2F、PutnamBench、IMO 2025、USAMO 2026上的证明成功率分别为100.0%、90.6%、4/6、4/6，优于基线方法。概念引导的变异在MiniF2F和PutnamBench上分别比随机文本引导的变异高出6.9和8.2个百分点，并在IMO 2025和USAMO 2026上各多解出一题。

Conclusion: 该框架通过变异机制弥补了全失败场景下缺乏成功轨迹的问题，并将演化范围从根指令扩展到参考知识，有效提升了技能增强Lean证明器的证明能力，验证了概念引导变异相较于随机文本引导的显著优势。

Abstract: Skill evolution offers a promising way to improve large language model agents without updating their parameters, but its use in formal theorem proving remains underexplored. Existing methods mainly target natural-language reasoning, improving skills by analyzing successful and failed trajectories and incrementally revising solving strategies. Although the Lean verifier provides reliable execution feedback, when all sampled trajectories fail, existing skill evolution methods lack successful trajectories from which to infer effective update directions. Furthermore, these methods also focus mainly on the root instruction file, thus underexploring the evolution of reference knowledge including mathematical concepts and proving techniques. To address these limitations, we propose a mutation-enhanced skill self-evolution framework for building skill-augmented Lean provers. The framework jointly evolves a high-level solving policy and its reference knowledge through progressive and mutation-based updates. Progressive evolution derives local improvements from successful and failed trajectories, while mutation is triggered when no complete proof can be generated, sampling mathematical concepts to produce and select new skill candidates under verifier feedback. We evaluate our method on MiniF2F, PutnamBench, the 2025 International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO 2025), and the 2026 USA Mathematical Olympiad (USAMO 2026). Under the same backbone model, trajectorysampling budget, and test-time compute, our method achieves proof success rates of 100.0%, 90.6%, 4/6, and 4/6, respectively, with GPT-5.5, outperforming the baseline methods. Further analysis shows that concept-guided mutation outperforms random-text-guided mutation by 6.9 and 8.2 percentage points on MiniF2F and PutnamBench, respectively, while solving one additional problem on both IMO 2025 and USAMO 2026.

</details>


### [843] [Debias Anything: Fairness with Diversity without Supervision in Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01815)
*Théau d'Audiffret,Mariia Vladimirova,Jean-Yves Franceschi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种通用适配器方法，联合提升扩散模型生成的人口属性公平性与多样性，无需敏感属性标注。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型虽能生成高质量图像，却会复现并放大训练数据中的人口属性失衡。现有去偏方法多依赖分类器引导或显式文本条件，降低了适用性与输出多样性；而单纯促进多样性的方法又无法保证属性比例公平。因此需要一种能同时兼顾公平与多样性、且通用性强的方法。

Method: 提出将适配器连接到冻结的扩散模型，接入预训练的视觉-语言嵌入空间，从而在无需敏感属性标注的情况下施加公平与多样性引导。公平性方面，用成对文本提示定义属性方向，引导批次组成趋向特定比例；多样性方面，引入一个分数，度量由该表示推导出的语义估计之间的不一致程度。该形式化支持无条件与文本条件扩散模型，且不需要敏感属性的先验知识或数据。

Result: 实验证实，该方法在公平性水平相当的情况下，提升了生成质量与多样性得分。

Conclusion: 该方法可普遍适用于任意扩散模型与任意敏感属性，在无需敏感属性标注的前提下，实现公平性与多样性的联合优化。

Abstract: Although diffusion models produce high-quality images, they also reproduce and amplify demographic imbalances in their training data. Debiasing their generation process post-training w.r.t. some sensitive attribute usually relies on classifier guidance or explicit text extra-conditioning, but this reduces methods' applicability and output diversity. Conversely, methods promoting diversity alone do not ensure fair attribute representation. In this paper, we propose a method tackling fairness and diversity jointly that is generally applicable to any diffusion model and any sensitive attribute. To this end, an adapter connects the frozen diffusion model to a pretrained vision-language embedding space, enabling fairness and diversity guidance without sensitive-attribute annotations. For fairness, pairs of text prompts define attribute directions which guide batch composition towards specific proportions. For diversity, we introduce a score measuring disagreement between the semantic estimates derived from this representation. The formulation supports unconditional and text-conditional diffusion models, while requiring no prior knowledge or data of sensitive attribute. Experiments confirm that our method improves quality and diversity scores at comparable fairness levels.

</details>


### [844] [MECHVAR: Variance-Guided Mechanism Discrimination for Autonomous Machine Learning Experiment Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01819)
*Yifan Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 MECHVAR，一种用于有限库机制辨识的序列实验选择准则：通过最大化候选机制预测响应的后验加权方差来选下一探测，并给出其与 Box–Hill 后验加权成对 KL 准则的等价性、与期望信息增益 (EIG) 的局部联系，以及向量化高效实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基准性能提升往往是"机制模糊"的：复现改进本身并不能揭示其成因。因此需要一种能在有限候选机制库中判别机制、且可审计、计算开销低的序列实验选择方法。

Method: 将问题形式化为有限库机制辨识：给定后验加权的候选机制、可执行探测与有限实验预算，构成序列实验选择问题。MECHVAR 以最大化预测响应的后验加权方差作为采集分数进行下一探测选择。在共享高斯预测模型下，证明该分数与经典 Box–Hill 后验加权成对 KL 准则成正比，同时支持 O(KE) 向量化重打分并可按机制对进行加性审计；局部展开进一步说明当预测响应间隔较小时该分数与 EIG 相联系。

Result: 在 25 块压力审计中，MECHVAR 在若干中等误设情形下优于 confirmation-first 策略，但与 EIG 的主要对比在统计上仍未判定。在留出 Digits 循环中，归一化机制辨识 AUC 为：MECHVAR 0.8975、score-greedy 0.7825、EIG 0.9092。在 K=100、E=200 时，记录环境下单线程全库打分中位数：MECHVAR 为 10.36 微秒，六节点求积 EIG 为 57.69 毫秒。

Conclusion: 当共享预测尺度是可接受的近似时，MECHVAR 为有限库实验选择提供了一种轻量、可审计的采集规则，其辨识精度接近 EIG 而打分成本低数个数量级。

Abstract: Benchmark gains are often mechanism-ambiguous: reproducing an improvement does not by itself identify why it occurs. We study finite-library mechanism discrimination, where posterior-weighted candidate mechanisms, executable probes, and a limited experimental budget define a sequential experiment-selection problem. MECHVAR selects the next probe by maximizing the posterior-weighted variance of its predicted responses. Under a shared-Gaussian predictive model, this score is exactly proportional to the classical Box--Hill posterior-weighted pairwise-KL criterion, yet it admits O(KE) vectorized rescoring and a transparent additive audit over mechanism pairs. A local expansion further links the score to expected information gain (EIG) when predicted response separations are small. In a 25-block stress audit, MECHVAR outperforms confirmation-first in several moderate misspecification regimes, while its primary comparisons with EIG remain statistically unresolved. In a held-out Digits loop, normalized mechanism-identification AUC is 0.8975 for MECHVAR, 0.7825 for a score-greedy policy, and 0.9092 for EIG. At K = 100, E = 200, median single-thread full-library scoring is 10.36 microseconds for MECHVAR versus 57.69 ms for six-node quadrature EIG in the recorded environment. MECHVAR therefore provides a lightweight, auditable acquisition rule for finite-library experiment selection when a shared predictive scale is a defensible approximation.

</details>


### [845] [Scientific Discovery under Validation Congestion via Multi-Fidelity Pairwise Rankings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01827)
*Kevin Tirta Wijaya,Alston Lo,Michael Sun,Wojciech Matusik,Vahid Babaei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PRISMS框架，利用来自一个或多个专家（可跨不同专业水平）的成对排序信号进行候选科学设计筛选，避免依赖数据饥渴的回归模型，并通过基于Fisher信息准则的自适应升级查询策略，在迭代筛选和无约束优化任务中均优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代计算方法能大规模生成候选分子、材料等科学设计，但实验验证能力稀缺，形成"验证拥堵"。现有筛选方法多依赖预测绝对分数的回归模型，而训练此类模型需要大量实验数据，启动成本高。作者认为科学发现本质上是比较性的，成对排序信号更易获取，因此可替代绝对测量来驱动筛选。

Method: 提出PRISMS框架：从单个或多个专家（可跨经验规则、智能体工作流、人类科学家等不同保真度层级）采集成对排序，识别最有前景的候选；不依赖数据饥渴的回归器。当专家在保真度和成本上存在差异时，PRISMS基于Fisher信息准则，将成对查询从低保真度排序者逐步升级到高保真度排序者。

Result: 在固定药物发现库的迭代筛选中，PRISMS比仅用回归的主动学习少用约42%轮次达到50% top-10发现召回率，比无选择性升级的基于排序方法少用约15%轮次；在无预定义库约束的新设计优化中，PRISMS比贝叶斯优化基线获得约18.8%更高的超体积。

Conclusion: 以专家成对排序为核心的筛选范式可有效缓解实验验证拥堵，避免对大量绝对标签数据的依赖；结合基于Fisher信息准则的保真度升级机制，PRISMS在筛选召回效率和优化质量上均取得一致提升，为比较式科学设计发现提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Modern computational methods can now propose candidate molecules, materials, and other scientific designs at an unprecedented scale, creating a validation congestion where candidates are abundant, but experimental capacity to physically evaluate them remains scarce. Discovering novel scientific designs has therefore become increasingly dependent on curation: selecting a small set of promising designs for slow and costly experiments. Existing curation methods typically rely on data-driven regression models that predict absolute scores, but training these models requires substantial experimental data to begin with. Yet, useful curation signals do not have to take the form of absolute measurements, as scientific design discovery is often comparative in nature. Here, we propose that curation can instead be primarily driven by expert pairwise rankings, which are substantially easier to gather. The expertise can come from computational tools or human input of multiple levels of fidelity, ranging from empirical rules of thumb to agentic workflows and experienced scientists. We introduce PRISMS, a framework that uses pairwise rankings from one or more experts, potentially spanning multiple levels of expertise, to identify the most promising candidates without relying on data-hungry regressors. When experts differ in fidelity and cost, PRISMS escalates pairwise queries from lower- to higher-fidelity rankers based on a Fisher-information criterion. In iterative screening that selects designs from fixed drug discovery libraries, PRISMS achieves 50% top-10 discovery recall in ~42% fewer rounds than regression-only active learning, and in ~15% fewer rounds than the ranking-based method with no selective escalation. In optimization that generates new designs without restriction to a predefined library, PRISMS achieves ~18.8% higher hypervolume than the Bayesian optimization baseline.

</details>


### [846] [Pooling Helps, Learned Weighting Hurts In-Context: Decomposing Group Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01831)
*Michael Fore,James Mason Inder,Mrishika Nair,Praneetha Vaddamanu,Sharlina Keshava*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 通过推理时编辑注意力矩阵α，将组注意力(head)拆分为V/O投影与Q/K加权两条通路：均匀池化(V/O)在20个传感器网络配置中18个为正；学习到的Q/K加权对多变量(MV)有益或可忽略，但显著损害10个ICL配置中的8个；仅在首个block将α均匀化即可改善所有ICL配置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Chronos-2提出的组注意力在固定patch索引上对一组变量进行注意力计算，同时服务多变量(MV)与上下文学习(ICL)预测。既有工作仅将该跨变量注意力设计作为整体评估，未拆解机制中真正带来收益的部分，也未检验其在MV与ICL两种范式下的适用性差异。

Method: 在推理阶段直接编辑注意力矩阵α，将一个head的两条通路解耦：V/O通路（对组内变量做加权摘要并投影）与Q/K通路（决定加权权重）。通过将α替换为均匀权重（即去掉任何Q/K加权，仅保留V/O均匀池化），分别测量两条通路在MV与ICL配置下的独立贡献；进一步逐层隔离，考察在不同block对α做均匀化处理的效果。

Result: 均匀池化(V/O且无Q/K加权)在20个传感器网络配置中有18个为正收益。学习到的Q/K加权效果按组类型分化：对MV为正或可忽略，但显著降低10个传感器网络ICL配置中8个的性能，其中4个甚至差于单变量推理。逐层分析显示，仅对第一个block的α做均匀化即可改善所测试的全部ICL配置。

Conclusion: 组注意力的收益主要来自V/O的均匀池化而非Q/K学习加权；学习加权对MV并无一致必要，但在ICL下常为负向因素。因此，在ICL场景中可通过在首个block将α均匀化来消除该负向影响，为跨变量注意力机制的设计与取舍提供了细粒度证据。

Abstract: Group attention, introduced by the time series forecasting model Chronos-2, attends over the variates of a group at a fixed patch index and serves both multivariate (MV) and in-context learning (ICL) forecasting. Rather than evaluating this cross-variate attention design as a whole, we ask which part of the mechanism earns the benefit and probe its applicability to both MV and ICL regimes. By editing the attention matrix $α$ at inference we separate the two pathways a head comprises: V/O, which projects a weighted summary of the group, and Q/K, which decides the weights. Uniform pooling (V/O without any Q/K weighting) is positive on 18 of our 20 sensor-network configurations, while the learned weighting (Q/K) splits by group type: its contribution is positive or negligible for MV, but materially degrades 8 of the 10 sensor-network ICL configurations, leaving 4 of them worse than univariate inference. By isolating the impact of different layers, we find that uniforming $α$ in the first block alone improves every ICL configuration we test.

</details>


### [847] [Flowing Faster to Coordinate: One-Step Online Multi-Agent Flow Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01882)
*Zhuoran Li,Yunzhan Li,Xun Wang,Yihan Du,Longbo Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出OMAF框架，用单步Flow模型替代扩散策略的多步迭代采样，在在线MARL中兼顾表达力与训练效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线MARL策略需在表达复杂的多模态动作分布与高效训练/执行之间取得平衡。扩散类生成策略虽能忠实刻画复杂多模态行为，但迭代采样代价高，难以扩展到在线多智能体场景。

Method: OMAF采用基于Transformer的flow策略建模复杂协调行为；用近似路径得分代理（approximate path score surrogate）为同步的flow策略优化提供原理性路径；并设计联合优化方案，将softmax Q值估计与联合flow策略目标耦合，实现稳定且样本高效的协调策略学习。取消迭代采样。

Result: 在MPE和MAMuJoCo的10个标准任务上，OMAF持续取得更优性能，回报最高提升3.4倍，样本效率最高提升10.5倍。

Conclusion: OMAF是一种兼具表达力与计算效率的单步flow策略范式，验证了其在在线MARL中的有效性。

Abstract: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) provides a powerful framework for learning coordinated behaviors through interactions with the environment.
